Abstract: Snapshot Spectral Imaging (SSI) provides high-dimensional temporal-spatial-spectral observation to uncover intrinsic physical characteristics. However, its complex system and repetitive calibration requirements hinder edge applications. Here, we propose a compact, cost-effective, calibration-free SSI method, Aperture Diffraction Imaging Spectrometer (ADIS), which consists only of a diffractive lens with a binary mask and a Bayer-filtered sensor, requiring no additional physical footprint compared to standard RGB cameras. ADIS disperses and multiplexes wavelengths, mapping energy to distinct sensor locations, enabling full-resolution recovery from superpixel-level encodings. ADIS directly leverages theoretically computed PSFs to enable calibration-free spectral reconstruction, while tolerating lens-dependent variations across different optical configurations and bridging the gap between simulation and reality. To achieve SSI by solving a sparsely-constrained inverse problem, we introduce the Orthogonal Diffraction-Aware Unfolding Framework (ODAUF) with Voxel Shift Transformer (VST) for improved orthogonal diffraction perception. Integrating VST into ODAUF forms the efficient Orthogonal Diffraction-Aware Unfolding Voxel Shift Transformer (ODAUVST), delivering excellent recovery and reduced parameters. By elaborating on theory, systematic and comprehensive comparing, and demonstrating real SSI results, we validate the superiority of ADIS, achieving calibration-free full-resolution SSI within a commercial camera footprint.

</details>


### [79] [Background-Free Objectness Learning for Class-Agnostic Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29232)
*Dania Batool,Liliana Lo Presti,Marco La Cascia,Filippo Vella*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: B-FOR是一种无需背景监督的密集类无关检测框架，通过预测密集多尺度目标中心和尺度场来学习目标性，在PASCAL VOC、MS-COCO和Open Images上相比现有类无关基线提升超过+10 AR点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统目标检测器在封闭集监督下训练，将未标注区域隐式视为背景，这在不完全标注下引入"目标性偏差"（objectness bias）——视觉上有效但未标注的目标被用作负样本，使目标性依赖于标注类别体系而非通用目标结构。这一问题在类无关和开放世界检测中尤为严重。

Method: B-FOR将检测形式化为预测密集多尺度目标中心和尺度场，目标假设从局部空间结构中涌现。监督通过空间结构化的软目标仅限制在可靠的标注区域，避免前景-背景判别。此外引入位移感知尺度场（displacement-aware scale fields），将目标范围建模为学习所得目标性场的空间变化属性，以支持从涌现的局部极大值中解码。

Result: 在PASCAL VOC、MS-COCO和Open Images上的实验表明，该方法对未见类别和跨数据集目标分布具有强泛化能力，相比现有类无关基线在召回率上提升超过+10 AR点。

Conclusion: 消融实验证明，局部化目标性监督和位移感知尺度场对于在不完全标注下实现类无关定位都至关重要。

Abstract: Object detectors are typically trained under closed-set supervision, where unlabeled regions are implicitly treated as background. Under incomplete annotations, this assumption introduces objectness bias: visually valid but unlabeled objects are used as negatives, tying objectness to the annotated taxonomy rather than generic object structure. This limitation is particularly problematic for class-agnostic and open-world detection. This paper proposes Background-Free Objectness Learning (B-FOR), a dense class-agnostic detection framework that learns objectness without explicit background supervision on unlabeled regions. B-FOR formulates detection as the prediction of dense multi-scale object-center and scale fields, from which object hypotheses emerge as local spatial structures. Supervision is confined to reliable annotated regions through spatially structured soft targets, avoiding foreground-background discrimination. To support decoding from emergent local maxima, the paper further introduces displacement-aware scale fields that model object extent as a spatially varying property of the learned objectness field. Experiments on PASCAL VOC, MS-COCO, and Open Images demonstrate strong generalization to unseen categories and cross-dataset object distributions. B-FOR improves recall by more than +10 AR points over prior class-agnostic baselines. Ablation studies show that both localized objectness supervision and displacement-aware scale fields are critical for class-agnostic localization under incomplete annotations. Code available at: https://github.com/Daniaawan/B-FOR.

</details>


### [80] [Generalization over Memorization: Generalization-Aware Diffusion Adaptation for Single-Image Multi-View Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29233)
*Jie Li,Xingchen Zou,Yuxuan Liang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍了ACM Multimedia 2026 Grand Challenge中单图引导多视角图像合成任务的冠军方案GoM（Generalization over Memorization）。该方案在293支注册队伍中排名第一，针对仅40个训练场景的多视角生成任务，提出了场景分离验证、曝光匹配选择和定向扩散适配三大策略，并通过rank-32 LoRA适配4B整流流DiT模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者发现多视角图像合成任务中存在关键性的模型选择失败问题：共享的训练集和验证集场景使得模型的记忆行为被误认为是可迁移的视角控制能力。这一发现促使作者提出需要专门设计验证和训练策略来区分真正的泛化能力与记忆效应。

Method: GoM框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 场景分离验证（scene-disjoint validation），确保验证场景不参与训练，从而真实评估泛化能力；(2) 曝光匹配选择（exposure-matched selection），确保模型比较的公平性；(3) 定向扩散适配（targeted diffusion adaptation），采用rank-32 LoRA适配4B整流流DiT，结合优化器重启、后期检查点平均和VAE解码器微调等技术。

Result: 在293支注册队伍中排名第一，56支队伍在公共Phase-A排行榜上获得至少一次评分提交。超过300次离线实验和24次在线提交支持了该方案的有效性。

Conclusion: 验证设计（validation design）和训练轨迹控制（training-trajectory control）在小数据生成建模中与架构规模同等重要。该工作强调了在数据稀缺条件下，评估协议设计的严谨性和训练过程的精细控制对模型泛化性能的决定性影响。

Abstract: We present the winning solution to the ACM Multimedia 2026 Grand Challenge on Single-Image Guided Multi-Angle Image Synthesis. It ranks first among 293 registered teams; 56 teams obtained at least one scored submission on the public Phase-A leaderboard. With only 40 training scenes, the challenge requires 26 target views from one RGB model and one forward pass per view; it prohibits explicit geometry, external rendering, chained generation, candidate selection, and post-processing. We identify a critical model-selection failure: shared training and validation scenes make memorization appear as transferable view control. We therefore introduce GoM. Short for Generalization over Memorization, the framework combines scene-disjoint validation, exposure-matched selection, and targeted diffusion adaptation. Its synthesis model adapts a 4B rectified-flow DiT using rank-32 LoRA, optimizer restarts, late-checkpoint averaging, and VAE decoder tuning. More than 300 offline experiments and 24 online submissions show that validation design and training-trajectory control can matter as much as architecture scale in small-data generative modeling.

</details>


### [81] [Uncertainty-Aware Multimodal Anti-UAV Detection via Evidential Fusion and Conflict-Discounted Belief Aggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29235)
*Sharanda Suttorp,Seyed Sahand Mohammadi Ziabari,Ali Mohammed Mansour Alsahag*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出将EDTC扩展到RGB-热成像多模态反无人机感知，通过折扣信念融合（DBF）将模态间冲突转化为不确定性质量。实验表明多模态融合优于单模态（测试准确率0.670 vs 0.604/0.598），实时速度达38 FPS+，但DBF与无折扣平均在经验上无显著差异，因为基准数据集中模态间冲突趋近于零。这是一个结构性空结果，揭示了冲突感知融合的适用边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有反无人机多模态系统采用确定性RGB-热成像融合，无法建模预测不确定性，在传感器流退化（遮挡、快速运动、模态失效）时不可靠。EDL已用于单模态热成像感知（EDTC），但跨模态证据融合仍未被探索。

Method: 将EDTC扩展至RGB-热成像多模态感知，采用折扣信念融合（DBF）：先将模态间冲突转化为不确定性质量，再聚合各流意见；边界框通过选择更低不确定性模态来解析。

Result: 在Anti-UAV基准上，多模态融合一致优于任一单模态（测试准确率0.670 vs 0.604红外/0.598 RGB），实时速度≥38 FPS。融合不确定性校准良好（ECE 0.057），但作为定位失败检测器弱于空间方差（AUROC 0.626 vs 0.739）。DBF与无折扣平均经验上无差异，模态间冲突接近零。

Conclusion: DBF融合的折扣步骤在此基准上无效，原因在于基准的近乎普遍存在性编码和空洞的漏检编码共同抑制了模态间冲突。这一诊断界定冲突感知融合能提供可测量收益的范围。

Abstract: Anti-UAV perception systems must remain reliable when sensor streams degrade under occlusion, fast motion, or modality-specific failure. Existing multimodal anti-UAV systems fuse RGB and thermal streams deterministically, without modeling predictive uncertainty, and cannot express doubt when streams disagree. Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) produces calibrated per-class uncertainty in a single forward pass. EDTC already exploits this for thermal-only perception, yet cross-modal evidential fusion remains unaddressed.
  This paper extends EDTC to multimodal RGB-Thermal perception via Discounted Belief Fusion (DBF), which converts inter-modal conflict into uncertainty mass before aggregating stream opinions. Bounding boxes are resolved by selecting the lower-uncertainty modality. On the Anti-UAV benchmark, multimodal fusion consistently outperforms either single stream (test Acc 0.670 vs. 0.604 IR, 0.598 RGB) at real-time speed (at least 38 FPS). However, DBF is empirically indistinguishable from undiscounted averaging: near-zero inter-modal conflict on this presence-dominated benchmark leaves the discounting step inert. The fused uncertainty is well-calibrated (ECE 0.057) yet expectedly a weaker localization failure detector than spatial variance (AUROC 0.626 vs. 0.739). The null result is structural: the benchmark's near-universal presence and vacuous miss-encoding jointly suppress inter-modal conflict, a diagnosis that delimits where conflict-aware fusion provides measurable benefit.

</details>


### [82] [AGRICAM: A Track-Mounted Crop Pollination Monitoring Robot](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29237)
*Malika Nisal Ratnayake,Adel N. Toosi,James Cook,Romina Rader,Alan Dorin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一种名为AGRICAM的自主机器人系统，用于保护性栽培系统中大规模授粉监测。该系统在低成本轨道上自主运行，集成RGB相机、微气候传感器、GPS、RFID、运动传感器和4G网络，通过云端计算机视觉模型量化传粉者访花行为。在商业蓝莓农场80米长工业隧道中部署30小时，成功绘制授粉格局，确认了传粉者均匀分布，并揭示了时间与微气候对昆虫活动的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 昆虫授粉对全球粮食生产至关重要，但商业农场规模的传粉者监测仍是挑战。现有计算机视觉和深度学习技术虽能详细分析传粉者行为，但监测需在细节与空间覆盖、人力及技术资源之间权衡，缺乏兼顾大规模覆盖与自动化程度的高效监测方案。

Result: 在商业蓝莓农场的80米长工业授粉隧道中成功部署30小时，绘制了昆虫授粉格局。空间分析确认了隧道内传粉者均匀分布（符合农场管理预期），同时数据揭示昆虫活动随时间和微气候变化存在显著差异。

Conclusion: AGRICAM被证明是一种可扩展、自动化的作物授粉监测系统，能够支持数据驱动的决策以优化授粉管理，从而提高作物生产力和粮食安全。该系统实现了商业化规模下的自动化监测能力，弥补了现有技术在监测规模与精细度之间的鸿沟。

Abstract: Insect pollination is critical for global food production, yet monitoring pollinators at commercial farm scale remains a challenge. Recent advances in computer vision and deep learning have enabled detailed analysis of pollinator behaviour, but monitoring must trade-off detail against spatial coverage and human or technological resources. This paper presents the Automated Guided Robot for Insect and Crop Activity Monitoring (AGRICAM), a purpose-built robotic system designed to meet the requirements of large-scale pollination monitoring in protected cropping systems. AGRICAM operates autonomously on low-cost, easily installed track for movement along crop rows, without disrupting farm operations or insect behaviour. The platform integrates two RGB cameras, microclimate sensors, GPS and RFID modules, motion sensors, and 4G cellular network connectivity for data transmission. A web interface enables remote device configuration and scheduling. The system autonomously captures video and image data of insects' locations and local environmental conditions. These are transferred to the cloud and analysed using computer vision models to quantify pollinator visitation and spatio-temporal activity variation. We deployed the system on a commercial blueberry farm to demonstrate and test its capability. It successfully mapped insect pollination patterns across 80 m long industrial polytunnels over 30 hours. This data enabled spatial analyses of insect activity we used to confirm a uniform pollinator distribution within polytunnels, as desired by the farm management team. The data also highlighted variation of insect activity associated with time of day and microclimate. AGRICAM therefore has been shown to be a scalable, automated crop pollination monitor that can support data-driven decisions to enhance pollination management, thereby improving crop productivity and food security.

</details>


### [83] [DARD: Zero-Shot Degradation-Aware Retinex-Guided Diffusion for Low-Light Image Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29243)
*Wenjie Cai,Yuezhe Yang,Jianyang Xia,Xingbo Dong,Zhe Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DARD是一个零样本、退化感知的Retinex引导扩散框架，用于低光照图像增强（LLIE）。它通过测试时退化感知Retinex分解提取图像特定的物理先验，利用时间步自适应频率融合策略注入逆向扩散过程，并通过物理一致性和CLIP语义引导进行反向细化，在多个真实低光照基准上优于现有零样本方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散增强方法要么依赖成对监督，要么在零样本设置下缺乏可靠场景约束，导致结构不一致和颜色漂移。传统Retinex模型提供可解释的物理先验可作为可靠场景约束，但在真实场景混合退化下表现不佳。

Method: 1) 测试时退化感知Retinex分解：从退化输入中提取图像特定的物理先验，提供结构引导；2) 时间步自适应频率融合策略：将先验注入反向扩散，平衡结构锚定与细节生成；3) 引导反向细化过程：结合物理一致性和CLIP语义引导，抑制结构伪影和语义漂移。

Result: DARD在多个真实世界低光照基准上实现了强失真和感知性能，持续优于现有零样本基线。在下游语义分割任务中，DARD增强的图像相比AGLLDiff实现了28.10%的mIoU相对提升。

Conclusion: DARD通过将Retinex物理先验与扩散模型结合，在零样本低光照增强中实现了结构一致性和生成质量的平衡，并验证了其对下游任务（如语义分割）的实际价值。

Abstract: Existing diffusion-based enhancement methods provide strong generative capability for low-light image enhancement (LLIE), yet they either rely on paired supervision or lack reliable scene constraints in zero-shot settings, often leading to structural inconsistency and color drift. Motivated by conventional Retinex models, which offer physically interpretable priors that can serve as reliable scene constraints yet struggle with mixed degradations in real-world scenarios, we propose DARD, a zero-shot Degradation-Aware Retinex-guided Diffusion framework for LLIE. DARD first extracts image-specific physical priors from the degraded input through a test-time degradation-aware Retinex decomposition, thereby providing reliable structural guidance for zero-shot restoration. It then injects these priors into reverse diffusion through a timestep-adaptive frequency fusion strategy to balance structural anchoring and detail generation. Finally, a guided reverse refinement process with physical consistency and Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP)-based semantic guidance is introduced to suppress structural artifacts and semantic drift during sampling. Extensive experiments show that DARD achieves strong distortion and perceptual performance and consistently outperforms existing zero-shot baselines across multiple real-world low-light benchmarks. To further validate the practical utility of our method for downstream applications, we evaluated its impact on semantic segmentation. Experiments demonstrate that images enhanced by DARD achieve a 28.10% relative improvement in mIoU over AGLLDiff.

</details>


### [84] [QCell: Recombining and Aligning Cell Queries for Overlapping Instance Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29253)
*Yaroslav Prytula,Anton Popov,Dmytro Fishman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: QCell是一种基于查询的新型实例分割模型，用于处理显微镜图像中重叠细胞的去重叠分割。它通过实例重组模块在隐空间中分解和重组查询表示，并结合对比查询对齐目标，在ISBI2014等基准上超越现有方法（+2.2 AP, +2.7 AJI），并引入了新的类器官数据集基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 显微镜下重叠细胞的实例分割面临挑战，因为结构半透明导致重叠区域边界弱、视觉证据混合。现有方法依赖局部感兴趣区域或形状先验，缺乏跨重叠物体的全局推理能力，因此需要一种能在全局层面推理完整对象结构的方法。

Method: QCell包含两大核心组件：(i) 实例重组模块，在潜在空间中分解并重组查询表示，使模型能在重叠条件下推理完整对象结构；(ii) 对比查询对齐目标，结合判别性实例特征学习与重叠细胞查询的分离。此外还引入了一个新的类器官数据集基准。

Result: QCell在多个基准上优于最先进方法，在ISBI2014上取得+2.2 AP和+2.7 AJI的提升，代码已开源。

Conclusion: 基于查询的全局推理方法能有效解决重叠细胞分割中的弱边界和混合视觉证据问题，优于依赖局部ROI或形状先验的传统方法，为类器官等复杂显微镜场景提供更可靠的分割方案。

Abstract: Instance segmentation of overlapping cells in microscopy remains challenging due to semi-transparent structures that produce weak boundaries and mixed visual evidence in overlap regions. Existing methods address this through local regions of interest or shape priors but lack global reasoning across overlapping objects. We present QCell, a novel query-based model that de-overlaps cell instances in microscopy scenes. Our approach combines (i) an instance recombination module that decomposes and recombines query representations in latent space, enabling the model to reason about complete object structure under overlap, and (ii) a contrastive query alignment objective that combines distinctive instance feature learning and separation of overlapping cell queries. We additionally introduce a new Organoid dataset benchmark for overlapping cell segmentation. We show that QCell outperforms state-of-the-art methods across multiple benchmarks, achieving +2.2 AP and +2.7 AJI on ISBI2014. Code is available at https://github.com/SlavkoPrytula/QCell

</details>


### [85] [Learning to Ground Before Reading: Unified PCB Engineering Drawing Parsing with Compact Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29268)
*Jinghao Liu,Xingrun Liu,Gengchen Sun,Han Xiao,Xingyu Chen,Yuhui Deng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需检测器的紧凑型VLM（Localization-First），通过localization-first curriculum学习策略，直接在整页PCB工程图纸上完成区域定位、分类和内容解析，相比联合训练在严格定位F1上提升0.0955。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统PCB工程图解析依赖于先定位区域再裁剪给专用识别器，但一旦漏检区域则无法在下游恢复。现有方法面临"局部化丢失不可逆"的根本问题，需要一种直接从整页读取的解析方案。

Method: 训练一个紧凑型VLM直接读取整页图纸，输出区域类别、归一化边界框和文本/HTML内容序列。将边界框转换为坐标token进行监督。采用localization-first curriculum：先学习类别-框格式，再加入内容目标，并使用content-aware resampling处理稀疏标注问题。

Result: 在ED数据集的固定验证集上，Localization-First相比联合训练在严格定位F1上提升0.0955（配对图像bootstrap 95%区间[0.0350, 0.1572]）。G-Unified取得最低NED、最高cell F1和唯一非零的exact-match分数。

Conclusion: 本文提供了一个无需检测器的全页PCB图纸解析baseline（G-Unified），验证了localization-first curriculum的有效性，为工程图纸等复杂文档的端到端解析提供了新方向。

Abstract: PCB engineering drawings mix sparse graphics, dense tables, and text whose meaning depends on page position. Localizing the regions and sending crops to specialized recognizers are determined as the methods for most parsers, so missed regions cannot be recovered downstream. We train a compact VLM to read the full page and get a sequence of region classes, normalized boxes, and text or HTML content. Bounding boxes are converted to coordinate tokens for supervision. Inference uses no detector or crop parser. The joint target is difficult to optimize because class and box tokens are sparse relative to the much longer content sequences. Our localization-first curriculum learns the class-box format before adding content targets with content-aware resampling. On the fixed validation split of the Engineering Drawing Dataset (ED dataset), Localization-First improves strict localization F1 by 0.0955 over joint training (paired image-bootstrap 95% interval: [0.0350, 0.1572]). G-Unified has the lowest NED, highest cell F1, and only nonzero exact-match score. It provides a detector-free baseline for full-page PCB drawing parsing.

</details>


### [86] [LightFuse: Relightable Interactive Gaussian Scene Reconstruction via Multi-Scan Fusion and 2D Gaussian Ray Tracing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29269)
*Haonan Zhou,Gaoxiang Linghu,Youlin Jia,Hongyu Cui,Kewei Wei,Kaiyue Zhou,Bruce X. B. Yu,Gaoang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LightFuse 是一个基于 2D 高斯的框架，用于可重打光的交互式场景重建。它通过融合不同物体排列的观测、几何细化以及分阶段训练的可微单次光线追踪，实现了共享材质与逐状态环境光照的显式解耦，支持物体重排、材质编辑和重新打光，在合成场景上显著超越现有最强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可交互场景重建方法要么将光照烘焙进外观，要么仅对固定场景恢复材质和光照，导致编辑后的布局出现不一致的阴影和间接光照。需要一种方法在支持场景编辑的同时显式解耦材质与光照，实现物理正确的重打光。

Method: LightFuse 首先跨状态融合观测，重建共享背景和可移动物体；然后进行面向光线追踪的几何细化以获得更完整一致的表面；最后在细化后的几何上采用分阶段训练的可微单次光线追踪，将共享的金属-粗糙度材质与逐状态的环境光照分离。

Result: 在合成场景实验中，LightFuse 实现了最先进的重打光质量，平均比最强基线高出 +9.74 dB PSNR 和 +0.121 SSIM。

Abstract: Relightable interactive scene reconstruction aims to build an editable 3D model from scans of different object arrangements and render new layouts under novel illumination. Existing methods either bake lighting into appearance or recover material and illumination only for fixed scenes, leaving edited layouts with inconsistent shadows and indirect lighting. We present LightFuse, a 2D Gaussian framework that extends interactive scene reconstruction with explicit material-illumination decomposition and physically based relighting. LightFuse first fuses observations across states to reconstruct a shared background and movable objects. It then conducts ray-tracing-oriented geometry refinement to produce more complete and consistent surfaces. On the refined geometry, staged training with differentiable one-bounce ray tracing separates shared metallic--roughness material from state-specific environment lighting. The resulting scene supports object rearrangement, material editing, and relighting, while ray tracing recomputes appearance after each interaction. Experiments across synthetic scenes demonstrate state-of-the-art relighting quality, outperforming the strongest baseline by +9.74\,dB PSNR and +0.121 SSIM on average. Project page: https://zhn202.github.io/LightFuse/

</details>


### [87] [RAGDiffusion++: From Macro-Retrieval to Micro-Fidelity Alignment for Garment Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29280)
*Yuhan Li,Xianfeng Tan,Fangao Zeng,Wenxiang Shang,Pipei Huang,Hao Zhou,Zhiyu Jin,Wenjun Zhang,Bingbing Ni*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合强化学习（RL）和对抗正则化的方法，解决服装图像生成中高频纹理细节丢失（High-Frequency Trajectory Collapse）和伪影利用（Artifact Hacking）的问题，从而实现工业级微观纹理真实感的服装资产生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前作RAGDiffusion解决了宏观结构幻觉问题，但微观纹理细节（如织物编织、复杂logo）仍无法生成。代码指出这是"高频轨迹坍缩"问题——监督微调（SFT）收敛到条件均值，导致高频纹理几乎不可采样。此外，直接使用RL后训练会引发"伪影利用"问题，模型通过生成欺骗性棋盘噪声来利用奖励模型的语义偏见。

Method: 提出三个关键要素：(i) 容量基础——构建27,725对高复杂度服装数据集（STGarment-Plus）并升级为双图像流FLUX架构；(ii) 感知奖励——训练属性感知奖励模型（Garment-RM），基于500K图像通过细粒度对比学习，人类偏好准确率达84.67%；(iii) 防伪影机制——提出对抗正则化GRPO（AR-GRPO）策略，在RL采样轨迹中集成动态判别器，惩罚伪影同时丰富真实高频细节。

Result: 奖励模型Garment-RM达到84.67%的人类偏好准确率；构建了27,725对高复杂度数据集和500K训练图像；AR-GRPO策略有效实现高频细节生成同时防止伪影利用。

Conclusion: RL能够从根本上重塑流模型的采样分布，在准确奖励引导下提升高保真轨迹的概率；对抗正则化可防止对奖励盲区的利用。三者结合是生成工业级纹理真实感服装的关键。

Abstract: Standard clothing asset generation---restoring forward-facing flat-lay garment images from diverse real-world contexts---holds immense commercial value yet demands both macroscopic topological accuracy and microscopic physical fidelity. Although our previous work RAGDiffusion effectively eradicated large-scale structural hallucinations via retrieval-augmented macro-constraints, achieving industrial-grade micro-texture realism remains an unsolved bottleneck. We formally identify this limitation as High-Frequency Trajectory Collapse: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) converges to the conditional mean of the training distribution, which is dominated by smooth, low-frequency textures, causing high-frequency patterns (e.g., fabric weaves, intricate logos) to become nearly un-sampleable. Naively applying Reinforcement Learning (RL) post-training further triggers Artifact Hacking, where models exploit semantic biases in generic reward models by generating deceptive checkerboard noise. Our key insight is that RL can fundamentally reshape the sampling distribution of flow models---elevating the probability of high-fidelity trajectories under accurate reward guidance---while adversarial regularization prevents exploitation of reward blind spots. Realizing this principle requires three prerequisites: (i)inherent capacity, established through a 27,725-pair high-complexity garment dataset (STGarment-Plus) and a Dual-Image-Stream FLUX architecture upgrade; (ii)perceptive reward, provided by a novel attribute-aware reward model (Garment-RM) trained on 500K images via fine-grained contrastive learning, achieving 84.67% human preference accuracy; and (iii)hacking prevention, enforced by our Adversarial-Regularized GRPO (AR-GRPO) strategy that integrates a dynamic discriminator into the RL sampling trajectory to penalize artifacts while enriching authentic high-frequency details.

</details>


### [88] [Elastic Token Compression for Pixel-Space Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29281)
*Eduard Zamfir,Christian Reisswig,Zongwei Wu,Yongqin Xian,Radu Timofte*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Region Token Interface (RTI)方法，通过基于Hilbert曲线的区域令牌化来减少像素空间扩散模型中的冗余计算。该方法利用自然图像中细节集中在少数区域的特性，将平坦区域的冗余令牌合并为区域令牌，在不损失质量的同时实现2.0-2.6倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然图像的细节集中在一小部分区域，但现有扩散模型对每个patch、每一层、每个时间步都分配完整令牌，造成大量计算浪费。像素空间模型尤为严重，因为没有自动编码器来先吸收低层冗余。现有方法各有缺陷：相似性合并导致组分散、潜在瓶颈丢弃空间位置信息、直接跳过则删除了本应总结的内容。

Method: RTI方法首先对预训练像素文本到图像Transformer进行探测，发现中间块令牌在图像平坦区域是冗余的。利用Hilbert空间填充曲线的特性（连续位置总是图像邻居），将二维区域分组问题转化为一维切分问题。在模型特征变化最大的位置进行切割，将每个连续区间池化为一个区域令牌。微调期间随机抽取区域数量，使单个检查点能服务于任意计算预算。

Result: RTI在匹配的计算预算下优于先前的缩减方法，在2.0倍速度下匹配密集生成质量，在2.6倍速度下仍保持接近质量。

Conclusion: 通过尊重内容形状的区域令牌化和随机预算训练策略，RTI有效利用了自然图像的冗余特性，在保持生成质量的同时显著提升扩散模型的推理效率。

Abstract: Natural images concentrate their detail in a small fraction of the frame, yet diffusion models spend a full token on every patch, in every layer and at every timestep. The waste is largest in pixel-space models, with no autoencoder to absorb low-level redundancy first. Probing a pretrained pixel text-to-image transformer, we find its middle-block tokens redundant wherever the image is flat. The redundancy occupies connected, content-shaped regions, and exploiting it requires tokens with the same geometry. Cutting a Hilbert ordering of the patches provides them. Consecutive positions are always image neighbours, so any contiguous run is a connected region whose size and shape follow the content, and grouping in two dimensions becomes a cut in one. Existing reductions each lose part of this. Similarity merging scatters its groups, latent bottlenecks discard position, and skipping deletes what it should summarize. We cut where the model's features change most and pool each run into one region token. Our Region Token Interface (\method{}) adapts a diffusion model to these tokens, with the region count drawn at random during fine-tuning so one checkpoint serves every budget. \method{} leads prior reduction methods at matched budgets, matches dense quality at $2.0\times$ the speed, and stays close at $2.6\times$. The code and models are open-sourced at https://eduardzamfir.github.io/rti

</details>


### [89] [3D-MRL: Nested Multimodal 3D Representations via Matryoshka Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29285)
*Márcus Lobo,Vitor Matias,Jeová Farias,Moacir Ponti*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出3D-MRL，一个基于Matryoshka表示学习的多模态3D预训练框架，通过在3D编码器上应用嵌套表示学习目标，使单一模型能够生成不同维度的3D表示，支持零样本和少样本识别及跨维度检索，无需重训练即可适应不同计算预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大规模多模态3D预训练方法生成固定维度的嵌入，导致不同计算预算需要训练和部署不同的模型，缺乏灵活性和效率。

Method: 将点云与冻结的CLIP图像和文本嵌入进行对齐，同时在多个嵌入维度上应用对比监督。Matryoshka目标仅应用于3D编码器，使单一模型能够产生不同维度的嵌套表示。

Result: 在Objaverse-LVIS、ModelNet40和ScanNet数据集上，零样本和少样本3D识别任务达到有竞争力的性能。在Objaverse-LVIS上，Top-1准确率从46.8%提升至50.9%。检索实验表明不同嵌入维度提供不同级别的语义和几何特异性。

Conclusion: 3D-MRL验证了Matryoshka表示学习在多模态3D预训练中的有效性，单个模型即可支持多种嵌入维度，在识别和检索任务上均表现出色。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models align point clouds with image and text embeddings, enabling zero-shot recognition, retrieval, and open-vocabulary understanding of 3D shapes. Existing multimodal 3D pre-training methods produce fixed-dimensional embeddings, requiring separate models for different computational budgets. We propose 3D Matryoshka Representation Learning (3D-MRL), a multimodal 3D pre-training framework based on Matryoshka Representation Learning. 3D-MRL learns nested 3D representations by aligning point clouds with frozen CLIP image and text embeddings while applying contrastive supervision across multiple embedding dimensions. The Matryoshka objective is applied only to the 3D encoder, allowing a single model to produce representations at different dimensionalities without retraining. Experiments on the Objaverse-LVIS, ModelNet40, and ScanNet datasets show that 3D-MRL achieves competitive performance on zero-shot and few-shot 3D recognition tasks. In addition, the learned representations support retrieval across different embedding dimensions within a single model. On Objaverse-LVIS, 3D-MRL improves Top-1 accuracy from 46.8% to 50.9%. Retrieval experiments further show that different embedding dimensions yield varying levels of semantic and geometric specificity.

</details>


### [90] [PERSIST: Persistent-State Discrimination for Shot Boundary Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29287)
*Tingyu Lin,Christian Stippel,Armin Dadras,Jakob Zenzmaier,Florian Kleber,Wolfgang Aigner,Robert Sablatnig*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PERSIST框架，将镜头边界检测(SBD)从局部视觉不连续检测重新定义为边界语义判别任务。其核心思想是：只有伴随视频潜在时间状态持续更新的局部变化才被视为镜头边界，而非短暂的波动。通过FiLM条件正弦表示网络学习连续潜在状态，结合结构化判别器整合局部变化、瞬时脉冲和回归趋势三个语义线索，在双速率时间骨干上生成可解释的逐帧信号。实验表明该方法能显著减少闪光、文本覆盖和存档材料等假阳性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统SBD方法将镜头边界视为局部视觉不连续的定位，但大量假阳性（如手持抖动、光照闪烁、运动模糊、遮挡和损坏档案材料）会产生同样明显的局部变化却不引入新镜头。因此需要区分真正的边界（伴随潜在时间状态持续更新）和短暂的瞬态干扰（回归周围趋势）。

Method: 提出PERSIST框架：(1) 使用FiLM条件正弦表示网络学习连续潜在状态；(2) 通过结构化判别器整合局部变化、瞬时脉冲和回归趋势三个语义线索；(3) 采用双速率时间骨干生成单一可解释的逐帧信号；(4) 将持久性标准训练进分类器，门控三元组提供每帧可读效果；(5) 仅使用ClipShots真实转换进行训练（对比方法使用85%合成转换的额外语料库）。

Result: 在2,727个视频的子类型诊断中，PERSIST相比相同训练的线索检测器减少了33-80%的闪光、文本覆盖和存档假阳性；在匹配真实转换召回率下，相比TransNetV2在诊断集上伪事件假阳性约减少一半，在ClipShots数据上假阳性减少约四分之一，同时保持召回率；在在线、广播、短视频和历史档案迁移评估中达到与最强公开检测器相当的性能。

Conclusion: 将SBD重新定义为边界语义判别（持久性测试）是有效的，PERSIST在更严格的训练条件下（仅使用真实转换，无合成数据）达到与依赖大量合成数据的最强检测器相当甚至更优的性能，同时提供可解释的逐帧决策机制。

Abstract: Shot boundary detection (SBD) is widely treated as the localisation of local visual discontinuities, yet many false positives such as hand-held shake, illumination flicker, motion blur, occlusion, and damaged archival material produce equally sharp local change without introducing a new shot. We reformulate SBD as boundary semantic discrimination: a frame is favoured as a boundary only when its local change evidence is accompanied by a persistent update of the video's latent temporal state, rather than a transient excursion that returns to the surrounding trend. This persistence test is operationalised with a continuous latent state from a FiLM-conditioned sinusoidal representation network and a structured discriminator that combines three semantic cues, local change, transient impulse, and return-to-trend, into a single interpretable per-frame signal over a dual-rate temporal backbone. The resulting framework, PERSIST, turns every decision into an inspectable one: the persistence criterion is trained into the classifier, its per-frame effect stays readable from the gate triple, and its learned latent state is measurably boundary-discriminative. On a 2,727-video per-subtype diagnostic it removes 33-80% of flash, text-overlay, and archival false positives relative to an identically trained cue detector, and at matched true-transition recall it roughly halves TransNetV2's pseudo-event false positives on that diagnostic and cuts its false positives on ClipShots footage by about a quarter, while preserving recall. It does so while reaching parity with the strongest public detector across online, broadcast, short-form, and historical-archive transfer evaluations, under markedly stricter training: it learns from ClipShots real transitions only, whereas the anchor draws on additional corpora whose transitions are 85% synthetic. Code is available at https://github.com/linty5/PERSIST.

</details>


### [91] [AOI-Net: Structural Face AOI-Guided Eye-Gaze Track Representation Learning for Autism Spectrum Disorder Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29289)
*Zhanpei Huang,Binbin Sun,Jialiang Chen,Yiou Wang,Taochen Chen,Yuzhu Ji,Yiqun Zhang,Yiu-Ming Cheung*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出AOI-Net，一种基于面部感兴趣区域(AOI)引导的眼动轨迹网络，用于自闭症谱系障碍(ASD)筛查。该网络联合建模短期时间动态与AOI层面的结构组织，通过门控机制自适应融合两种表征，并采用类别分布感知学习缓解临床数据中的类别不平衡问题。在包含8个刺激子集、1300余名参与者的临床眼动数据库上，AOI-Net一致优于现有最先进方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有眼动计算方法通常将注视行为表示为离散的注视轨迹和注视事件，导致表征主要由短期时间动态主导，限制了强调长期依赖的模型。同时，注视行为天然组织在语义上有意义的AOI上，但AOI间的注意力分配与转换关系很少被显式建模，这限制了对ASD筛查中结构性注视线索的利用。

Method: 提出结构化的面部AOI引导眼动轨迹网络(AOI-Net)：1)联合建模短期时间动态与AOI级结构组织两种表征；2)引入网络门控机制，根据两种表征对注视行为刻画的贡献自适应整合互补信息；3)采用类别分布感知学习，缓解ASD与典型发育(TD)参与者之间显著类别不平衡问题，促进偏斜类别分布下的判别性嵌入学习。

Result: 在一个独特的大规模临床眼动数据库（包含8个刺激子集、超过1300名参与者）上，AOI-Net一致性地优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: AOI-Net不仅实现了可解释的注视行为建模，还为现实医疗中可扩展的AI驱动的ASD筛查提供了实用基础，代码已开源。

Abstract: Eye-movement tracking has emerged as a promising non-invasive approach to Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) screening, with systematic differences in attentional allocation and revisit behaviors observed during socially interactive tasks. Existing computational methods typically characterize eye-movements using discrete gaze trajectories and fixation events, yielding representations dominated by short-range temporal dynamics and limiting models that primarily emphasize long-range dependencies. Meanwhile, gaze behavior is naturally organized across semantically meaningful Areas of Interest (AOIs), whose attention allocation and transitions provide important structural cues, yet their relationships are rarely modeled explicitly. To address these limitations, we propose a structural face AOI-guided Eye-Gaze Track Network (AOI-Net) that jointly models short-term temporal dynamics and AOI-level structural organization. A network gating mechanism adaptively integrates the complementary temporal and structural representations according to their contributions to gaze-behavior characterization. To mitigate the pronounced class imbalance commonly encountered between individuals with ASD and Typically Developing (TD) participants in clinical datasets, class-distribution-aware learning is further employed to facilitate discriminative embedding learning under skewed class distributions. Experiments on a unique and large-scale clinical eye-tracking database comprising eight stimulus subsets and more than 1,300 participants show that AOI-Net consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods. The proposed framework also enables interpretable gaze-behavior modeling and provides a practical basis for scalable AI-driven ASD screening in real-world healthcare. The code is available at https://github.com/Zhanpei-ai/CIM-AOI-Net/tree/main/Code

</details>


### [92] [Hyper3-CLIP: Hierarchy-Conditioned Hyperbolic Vision-Language Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29313)
*Matin Mahmood,Antonio Rueda-Toicen,Mohamed ElBassat,Seifeldin Elkerdany,Weixing Wang,Gerard de Melo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Hyper3-CLIP，一种层级条件化的双曲视觉-语言模型，结合全局、局部及全局-局部对比学习与查询条件化的视觉池化，无需推理时额外开销即可提升图文检索和多标签分类性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的CLIP类视觉语言模型使用欧几里得嵌入和全局池化，难以编码部分-整体和父-子等关系结构。双曲VLM虽能弥补这一缺陷，但其使用静态图像和区域特征；而基于查询条件化的方法又缺乏层级几何结构。这两条研究路线彼此分离，尚未统一。

Method: 本文构建轻量级查询层级（包含完整描述、句子片段、局部零件描述和提取短语），每个查询条件化视觉patch的池化过程，并支持图像-文本、整体-部分和父-子蕴含损失。查询条件化池化仅在训练阶段启用。

Result: Hyper3-CLIP在COCO和Flickr上提升了R@5和R@10检索性能，在VOC和COCO上提升了多标签分类性能，同时在层级指标上保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 查询条件化的池化在训练时能够有效利用层级结构信息，且推理时无需额外开销，验证了将双曲几何与查询条件化相结合的可行性。

Abstract: CLIP-like vision-language models (VLMs) trained with contrastive objectives learn strong global image-text representations, but their Euclidean embeddings and global pooling fail to encode relational structure such as part-whole and parent-child relations. Hyperbolic VLMs address this gap with entailment-based objectives, and text-conditioned variants improve fine-grained alignment through sentence- and phrase-level queries. However, these two lines of work remain separate: hyperbolic VLMs use static image and region features, while query-conditioned methods lack hierarchical geometric structure. We present Hyper3-CLIP, a hierarchy-conditioned hyperbolic VLM that combines global, local, and global-local contrastive learning with query-conditioned visual pooling. To train the model, we construct lightweight query hierarchies from text, comprising full captions, sentence fragments, localized part descriptions, and extracted phrases. Each query conditions the pooling of visual patches, and the resulting representations support image-text, whole-part, and parent-child entailment losses. Query-conditioned pooling is active only during training. Hyper3-CLIP improves R@5 and R@10 retrieval on COCO and Flickr, as well as multi-label classification on VOC and COCO, while remaining competitive on hierarchy metrics. We also audit zero-shot prompt sensitivity under fixed prompt regimes and study the effect of the localized GRIT part budget used during training. Code is available at https://github.com/Hyper3Labs/hyper3-clip.

</details>


### [93] [Test-Time Scaling for Video Diffusion Models via Diagnosis-Guided Candidate Recycling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29322)
*Hangzhou He,Lunhao Duan,Shanshan Zhao,Kaiwen Li,Qing-Guo Chen,Weihua Luo,Yanye Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GEARS是一个训练无关的视频扩散模型测试时扩展（TTS）框架，通过"诊断引导的候选回收"机制，将生成过程中被丢弃的候选样本转化为可编辑的先验，在相同的NFE预算下显著提升轻量级视频生成模型的质量，使1.3B模型达到与14B模型相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频扩散模型的测试时扩展方法大多局限于"噪声搜索"范式——采样、选择或扰动去噪轨迹并丢弃低分候选，这种生成即丢弃的过程不仅浪费计算资源，还丢失了已编码的部分运动、布局和外观结构信息。作者希望提出一种更高效的训练无关方法，能够复用失败的候选样本。

Method: GEARS包含两个协作组件：(1) Stage-Aware Scheduler（阶段感知调度器）决定修复什么、何时修复以及哪些候选应被保留、回收或丢弃；(2) Candidate Recycler（候选回收器）从关键帧和多维度奖励反馈中诊断可恢复的失败，生成候选特定的修复提示，并通过流形感知的潜在SDEdit修复相应候选。修复后的候选被回收进搜索池，在标准噪声扰动之外创建了精炼路径，同时保留有用结构。

Result: 在匹配的NFE预算下，GEARS在VBench基准上持续优于现有视频TTS方法，使1.3B模型达到与14B模型相当的总分。消融实验验证了自适应调度、诊断条件编辑和流形感知重去噪的必要性。

Conclusion: GEARS通过将失败的生成候选转化为可编辑先验而非简单丢弃，为视频生成中的测试时扩展提供了一种更高效的训练无关方案，显著缩小了轻量级模型与大规模模型之间的质量差距。

Abstract: Recent video diffusion models have achieved remarkable generation quality, but high-fidelity results still largely depend on closed-source systems or costly large-scale infrastructure. Test-time scaling (TTS) offers a training-free way to improve lightweight generators by spending additional inference compute, yet existing methods mostly remain within a noise-search paradigm: they sample, select, or perturb denoising trajectories and discard low-scoring candidates after expensive generation. This generate-and-discard process wastes not only computation but also the partial motion, layout, or appearance structure already encoded in recoverable samples. We present \textbf{GEARS} (\textbf{G}uided \textbf{E}diting for \textbf{A}daptive \textbf{R}ecycling \textbf{S}earch), a training-free framework that introduces {diagnosis-guided candidate recycling} into video TTS by turning such candidates into editable priors through a generation-evaluation-editing loop. GEARS consists of two collaborative components. The \textbf{Stage-Aware Scheduler} determines what to repair, when to repair it, and which candidates should be preserved, recycled, or discarded. The \textbf{Candidate Recycler} diagnoses recoverable failures from keyframes and multi-dimensional reward feedback, derives candidate-specific repair prompts, and repairs the corresponding candidates through manifold-aware latent SDEdit. The repaired candidates are recycled into the search pool, creating refinement paths beyond standard noise perturbation while preserving useful structure. Under matched NFE budgets, GEARS consistently outperforms existing video TTS methods on VBench, bringing a 1.3B model to a total score comparable to a 14B counterpart, and ablations verify the necessity of adaptive scheduling, diagnosis-conditioned editing, and manifold-aware re-denoising. Code is available on GitHub.

</details>


### [94] [Neural video codecs quality assessment dataset and benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29331)
*Nikolay Safonov,Nikita Gornostaev,Alexandra Dubonos,Dmitriy Vatolin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文构建了一个大规模主观视频质量评估数据集，包含神经视频编码器（NVCs）和传统视频编码器压缩的视频，通过众包成对比较收集主观评分，为神经视频编码器的质量评估指标开发与基准测试提供资源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经视频编码器（NVCs）作为新兴的深度学习视频压缩方法，引入了全新的时间压缩范式，传统视频质量评估方法难以充分评估其性能，因此需要一个针对NVCs的大规模主观数据集来支撑质量评估指标的开发与改进。

Method: 构建大规模主观数据集，包含由神经视频编码器和传统视频编码器压缩的视频；通过众包成对比较的方式收集主观评分；数据集公开提供以供研究和基准测试使用。

Result: 提出了一个公开可用的、涵盖神经与传统视频编码器压缩视频的大规模主观数据集，可服务于神经视频编码器质量评估指标的开发与基准测试。

Conclusion: 该数据集为神经视频编码器的质量评估研究提供了宝贵资源，有助于推动针对NVCs新颖时间压缩范式的质量评估指标发展。

Abstract: Video traffic constitutes a significant share of global web traffic. To reduce its volume, video codecs have been developed and continuously improved. While the industry has achieved substantial progress in traditional video coding, neural video codecs (NVCs) have recently emerged as a new approach that applies deep learning to video compression. This creates new challenges for compression quality assessment, which is essential for the further development and improvement of such codecs. In particular, it is important to evaluate the novel temporal compression paradigms introduced by NVCs. In this work, we present a large-scale subjective dataset of videos compressed with both neural and traditional video codecs. The subjective scores were collected through crowd-sourced pairwise comparisons. The proposed dataset provides a valuable resource for the development and benchmarking of video quality metrics tailored to neural video codecs. The dataset is available at the following link: https://videoprocessing.github.io/nvc-dataset-benchmark

</details>


### [95] [GenFirst: Generation Before Reconstruction for Stable End-to-End Latent Generative Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29335)
*Guangting Zheng,Yiyuan Zhang,Tao Yang,Yunpeng Chen,Rui Zhu,Jiajun Deng,Yanyong Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出GenFirst，一种生成优先于重建的直接端到端潜在生成模型训练策略。作者通过分析不同目标函数如何塑造潜在空间，发现KL散度中的熵项对防止潜在塌缩至关重要，并识别出重建与生成之间存在不对称学习动态。基于此，他们提出"先生成后重建"的训练策略，先在弱重建压力下用生成目标塑造潜在空间，再逐步加强重建以恢复视觉细节，实现了无需潜在塌缩的首个直接端到端训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统潜在生成模型采用两阶段流水线（先训练VAE重建，再在冻结的潜在空间上训练生成模型），但这种重建优化得到的潜在表示不一定适合生成任务。端到端联合训练虽然更理想，但面临潜在塌缩和生成-重建冲突两大难题，因此作者希望重新审视这个问题并找到解决方案。

Method: 作者首先通过分析不同目标函数对潜在空间的影响，识别出两个关键见解：(1) KL散度目标中的熵项是防止塌缩的关键，因为重建和先验拟合倾向于收缩后验，而熵项保留非退化的潜在不确定性；(2) 重建与生成存在不对称学习动力学，重建速度快且受强监督，而生成更慢且更难优化。基于这些见解，提出GenFirst策略：先生成后重建，即先用生成目标在弱重建压力下塑造潜在空间，再逐步增强重建以恢复视觉细节。

Result: 在ImageNet-256上，SiT实现gFID 0.97（使用CFG）和1.45（无CFG）；在文生图任务上MMDiT达到GenEval得分0.90。此外，该框架还扩展到共享视觉潜在空间的生成与表示学习，以及连续统一文图生成任务。

Conclusion: 实验结果证明了稳定端到端潜在学习在不同生成先验和模态上的通用性，为解决潜在生成模型中的端到端训练难题提供了全新思路。

Abstract: Latent generative models typically follow a two-stage pipeline, training a variational autoencoder for reconstruction and then a generative model on the frozen latent space. Since reconstruction-optimized latents are not necessarily generation-friendly, jointly training both models is an appealing alternative. However, direct end-to-end training remains challenging, as it is prone to latent collapse and faces a generation-reconstruction conflict. We revisit this problem by analyzing how different objectives shape the latent space and identify two key insights. First, the entropy term in the Kullback-Leibler divergence objective is essential for preventing collapse: reconstruction and prior fitting tend to shrink the posterior, while entropy preserves non-degenerate latent uncertainty. Second, reconstruction and generation exhibit asymmetric learning dynamics: reconstruction is fast and strongly supervised, whereas generation is slower and harder to optimize. Based on these insights, we achieve the first direct end-to-end training without latent collapse and propose GenFirst, a simple generation-before-reconstruction strategy. The generative objective first shapes the latent space under weak reconstruction pressure, after which reconstruction is progressively strengthened to recover visual details. We validate GenFirst with continuous autoregressive priors with exact likelihoods and SiT priors with implicit likelihoods. With our end-to-end objective and GenFirst, SiT achieves a gFID of 0.97 with CFG and 1.45 without CFG on ImageNet-256, while MMDiT reaches a GenEval score of 0.90 on text-to-image generation. Beyond image generation, we extend the framework to shared visual latents for generation and representation learning, and to continuous unified text-image generation. These results demonstrate the generality of stable end-to-end latent learning across generative priors and modalities.

</details>


### [96] [FISICA: A Deployed Service for Plantar-Pressure and Posture Assessment with Ontology-Grounded Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29336)
*Juhwan Song,Heejung Kim,Juntae Noh,Jonghak Ryu,Huiju Park,Junseong Lee,Dohyeon Ahn,Byungwoo Jo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FISICA 是一个已投入生产的身体评估与推荐系统，通过站立姿势的两张照片结合特制压力秤（634个力敏元件+4个称重传感器），输出足底负载、姿态坐标、3D虚拟人、视觉报告及鞋履/运动推荐。其核心方法贡献在于虚拟人构建：不使用固定增益将测量角度映射到骨骼，而是用与真人相同的测量函数反复求解直至一致，并提出采样不变的脊柱度量（正常与驼背记录分离7.2度，单关节公式仅0.9度）。系统在产响应迅速（通用API中位0.023s，足压0.45s，推荐2.16-2.26s且规则部分均<1s），关键点图达0.960 PCK@0.2，目录含699双鞋、10,500条事实数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有身体评估与推荐服务在测量到虚拟人/骨骼映射上依赖手工调优的固定增益，导致姿态表征不准确且泛化性差；同时缺乏将足底压力、姿态分析和推荐整合的系统化生产方案。

Method: 1) 特制压力秤：634个1cm网格力敏元件+4个称重传感器采集足底负载；2) 规则式评估器控制所有推荐，语言模型仅解释存储结果；3) 核心创新为虚拟人构建：用与受试者相同的测量函数测量虚拟人，迭代求解至两者一致，配合采样不变的脊柱度量评估。

Result: 脊柱度量在正常与驼背记录上分离7.2度（单关节公式仅0.9度）；生产响应时间：通用API中位0.023s、足压分析0.45s、推荐2.16-2.26s且规则部分恒<1s；关键点图0.960 PCK@0.2；目录含699双鞋和10,500条事实。

Conclusion: FISICA证明了一种"测量一致性"驱动而非增益调优的虚拟人构建方法在生产环境中有效，且规则式推荐+LLM解释的架构兼顾可靠性与可解释性；放射学金标准的验证研究已获批准，尚待完成。

Abstract: FISICA is a body-assessment and recommendation service running in production. One standing session with two photographs returns foot-loading measures, posture coordinates, a driven 3D avatar, a visual report, and ranked shoe and exercise candidates. Measurement comes from a purpose-built scale carrying 634 force-sensitive elements on a 1 cm grid and four load cells, and a rule-based evaluator controls every recommendation while a language model only explains the stored result. The method contribution is the avatar. Instead of mapping a measured angle onto a rig through a tuned gain, we measure the avatar with the same function used on the subject and solve until the two agree, on a sampling-invariant spinal metric that separated a normal from a kyphotic record by 7.2 degrees against 0.9 degrees for a single-joint formulation. In production, general APIs respond at a 0.023 s median, plantar-pressure analysis at 0.45 s, and recommendation at 2.16 s to 2.26 s with the rule-based portion under one second in every trial. The served keypoint graph reaches 0.960 PCK@0.2 on public data, and the catalog holds 699 shoes with 10,500 typed facts. An approved study supplies the radiographic reference for the validation still ahead.

</details>


### [97] [GSPotential: Camera Potential Field for Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29346)
*Zeyuan An,Yanghang Xiao,Zhiying Leng,Yijun Feng,Xiaohui Liang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GSPotential框架，通过相机势场量化视角空间监督不平衡性，指导稀疏视角下的3D高斯泼溅重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D高斯泼溅在稀疏视角下存在严重过拟合和几何伪影，现有方法引入外部先验但忽视了监督在视角空间中的非均匀分布，导致先验使用和基元控制的特异性不足。

Method: 1) 构建相机势场以识别监督最匮乏的"监督低谷"区域；2) 设计概率球面采样策略，在低势场区域放置虚拟相机，利用点云渲染提供针对性几何引导；3) 势场提供方向覆盖线索，对弱覆盖空间扇区进行保守的高斯更新。

Result: 大量实验表明GSPotential在实现高重建保真度的同时保持具有竞争力的训练效率。

Conclusion: 通过量化并引导视角空间监督分布，GSPotential有效缓解了稀疏视角下3D高斯泼溅的重建问题，兼顾了重建质量与训练效率。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting has achieved remarkable success in photorealistic rendering, yet it suffers from severe overfitting and geometric artifacts in sparse-view scenarios due to the inherent deficiency of photometric supervision. Recent advances have attempted to regularize optimization by incorporating external priors, such as depth, point clouds, or diffusion models. However, these methods typically overlook the non-uniform distribution of supervision across the viewing space, resulting in limited specificity in prior use and primitive control. In this paper, we propose GSPotential, a framework that quantifies view-space supervision imbalance using a Camera Potential Field. Our key insight is to identify supervision valleys where photometric constraints are most deficient, and use the potential field to guide reconstruction from two complementary aspects. First, we devise a probabilistic spherical sampling strategy that places informative virtual cameras in low-potential regions. Point-cloud renderings from these views then provide targeted geometric guidance. Second, the same field provides a directional coverage cue for conservative Gaussian updates in weakly covered spatial sectors. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GSPotential achieves high reconstruction fidelity while maintaining competitive training efficiency.

</details>


### [98] [Sketch2Inspire: Structure-Sensitive Evaluation for Product Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29364)
*Ge Kong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Sketch2Inspire，一个用于早期产品设计检索的多模态基准资源，基于Amazon Berkeley Objects构建，包含文本、边缘草图代理及其融合查询，并区分了类别级检索与结构敏感的内部类别检索，通过人工评分参考协议校准检索性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 早期产品设计检索不仅需要类别识别，还需要匹配语义意图和粗略结构线索。现有产品图像资源和通用图文检索基准很少区分类别检索与类别内结构匹配，缺乏专门针对这一需求的诊断性资源。

Method: 从Amazon Berkeley Objects中构建Sketch2Inspire，包含对齐的文本查询、基于边缘的草图代理查询以及文本-草图融合查询。采用CLIP系列编码器构建轻量级参考系统，对比纯文本检索、纯草图检索、加权晚期融合和文本优先重排序四种策略，不更新模型权重。

Result: 在广泛相关性下晚期融合取得最高nDCG=0.9962；在自动结构敏感相关性下晚期融合仍最优（nDCG=0.7015），优于纯文本检索（0.5912）；人工评分中晚期融合nDCG@10最高（0.9133），纯文本检索次之（0.9030）。

Conclusion: 多模态输入的检索增益取决于相关性的定义方式。Sketch2Inspire可作为诊断资源评估模态贡献，支持带独立人工标注的结构感知产品检索协议开发。

Abstract: Early-stage product design retrieval often requires more than category recognition: designers may need reference examples that match both a short semantic intent and a rough structural cue. Existing product-image resources and generic image--text retrieval benchmarks rarely separate category retrieval from within-category structural fit. We present Sketch2Inspire, built from a curated subset of Amazon Berkeley Objects with aligned text queries, edge-based sketch-proxy queries, and fused text--sketch queries. The resource separates broad category-level retrieval from structure-sensitive within-category retrieval and includes a human-graded reference protocol for calibration. We evaluate a lightweight reference system based on pretrained CLIP-family encoders, comparing text-only retrieval, sketch-only retrieval, weighted late fusion, and text-first reranking without updating model weights. Under broad relevance, late fusion obtains the highest score (nDCG = 0.9962). Under automatic structure-sensitive relevance, late fusion again obtains the highest score (nDCG = 0.7015), exceeding text-only retrieval (nDCG = 0.5912). In the human-graded results, late fusion obtains the highest nDCG@10 (0.9133), while text-only retrieval ranks second (0.9030). These results show that the retrieval gain from multimodal input depends on how relevance is defined. Sketch2Inspire therefore provides a diagnostic resource for evaluating modality contribution and supports the development of structure-aware product-retrieval protocols with independent human annotation.

</details>


### [99] [Think, Look, and Revise: Inconsistency-Aware Visual Self-Correction in MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29374)
*Yu Cheng,Arushi Goel,Hakan Bilen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ReVISE是一个为多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）配备验证和动态错误恢复能力的框架，通过监督训练数据集和基于强化学习的目标奖励，使模型能够验证工具输出、在视觉不匹配时重构查询、并在外部工具不可靠时回退到内在推理，从而提升工具增强多模态推理的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工具增强的多模态推理方法很少验证工具输出，缺乏检测和恢复工具失败的能力，导致感知瓶颈问题无法被有效解决。

Method: ReVISE包含两个核心组件：(1) 一个精选训练数据集，监督模型的反思行为，包括验证工具证据、在视觉不匹配时重构查询、以及在外部工具不可靠时回退到内在基础推理；(2) 基于强化学习的目标奖励机制，鼓励内部反思并惩罚空间错位。

Result: 在多个基准测试上的实验表明，ReVISE相对于现有方法取得了一致的性能提升，证明了错误检测和纠正在工具增强多模态推理中的重要性。

Conclusion: ReVISE验证了在工具增强多模态推理中引入验证和错误恢复机制的有效性，为构建更可靠的工具增强推理系统提供了新思路。

Abstract: Tool-augmented multimodal reasoning integrates external tools (e.g., object detection, depth estimation) into multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to address perceptual bottlenecks in complex visual tasks. However, existing approaches rarely verify tool outputs, limiting their ability to detect and recover from tool failures. We propose ReVISE, a framework that equips MLLMs with verification and dynamic error recovery for tool-augmented reasoning. ReVISE introduces (1) a curated training dataset that supervises reflective behaviors, enabling models to validate tool-derived evidence, reformulate queries when visual mismatches arise, and fall back to intrinsic grounding when external tools are unreliable; and (2) a reinforcement learning based targeted rewards that encourage internal reflection and penalize spatial misalignment. Experiments on several benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over existing methods, highlighting the importance of error detection and correction in tool-augmented multimodal reasoning.

</details>


### [100] [FiLM-GPNet: Geometry-Aware Pseudo-Supervised Phase Restoration with Zero-Shot Generalization for Large Temporal InSAR Stacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29384)
*Getnet Demil,Muhammad Farhan Humayun,Tomi Westerlund,Jukka Heikkonen,Mourad Oussalah*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出FiLM-GPNet，一种基于几何条件化的SAR干涉相位恢复网络，利用特征级线性调制和7D几何描述符自适应不同采集几何，通过Goldstein滤波伪监督和干涉物理三重闭合一致性约束训练，在多个Capella数据集上显著降低时间残差、闭合误差并提升解缠成功率和DEM精度，且具有跨区域零样本泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 密集商业化SAR时间序列使得时序InSAR分析成为可能，但传统固定经典滤波器在异构采集几何下表现不佳，导致相位质量下降和时间一致性受损。

Method: 提出FiLM-GPNet：1) 利用特征级线性调制（FiLM）和7D每对几何描述符显式适应采集差异；2) 以Goldstein滤波干涉图作为伪监督进行训练；3) 通过三重闭合一致性损失引入干涉物理正则化；4) 同时估计每像素偶然不确定性。

Result: 在IEEE GRSS 2026数据融合竞赛的三组Capella Spotlight数据上：夏威夷时间残差降低68%，西澳大利亚降低66%；闭合误差分别减少10%和13%；西澳大利亚解缠成功率提升7.7个百分点，DEM NMAD改善31%；对洛杉矶堆栈无需重训即实现强零样本泛化。

Conclusion: 几何条件化恢复可作为跨异构堆栈中固定经典滤波的有效替代方案，在相位恢复质量和时序一致性方面均优于传统方法。

Abstract: The growing availability of dense commercial Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) time series enables temporal Interferometric SAR (InSAR) analysis, but fixed classical filters fail under heterogeneous acquisition geometries, degrading phase quality and temporal consistency. We propose FiLM-GPNet, a geometry-conditioned network for wrapped-phase restoration that explicitly adapts to acquisition differences using Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) and a 7D per-pair geometry descriptor. The model is trained with pseudo-supervision from Goldstein-filtered interferograms and regularized by interferometric physics via triplet-closure consistency, while also estimating per-pixel aleatoric uncertainty. Experiments on three Capella Spotlight stacks from the IEEE GRSS 2026 Data Fusion Contest show that FiLM-GPNet reduces temporal residual by 68% (Hawaii) and 66% (Western Australia) relative to the Goldstein baseline, alongside closure error reductions of 10% and 13%, respectively. In Western Australia, it further improves unwrapping success rate by 7.7 percentage points and Digital Elevation Model (DEM) Normalized Median Absolute Deviation (NMAD) by 31%. The model also shows strong zero-shot generalization to a geographically and geometrically distinct third stack (Los Angeles) without retraining, supporting geometry-conditioned restoration as an effective alternative to fixed classical filtering across heterogeneous stacks.

</details>


### [101] [GATE: Reliability-Gated Gaussian Evidence Fusion for Training-Free Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29395)
*Pedram MohajerAnsari,Amir Salarpour,Run Wang,Mert D. Pesé*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出GATE，一种无需训练的、两遍式的转导测试时适应框架。它利用未标记的目标集，在共享视觉-语言特征空间中构建两种互补的高斯证据源（文本高斯和图像高斯），通过类级可靠性门控和广义专家乘积融合，对冻结的视觉-语言模型（如CLIP、SigLIP）进行零样本预测的残差修正，在多个基准和骨干网络上取得最优结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-语言模型（如CLIP、SigLIP）在零样本识别中表现强大，但面对与预训练分布不同的目标数据时性能会下降。现有的测试时适应方法要么仅依赖提示侧适应，要么仅依赖图像侧目标证据，未能充分利用目标未标记数据集中的分布信息。作者希望在不使用源数据或目标标签、且完全冻结模型参数的前提下，更有效地提升模型在目标域上的鲁棒性。

Method: GATE框架包含以下核心组件：1）两遍式转导测试时适应，利用未标记目标集；2）构建两种互补的高斯证据源——文本高斯（由多个语言描述估计）和图像高斯（由可靠未标记目标样本估计）；3）类级可靠性门控，控制图像派生伪证据的影响；4）分数级广义Product-of-Experts融合，产生对原始零样本logits的归一化残差修正。图像编码器、文本编码器和提示参数全程保持冻结。

Result: 在细粒度识别数据集、ImageNet系列分布偏移、多种CLIP骨干网络以及SigLIP-B/16上，GATE在每个基准/骨干网络组中均取得最佳平均精度。相比零样本性能平均提升5.41个百分点，比最强的非GATE基线平均高出1.94个百分点。

Conclusion: GATE证明了可靠性门控的分布性证据（高斯证据）对于冻结视觉-语言模型自适应是有效的，通过同时利用文本和图像两侧的分布信息，在完全不训练任何参数的情况下显著提升了模型在目标域上的鲁棒性和识别精度。

Abstract: Vision-language models such as CLIP and SigLIP provide strong zero-shot recognition, but their predictions can degrade when deployed on target data that differ from the pretraining distribution. Test-time adaptation offers a practical way to improve robustness without source data or target labels, yet existing methods often rely on either prompt-side adaptation or image-side target evidence alone. In this work, we introduce GATE, a training-free two-pass transductive test-time adaptation framework that uses the unlabeled target set while keeping the image encoder, text encoder, and prompt parameters fully frozen. Instead of representing each class with a single prototype, GATE builds two complementary Gaussian sources of evidence in the shared vision-language feature space: a text Gaussian estimated from multiple language descriptions and an image Gaussian estimated from reliable unlabeled target samples. A class-wise reliability gate controls the influence of image-derived pseudo-evidence, and a score-level generalized Product-of-Experts fusion produces a normalized residual correction to the original zero-shot logits. Across fine-grained recognition datasets, ImageNet-family distribution shifts, multiple CLIP backbones, and SigLIP-B/16, GATE achieves the best average accuracy in every benchmark/backbone group. It improves zero-shot performance by an average of 5.41 points and outperforms the strongest non-GATE baseline by 1.94 points, demonstrating the benefit of reliability-gated distributional evidence for frozen VLM adaptation.

</details>


### [102] [A Visual Question Answering Model to Automate Nondestructive Evaluation Image Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29408)
*Mehrdad Shafiei Dizaji,Hoda Azari*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种专门用于无损评估（NDE）应用的视觉问答（VQA）模型，结合ResNet-50进行图像特征提取和GPT-2进行语言生成，使检查人员能够通过自然语言交互方式查询NDE图像，如询问"是否有裂纹"或"缺陷位于何处"，从而提高检查效率和准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的无损评估依赖人工检查，效率较低且容易出现人为错误。作者希望引入VQA模型，使检查人员能够通过自然语言交互方式直接查询NDE图像，从而提升检查效率和实用性。

Method: 系统采用深度学习与自然语言处理技术，集成两个核心组件：ResNet-50用于图像特征提取，GPT-2用于语言生成，两者结合实现图像内容理解与自然语言回答的生成。

Result: 该VQA模型能够为检查人员提供准确、信息丰富的反馈，显著提高检查效率，减少潜在错误，并增强实际现场场景中的可用性。

Conclusion: 通过实现直接问答交互，该VQA模型在无损评估领域展示了良好的应用前景，能够有效改善实际现场检查流程的效率和可靠性。

Abstract: This study introduces a Visual Question Answering model designed specifically for nondestructive evaluation applications. VQA models allow inspectors to interactively query NDE images, asking targeted questions like, Is there a crack or Where is the defect located and receive precise answers from the model. Leveraging deep learning and natural language processing, the developed system integrates image feature extraction (via a ResNet-50 model) and language generation capabilities (via GPT-2) to provide accurate, informative feedback. By enabling direct question-and-answer interactions, this VQA model significantly improves inspection efficiency, reduces potential errors, and enhances usability in practical field scenarios.

</details>


### [103] [Polis: 3D Self-Supervision at City Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29426)
*Alexander Rusnak,Sophia Kovalenko,Jingru Wang,Ismail Moudden,Xiru Wang,Frédéric Kaplan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Polis，首次将Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularization (SIGReg)作为原生点云编码器的训练目标，结合几何匹配的余弦不变性、VICReg风格抗坍缩项、大规模室外预训练混合数据及重力保持空间视图采样，在14个城市与建筑尺度数据集上通过冻结特征基准进行评估，在城市尺度任务上显著优于现有方法，但在细粒度地面采集任务上排名反转。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市级3D模型的可靠语义表征对城市分析、基础设施监测、自动驾驶和遗产保护日益重要，但大规模航测获取的城市场景与大多数3D自监督模型预训练所用的室内、物体级和自动驾驶LiDAR数据差异显著，需要专门针对该领域的自监督方法。

Method: Polis采用SIGReg作为原生点云编码器的目标函数，结合几何匹配的余弦不变性、VICReg风格抗坍缩项，使用12.8k场景的室外预训练混合数据和重力保持的空间视图采样策略进行训练。

Result: 在三个预训练不相交的城市数据集上，Polis在高容量冻结探测下达到23.8%平均mIoU（次优编码器为16.3%）；在匹配点与体素预算下达17.3%对16.1%。在城市尺度数据集上保持领先，但在细粒度立面和街景标签的局部地面采集数据上排名反转。

Conclusion: 分布正则化的联合嵌入架构能够在具有挑战性的城市尺度3D场景上取得成功，且当自监督设计针对该领域的采集几何和空间上下文时迁移性能提升，同时也揭示了这种领域特化的局限性。

Abstract: Reliable semantic representations derived from city-scale 3D models are increasingly important for urban analysis, infrastructure monitoring, autonomous systems, and heritage conservation. However, urban scenes of large spatial extent captured through aerial surveying differ substantially from the indoor, object-level, and self-driving LiDAR data used to pretrain most 3D self-supervised models. We introduce Polis, to our knowledge the first application of Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularization (SIGReg) as an objective for a native point cloud encoder, and evaluate it through a frozen-feature benchmark spanning fourteen city- and building-scale corpora. Polis combines geometrically matched cosine invariance, SIGReg, and VICReg-style anti-collapse terms with a 12.8k-scene outdoor pretraining mixture and gravity-preserving spatial view sampling. Controlled ablations show that this objective outperforms student--teacher architecture alternatives, as well as Polis versions without anti-collapse terms, on the same representative outdoor corpus. On three pretraining-disjoint city datasets, Polis reaches $23.8\%$ mean mIoU versus $16.3\%$ for the next-best encoder under high-capacity frozen probing, and $17.3\%$ versus $16.1\%$ at a matched point and voxel budget. The same city-scale lead holds on datasets whose training sets were seen in pretraining. On localized terrestrial captures with fine-grained facade and streetscape labels, the ranking reverses. Our results show that distributionally-regularized joint embedding architectures can be successful on challenging city-scale 3D scenes, and that transfer improves when self-supervision is designed for the capture geometry and spatial context of this domain while also revealing the limits of this specialization.

</details>


### [104] [Calibration and Comparative Analysis of Forward-Looking Sonar and 3D Sonar for Enhanced Underwater Object Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29433)
*Aditya Penumarti,Khanh Dong,Zi-Hao Zhang,Yongkyoon Park,Zhenqi Wu,Trung Dong,Shahriar Negahdaripour,Xiaomin Lin,Jane Shin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对声纳生成大量噪声导致3D点云特征难以提取的问题，提出利用2D强度图像和3D点云两种声纳模态，通过自动校准在模态间过滤噪声特征，实验表明自动校准比手动校准提升5%，过滤后特征提取比原始点云提升超过40%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 声纳噪声大，新一代技术产生全3D点云后噪声在稀疏点云中被放大，使得导航、识别或重建任务中的特征识别变得困难。

Method: 使用两种不同的声纳模态：一种产生2D强度图像，另一种产生3D点云。通过实施自动校准，在模态之间过滤噪声特征以增强特征提取。

Result: 自动校准比手动校准性能提升5%，过滤机制相比原始点云使特征提取性能提升超过40%。

Conclusion: 双模态声纳结合自动校准与噪声过滤能有效提升特征提取性能，代码和数据集已公开。

Abstract: Sonars generate a significant amount of noise. With the advent of new technology capable of producing full 3D point clouds, the noise is amplified in sparse point clouds, making it challenging to recognize features for navigation, recognition, or reconstruction. To address this challenge, we propose using two different sonar modalities: one that produces a 2D intensity image and another that generates a 3D point cloud. By implementing auto-calibration, we can filter out noisy features between the modalities to enhance feature extraction. Experiments demonstrate that auto-calibration improves performance over manual calibration by 5% and that filtering enhances feature extraction by more than 40% relative to the raw point cloud. Code and datasets are given at https://theaprilab.org/fls-3d-calibrator

</details>


### [105] [Text-Guided Diffusion-Based Adversarial Attacks on Chest X-Ray Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29456)
*Basudha Pal,Arjun Narayanan,Neha Ajith,Vikas R Bhat,Muhammad Umair*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于文本引导扩散模型的对抗攻击框架，用于胸部X光（CXR）多疾病分类任务。该方法通过优化可学习的文本条件而非直接操纵像素来生成对抗样本，在保持生成器和分类器冻结的情况下，通过学习的图像先验实现对抗生成。实验结果显示该方法在二分类和多疾病分类中均造成最大的性能退化（AUROC降至0.3885-0.5646和0.4441-0.4878），同时保持高图像保真度（SSIM 0.9080），且临床医生对95.9%的二分类和73.8%的多疾病对抗图像判读不变，揭示人机判读的显著差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医疗AI鲁棒性评估主要依赖像素空间攻击（如FGSM、PGD、CW），这些方法虽引入数值受限的扰动，但可能不代表合理的放射学变异。特别是在多疾病CXR分类中，模型需同时评估多个重叠病理，对抗失败可能改变多个诊断预测。因此需要更符合临床现实、基于生成式威胁模型的鲁棒性评估方法。

Method: 提出文本引导的扩散式对抗攻击框架：优化可学习的文本条件向量，同时冻结扩散生成器和目标分类器，通过学习的图像先验而非直接像素操作生成对抗样本。该框架在二分类肺不张和多疾病CXR分类场景中，与FGSM、PGD、Carlini-Wagner攻击进行对比评估。

Result: 所提方法在多个分类器架构上均产生最大的性能退化：二分类AUROC降至0.3885-0.5646，多疾病设置为0.4441-0.4878。同时图像保真度优越（SSIM 0.9080，LPIPS 0.1670，FID 51.23）。关键发现：尽管模型预测发生重大变化，临床医生对95.9%的二分类和73.8%的多疾病对抗图像判读保持不变。

Conclusion: 生成式对抗攻击揭示了人类与机器判读之间存在重要的临床差异，表明医疗AI鲁棒性评估需超越传统像素空间攻击，转向生成式威胁模型，以暴露在视觉和临床合理图像变异下模型可能出现的失败。

Abstract: As artificial intelligence is increasingly integrated into chest X-ray (CXR) interpretation, triage, and clinical decision support, understanding its vulnerability to adversarial manipulation is critical for safe deployment. Existing robustness evaluations, however, predominantly rely on pixel-space attacks that introduce numerically constrained perturbations but may not represent plausible radiographic variation. This limitation is particularly important in multi-disease CXR classification, where models simultaneously evaluate multiple overlapping pathologies and adversarial failures may alter several diagnostic predictions. We propose a text-guided diffusion-based adversarial framework that optimizes learnable text conditioning while keeping the diffusion generator and target classifier frozen, enabling adversarial generation through a learned image prior rather than direct pixel manipulation. We evaluate the framework across multiple classifier architectures in both binary atelectasis and multi-disease CXR classification and compare it with FGSM, PGD, and Carlini-Wagner attacks. Our approach consistently produced the greatest degradation in classifier performance, reducing AUROC to 0.3885-0.5646 in binary classification and 0.4441-0.4878 in the multi-disease setting, while achieving superior image fidelity (SSIM 0.9080, LPIPS 0.1670, FID 51.23). Importantly, clinician interpretation remained unchanged for 95.9% of binary and 73.8% of multi-disease adversarial images despite substantial changes in model predictions. These findings reveal a clinically important discrepancy between human and machine interpretation and demonstrate the need to extend medical AI robustness evaluation beyond conventional pixel-space attacks toward generative threat models that can expose failures under visually and clinically plausible image variations.

</details>


### [106] [Co-Evolutionary Prompt Optimization with Cross-Category Transfer for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29467)
*Sisi Zhu,Changwei Yu,Renshuai Tao,Zhenliang Ni*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CoEvoAD，一个用于零样本异常检测的协同进化框架，通过进化算法在离散自然语言空间中搜索提示词，替代传统连续提示嵌入方法，提升可解释性和跨类别泛化能力，并在多个数据集上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于CLIP的零样本异常检测方法通常采用连续提示嵌入进行提示优化，将语义编码在潜在向量中，缺乏可解释性和可扩展性。

Method: 1) 提出CoEvoAD协同进化框架，在离散自然语言空间中使用进化算法进行提示搜索；2) 候选提示通过种群进化迭代生成、评估和选择，保留自然语言的可解释性和可组合性；3) 引入跨类别迁移目标（CCTO），将保留源类别视为未见类别的代理，基于估计的跨类别迁移性对提示规则进行评分。

Result: 在多个异常检测数据集上进行了大量实验，结果表明CoEvoAD达到了最先进的性能。

Conclusion: CoEvoAD通过离散提示进化搜索有效解决了现有连续提示方法可解释性不足的问题，同时通过CCTO机制提升了跨类别泛化能力，为ZSAD提供了新的研究范式。

Abstract: Zero-shot anomaly detection (ZSAD) has gained significant attention for its practical value in industrial inspection. Recently, CLIP-based approaches have been widely adopted in ZSAD due to their strong vision-language generalization capabilities. However, existing methods commonly employ continuous prompt embeddings for prompt optimization and encode semantics in latent vectors, which lack interpretability and scalability. To this end, we propose CoEvoAD, a co-evolutionary framework for discrete prompt selection. CoEvoAD performs prompt search in the discrete natural-language space using an evolutionary algorithm. Candidate prompts are iteratively generated, evaluated, and selected throughout population evolution, thus preserving the interpretability and composability of natural language. Furthermore, we introduce a Cross-Category Transfer Objective (CCTO), which treats held-out source categories as proxies for unseen categories and scores prompt rules based on their estimated cross-category transferability, effectively improving cross-category generalization. Extensive experiments are conducted to validate the effectiveness of CoEvoAD, and the results show that it achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple anomaly detection datasets. The code is available at https://github.com/rstao-bjtu/CoEvoAD.

</details>


### [107] [Seeing Through Extreme Visual Sparsity: Surface Understanding from a Single Random Visual Patch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29475)
*Sindhuja Penchala,Sudip Mittal,Noorbakhsh Amiri Golilarz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SSUF（稀疏表面理解框架），一个统一的双任务学习框架，将四种预训练架构（ConvAE、ViT、Swin Transformer、MAE）适配用于表面重建和材料分类。在Touch-and-Go数据集上，仅保留10%可见像素的稀疏观测条件下，Swin Transformer取得最佳分类性能（准确率89.21%），MAE取得最佳重建性能（PSNR 16.06dB），ViT在重建与分类间取得最佳平衡，所有模型均实现实时推理（<5ms/张）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从不完整视觉观测中识别表面材料是机器人感知和环境理解中的挑战性问题，现有工作缺乏统一的框架来比较不同预训练架构在稀疏观测下的表面重建与材料分类能力。

Method: 提出SSUF统一双任务学习框架，适配四种预训练架构（ConvAE、ViT、Swin Transformer、MAE）同时进行表面重建和材料分类。通过扩展分类头或重建解码器，使各模型具备双任务能力，并在稀疏观测协议（仅10%像素可见）下进行评估。

Result: Swin Transformer分类最优（准确率89.21%、F1=0.8922、ROC-AUC=0.9813）；MAE重建最优（PSNR=16.06dB、SSIM=0.4501）；ViT在重建与分类之间平衡最佳；所有模型推理时间<5ms/张，满足实时要求。

Conclusion: 预训练架构能够在严重视觉稀疏条件下支持材料识别，但准确图像重建仍具挑战性；不同架构各有优势，选择需根据任务侧重而定。

Abstract: Surface material recognition from incomplete visual observations remains a challenging problem in robotic perception and environmental understanding. This paper discusses Sparse Surface Understanding Framework (SSUF), a unified dual-task learning framework that adapts four pretrained architectures-Convolutional Autoencoder (ConvAE), Vision Transformer (ViT), Swin Transformer, and Masked Autoencoder (MAE) for si-multaneous surface reconstruction and material classification. Experiments were conducted on the Touch-and-Go dataset using a sparse observation protocol in which only 10% of the original image remained visible while the remaining regions were masked. To enable a fair comparison, reconstruction-oriented models were extended with classification heads, whereas classification- oriented models were augmented with reconstruction decoders. The resulting architectures were assessed using reconstruction quality, classification performance, model complexity, and in-ference efficiency metrics. Experimental results revealed distinct strengths across the models. Swin Transformer achieved the best classification performance with an accuracy of 89.21%, an F1-score of 0.8922, and a ROC-AUC of 0.9813. In contrast, MAE produced the highest reconstruction scores among evaluated models, with a PSNR of 16.06 dB and an SSIM of 0.4501, while ViT provided the best overall balance between reconstruction and classification performance. Furthermore, all models achieved real-time inference, requiring less than 5 ms per image. Over-all, the results show that pretrained architectures can support material recognition under severe visual sparsity, while accurate image reconstruction remains challenging.

</details>


### [108] [GeoAgent: Evaluating VLM Geolocalization Through Embodied Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29483)
*Arka Mukherjee,Soham Roy,Kartikeya Trivedi,Shreya Ghosh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍了GeoAgent，一个基于智能体环境的地理定位基准测试平台，要求多模态智能体在街景环境中自主导航收集观测数据后进行地理定位预测。研究发现现代VLM在国家和地区级别预测成功，但在区域模式识别上存在困难；智能体导航相比静态图像基线显著提高了准确率，同时揭示了前端模型在发达/发展中地区背景下的严重偏差和错误先验下的自我改进能力不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的VLM地理定位研究大多局限于静态图像检索、分类和预测，未能真实重现地理定位任务。作者认为忠实重现该任务应涉及具身导航，即多模态智能体自主探索环境收集观测后再提交预测。

Method: 构建GeoAgent基准测试，一个基于智能体环境的基准，要求智能体在街景环境中导航，通过序贯推理来精细化地理位置预测。智能体需要自主探索环境、收集观测数据，然后提交最终预测。

Result: 现代VLM在国家和地区级别预测成功，但在区域模式辨别上困难；智能体导航相比静态图像基线显著提高各指标精度；发现前端模型架构在发达/发展中地区的严重偏差；模型在错误先验下自我改进能力差。

Conclusion: 该工作确立了具身导航和地理空间推理的挑战，公开了代码和GeoAgent环境供后续研究使用。

Abstract: Modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs) perform well above the human baseline in image geolocalization, a task critically important in disaster response, OSINT verification, and location privacy. However, most efforts to study AI behavior on the task remain limited to static image-based retrieval, classification, and predictions. We argue that faithful recreation of the task should involve embodied navigation, where a multimodal agent autonomously explores its surroundings to gather observations before submitting a prediction. To this end, we introduce \textbf{GeoAgent}, an agentic environment-based benchmark that requires agents to navigate Street View environments to refine their geolocalization through sequential reasoning. Our analysis shows that modern VLMs struggle to discern regional patterns while succeeding at country- and continent-level predictions. When compared to static image-based baselines, agentic navigation significantly improves accuracy across established metrics. We also note severe bias in a developed/developing region context across frontier model architectures and poor self-improvement capabilities given incorrect priors. Overall, our work establishes the challenges of embodied navigation and geospatial reasoning. We publicly release our code and the GeoAgent environment: https://geoagent-benchmark.github.io

</details>


### [109] [ARMOR: Manifold-Oriented Training for Adversarially Robust Aerial Object Detection under Data Scarcity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29510)
*Haoran Wang,Matthew Lau,Alec Helbling,Matthew Hull,ShengYun Peng,Mansi Phute,Martin Andreoni,Willian T. Lunardi,Duen Horng Chau,Wenke Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ARMOR是一种针对航拍目标检测器的对抗防御方法，在训练数据稀缺（仅数百张图像）的条件下，通过掩蔽背景以保留目标相关特征、注入随机补丁以增强特征鲁棒性，实现数据高效的数据流形建模与对抗鲁棒训练。实验表明该方法在保持高干净性能（置信度>0.90）的同时，将对抗鲁棒性最多提升0.32。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 航拍目标检测模型容易受到物理通用对抗补丁的攻击导致漏检，同时防御方面临训练数据稀缺的瓶颈——航拍图像采集标注成本高昂，部署点通常只有数百张图像，远低于对抗鲁棒性基准假设的数万张。因此需要一种在低数据条件下同时解决模型脆弱性和数据稀缺问题的防御方法。

Method: ARMOR基于流形对抗训练(OMAT)的核心思想，但采用数据高效策略：(i)掩蔽图像背景以保留目标相关特征，从而建模数据流形；(ii)在目标上注入随机补丁以提升特征鲁棒性。该方法直接复用检测任务已有的标签信息，避免了OMAT中训练大型生成模型和数据密集型对抗训练的高数据需求。

Result: 在低数据实验条件下，面对物理可实现的对抗补丁（包括查询无关的迁移攻击和防御感知攻击），ARMOR保持了超过0.90的干净模型置信度，同时将对抗鲁棒性相比最先进的防御方法最多提升0.32的模型置信度。印刷补丁物理实验确认这些优势在部署中依然成立。

Conclusion: ARMOR成功将基于流形的训练思想转化为在训练数据稀缺条件下防御目标检测器的有效方法，为低数据航拍场景下的对抗防御提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Aerial object detection is increasingly deployed in real-world applications, but models remain vulnerable to physical, universal adversarial patches that cause them to miss objects. Furthermore, defenders face the practical constraint of training data scarcity: aerial imagery is costly to collect and label, so a deployment site typically yields hundreds of images rather than the tens of thousands that adversarial robustness benchmarks assume. To tackle model vulnerability and training data scarcity, we propose Adversarial Robustness with Manifold-Oriented Training (ARMOR), a novel defense that realizes the core insights of on-manifold adversarial training (OMAT) in low-data regimes. ARMOR builds on the insight of OMAT to model the data manifold - the compact structure capturing the data's relevant features - to learn and robustify these features during training. While OMAT relies on the data-intensive operations of training large generative models and adversarial training to achieve this, ARMOR adopts a data-efficient approach that reuses labels the detection task already supplies: ARMOR (i) masks image backgrounds to retain object-relevant features, and (ii) injects randomized patches on objects to improve feature robustness. Our low-data experiments with physically-realizable adversarial patches evaluate both query-free transfer attacks and defense-aware attacks. ARMOR maintains strong clean performance of over 0.90 model confidence, while improving adversarial robustness by up to 0.32 in model confidence over state-of-the-art defenses. Physical experiments with printed patches confirm that these gains survive deployment. Overall, ARMOR translates insights from manifold-based training to defend object detectors amidst training data scarcity.

</details>


### [110] [FuncRoom-Agent: Sequential Feed-Forward 3D Functional Indoor Scene Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29519)
*Hao Feng,Zhi Zuo,MingJian Liang,Jingyu Hu,Xiaowei Hu,Liupengfei Wu,Dian Zhang,Guoxin Fang,Zhengzhe Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出函数房间生成（Function-Room Generation），一种以显式功能目标为导向的室内3D场景生成新设定。通过递归领域特定语言（DSL）组织分层对象组合，采用顺序前馈场景构建框架蒸馏递归构建轨迹为场景构建专家，并引入ScenePRM（执行落地的过程奖励框架）通过强化学习提升专家性能，实现无需迭代修复的高效功能房间生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有室内场景生成方法多侧重视觉合理性而非显式功能目标；已有的智能体方法虽提升可控性，但依赖昂贵的测试时"生成-评估-修订"循环，导致功能房间生成速度慢且计算开销大。

Method: 1）设计递归领域特定语言，分层组织从房间结构、主要家具到密集支撑面与嵌套小物体的层级对象组合，将房间表示为带显式几何和功能关系的分阶段可执行程序；2）提出顺序前馈场景构建框架，将递归构建轨迹蒸馏为场景构建专家，推理时专家分阶段编写DSL代码，由确定性执行器直接实例化，无需教师智能体、在线评判或迭代修复；3）引入ScenePRM，一种执行落地的过程奖励框架，通过功能、几何、关系及未来可构建性反馈的强化学习提升专家性能。

Result: 建立了面向功能的基准测试，在通用室内场景生成和函数房间生成任务上均达到最先进性能，实现了更强的功能完整性、关系正确性、几何可执行性和生成效率。

Conclusion: 通过DSL表达、前馈构建框架和过程奖励强化学习三方面创新，实现了高效且功能完备的室内场景生成，验证了显式功能导向生成路径的可行性。

Abstract: We introduce Function-Room Generation, a new indoor 3D scene generation setting that creates rooms supporting explicit functional goals rather than merely visually plausible layouts. Existing agentic and executable methods improve controllability, but often depend on costly test-time generate--evaluate--revise loops, making functional room generation slow and computationally expensive. We address this challenge with three technical contributions. First, we design a recursive domain-specific language to effectively organize the hierarchical object compositions required by functional rooms, from room structure and major furniture to dense support-surface and nested small objects. It represents rooms as staged executable programs with explicit geometric and functional relations. Second, we propose a sequential feed-forward scene construction framework that distills recursive construction traces into a scene construction expert. At inference time, the expert writes executable DSL code stage by stage, and a deterministic executor directly instantiates each stage without teacher agents, online critics, or iterative repair. Third, we introduce ScenePRM, an execution-grounded process reward framework that improves the expert through reinforcement learning with functional, geometric, relational, and future-constructability feedback. We further establish a function-oriented benchmark and show state-of-the-art performance on both general indoor scene generation and function-room generation, achieving stronger functional completeness, relation correctness, geometric executability, and generation efficiency.

</details>


### [111] [NepScript Genesis: Neural Architecture Search for Handwritten Devanagari Digit Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29540)
*Mausam Gurung,Prabin Neupane,Sajjan Acharya*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出NepScript Genesis，一个面向条件Devanagari手写数字合成的自动GAN发现NAS框架。Adaptive Exploration策略在不到一个GPU小时内实现FID=79.12（较DCGAN基线提升76.19%），并在低资源场景下通过GAN合成数据增强使CNN分类准确率从91.0%提升至96.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手写数字识别在低资源语言场景下数据稀缺，而GAN合成可作为数据增强手段，但GAN架构设计高度依赖人工经验且易发生模式崩溃。作者旨在通过NAS自动化发现最优GAN架构，同时解决Devanagari手写数字合成中的特定挑战。

Method: 构建DCGAN基线（FID=332.28），比较五种NAS策略；采用两阶段架构选择流程，并由新提出的领域感知评估指标（Enhanced Score）引导；在搜索阶段融入脚本特定结构启发式以防止早期模式崩溃。

Result: Adaptive Exploration策略取得最优质量-效率权衡：FID=79.12（较基线提升76.19%），模式覆盖最高（Recall=0.531），用时不到一个GPU小时；在低资源下游任务中，GAN合成数据增强使CNN分类准确率从91.0%提升至96.5%（+5.5个百分点）。

Conclusion: NAS优化的GAN合成能产生足够高质量的Devanagari数字，在真实数据稀缺时有效提升实际识别管线的性能；脚本特定结构启发式能有效防止搜索阶段早期模式崩溃。

Abstract: This paper introduces NepScript Genesis, a Neural Architecture Search (NAS) framework for automated Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) discovery, applied to conditional Devanagari handwritten digit synthesis. We compare five NAS strategies against a carefully constructed Deep Convolutional GAN (DCGAN) baseline (FID=332.28). Architecture selection utilizes a two-stage pipeline guided by a novel domain-aware evaluation metric (Enhanced Score). Results demonstrate that Adaptive Exploration achieves the optimal quality-efficiency trade-off, attaining an FID of 79.12 -- a 76.19% improvement over the baseline -- and the highest mode coverage among the NAS strategies (Recall=0.531) in under one GPU-hour. Furthermore, we demonstrate that incorporating script-specific structural heuristics into the search phase prevents early-stage mode collapse. In a downstream low-resource evaluation, augmenting 250 real training samples per class with GAN-generated digits from the best NAS model improves CNN classification accuracy from 91.0% to 96.5% (+5.5 percentage points), demonstrating that NAS-optimized synthesis produces digits of sufficient quality to benefit practical recognition pipelines when real data is scarce.

</details>


### [112] [MotionSync: Non-Causal Refinement of Causal Tracker for Label-Efficient 3D Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29567)
*Rahul Ahuja,Bala Murali Manoghar Sai Sudhakar,Shashwata Gupta,Venkatraman Narayanan,Varun Ravi Kumar,Senthil Yogamani*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MotionSync通过将因果/非因果边界作为显式架构接缝，使得一个系统同时服务在线跟踪与离线自动标注两个场景。在线部分基于强基线跟踪器扩展不确定性校准、帧率不变运动关联门控和多假设运动；离线部分用RTS平滑、物理验证的间隙补全和语义剪枝对缓冲轨迹进行修正。在不改动因果估计的前提下，作为自动标注器在10%标签预算下提升+3.3 mAP/L2，重训练可恢复73%的人工监督收益。


<details>
