  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统自动驾驶数据引擎中，3D框-轨迹注释是成本瓶颈。离线系统虽然能缓解标注负担，但完全替代在线感知栈，导致需要同时维护和协调两套系统。作者希望设计一个统一的系统，既能提供在线结果又能做离线精化，避免两套系统共存的开销。

Method: 1) 将因果/非因果边界作为显式架构接缝；2) 严格因果跟踪器基于强基线扩展：创新驱动的不确定性校准、帧率不变的运动关联门控、多假设运动与学习模式选择；3) 非因果精化通路：对位置、尺寸和偏航角分别应用RTS平滑，物理验证的间隙补全，基于LiDAR点标签的语义鬼影轨迹剪枝；4) 精化器不回写，保持因果估计不变，精化效果作为增量delta。

Result: 固定3D检测器在25%人工标签+MotionSync伪标签下达到全监督mAP的96.9%（Waymo）。10%标签预算下，非因果通路比因果阶段伪标签提升+3.3 mAP/L2。用精化输出重训练在线跟踪器可恢复73%的人工监督收益。作为跟踪器与领先离线方法在主要指标上持平，且在错误构成上更优（同时减少漏检和碎片化，体现间隙补全特征而非调参检测器）。

Conclusion: MotionSync证明一个系统可以同时服务在线和离线两个需求，通过显式架构接缝避免了两套系统的维护成本。其精化通路的增益来自于轨迹层面的间隙补全与语义剪枝，而非简单的检测器调优，且精化输出可有效自我回馈提升跟踪器性能。这一设计为自动标注和在线感知的协同提供了一个统一、高效且可扩展的方案。

Abstract: Three-dimensional box-and-track annotation is the cost bottleneck in autonomous-driving data engines, and the offline systems built to relieve it replace the online perception stack outright, so a team needing both regimes maintains and reconciles two. MotionSync makes the causal/non-causal boundary an explicit architectural seam instead. A strictly causal tracker, built on a strong published baseline and extended with innovation-driven uncertainty calibration, frame-rate-invariant kinematic association gates, and multi-hypothesis motion with learned mode selection, emits a valid online result. A non-causal pass then revises the buffered trajectories with Rauch--Tung--Striebel smoothing applied separately to pose, extent and yaw, physics-validated gap completion, and semantic pruning of ghost tracks against LiDAR point labels. The refiner never writes back, so one system serves both regimes and refinement's effect is a delta over an unaltered causal estimate. Used as an auto-labeller, a fixed 3D detector trained on 25% human labels plus MotionSync pseudo-labels reaches 96.9% of its full-supervision mean average precision (mAP) on Waymo, and at a 10% budget the non-causal pass accounts for +3.3 mAP/L2 over pseudo-labels from the same tracker's causal stage. Re-fitting the online tracker on its own refined output recovers 73% of the benefit of human supervision, while its causal output is worse supervision than no re-fitting at all. As a tracker MotionSync is at parity with the leading published offline entries on the headline metric and ahead of them on error composition, which is where a refinement pass can act at all: it reduces misses and fragmentations together, the signature of gap completion rather than of a tuned detector.

</details>


### [113] [TRINITY: A Multi-Perspective Benchmark for Personal-Style Video Highlight Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29577)
*Qianqian Chen,Hyun Bin Kim,Denzel Elden Wijaya,Yang Yi,Bo Liu,Yangkai Ding*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出TRINITY，一个多视角视频高光检测基准，将显著性分解为事件、情感和自然三个互补维度，并设计了共享骨干的多分支架构进行并行多视角预测，在多个数据集上显著超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统视频高光检测依赖于狭隘的、以事件为中心的显著性定义，在无约束的个人视频中难以泛化，因为这些视频的高光是异构且依赖于观看视角的。需要一个多视角的基准和建模方法来更全面地定义视频显著性。

Method: 提出TRINITY基准，将高光显著性分解为事件（Event）、情感（Emotion）和自然（Nature）三个互补维度，并置于统一的时间框架内。基于此，设计了一个共享骨干网络（shared-backbone）的多分支架构，通过视角特定的专家（view-specific experts）进行并行的多视角预测。

Result: 在Mr. HiSum上取得+7.15/+3.62 mAP（rho=15%/50%）的提升，在YouTube Highlights上取得+10.82 mAP的提升，显著优于最先进的基线方法。

Conclusion: 多视角建模为视频显著性提供了更稳健和更全面的表述，尤其在复杂的真实世界场景中表现优异。基准和代码将公开发布。

Abstract: Traditional video highlight detection relies on a narrow, event-centric definition of saliency, which often fails to generalize to unconstrained personal videos where highlights are heterogeneous and perspective-dependent. To address this, we introduce TRINITY, a multi-perspective benchmark that decomposes highlight saliency into three complementary dimensions, Event, Emotion, and Nature, within a unified temporal framework. Leveraging this multi-faceted view, we propose a shared-backbone multi-branch architecture designed for parallel multi-perspective prediction via view-specific experts. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving gains of +7.15/+3.62 mAP (rho=15%/50%) on Mr. HiSum and +10.82 mAP on YouTube Highlights. These results validate that multi-perspective modeling provides a more robust and comprehensive formulation of video saliency, especially for complex real-world scenarios. The benchmark and relevant codes will be released upon acceptance. The benchmark is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/vanilladucky/TRINITY and the code is available at https://github.com/vanilladucky/TRINITY.

</details>


### [114] [Guardrail-Agnostic Societal Bias Evaluation in Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29590)
*Yusuke Hirota,Michael Ross Boone,Arun George Zachariah,Jibin Rajan Varghese,Yu-Chiang Frank Wang,Boyi Li,Ryo Hachiuma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种针对具有安全护栏的大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的社会偏见评估方法。该方法通过将任务与图像中人物解耦（不直接询问人物属性，而是将图像作为隐含的人口统计线索附加到与人物无关的提示中），避免了安全护栏模型的拒绝响应，从而实现了可靠的偏见测量。在20个最新LVLMs上的实验表明，所有模型都会在任务无关的场景中不恰当地使用用户人口统计信息，且专有模型比开源模型偏见更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有偏见评估基准依赖直接询问图像中人物属性的提示，但具有强大安全护栏的LVLMs（如GPT和Claude）常常拒绝此类提示，导致评估不可靠。需要一种新的评估范式来绕过护栏限制，实现对现代LVLMs社会偏见的有效测量。

Method: 将评估任务与图像中的人物解耦：使用不涉及人物的提示（如虚构故事、术语解释、考试问答），将图像作为临时用户信息附加以隐含提供人口统计线索，然后比较不同用户人口统计条件下的模型输出差异。通过故事生成、术语解释和考试问答三类任务进行实例化。

Result: 在20个开闭源LVLMs上的实验发现：所有模型都会在与人物无关的任务中不恰当地使用用户人口统计信息（例如，为男性用户生成的故事角色常被描绘为机械师，为女性用户则描绘为护士）；专有模型（如GPT-5）虽然仍有偏见但显著低于开源模型。

Conclusion: 现有LVLMs普遍存在社会偏见，安全护栏虽能阻止直接偏见性回答但无法消除深层偏见。专有模型偏见较低可能与持续监控和改进有关，建议将偏见监控纳入模型开发流程。

Abstract: We propose a societal bias evaluation method for large vision-language models (LVLMs) in the era of strong safety guardrails. Existing benchmarks rely on prompts that ask models to infer attributes of people in images (e.g., "Is this person a CEO or a secretary?"). However, we find that LVLMs with strong guardrails, such as GPT and Claude, often refuse these prompts, making evaluations unreliable. To address this, we change the prior evaluation paradigm by decoupling the task from the depicted person: instead of inferring person's attributes, we use prompts that do not ask about the person (e.g., "Write a fictional story about an imaginary person.") and attach the image as provisional user information to implicitly provide demographic cues, then compare outputs across user demographics. Instantiated across three tasks --- story generation, term explanation, and exam-style QA --- our method avoids refusals even in guardrailed LVLMs, enabling reliable bias measurement. Applying it to 20 recent LVLMs, both open-source and proprietary, we find that all models undesirably use user demographic information in person-irrelevant tasks; for instance, characters in stories are often portrayed as mechanic for male users and nurse for female users. Although still biased, proprietary models like GPT-5 show lower bias than open-source ones. We analyze potential factors behind this gap, discussing continuous model monitoring and improvement as a possible contributor for reducing bias.

</details>


### [115] [SnapBench: Benchmarking Snap-and-Ask Multimodal Retrieval for Mobile Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29607)
*Zirong Chen,Fuda Ye,Kuan Zhang,Enjun Du,Junfu Pu,Xinlei Wang,Xinyu Zuo,Lisheng Duan,Jin Ma,Yongqi Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了SnapBench，首个针对"拍照即问"（snap-and-ask）多模态检索场景的配对鲁棒性基准测试，涵盖1,145个查询、9,085个图库项目、53种受控退化条件。评估了16种多模态检索器，发现图像退化显著损害检索性能，而文本退化影响有限。此外提出MOOR自适应融合方法，强调可靠性感知的模态校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动AI的"拍照即问"检索已成为常见入口，但真实场景中照片常模糊、文本问题常简短或拼写错误。现有基准仅测试干净输入或未隔离配对鲁棒性，缺少一个能系统评估snap-and-ask检索在输入退化下的鲁棒性基准。

Method: 构建SnapBench基准：包含1,145个查询、9,085个图库项目、53种受控退化条件并有人工标注。评估16种多模态检索器（覆盖双塔编码器和基于embedding的VLM）。同时提出MOOR（Modality-anchored, Outlier-aware, Optimal Reweighting）自适应融合方法，用于可靠性感知的模态融合。

Result: 图像退化显著降低检索性能；文本退化主要影响纯文本检索，对联合检索影响有限。纯图像检索在干净条件下常优于联合检索，表明存在"粗粒度文本拖累"问题，且在噪声输入下缺乏跨模态回退机制。

Conclusion: SnapBench为snap-and-ask场景提供了受控测试平台，揭示现有检索器在噪声输入下的鲁棒性缺陷，MOOR方法强调了可靠性感知模态校准的必要性。

Abstract: Mobile AI acts as a visual oracle, empowering users to snap a picture of something and ask for information. Snap-and-ask retrieval is now one of the most common entry points for mobile AI, yet photos are often blurry, while text questions may be short or mistyped. Existing benchmarks only test on clean inputs or do not isolate paired robustness in snap-and-ask retrieval. Therefore, we introduce SnapBench, the first paired benchmark for robust snap-and-ask multimodal retrieval, spanning 1,145 queries, 9,085 gallery items under 53 controlled corruption conditions with human annotations. We evaluate 16 multimodal retrievers, covering dual-tower encoders and embedding-based VLMs. Results show that image corruptions substantially degrade retrieval, while text corruptions mainly affect text-only retrieval and have limited impact on joint retrieval. Clean image-only retrieval often outperforms joint retrieval, indicating the coarse-text drag and the lack of cross-modal fallback under noisy inputs. SnapBench provides a controlled testbed for evaluating robust retrieval in snap-and-ask scenarios. We further propose MOOR (Modality-anchored, Outlier-aware, Optimal Reweighting), a simple adaptive fusion approach, highlighting the need for reliability-aware modality calibration in snap-and-ask retrieval.

</details>


### [116] [nnMNet: Baseline for Martian Terrain Semantic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29609)
*Ming-Han Lee,Chi-Yeh Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出nnMNet，一个用于火星地形语义分割的新基线模型，集成了线性注意力与轻量级卷积，并引入空间感知融合块（SAFB）以弥合局部与全局表示之间的差距。同时，作者通过整理和标准化三个高质量数据集建立了统一的基准。nnMNet在SynMars-TW、SynMars-Air和MarsScapes上分别取得了86.61%、83.25%和88.24% mIoU的最新结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 火星表面高度非结构化且复杂，语义分割困难，但该领域缺乏鲁棒、公开可复现的基线模型和统一基准来促进公平评估。

Method: 基于nnWNet架构，集成线性注意力以更好地捕捉全局上下文，使用轻量级卷积降低计算开销，并引入空间感知融合块（SAFB）来增强和组合具有不同特征的表征。同时整理和标准化三个数据集建立统一基准。

Result: nnMNet在SynMars-TW、SynMars-Air和MarsScapes三个数据集上分别取得86.61%、83.25%和88.24%的mIoU，达到新的最先进水平。

Conclusion: nnMNet为火星地形语义分割提供了鲁棒且可复现的新基线，并建立了统一基准，代码、模型和数据集均已公开，有助于推动该领域公平比较和后续研究。

Abstract: Semantic segmentation is a crucial task for understanding Mars, the most Earth-like planet in our solar system. However, it is challenging because the Martian surface is highly unstructured and complex, making accurate pixel-level prediction and fine-grained annotation difficult. Recent advancements in deep learning have introduced numerous methods and datasets to address these challenges. Nevertheless, the field lacks a robust, publicly available, and reproducible baseline, as well as a unified benchmark to facilitate fair evaluations. In this work, we present nnMNet, a new baseline model designed for Martian terrain semantic segmentation. Building upon nnWNet, we integrate linear attention to better capture global context and employ lightweight convolutions to reduce computational overhead. To bridge the gap between local and global representations, we introduce the Spatially-Aware Fusion Block (SAFB), which augments and combines features with diverse characteristics. Furthermore, we establish a new benchmark by curating and standardizing three high-quality datasets for thorough evaluation. nnMNet achieves new state-of-the-art 86.61%, 83.25%, and 88.24% mIoU on SynMars-TW, SynMars-Air, and MarsScapes, respectively. Our code, models, and datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/dereklee0310/nnMNet.

</details>


### [117] [See the Change, Keep the Flow: Unsupervised Action Segmentation via Spectral-Temporal Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29611)
*Yun Li,Jun Xiao,Cong Zhang,Kin-Man Lam*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SpecT-OT，一种基于谱-时间表示学习框架的无监督动作分割方法。它通过频谱重参数化投影器（SRP）和时序亲和正则化（TAR）改进最优传输伪标签的质量，在四个基准上15项指标中13项达到最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 最优传输（OT）方法在无监督动作分割中提供结构化的帧-动作分配，但其伪标签质量受限于表示空间。现有方法忽视了表示几何需要同时具备判别性和时序一致性这一关键需求，导致伪标签不可靠。

Method: SpecT-OT包含两个核心组件：(1) 频谱重参数化投影器（SRP）——用固定傅里叶基和可学习系数参数化投影器权重，以更好建模快速变化的判别性特征；(2) 时序亲和正则化（TAR）——对成对帧亲和度施加距离感知、无标签约束，稳定局部时序结构。两者结合基于非平衡最优传输伪标签概念，产生更可靠伪标签用于迭代表示学习。

Result: 在四个基准数据集上，SpecT-OT在15项指标中的13项取得最佳结果，其中在Breakfast上MoF提升4.1个百分点，在Desktop Assembly上F1提升7.4个百分点，优于所有现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: 同时关注判别性（谱域）和时序一致性（时域）的表示空间能显著提升OT伪标签质量，进而提高无监督动作分割性能。这验证了"可靠的OT伪标签需要既对判别性变化敏感又沿局部时序连贯的表示几何"这一观点。

Abstract: Unsupervised action segmentation aims to discover latent action categories and their temporal organization without action annotations. Optimal transport-based methods provide structured frame-to-action assignments, however, their pseudo-label quality is fundamentally conditioned on the representation space used to construct the transport cost. We argue that reliable OT pseudo-labeling requires a representation geometry that is simultaneously sensitive to discriminative action changes and coherent along local temporal progressions. Based on this insight, we propose SpecT-OT, a spectral-temporal representation learning framework built upon an unbalanced optimal transport pseudo-labeling concept. SpecT-OT introduces a Spectral Reparameterization Projector (SRP), which parameterizes projector weights with fixed Fourier bases and learnable coefficients to improve the modeling of rapidly varying discriminative features, and Temporal Affinity Regularization (TAR), which imposes distance-aware, label-free constraints on pairwise frame affinities to stabilize local temporal structure. The two components jointly produce more discriminative and temporally stable transport costs, yielding more reliable pseudo-labels for iterative representation learning. Experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate strong performance compared with state-of-the-art methods. SpecT-OT achieves the best results on 13 of 15 metrics, including 4.1-point MoF and 7.4-point F1 gains over the baseline on Breakfast and Desktop Assembly, respectively.

</details>


### [118] [CineForge: Self-Improving Agents for Long-Horizon Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29621)
*Junxiang Liu,Lin Wang,Haiyu Shi,Hongxu Ma,Xiaoyu Yang,Chunjie Chen,Xiaoxiao Xu,Kaiqiao Zhan,Boao Wang,Shuizhou Shi,Tianyun Zhu,Jie Li,Jiangtong Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CineForge，一个自进化的视频制作智能体框架，通过将故事生产过程中的反复失败转化为跨故事的持久性、阶段性改进，实现长时程叙事视频生成性能的持续提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自适应视频系统主要优化请求或复用技能，未能将生产过程中反复出现的失败与跨故事的持久性、阶段针对性改进相连接，缺乏系统性学习和进化的能力。

Method: CineForge由两部分组成：CineForge-Produce将源故事组织为类型化的叙事、角色、空间和电影状态，协调资产与片段生成并记录规范化生产轨迹；CineForge-Evolve采用CPPE（案例到模式到策略进化）方法审查轨迹证据，将反复发现的模式整合为受限的阶段局部补丁，通过结构重放和置信度控制的成对评估部署验证过的更新。同时引入CineScope评估体系，包含100个剧本的CineScope-Data数据集和多尺度CineScope-Metric指标（涵盖因果状态、导演编排、节奏与资源分配、角色弧线）。

Result: 在CineScope-Data和两个公开基准上，进化后的CineForge策略将CineScope-Metric从4.024提升至4.380，优于三个长视频基线模型，在ScriptAgent下持续获益，并将新故事的审查LLM调用减少37.0%。

Conclusion: 生产轨迹可作为视频智能体的可操作经验，使其在长形式故事讲述任务中实现跨故事的累积性改进。

Abstract: Long-horizon story-driven video generation requires a production agent to coordinate narrative decomposition, state tracking, shot design, prompt construction, rendering, and revision across interdependent scenes. Existing adaptive video systems primarily refine requests or reusable skills, leaving recurring production failures disconnected from persistent, stage-targeted improvements across stories. We introduce CineForge, a self-evolving video-production agent framework that couples CineForge-Produce for video generation with CineForge-Evolve for cross-story policy evolution. CineForge-Produce organizes each source story into typed narrative, character, spatial, and cinematic states, uses them to coordinate asset and clip generation, and records the process as a canonical production trajectory. CineForge-Evolve applies Case-to-Pattern-to-Policy Evolution (CPPE) to review trajectory evidence, consolidate recurrent findings into bounded stage-local patches, and deploy validated updates through structural replay and confidence-controlled paired evaluation. To measure complete story realization, we introduce CineScope, which combines a 100-script CineScope-Data suite with a human-aligned, multiscale CineScope-Metric spanning causal state, directorial orchestration, pacing and resource allocation, and character arc. Across CineScope-Data and two public benchmarks, the evolved CineForge policy improves CineScope-Metric from 4.024 to 4.380, outperforms three long-video baselines with consistent gains under ScriptAgent, and reduces review LLM calls by 37.0% on new stories. These results establish production trajectories as actionable experience for video agents that improve cumulatively across long-form storytelling tasks.

</details>


### [119] [SPLG-Mamba: Structure-Preserving Local-Global Mamba Network for Salient Object Detection in Optical Remote Sensing Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29626)
*Yi Xu,Ruichao Hou,Tongwei Ren,Gangshan Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SPLG-Mamba网络，通过平滑细节重校准、层级感知的局部-全局Mamba和门控跨尺度融合来保留光学遥感图像显著目标检测中的结构完整性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ORSI-SOD方法虽能定位显著区域，但预测结果常出现碎片化、不完整或前景响应局部缺失等结构退化问题，这与层级特征传播密切相关。

Method: 1) Smooth-Detail Recalibration (SDR)：在状态空间建模前重校准平滑响应和细节残差；2) Hierarchy-aware Local-Global Mamba：浅层用局部建模、深层用全局建模；3) Gated Cross-Scale Fusion (GCSF)：在解码阶段控制跨尺度细节注入。

Result: 在ORSSD、EORSSD和ORSI-4199三个基准数据集上取得最先进的结果，结构完整性和连续性得到改善。

Conclusion: SPLG-Mamba有效解决了ORSI-SOD中的结构退化问题，通过分层特征处理和受控跨尺度融合实现了更好的结构保持。

Abstract: Salient object detection in optical remote sensing images (ORSI-SOD) requires dense predictions that preserve object completeness and structural continuity under complex backgrounds, scale variation, and irregular object shapes. Existing methods often localize salient regions, but their predictions may still suffer from structural degradation, including fragmented, incomplete, or locally missing foreground responses. This degradation is closely related to hierarchical feature propagation, where shallow details can introduce texture-induced background responses, deep semantics may over-smooth weak structures, and uncontrolled cross-scale fusion can disturb coherent regions. To address this issue, we propose a novel Structure-Preserving Local-Global Mamba Network, SPLG-Mamba, for ORSI-SOD. Specifically, SPLG-Mamba integrates Smooth-Detail Recalibration (SDR), hierarchy-aware Local-Global Mamba, and Gated Cross-Scale Fusion (GCSF). SDR recalibrates smoothed responses and detail residuals before state-space modeling, Local-Global Mamba assigns local modeling to shallow feature levels and global modeling to deep feature levels, and GCSF controls cross-scale detail injection during decoding. Experiments on ORSSD, EORSSD, and ORSI-4199 demonstrate state-of-the-art results and improved structural completeness and continuity. The code is available at https://github.com/yxu9910/SPLG-Mamba

</details>


### [120] [Conducting Stylistic Analysis of Paintings through an Art-History Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29644)
*Marc S. Walton,Astrid Harth*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个AI框架，通过视觉变换器（ViT）编码绘画作品，利用稀疏字典学习分解为可解释的特征，再由大语言模型（LLM）将这些特征转化为风格描述，最终通过ReAct框架整合成连贯的艺术品风格分析，弥合了传统艺术史风格分析与AI黑箱分类之间的方法论鸿沟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统艺术品归属鉴定依赖艺术史家的细致视觉观察和风格分析描述，而现有AI模型仅提供无法解释的概率分类结果，缺乏可解释性和与人类语义关切对接的能力，需要一种能将视觉特征转化为可理解描述性术语的框架。

Method: 1) 在大规模带元数据的绘画语料上训练ViT，将艺术史数据编码为嵌入表示；2) 通过稀疏字典学习将嵌入分解为一组跨训练集重复出现的共享特征；3) 利用LLM检索每个特征关联的艺术作品及策展人撰写的文本，综合生成反映风格属性的描述；4) 由自主协调LLM采用ReAct框架对特征进行加权、测试和细化，形成连贯的艺术品描述或比较。

Result: 该框架能自动完成绘画的风格分析，将详细的视觉特征转化为描述性术语，同时支持证据收集、发现和验证，为基于视觉的计算艺术史奠定了基础。

Conclusion: 该研究弥合了以图像为数据与人文主义语义关切之间的鸿沟，将视觉计算艺术史确立为未来发展的新兴领域，为艺术史研究提供了可解释的AI辅助工具。

Abstract: Attributing an artwork to an artist has traditionally relied on detailed visual observations and descriptions, known as stylistic analysis in art history. By contrast, current artificial intelligence (AI) models used in the field offer only unexplained probabilistic classifications. To bridge this methodological gap, we present an AI framework that automates stylistic analysis of paintings, providing a foundation for enhancing evidence collection, discovery, and verification. By training a vision transformer (ViT) on a large corpus of paintings with metadata, our system encodes this art history-specific data as embeddings. These representations are factorized via sparse dictionary learning into a shared set of features that recur across the training set. A large language model (LLM) then interprets each feature by retrieving associated artworks and their accompanying curator-written texts, and synthesizes them into descriptions that reflect their stylistic attributes. Finally, an autonomous coordinator LLM applies a reasoning-and-action (ReAct) framework to weight, test, and refine these features into cohesive descriptions of an artwork, or comparisons of artworks. This approach converts detailed visual features into descriptive terms, addressing a key challenge in art history. It thus connects the use of images as data with the semantic concerns of humanists, establishing vision-based computational art history as an area for future growth.

</details>


### [121] [PhysVR: Vision-Language Model Guided Interference-aware Temporal Feature Refinement for Remote Physiological Measurement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29663)
*Zixu Li,Jianjun Qian,Hang Shao,Daoheng Li,Lei Luo,Jian Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PhysVR，一种基于视觉-语言模型引导的干扰感知时序特征细化框架，用于远程光电容积描记（rPPG）估计。该方法通过融合生理信号证据和视觉干扰证据，构建干扰感知的时序上下文，并利用共享校正单元和四个干扰专用专家实现时序特征的精细化，在五个公开基准上取得了优于现有方法的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有rPPG方法主要在特征学习阶段抑制干扰，但很少检验学习到的时序特征是否仍受干扰影响，也缺乏在rPPG估计前进一步抑制干扰的手段。本文旨在解决这一被忽视的问题，即如何检测并抑制时序特征中残留的干扰成分。

Method: PhysVR包含以下核心组件：1）生理骨干网络生成全局时序特征和粗rPPG预测，并从局部时序特征构建信号派生的生理可靠性证据；2）冻结的视觉-语言模型在干扰导向提示下处理采样的人脸帧，证据头从VLM输出中提取视觉干扰证据；3）时序交叉注意力融合生理和视觉证据与全局时序特征，构建干扰感知时序上下文；4）共享时序校正单元进行通用细化，四个干扰专用专家通过自适应路由选择性抑制不同干扰（光照变化、头部运动、面部模糊、ROI不稳定）；5）细化后的时序特征用于最终rPPG估计。

Result: 在五个公开基准数据集上的大量实验表明，PhysVR在数据集内和跨数据集评估协议下均一致优于代表性方法。

Conclusion: 通过视觉-语言模型引导的干扰感知时序特征细化，PhysVR有效解决了rPPG学习中时序特征仍受干扰影响的问题，证明了在估计前主动抑制干扰对提升rPPG性能的有效性。

Abstract: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables contactless physiological measurement from facial videos, yet its subtle pulse-related variations are easily affected by illumination variation, head motion, facial blur, and region-of-interest instability. Existing methods mainly suppress interference during feature learning, while whether the learned temporal features remain affected by interference and how to further suppress such interference before rPPG estimation are rarely examined. To address this limitation, we propose PhysVR, a vision-language model guided interference-aware temporal feature refinement framework for rPPG estimation. Specifically, a physiological backbone produces global temporal features and a coarse rPPG prediction, from which signal-derived physiological reliability evidence is constructed from local temporal characteristics. In parallel, a frozen vision-language model processes sampled facial frames under an interference-oriented prompt, and an evidence head extracts visual interference evidence from the VLM output. Temporal cross-attention integrates the physiological and visual evidence with the global temporal features to construct interference-aware temporal context. Guided by this context, a shared temporal correction unit performs general refinement, while four interference-specific experts selectively suppress different interference through adaptive routing. The refined temporal features are then used for final rPPG estimation. Extensive experiments on five public benchmarks demonstrate that PhysVR consistently outperforms representative methods under both intra-dataset and cross-dataset evaluation protocols.

</details>


### [122] [MedSegBenchmarker: A Raw-Count-First Framework for Controlled 2D Medical Image Segmentation Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29677)
*Vanessa Borst,Lukas Horn,Daniel Grillmeyer,Thomas Prantl,Samuel Kounev*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了MEDSEGBENCHMARKER (MSB)，一个配置驱动的2D医学图像分割基准测试框架，集成重复图像检测、分组数据划分、YAML研究规范、可恢复训练、超参数优化和交叉验证等功能。通过在三个异构2D数据集上的案例研究，证明评估聚合策略等看似微小的选择会改变排名结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学图像分割的公平可复现比较面临挑战：数据集异构、评估协议不一致、架构快速演进。现有比较隐含假设模型排序对数据划分、预处理、指标聚合、不确定性估计和计算约束不敏感，且缺乏可扩展的统一评估框架。

Method: MSB采用配置驱动设计，包含：重复/近重复图像检测、分组感知数据划分、YAML研究规范、可恢复训练、超参数优化、交叉验证和基于检查点的评估。不同于仅保留聚合指标，MSB导出样本级和类别级的像素计数及预测，连同评估上下文，支持事后分析而无需重复推理。

Result: 在三个异构2D数据集、多种医学分割和通用视觉模型、256/512像素分辨率下评估。重新聚合相同预测后发现：六个数据集-分辨率设置中有三个改变了最佳排名架构（尽管聚合策略间秩相关高）。提高输入分辨率产生模型和数据集依赖的性能增益或损失。

Conclusion: 评估和实验设置中看似微小的选择（如指标聚合策略）可以显著影响基准测试结论。MSB提供了一个实用且可扩展的基础，使基准条件和评估选择变得明确且可复现。

Abstract: Despite rapid advances in MIS, fair and reproducible comparisons of segmentation models remain challenging due to heterogeneous datasets, inconsistent evaluation protocols, and rapidly evolving architectures. In particular, comparisons often implicitly assume that model rankings are invariant to data partitioning, preprocessing, metric aggregation, uncertainty estimation, and computational constraints. The lack of extensible and unified evaluation frameworks further limits systematic investigation of new models, datasets, and training paradigms. We present MEDSEGBENCHMARKER (MSB), a configuration-driven framework for controlled benchmarking of 2D MIS. It integrates duplicate and near-duplicate image detection, group-aware data splitting, YAML study specifications, resumable training, hyperparameter optimization, cross-validation, and checkpoint-based evaluation. Rather than retaining only aggregate performance measures, MSB exports sample- and class-level pixel counts and predictions together with the evaluation context. These elementary artifacts enable post-hoc analyses without repeated inference. We demonstrate MSB in a case study involving three heterogeneous 2D datasets and multiple MIS and general-purpose vision models evaluated at 256- and 512-pixel input resolutions. Reaggregation of identical predictions changes the top-ranked architecture in three of six dataset-resolution settings, despite high rank correlations between aggregation strategies. Increasing input resolution produces model- and dataset-dependent performance gains and losses that must be considered alongside empirically measured inference complexity. These results show that seemingly minor choices in evaluation and experimental setup can affect benchmark conclusions. MSB, available at GitHub, provides a practical and extensible basis for making benchmark conditions and evaluation choices explicit and reproducible.

</details>


### [123] [GeoRay: Gauge-Aware Feed-Forward Satellite 3D Reconstruction in the Geodetic Frame](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29680)
*Zhe Dong,Wanqing Wu,Yuzhe Sun,Haochen Jiang,Yuchen Ma,Lecheng Ren,Tianzhu Liu,Yanfeng Gu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出GeoRay方法，解决卫星摄影测量中的稠密地表高度绝对测绘问题。方法包含轻量级射线一致性适配器、显式垂直基准机制和校准逆方差融合，在26个US3D瓦片上达到2.99米绝对MAE（91.9%覆盖率），比最强前馈基线提升46.4点，且支持零控制点、单控制点和稀疏控制点推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前馈3D基础模型擅长透视场景重建，但卫星摄影测量需要的是不同的产品：在非中心有理多项式相机（RPCs）下的绝对大地坐标框架中的稠密地表高度。领域自适应无法解决这一问题，因为透视预训练特征在RPC高度射线上不可靠，绝对高程存在低阶基准-传感器偏差的规范互换性，且单目与多视角线索在不同区域失效。

Method: GeoRay采用三管齐下的方法：(1)轻量级射线一致适配器使冻结骨干网络沿原生RPC射线可匹配；(2)显式基准机制将起伏与绝对水平分离，构造上对垂直原点等变，使单一训练模型可服务零/单/稀疏控制点推理；(3)校准逆方差融合组合两个起伏信息流。

Result: 在26个US3D held-out瓦片上，GeoRay达到2.99米绝对MAE和91.9%覆盖率，在完整性感知精度上比最强合规前馈基线提升46.4点，在两个迁移场景下仍保持最精确，模型前向时间仅24秒每瓦片。

Conclusion: GeoRay通过针对RPC相机几何的专门设计，成功弥合了透视预训练基础模型与卫星摄影测量绝对测绘需求之间的差距，为绝对帧高程重建提供了无需配准和测试参考泄漏的可靠方案。

Abstract: Feed-forward 3D foundation models reconstruct perspective scenes in one pass. Satellite photogrammetry needs a different product, one that domain adaptation alone does not deliver: dense surface height in an absolute geodetic frame under non-central rational polynomial cameras (RPCs). Perspective-pretrained features are not reliably observable along RPC height rays, absolute elevation carries a low-order height--datum gauge exchangeable with sensor bias to first order, and monocular and multi-view cues fail in different regions. \method{} treats all three. Lightweight ray-consistent adapters make a frozen backbone matchable along native RPC rays. An explicit datum mechanism separates relief from absolute level and is equivariant to the vertical origin by construction, so one trained model serves zero-, one-, and sparse-control inference. Calibrated inverse-variance fusion combines the two relief streams. \bench{}, our absolute-frame benchmark of eighteen systems across in-domain, cross-dataset, and cross-city tiers, scores absolute placement without registration or test-reference leakage. On 26 held-out US3D tiles, \method{} attains $2.99$\,m absolute MAE at $91.9\%$ coverage, improves completeness-aware accuracy by $46.4$ points over the strongest compliant feed-forward baseline, remains the most accurate such system under both transfer shifts, and runs in $24$\,s model-forward time per tile. Code and models will be released at https://github.com/HIT-SIRS/GeoRay

</details>


### [124] [A Calibration Audit of Confidence in Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29705)
*Nanxing Nick Deng,Qing Cheng,Niclas Zeller,Daniel Cremers*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文审计了七个发布的feed-forward 3D重建骨干模型在十三个数据集上的置信度输出，检验其作为误差预测的可靠性。发现置信度能很好地对误差进行排序，但不确定性的量级在训练条件之外过于乐观（中位数偏差2.4倍），且模型越自信偏差越大。通过每个骨干和数据集的两个常数幂律校正可将偏差降至1.35倍，对少数标注场景重拟合可达1.12倍，但无法修正逐场景的形状偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前馈式3D重建模型会输出逐像素置信度，下游系统将其视为可靠性信号。但该置信度是作为损失权重训练的，而非作为不确定度量级训练的，其是否能真正用于误差预测从未被系统测量过。

Method: 作者对七个已发布的骨干模型在十三个数据集上进行审计，从四个属性评分置信度：误差排序能力、平均量级正确性、跨置信度范围的可靠性、区间覆盖真实值的能力。并测试了幂律常数校正方法及基于少量标注场景的重拟合方案。

Result: 置信度能很好地排序误差，但在非训练条件下预测的不确定性过低，中位数偏差2.4倍，且越自信偏差越大。该现象即使在损失达到最优时仍会出现。两常数幂律校正将中位数偏差降至1.35倍，目标数据集重拟合可降至1.12倍，但任何重缩放都无法修正场景级的形状偏差——三分之二的留出场景仍偏离五点区间。

Conclusion: 3D重建模型的置信度适合作为误差的相对排序信号，但作为绝对不确定度量级使用时在分布变化下系统性过乐观。虽然全局缩放可以修正量级，但模型缺少跨预测的尺度知识，导致场景级误差形状无法被任何重缩放修复，这暗示模型的不确定性校准存在更深层的结构性问题。

Abstract: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models emit a per-pixel confidence that downstream systems read as a reliability signal. It is trained as a loss weight, not as an uncertainty magnitude, and whether it can be used as an error prediction has not been measured. We audit seven released backbones on thirteen datasets and score the confidence on four properties, how well it ranks error, whether its level is right on average, whether it holds across the confidence range, and whether its intervals cover the truth. The confidence ranks error well, but the predicted uncertainty is too low when it is read under conditions that are not exactly those of training. The median case is off by 2.4x across all seven models, and the error prediction is further off the more confident the model is. We show that this phenomenon can appear even though the loss's optimum is reached. A released model resumed under its own loss reaches that optimum on its training data within a few hundred updates and stays overconfident on unseen frames. A power law with two constants per backbone and dataset corrects the overall magnitude of the predicted uncertainty and leaves the ranking untouched. What no rescaling reaches is the scene, which we attribute to the model's missing knowledge of scale across predictions. Every correction we tried is close to right on average and still leaves two thirds of held-out scenes outside a five-point band, because what a scene is missing is a shape rather than a shift. We release the audit protocol, its results, and the fitted constants per model and dataset. Fitted with the target dataset held out, the constants bring the median case from 2.4x off to 1.35x, and a refit on a few labelled scenes of that dataset reaches 1.12x.

</details>


### [125] [XDG: Accelerated Visual Disambiguation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29733)
*Gonglin Chen,Ben Southall,Hanyuan Xiao,Wenbin Teng,Haolin Xiong,Tianwen Fu,Junyi Ouyang,Kshitij Singh Minhas,Supun Samarasekera,Rakesh Kumar,Yajie Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: XDG是一种高效的视觉消歧模型，用于大规模结构从运动中解决视觉别名（doppelganger）问题。它利用3D基础模型Depth Anything 3已有的跨视图几何推理能力，通过轻量级LoRA适配器微调，并将相机token重新用作配对级分类token，使用紧凑MLP头预测图像对是否观测同一3D表面。相比现有方法，XDG在保持竞争力的同时实现了超过3倍的推理加速，在LaMAR场景中节省超过10小时的处理时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉别名（视觉相似但物理不同的表面）会导致错误的图像匹配并降低SfM重建质量。现有方法虽然使用几何感知的基础模型特征来缓解该问题，但在骨干网络上叠加了重型Transformer分类器，使得大规模消歧计算代价高昂。

Method: 关键洞察：3D基础模型已经具备跨视图几何推理能力，因此消歧应直接适配骨干网络表示，而非在独立的重量级解码器中重新学习配对推理。具体做法：用轻量级LoRA适配器微调Depth Anything 3，将其相机token重新用作紧凑的配对级分类token，通过紧凑MLP头判断图像对是否观测同一3D表面。

Result: XDG在成对及重建基准上与最先进的消歧方法保持竞争力，同时实现超过3倍的推理加速。在包含数千张图像的单个LaMAR场景中，XDG节省了超过10小时的视觉消歧处理时间。

Conclusion: XDG证明了直接适配3D基础模型表示而非构建重型解码器，可以在保持消歧精度的同时实现高效的大规模SfM视觉消歧，提供了有利的精度-效率权衡。

Abstract: Visual aliasing, also known as the doppelganger problem, remains a key challenge for structure-from-motion (SfM): visually similar but physically distinct surfaces can produce incorrect image matches and degrade reconstruction quality. Previous work mitigates this issue with geometry-aware foundation-model features, but places a heavy transformer classifier on top of the backbone, making large-scale disambiguation expensive. We introduce XDG, an efficient visual disambiguation model designed for scalable SfM. Our key observation is that a 3D foundation model already performs the cross-view geometric reasoning necessary for visual disambiguation, so doppelganger classification should adapt the backbone representation directly rather than relearn pair reasoning in a separate heavy decoder. XDG fine-tunes Depth Anything 3 with lightweight LoRA adapters and repurposes its camera tokens as compact pair-level classification tokens. A compact MLP head predicts whether a candidate image pair observes the same 3D surface. Extensive experiments show that XDG provides a favorable accuracy-efficiency tradeoff: it remains competitive with the state-of-the-art disambiguation method across pairwise and reconstruction benchmarks and delivers more than a 3x inference speedup. On individual LaMAR scenes containing thousands of images, XDG saves more than 10 hours of visual disambiguation processing. Code is available at https://github.com/xtcpete/xdg.

</details>


### [126] [Drift Calibration in Geometric Eye Tracking Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29739)
*Jiaqi Liu,Zixuan Wang,Yuhong Zhang,Dingkang Liang,Jane Hanqi Li,Tzyy-Ping Jung,Gert Cauwenberghs*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个聚焦于校准的数据集（包含12名参与者、163次试验，分别使用18点拟合和32点测试网格），并在统一的空间外推协议下评估了全局、局部和复合校正函数。作者还引入了一个轻量级神经精化器，整合多个互补校准器的排序预测。在受控数据集上，后厂商校正使平均角度误差从1.53°降至1.03°（最强经典复合方法）和0.96°（精化器）。在闭环注视任务中，较低的残差误差与更高的性能相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 几何眼动追踪器虽能提供注视交互所需的空间精度，但其测量结果仍受残余的会话特定校准误差影响。现有研究因使用不同设备、目标布局和误差定义而难以比较，缺乏统一的数据集和评估协议来公正评价各种校正方法。

Method: 构建了一个校准聚焦数据集，包含163次试验和12名参与者，采用分离的18点拟合网格与32点测试网格；在此数据集上以统一的空间外推协议评估全局、局部及复合校正函数；引入轻量级神经精化器，融合多个互补校准器的排序预测。

Result: 在受控数据集上，厂商后校正将平均角度误差从1.53°降至1.03°（最强经典复合校正）及0.96°（神经精化器）。在闭环注视任务中，四种在线校正条件下，残差误差越低对应性能越高。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一个可复现的数据质量基准，有助于将注视作为交互建模中的行为信号使用，并证明神经精化器能进一步优于经典复合校正方法。

Abstract: Geometric eye trackers can provide the spatial accuracy required for gaze-based interaction and multimodal studies, but their measurements remain sensitive to residual session-specific calibration error. Research on correcting this error is difficult to compare because methods are typically evaluated with different devices, target layouts, and error definitions. We present a calibration-focused dataset containing 163 trials from 12 participants, with separate 18-point fitting and 32-point test grids, and use it to evaluate global, local, and composite correction functions under a common spatial-extrapolation protocol. We further introduce a lightweight neural refiner that combines ranked predictions from complementary calibrators. On this controlled dataset, post-vendor correction reduces the mean angular error from $1.53^\circ$ to $1.03^\circ$ with the strongest classical composite and to $0.96^\circ$ with the refiner. In a closed-loop gaze task, lower residual error is associated with higher performance across four online correction conditions. These results provide a reproducible data-quality benchmark for using gaze as a behavioral signal in interactive modeling.

</details>


### [127] [SynCrash: A Multi-Stage Pipeline for Zero-Shot Accident Detection and Localization in Traffic Surveillance Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29759)
*Arkya Jyoti Bagchi,Ritul Jangir,Varun Raskar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SynCrash是一个用于固定视角CCTV视频中零样本事故检测、空间定位和碰撞类型分类的多阶段流水线，针对CVPR 2026 ACCIDENT挑战赛设计。该流水线由三个解耦阶段组成：基于VideoMAEv2-giant骨干网络和CARLA合成数据的时序定位、基于YOLO和物理启发式混合规则的空间定位、以及基于车辆数量与配置的轻量级碰撞类型分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该论文旨在解决零样本事故检测问题——在不使用标注真实数据的情况下，同时预测事故发生的时间、空间位置（碰撞点）和碰撞类型。其核心动机是探索如何通过合成数据训练和预训练模型的知识迁移来替代对真实标注数据的依赖。

Method: 方法包含三个解耦阶段：(1) 时序定位：采用VideoMAEv2-giant骨干网络，在CARLA合成视频上微调，结合元数据感知嵌入和密集滑动窗口推理；(2) 空间定位：使用YOLO进行目标检测，结合基于边界框重叠和轨迹推理的物理启发式混合规则来预测碰撞点；(3) 碰撞类型分类：基于检测到车辆的数量和配置，采用轻量级规则驱动策略。

Result: 论文未在摘要中提供具体数值结果，但提出了关键洞察：时序理解受益于合成数据的监督微调，而空间理解更适合使用预训练目标检测器和可跨域迁移的物理先验。

Conclusion: SynCrash的核心贡献在于展示了一种混合策略——将合成数据驱动的时序模型与基于预训练检测器和物理规则的免训练空间模型相结合，从而在无需真实标注数据的情况下实现完整的事故分析管线。其设计理念认为不同任务需求应匹配不同的数据与模型策略。

Abstract: We present SynCrash, a multi-stage pipeline for zero-shot accident detection, spatial localization, and collision-type classification in fixed-view CCTV surveillance video. Our approach addresses the ACCIDENT at CVPR 2026 Challenge, which requires predicting when an accident occurs, where in the frame the impact happens, and what type of collision it is, all without access to labeled real-world training data. The pipeline operates in three decoupled stages: (1) Temporal localization via a VideoMAEv2-giant backbone fine-tuned on CARLA-based synthetic clips with metadata-aware embeddings and dense sliding-window inference; (2) Spatial localization using YOLO for object detection combined with a physics-informed hybrid heuristic that leverages bounding-box overlap and trajectory-based reasoning to predict the impact point; and (3) Collision-type classification using a lightweight rule-based strategy derived from the number and configuration of detected vehicles. The key insight is that temporal understanding benefits from supervised fine-tuning on synthetic data, whereas spatial understanding is better served by pretrained object detectors and physics priors that transfer naturally across domains.

</details>


### [128] [InspectorGPT: A Comparative Reasoning Enhanced VLM for Comprehensive Industrial Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29783)
*Weifei Chen,Honghao Zhang,Zhiyuan You,Xinyi Le*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出InspectorGPT，一种基于比较推理的VLM框架，通过将查询图像与无缺陷参考图像对比来进行工业异常检测。采用CoT微调和GRPO强化学习内化比较推理能力，并通过任务向量融合将分割分支与推理分支分开训练，实现像素级异常分割与语义推理的兼顾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统无监督方法依赖正常特征分布建模，泛化性受限；现有VLM零样本方法存在推理微调导致异常判别能力崩塌的问题，且仅提供文本决策或粗糙框，缺乏像素级分割。人类检测异常的本质是将查询图像与无缺陷参考进行对比，现有方法未充分利用这一显式原则。

Method: 1）构建InspectorGPT框架，输入为正常参考图像和查询图像，通过比较推理识别差异并执行多项检测任务；2）使用Chain-of-Thought微调和GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）配合定制可验证奖励来内化比较推理能力；3）引入InspectorGPT-Seg分支生成像素级异常掩码；4）将推理分支与分割分支分离训练，通过任务向量融合（task-vector fusion）结合二者以避免联合训练中的能力失衡。

Result: 广泛实验表明InspectorGPT在多维性能上表现优越，且对未见过基准具有良好泛化能力，验证了比较推理在全面工业检测中的有效性。

Conclusion: 比较推理是一种更显式且有效的工业异常检测原则，通过参考对比、分离训练与任务向量融合，可以实现语义推理和像素级分割的兼顾，为全面工业检测提供了新范式。

Abstract: Industrial anomaly detection is a critical component of modern manufacturing. Most traditional unsupervised methods rely on modelling normal feature distributions, inherently limiting generalization to unknown categories. To improve generalizability, some recent methods incorporate vision-language models (VLMs) for zero-shot detection via text prompts. However, we observe that reasoning-oriented post-training can cause anomaly discrimination to collapse, with some fine-tuned models performing worse than their base VLMs. Existing methods also provide only textual decisions or coarse boxes, without pixel-level segmentation. A more explicit detection principle comes from human inspection: anomalies are identified by comparing a query image with a defect-free reference. Inspired by this, we propose InspectorGPT, a VLM framework centered on comparative reasoning. Given a normal reference and a query image, InspectorGPT compares them to identify discrepancies and perform multiple inspection tasks with detailed reasoning. We internalize this capability through Chain-of-Thought (CoT) fine-tuning and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with tailored, verifiable rewards. We further introduce InspectorGPT-Seg for pixel-level anomaly masks. Segmentation supervision improves anomaly discrimination but weakens semantic reasoning, while joint training fails to balance them. We therefore train the two branches separately and combine them through task-vector fusion. Extensive experiments demonstrate superior multi-dimensional performance and generalization to unseen benchmarks, validating comparative reasoning for comprehensive industrial inspection.

</details>


### [129] [GridFlow: Structured Latent Flow for Seamless City-Scale 3D Point Cloud Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29793)
*Xinyu Wang,Muhammad Ibrahim,Atif Mansoor,Ajmal Mian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个多阶段框架，用于从卫星图像、语义分割图和数字表面模型(DSM)等遥感数据生成城市尺度的稠密彩色点云，解决了现有方法无法处理城市级规模、无缝拼接和部分可观测性等挑战。该方法通过Grid-Aligned VAE保持空间拓扑一致性，利用条件整流流模型生成几何潜在表示，并采用方向感知扩散模型分别处理可见水平面和遮挡垂直立面。同时引入City3D-MultiGen基准数据集（来自墨尔本和伦敦的163K个标注tile），实验证明该方法在所有几何指标上优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的点云生成方法局限于单一物体或有界室内场景，无法应对城市级生成中面临的规模庞大、无缝tile拼接和部分可观测性等独特挑战。需要一种能够生成大规模、无边界、颜色丰富的城市点云生成方法。

Method: 提出多阶段框架：1) Grid-Aligned VAE将每个tile编码为保持拓扑结构的潜在网格，token对应固定空间区域，实现空间连贯的多模态条件和紧凑的潜在空间边缘一致性；2) 条件整流流模型从融合的多模态条件合成几何潜在表示；3) 方向感知扩散颜色器分别处理卫星可见的水平面和被遮挡的垂直立面。

Result: 在City3D-MultiGen基准（163K个详细标注tile）上的实验表明，该方法在所有几何指标上优于适配的点云生成基线，能生成具有无缝边界、视觉连贯的彩色点云，可覆盖任意大的城市范围。

Conclusion: 该研究展示了利用Grid-Aligned VAE和条件流模型结合多模态遥感条件实现城市尺度无缝点云生成的可行性与有效性，并通过公开基准数据集推动了该领域的标准化评估。

Abstract: Generating realistic 3D city environments from remote sensing data is important for simulation, urban planning, and mixed reality, yet existing point cloud generation methods are limited to single objects or bounded indoor scenes and cannot handle the scale, seamless tiling, and partial observability challenges of city-scale generation. We present \ours{}, a multi-stage framework that generates dense, colored point clouds ($10^5$ points per $150\text{m}{\times}150\text{m}$ tile) at city scale, conditioned on satellite imagery, semantic segmentation maps, and digital surface models (DSM). A \emph{Grid-Aligned VAE} encodes each tile into a topology-preserving latent grid where tokens correspond to fixed spatial regions, enabling spatially coherent multi-modal conditioning and compact latent-space edge consistency that implicitly aligns thousands of boundary points for seamless cross-tile generation. A conditional rectified flow model synthesizes geometry latents from the fused multi-modal conditions, and an orientation-aware diffusion colorizer separately handles satellite-visible horizontal surfaces and occluded vertical façades. To support standardized evaluation, we build on public 3D data sources to introduce \emph{City3D-MultiGen}, a benchmark of $163$K densely annotated tiles from Melbourne and London with aligned point clouds, satellite images, semantic maps, and elevation data. Experiments show that \ours{} outperforms adapted point cloud generation baselines across all geometry metrics and produces visually coherent colored point clouds with seamless boundaries over arbitrarily large urban extents. Our benchmark details are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/e32/City3D-MultiGen

</details>


### [130] [Source-Dependent Deference in Medical Imaging Agents Under Falsified Findings: A Pilot Audit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29800)
*Ridam Roy,Md Shahriar Rashid,Md. Rajib Mia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文审计了医学影像工具调用智能体在收到虚假发现时的行为，发现当错误发现以放射科医生引述的散文形式呈现时，智能体的遵从率远高于工具返回的JSON格式（最强模型档位下13例中10例修改答案vs 13例中1例），揭示了来源标签和传递渠道的联合不对称性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具使用智能体正被应用于医学影像领域，但其在工具返回错误结果时的行为尚未被充分测量。作者希望了解ReAct风格的工具调用智能体在收到伪造发现后是否会放弃已给出的正确答案，以及这种放弃是否取决于发现的呈现方式。

Method: 在20个VQA-RAD闭卷问题上，对四个厂商指定模型档位进行审计。智能体先仅凭图像给出答案，然后否定性发现以两种方式送达：一是智能体自行调用analyze_image工具的JSON返回，二是归因于放射科医生的引用散文。以无需工具即答对的病例中的委托错误率为结局指标。

Result: 散文归因声称下的遵从率远高于工具格式：最强档位下，智能体在13例中修订了10个正确答案（工具格式下仅13例中1例），精确McNemar检验p=0.0039，Holm校正后为0.012。

Conclusion: 发现是来源与传递渠道的联合不对称性，来自一个小规模试点研究，其预先指定的停止规则未达到。作者并未声称隔离了来源标签，因为归因与传递渠道在设计中绑定，且工具声称仅在智能体调用工具时才到达。

Abstract: Tool-using agents are being proposed for medical imaging, and their behaviour when a tool returns a false finding is largely unmeasured. We audit whether a ReAct-style tool-calling agent abandons an answer it has already given correctly once a falsified finding arrives, and whether that depends on how the finding is presented. On 20 VQA-RAD closed questions across four vendor-designated model tiers, the agent commits to an answer from the image alone; a negated finding is then delivered either as JSON from an analyze_image tool the agent invokes itself, or as quoted prose attributed to a radiologist. Our outcome is the commission-error rate over cases answered correctly without any tool. Deference is much higher under the prose-attributed claim: at the strongest tier the agent revised its correct answer in 10 of 13 cases against 1 of 13 under the tool (exact McNemar p=0.0039, Holm-adjusted 0.012). We do not claim this isolates the source label. Attribution travels with the delivery channel in our design, and exposure differs because the tool claim reaches the agent only when it calls the tool. The finding is a joint source-and-delivery asymmetry from a small-scale pilot whose pre-specified stopping rule was not met.

</details>


### [131] [Foundation and Multimodal Large Language Models for Face Presentation and Morph Attack Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29802)
*Hatef Otroshi Shahreza,Asif Hussain Khan,Peter Lorenz,Alain Komaty,Sébastien Marcel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了通用基础模型（FMs）和多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在人脸呈现攻击检测（PAD）和变形攻击检测（MAD）中的能力，提出了五种不同内部信息访问程度的部署方法，包括零样本提示、logit概率浅层训练、参数高效微调（生成专门的PADLLM和MADLLM）、线性探测以及视觉编码器微调。在四个PAD数据集和四个MAD数据集上对16个MLLMs和30个视觉编码器进行了基准测试，结果表明微调模型在跨数据集评估中达到最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PAD和MAD检测器在跨数据集评估中泛化能力有限且性能退化，需要探索能否利用通用基础模型和多模态大语言模型来提升这两项人脸生物识别安全任务的检测性能。

Method: 提出五种不同模型内部信息访问层次的部署方法：(i) 现成MLLM的零样本提示；(ii) 在MLLM输出的next-token logit概率上训练浅层模型；(iii) 在任务特定问答数据上进行参数高效微调，得到PADLLM和MADLLM并提供文本推理；(iv) 对冻结视觉编码器进行线性探测；(v) 微调FM和MLLM的视觉编码器。实验覆盖16个开源MLLMs和30个视觉编码器骨干网络。

Result: 实验表明FMs和MLLMs在PAD和MAD上均能取得显著性能。微调后的模型在跨数据集评估中达到最先进的检测性能，表明通用预训练表示携带了大量攻击相关信息。

Conclusion: 通用基础模型和多模态大语言模型能够有效用于人脸呈现攻击检测和变形攻击检测，微调后的模型实现了跨数据集的SOTA性能，且代码将公开释放。

Abstract: Face recognition systems are increasingly deployed in security-critical applications, yet they remain vulnerable to presentation and morph attacks. Presentation attack detection (PAD) and morphing attack detection (MAD) are therefore essential components of trustworthy face biometrics. Despite advancements in PAD and MAD methods, existing detectors suffer from limited generalization and degrade in cross-dataset evaluation. In this paper, we systematically investigate whether general-purpose foundation models (FMs) and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) encode PAD-relevant and MAD-relevant information, and how such models can best be deployed for both tasks. We study five approaches with increasing access to the internal information of the model: (i) zero-shot prompting of off-the-shelf MLLMs; (ii) training a shallow model on the next-token logit probabilities at the output of the MLLM; (iii) parameter-efficient fine-tuning on task-specific question-answer data, yielding two specialized MLLMs, called PADLLM and MADLLM, which additionally provide textual reasoning for their decisions; (iv) linear probing of frozen vision encoders; and (v) fine-tuning of vision encoders of FMs and MLLMs. We benchmark 16 open-weight MLLMs and 30 vision encoder backbones on four PAD datasets (MSU-MFSD, CASIA-FASD, Replay-Attack, and OULU-NPU) and four MAD datasets (FFHQ, FRGC, FRLL, and FERET). Our experiments show that FMs and MLLMs can achieve significant performance for PAD and MAD. In addition, the fine-tuned models achieve state-of-the-art detection performance in cross-dataset evaluation, indicating that general-purpose pretrained representations carry substantial attack-relevant information. Source code of all our experiments will be publicly released.

</details>


### [132] [Beyond Global Realism: Virtual Try-On Evaluation and Optimization with Dimension-wise Garment Fidelity Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29804)
*Kaidong Zhang,Yukang Ding,Xiaoyu Liu,Ying Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DAT（Dimension-wise Assessment framework for virtual Try-on），一个将虚拟试穿中服装一致性分解为七个可解释维度的评估框架，并通过两阶段学习范式训练评估模型，同时可集成到强化学习优化中作为奖励信号指导VTON生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VTON评估指标（PSNR、SSIM、KID、FID）无法有效衡量生成服装与参考服装之间的一致性，特别是在捕捉服装保真度的多维特征方面存在不足。

Method: 1) 将服装一致性分解为七个可解释维度：轮廓、颜色、领口与袖型、主要装饰与结构、材质纹理、细节保真度、logo保留，每个维度建模为离散属性级预测任务；2) 采用两阶段学习范式：50K样本的大规模弱监督学习 + 10K高质量标注（通过多模型投票获得）的精细化训练；3) 使用加权交叉熵损失缓解各评估维度间的标签不平衡问题；4) 将评估模型集成到Qwen-Image-Edit的强化学习优化中，自适应聚合维度级奖励以强调训练中欠优化的方面。

Result: DAT模型（8B参数）在平衡准确率、SROCC和PLCC指标上达到最先进性能，超越Gemini-3.1、Qwen3.7-plus和GPT-5.5等强专有模型，同时作为有效的优化信号指导奖励引导的VTON生成。

Conclusion: DAT不仅能作为更可靠的VTON评估框架，还能作为优化信号集成到生成模型的强化学习训练中，实现评估与生成的双向赋能。

Abstract: Virtual try-on (VTON) requires not only realistic generation but also faithful preservation of garment characteristics. However, existing evaluation metrics such as PSNR, SSIM, KID and FID struggle to measure the consistency between the generated and reference garments, particularly in capturing the multi-dimensional characteristics of garment fidelity. To address this, we propose DAT: a Dimension-wise Assessment framework for virtual Try-on, which decomposes garment consistency into seven interpretable dimensions: silhouette, color, neckline and sleeve shape, major decoration and structure, material texture, fine-detail fidelity, and logo preservation, each formulated as a discrete attribute-level prediction task. To train this specialized assessment model, we adopt a two-stage learning paradigm comprising large-scale weak supervision on 50K samples, followed by refinement on 10K higher-quality annotations obtained via multi-model voting. Furthermore, we employ weighted cross-entropy loss to mitigate the severe label imbalance inherent across evaluation dimensions. Beyond its role as an evaluation framework, the assessment model can be integrated into reinforcement learning optimization of Qwen-Image-Edit for VTON, where dimension-wise rewards are adaptively aggregated to emphasize under-optimized aspects during training. Experimental results show that our method (8B parameters) achieves state-of-the-art performance in terms of balanced accuracy, SROCC, and PLCC, outperforming strong proprietary models such as Gemini-3.1, Qwen3.7-plus, and GPT-5.5, while also serving as an effective optimization signal for reward-guided VTON generation

</details>


### [133] [RegionCache: Semantic-Aware Region Reuse for Efficient Multi-Turn Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29809)
*Peizheng Li,Xin Ai,Hanyuan Liu,Qiange Wang,Yanfeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RegionCache是一个面向多轮图像编辑的语义感知复用框架，通过检测连续提示词之间的语义重叠和交叉注意力定位，选择性复用未变化区域的扩散状态，避免重复计算，在PixArt-alpha上实现1.43x-2.55x的端到端加速并保持图像质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多轮图像编辑中用户通常只修改小区域而大部分内容保持不变，但现有的基于扩散Transformer（DiT）的编辑管线每轮都会重新计算整个图像，造成大量冗余计算。现有DiT加速方法忽略跨提示词的语义对应关系，导致不必要的重计算或产生损害编辑质量的不安全复用。

Method: 提出RegionCache框架，包含两个核心组件：1）通过连续提示词之间的语义重叠和交叉注意力定位来检测可重用区域；2）基于提示词相似性和上下文一致性采用自适应复用调度策略，选择性复用未变化区域的扩散状态。

Result: 在PixArt-alpha上实验表明，RegionCache实现了1.43x-2.55x的端到端加速，同时保持了可比的图像质量。

Conclusion: RegionCache证明通过语义感知的区域级状态复用可以有效加速多轮图像编辑，兼顾效率与质量，代码已开源。

Abstract: Real-world image generation often involves multi-turn editing, where users iteratively modify small regions while most image content remains unchanged. However, existing diffusion transformer (DiT)-based editing pipelines recompute the entire image at every turn, causing substantial redundant computation. Existing DiT acceleration methods further ignore semantic correspondence across prompts, leading to unnecessary recomputation or unsafe reuse that harms editing quality. To address this, we propose RegionCache, a semantic-aware reuse framework for multi-turn image editing that selectively reuses diffusion states from unchanged regions. RegionCache detects reusable regions through semantic overlap between consecutive prompts and cross-attention localization, and adopts an adaptive reuse schedule based on prompt similarity and contextual consistency. Experiments on PixArt-alpha demonstrate that RegionCache achieves 1.43x--2.55x end-to-end speedup while maintaining comparable image quality. Code is available at https://github.com/hebutBryant/RegionCache.

</details>


### [134] [PhasorNet: Learning Structure from Frequency for Real-Time Stereo Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29819)
*Md Raqib Khan,Santosh Kumar Vipparthi,Subrahmanyam Murala*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PhasorNet是一个轻量级但强大的立体匹配框架，通过频域线索增强几何判别能力。它提出了相位增强Transformer（PAT）将傅里叶相位信息注入注意力机制，以及几何上下文融合细化模块（GCFRM）结合全分辨率卷积流和轻量级注意力流来保留细节。采用多尺度边缘引导高误差区域（EHR）损失优化训练。仅5.3M参数即在ETH3D基准上达到最先进性能，并在KITTI上展现出优秀的跨域泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 立体匹配在病态区域（如精细结构、反射或透明物体）中因外观线索模糊或不可靠而具有挑战性，现有方法难以在这些区域实现准确匹配，因此需要利用频域线索增强几何判别力。

Method: 1) Phase-Augmented Transformer (PAT)：将傅里叶相位信息注入注意力机制，生成光度鲁棒、结构保持的特征；2) Geometry-Context Fusion Refinement Module (GCFRM)：融合全分辨率卷积流与轻量级注意力流（利用WQA和CDGA块），高效保留细节和物体边界；3) 多尺度Edge-guided High-Error Region (EHR)损失，自适应聚焦高误差和边缘区域的优化。

Result: 仅使用5.3M参数，PhasorNet在ETH3D基准上达到最先进性能，并在KITTI上展现出优秀的跨域泛化能力，实现高效准确的实时立体匹配。

Conclusion: 通过频域相位信息增强注意力机制，结合高效的多流细化模块和自适应损失函数，PhasorNet证明了轻量级模型也能在挑战性立体匹配场景中达到最先进性能，为实时立体匹配提供了实用解决方案。

Abstract: Accurate stereo matching remains challenging in ill-posed regions such as fine structures, reflective, or transparent objects, where appearance cues are often ambiguous or unreliable. To tackle this, we propose PhasorNet, a lightweight yet powerful framework that boosts geometric discrimination via frequency-domain cues. At its core, the Phase-Augmented Transformer (PAT) injects Fourier-derived phase information into the attention mechanism, yielding photometrically robust, structure-preserving features that prioritize structural consistency in difficult areas. Additionally, we develop a Geometry-Context Fusion Refinement Module (GCFRM) that combines a full-resolution convolutional stream with a lightweight attention-based stream (leveraging WQA and CDGA blocks) to efficiently preserve fine details and object boundaries without excessive overhead. Training is further enhanced by a multi-scale Edge-guided High-Error Region (EHR) loss that adaptively focuses optimization on high-error and edge regions, guiding hierarchical cost volume refinement. With only 5.3M parameters, PhasorNet achieves state-of-the-art performance on the challenging ETH3D benchmark while exhibiting excellent cross-domain generalization on KITTI, delivering an efficient and practical solution for accurate real-time stereo matching.

</details>


### [135] [Null-Space Diffusion Restoration with Adaptive Uncertainty-Guided Fusion for Ultrasound Speckle Reduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29820)
*Juneyong Lee,Jaeyoung Choi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无标签的超声图像去斑方法UGNS（不确定性引导的零空间扩散框架），通过在稳定的正包络域中进行一致性校正，解决了监督学习的地面真值悖论和现有无监督扩散方法在非线性对数压缩域中的局限性。实验表明UGNS在PICMUS基准和体内数据集上取得了有竞争力的gCNR值，同时有效抑制散斑噪声并保持空间分辨率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超声B模式成像常受散斑噪声和伪影影响，需要平衡对比度、分辨率和结构保真度。监督学习方法因缺少体内无噪声参考图像而存在地面真值悖论；现有无监督扩散方法直接在对数压缩域执行数据一致性约束，映射回包络域时会不成比例地放大背景伪影。

Method: 提出UGNS框架，主要包含三个技术创新：(a)在稳定包络域提取结构先验以生成鲁棒信号包络；(b)开发自适应范围-零空间重建机制，利用自适应权重掩码通过范围空间投影保留组织区域；(c)引入自适应不确定性引导融合以减少采样变异性。核心思路是在逆对数压缩获得的稳定正包络代理上进行一致性校正。

Result: 在PICMUS基准和体内数据集上的广泛对比实验表明，UGNS在不同数据集上取得了有竞争力的广义对比噪声比（gCNR）值，并成功验证了其能有效抑制散斑噪声同时保持精细空间分辨率。

Conclusion: UGNS作为无标签解决方案，有效克服了监督学习的局限性和现有无监督方法的域不匹配问题，为超声图像去噪提供了一种新的范式，代码已开源。

Abstract: Ultrasound B-mode imaging commonly suffers from speckle noise and artifacts, requiring a delicate balance between contrast, resolution, and preservation of anatomical structures. Although recently developed despeckling methods have achieved some progress, supervised learning approaches remain fundamentally limited by the ground truth paradox, which arises from the absence of noise-free, ground truth reference images in in vivo scenarios. Existing unsupervised diffusion-based methods typically enforce data consistency directly in the nonlinear log-compressed domain, which can disproportionately amplify background artifacts when mapped back to the envelope domain. To overcome these limitations, we propose an uncertainty-guided null-space diffusion (UGNS) framework, a novel label-free solution that enforces consistency correction on a stabilized positive-envelope proxy obtained via inverse log compression. The proposed UGNS introduces several technical novelties: (a) extraction of a structural prior in the stabilized envelope domain to produce a robust signal envelope that preserves anatomical structure, (b) development of an adaptive range-null reconstruction mechanism that uses an adaptive weight mask to preserve tissue regions via range-space projection, and (c) introduction of uncertainty-guided fusion in an adaptive way to mitigate sampling variability. Extensive and comparative experiments were conducted using the PICMUS benchmark and in vivo datasets. The results demonstrate that UGNS achieves competitive generalized contrast-to-noise ratio (gCNR) values across diverse datasets. In addition, it is successfully validated that UGNS effectively suppresses speckle noise while preserving fine spatial resolution. Code is available at https://github.com/yousirong/UGNS.git.

</details>


### [136] [ContextBias: Controlled Evaluation of Bias Persistence Under Context Shift in Text-to-Image Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29847)
*Shaghayegh Kolli,Sina Emami,Moreno D'Incà,Pouyan Nejadi,Nicu Sebe,Massimiliano Mancini,Jana Diesner*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ContextBias评估框架和ContextBench基准（含92个职业角色、1,656个语义受控提示），用于研究文本到图像模型中职业角色视觉关联的稳定性和对上下文变化的敏感性。通过对4个先进模型生成66,240张图像的评估，发现角色放入语义无关的上下文中并不会抑制角色关联属性，反而会提高跨角色属性集中度（合并BI +0.047），人口统计线索、特征服饰和角色专用工具在无上下文、相关和不相关条件下都高度普遍，且对语义提示改写具有鲁棒性。场景构图和镜头取景则表现出最大的上下文敏感性。这揭示了上下文无关评估中不可见的刻板印象持久性，强调了偏差基准测试中需要受控上下文变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本到图像模型将职业角色与视觉属性相关联，从而产生刻板印象偏差。目前关键悬而未决的问题是：这些关联是否稳定，还是会在不同提示上下文中发生变化？现有评估大多缺乏受控的上下文变化，难以揭示上下文敏感性对偏差的影响。

Method: 提出ContextBias：一个受控评估框架；提出ContextBench：涵盖92个角色和1,656个语义受控提示的基准，用于隔离上下文变化对角色关联视觉表征的影响。在4个最先进模型上评估66,240张生成图像，比较无上下文、相关和不相关三种条件下的角色关联属性表现。

Result: 将角色置于语义无关上下文不会抑制角色关联属性；跨角色属性集中度反而增加（合并BI +0.047）。人口统计线索、特征服饰和角色专用工具在三种条件下高度普遍且鲁棒。场景构图和镜头取景对上下文最敏感。

Conclusion: 发现一种上下文无关评估中不可见的刻板印象持久性形式，强调需要在偏差基准测试中加入受控上下文变化，以更全面地捕捉模型中的刻板印象偏差。

Abstract: Text-to-image models learn associations between concepts - in the case of this paper, people's professions, which we refer to as roles - and visual attributes. These associations can underpin many observed forms of stereotypical bias. A key open question in this area is whether these associations are stable or change when visual representations of people in professional roles are placed in different prompted contexts. We introduce ContextBias, a controlled evaluation framework, and ContextBench, a benchmark spanning 92 roles and 1,656 semantically controlled prompts, designed to isolate the effect of contextual variation on role-linked visual representations. Evaluating four state-of-the-art models on 66,240 generated images, we find that placing a role in a semantically unrelated context does not suppress role-linked attributes; instead, cross-role attribute concentration increases (pooled BI $+0.047$). Demographic cues, characteristic garments, and role-specific tools remain highly prevalent across context-free, related, and unrelated conditions, and are robust to semantic prompt reformulation. Scene composition and camera framing show the greatest context-sensitivity. These findings reveal a form of stereotypical persistence that remains largely invisible to context-free evaluations, highlighting the need for controlled contextual variation in bias benchmarking. Code and dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/shaghayegh/ContextBias , https://github.com/Sina-Emami/ContextBias

</details>


### [137] [MariSat: A Maritime Dataset for Instance Segmentation of Objects in Satellite and Aerial Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29852)
*Amir Abbes,Ines Harrabi,Lucas Justin Yirepoa Kinda,Rim Trabelsi,Adnane Cabani,Fatma Abdelkefi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了 MariSat，一个包含 1260 幅航空和卫星图像的海上目标实例分割基准数据集，涵盖港口和海岸场景，对八类海上目标（帆船、游艇、摩托艇、渔船、游轮、军舰、拖船和货船）进行了像素级标注。数据集通过结合 SAM 3 文本提示分割模型与几何和比色后处理滤波器的半自动标注流程生成，并辅以 CVAT 平台的人工校正。作者还报告了数据集统计结果，并展示了其在 SAM 3 和 YOLO11 模型上的微调与基准测试结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动海上监视需要大规模、精确标注的数据集，但现有的实例分割任务数据集稀缺，尤其是对于拥挤港口环境下的小型船只的像素级标注。作者旨在填补这一空白，提供一个高质量、公开可用的海事分割基准。

Method: 数据集构建采用半自动标注流程：(1) 使用 SAM 3 文本提示分割模型进行初始分割；(2) 级联几何和比色后处理滤波器进行筛选和优化；(3) 使用 CVAT 平台进行人工校正和质量控制。数据集包含 1260 幅覆盖多样化港口和海岸场景的图像，按 8 个海事类别进行像素级标注，并划分为训练、验证和测试集。

Result: MariSat 数据集已完成构建并公开提供，包含分类统计的训练/验证/测试划分。该数据集已用于微调和基准测试分割与检测模型（SAM 3 和 YOLO11），作者报告了两项任务的详细定量和逐类结果。

Conclusion: MariSat 填补了海事实例分割领域缺乏大规模、精细标注公共数据集的空白，验证了半自动标注流程的有效性，并为实时海事监控的分割和检测模型提供了可靠的评测基准。

Abstract: Automated maritime surveillance from satellite and aerial imagery requires large, precisely annotated datasets, which remain scarce for the instance-segmentation task, particularly for small vessels in cluttered port environments. We present MariSat, a new benchmark dataset of 1260 aerial and satellite images covering diverse port and coastal scenes, annotated at the pixel level for eight maritime object classes (sailboat, yacht, jet-ski, fishing boat, cruise ship, military vessel, tugboat and cargo ship). The dataset was produced through a semi-automatic annotation pipeline combining the textpromptable segmentation model SAM 3 with a cascade of geometric and colorimetric post-processing filters, followed by a manual correction and quality-control pass performed with the CVAT annotation platform. We describe the image-collection methodology, the annotation and correction process, and the resulting data organization. We also report class-wise statistics for the training, validation, and test splits. MariSat has already been used to fine-tune and benchmark segmentation and detection models (SAM 3 and YOLO11) for real-time maritime monitoring. We report detailed quantitative and per-class results for both tasks. The MariSat dataset is publicly available on GitHub : https://github.com/amirabbes/P2M-Maritime-Segmentation

</details>


### [138] [OptiGeo: Efficient Monocular Geometry for Embodied Perception in Optically Challenging Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29881)
*Muxin Liu,Tianbo Liu,Jing Xia,Xiaoyang Lyu,Xiaoshan Wu,Bo Wang,Peng Dai,Zhongrui Wang,Shaoshuai Shi,Xiaojuan Qi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出OptiGeo，一种偏差感知的训练框架，通过清洁几何教师和残差修剪对齐来修复有偏的真实深度监督，解决单目深度估计在透明、反射和镜面环境中的失效问题。仅用30M参数即可超越300M级单目模型和十亿级多视角基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单目深度估计在透明、反射和镜面环境中存在传感器深度缺失或有偏的问题。现有方法依赖场景特定预处理、辅助模块或事后微调，导致架构冗余且过度特化。作者识别出传感器诱导的监督偏差是瓶颈：模型从有偏的真实深度监督中继承了光学困难区域的传感器失效模式。

Method: OptiGeo采用偏差感知训练框架：(1) 使用清洁几何教师来修复有偏的真实深度监督；(2) 通过残差修剪对齐来正确处理监督信号；(3) 将透明目标渲染重新定义为一个紧凑的清洁光学几何来源，而非大规模领域特定微调集。仅需小规模定向渲染集即可学习透明物体的几何结构，纠正真实传感器无法可靠监督的局部几何畸变。

Result: 仅30M参数的OptiGeo在透明场景基准上超越了300M级单目模型和十亿级多视角基线，同时在通用零样本深度估计和边界锐度上保持竞争力。真实世界导航实验验证了其在光学挑战场景中的实用性。

Conclusion: OptiGeo证明了将光学失效视为基础模型训练中的局部失效模式、并利用小规模清洁渲染几何修复监督偏差的有效性。该方法以极小参数量实现了对透明场景的高效感知，同时保持通用模型的泛化能力，为机器人部署提供了实用的感知模块方案。

Abstract: Monocular depth estimation has achieved strong open-domain generalization, yet reliable robotic deployment remains difficult in transparent, reflective, and specular environments, where depth sensors often produce missing or biased depth. Existing methods often handle such optical failures with scene-specific preprocessing, auxiliary modules, or post-hoc fine-tuning. While effective in constrained settings, these designs increase architectural redundancy and can over-specialize general geometry models to narrow optical scenarios. We revisit this problem as a localized failure mode within base-model training and identify sensor-induced supervision bias as a key bottleneck: models inherit sensor failure patterns from biased real-depth supervision in optically challenging regions. We then introduce OptiGeo, a bias-aware training framework that rehabilitates biased real supervision using a clean-geometry teacher and residual-trimmed alignment. We redefine transparency-targeted rendering as a compact source of clean optical geometry, rather than a large domain-specific fine-tuning set. With only a small targeted rendering set, OptiGeo learns the geometric structure of transparent objects and regions, correcting local geometry distortions that real sensors cannot reliably supervise. Despite only 30M parameters, OptiGeo outperforms substantially larger 300M-scale monocular models and billion-scale multi-view baselines on transparent-scene benchmarks, while remaining competitive on general zero-shot depth and boundary sharpness. Real-world navigation cases further validate its practicality as an efficient perception module in optically challenging scenes.

</details>


### [139] [MASQ: Mask-Aware Spatiotemporal Quantization for Unsupervised Skeleton Action Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29891)
*Xinyao Qin,Linxiang Peng,Youbao Ye,Di Yang,Jiangtao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MASQ框架，用于无监督骨架时序动作分割。通过解耦空间特征推断与时间平滑两个冲突任务，引入关节级结构化丢弃（JLSD）和掩码感知速度损失，解决空间掩码导致的表征模糊和离散量化导致的时序抖动问题。在三个骨架数据集上显著超越现有SOTA方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无监督骨架时序动作分割中，空间掩码表征学习会引入表征模糊性，而离散量化会放大潜在空间中的小波动，两者交互导致动作边界附近的代码切换不稳定和严重时序抖动。

Method: 1) 提出掩码感知动作时空量化（MASQ）框架，解耦空间特征推断与时间平滑两个冲突任务；2) 空间维度引入关节级结构化丢弃（JLSD），掩蔽选定关节的完整时间轨迹，鼓励学习判别性关节间协调模式；3) 时间维度设计掩码感知速度损失，仅对可见关节强制执行运动一致性，防止掩码信号引起的梯度冲突并稳定时序预测。

Result: 在HuGaDB、LARa和BABEL三个广泛使用的骨架数据集上，MASQ框架显著优于现有最先进的无监督方法，尤其在Mean over Frames准确率上建立了全面且实质性的领先优势。

Conclusion: 通过解耦空间与时间维度的学习目标，并针对性地设计掩码策略，MASQ有效解决了无监督骨架动作分割中表征模糊和时序抖动的问题，验证了所提方法的有效性和泛化能力。

Abstract: Unsupervised skeleton-based temporal action segmentation is a crucial task for understanding human behavior in long untrimmed sequences. Recent approaches often rely on discrete quantization to discover action boundaries from motion representations. However, when spatial masking is introduced for representation learning, it can introduce representation ambiguity, while discrete quantization further amplifies small fluctuations in the latent space. The interaction between these two factors often leads to unstable code switching and severe temporal jitter near action boundaries.To address these limitations, we propose a novel Mask-aware Action Spatiotemporal Quantization (MASQ) framework. Our framework decouples the conflicting tasks of spatial feature inference and temporal smoothing.In the spatial dimension, we introduce a Joint-Level Structured Dropout (JLSD) mechanism that masks the entire temporal trajectory of selected joints, to encourage the model to learn discriminative inter-joint coordination patterns. In the temporal dimension, we design a mask-aware velocity loss that enforces motion consistency only on visible joints, that prevents gradient conflicts caused by masked signals and stabilizing temporal predictions. Extensive experiments on three widely used skeleton datasets, including HuGaDB, LARa, and BABEL, demonstrate that the proposed MASQ framework significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art unsupervised methods. In particular, our model establishes a comprehensive and substantial leading advantage in the Mean over Frames accuracy.

</details>


### [140] [Off-Manifold Refinement: Guiding Video Generators with a Frozen World Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29904)
*Hai Nguyen-Truong,Tuan-Anh Vu,Dang Huynh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Off-Manifold Refinement (OMR)，一种推理时方法，通过在单次采样轨迹中注入世界模型（V-JEPA 2.1）的梯度反馈来提升视频生成的物理一致性，在VideoPhy-2上物理指标绝对提升5.0pp，推理开销仅为基础采样的1.71倍，且生成器和世界模型均保持冻结。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代视频生成器在物理动态方面经常失败（物体漂浮、轨迹违反重力、接触消失）。标准的去噪和流匹配目标只拟合视觉数据分布，不显式惩罚物理违规。现有解决方案（候选选择、世界模型引导、内部精炼、后训练）要么增加大量推理/训练成本，要么需要 curated 数据。

Method: OMR在中间ODE步骤中，将adapter空间的V-JEPA 2.1惊喜能量的梯度注入生成器速度，将潜在表示朝物理上更合理的区域移动。通过小型的潜在到嵌入adapter保持梯度在推理时可行，视频生成器和世界模型均保持冻结。

Result: 在固定的400-prompt VideoPhy-2详细子集上，OMR将联合语义符合与物理常识指标从47.0%提升至52.0%（绝对+5.0pp，相对+10.6%）。在50-prompt效率子集上，推理时间为基础采样的1.71倍。

Conclusion: OMR通过直接在世界模型反馈指导下精炼单条采样轨迹，以轻量推理成本实现了物理一致性的显著提升，避免了候选搜索或反复编解码的多倍开销，是一种高效的推理时物理校正方案。

Abstract: Modern video generators routinely fail at physical dynamics: objects float, trajectories violate gravity, contacts vanish. Standard denoising and flow-matching objectives fit visual data distributions but do not explicitly penalize such physical violations. Existing remedies can improve physical consistency, but typically add substantial inference or training cost. Candidate-selection methods generate and score multiple videos, while gradient-based world-model guidance repeatedly decodes and re-encodes intermediate estimates. Generator-internal refinement adds perturbation and re-denoising loops, whereas post-training requires curated data and additional optimization. We propose Off-Manifold Refinement (OMR), an inference-time method that instead injects world-model feedback directly into a single sampling trajectory. During scheduled middle ODE steps, we augment the generator velocity with the gradient of an adapter-space V-JEPA 2.1 surprise energy. This external correction can move the latent away from the uncorrected sampling trajectory and toward regions ranked as more physically plausible by the frozen predictor, after which the generator continues rendering from the corrected state. A small trained latent-to-embedding adapter keeps the gradient tractable at inference, and both the video generator and the world model remain frozen. On our fixed 400-prompt VideoPhy-2 detailed subset, OMR lifts the joint Semantic-Adherence-and-Physical-Commonsense metric from 47.0% to 52.0% (+5.0pp absolute, +10.6% relative) over the base Wan2.2-T2V-A14B sampler. On a separate fixed 50-prompt efficiency subset, it requires $1.71 \times$ the base runtime rather than the multiplicative cost of reward/search alternatives. Project page: https://itruonghai.github.io/omr.

</details>


### [141] [OrnaStyler: Ornament-Aware Latent Editing for Content-Preserving 3D Stylization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29905)
*Tomohiro Aizawa,Shigeru Kuriyama,Chunzhi Gu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OrnaStyler是一个零样本的文本引导3D资产风格编辑框架，基于整流流生成建模，通过倒转引导的编辑策略在几何和外观层面分阶段恢复内容感知的潜在表示，实现精细结构装饰的风格化编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的3D形状建模技术虽有快速进展，但当期望的风格化涉及细粒度结构装饰时，忠实风格化现有资产仍具挑战性——需要在保留源几何和对象身份的同时，连贯整合新的风格特定细节。

Method: 基于整流流生成建模，引入倒转引导的编辑策略，在几何和外观层面分阶段恢复内容感知的潜在表示。几何层面通过流倒转操作体素表示，合成装饰增强结构同时保留源资产的空间身份；外观层面引入邻域感知的特征修复机制，协调新生成的装饰与原始内容，实现几何-外观连贯整合。

Result: 在生成的和真实世界的3D资产上进行的广泛实验表明，OrnaStyler在内容保留、风格保真度和整体视觉真实感方面达到了最先进的编辑性能。

Conclusion: OrnaStyler仅在推理阶段运行，支持对几何增强或外观风格化的选择性编辑，有效缓解了体素空间中内容保留与风格表达之间的根本张力。

Abstract: Text-guided style editing of 3D assets is essential for adapting existing objects to diverse visual aesthetics in digital content creation. Despite rapid progress in 3D shape modeling, faithfully stylizing an existing asset remains challenging when the desired stylization involves fine-grained structural ornamentation, which requires the model to preserve the source geometry and object identity, while coherently integrating new style-specific details. We propose \textbf{OrnaStyler}, a zero-shot framework for text-guided ornament-aware 3D stylization. Built upon rectified flow-based generative modeling, OrnaStyler introduces an inversion-guided editing strategy that recovers content-aware latent representations at both geometry and appearance levels in a staged manner to facilitate faithful editing. Our core idea is to explicitly model the spatial configuration of stylistic elements, thereby mitigating the fundamental tension between content preservation and style expression in the voxel space. Specifically, at the geometry level, we manipulate voxel representations through flow inversion to synthesize ornament-enhanced structures while preserving the spatial identity of the source asset. Then, at the appearance level, we introduce an adjacency-aware feature inpainting mechanism to harmonize newly generated ornaments with the original content, yielding coherent geometry-appearance integration. Our approach operates solely in the inference phase and enables selective editing over geometric augmentation or appearance stylization. Extensive experiments on both generated and real-world 3D assets against prior methods demonstrate that OrnaStyler achieves state-of-the-art editing performance in terms of content preservation, style fidelity, and overall visual realism. Code is available at: https://github.com/tomohiro0427/OrnaStyler

</details>


### [142] [Matrix-Game 3.5: Enhancing Real-Time Streaming Interactive World Models with Patch Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29910)
*Runjia Qian,Zile Wang,Jihai Zhang,Kai Zou,Wei Yu,Jiaxing Li,Zexiang Liu,Yaokun Li,Fei Kang,Kaichen Huang,Mengyin An,Haobo Zhang,Biao Jiang,Jiahua Wang,Haofeng Sun,Yang Liu,Yangguang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Matrix-Game 3.5是Matrix-Game 3.0的升级版，通过三项关键改进——统一几何感知记忆框架（零新增参数的patch-memory和tiled-PRoPE）、静态-动态解耦世界表示、两阶段渐进式实时蒸馏框架（Perceptual Flow Matching和基于课程的Self-Rollout DMD）——实现了几何一致和长时程一致的实时交互式世界生成，支持分钟级的实时开放世界交互。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式世界模型虽然能扩展视频生成到持久仿真，但在长时程交互生成中面临巨大挑战：模型需同时保持场景几何、动态一致性和相机控制，并支持实时自回归生成，这些需求在现有方法中难以同时满足。

Method: 三项核心改进：(1) 统一几何感知记忆框架，包含patch-memory和tiled-PRoPE组件，零新增可学习参数，结合显式3D patch检索与投影相机条件化实现几何一致的相机控制和长时程场景回忆；(2) 静态-动态解耦世界表示，分别建模静态场景几何与动态主体，保持几何一致性和主体身份；(3) 两阶段渐进式实时蒸馏框架，通过Perceptual Flow Matching和基于课程的Self-Rollout DMD将双向扩散模型转化为少步因果生成器。

Result: 在涵盖Unreal仿真环境、开放世界游戏和互联网视频的统一训练语料上，Matrix-Game 3.5在长时程场景回忆、精确相机控制、主体一致性、提示驱动的世界生成以及稳定的实时开放世界交互方面均取得了强性能。

Conclusion: Matrix-Game 3.5证明通过几何感知记忆、解耦表示和渐进式蒸馏的组合策略，可以显著推进交互式世界模型在几何一致性和长时程一致性方面的能力，实现分钟级实时交互式生成，为游戏、机器人、具身智能和XR等应用奠定基础。

Abstract: Interactive world models extend video generation from offline clip synthesis toward persistent simulation of interactive virtual worlds, enabling applications in games, robotics, embodied agents, and XR. Achieving stable long-horizon interactive generation, however, remains challenging, as the model must simultaneously preserve scene geometry, dynamic consistency, and camera control while supporting real-time autoregressive generation. Building upon Matrix-Game 3.0, we present Matrix-Game 3.5, as shown in Figure 1, which advances real-time interactive world generation toward geometry-aware and long-horizon consistent simulation through three key improvements. First, we propose a unified geometry-aware memory framework, whose patch-memory and tiled-PRoPE components introduce no additional learnable parameters, combining explicit 3D patch retrieval with projective camera conditioning to enable geometry-consistent camera control and faithful long-horizon scene recall. Second, we introduce a static-dynamic disentangled world representation that separately models static scene geometry and dynamic subjects, preserving both geometric consistency and subject identity throughout long-horizon generation. Third, we develop a two-stage progressive real-time distillation framework that converts a bidirectional diffusion model into a few-step causal generator through Perceptual Flow Matching and curriculum based Self-Rollout DMD, enabling minute-long real-time interactive generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, with a unified training corpus spanning Unreal simulation environments, open-world games, and internet videos, MatrixGame 3.5 achieves strong performance in long-horizon scene recall, precise camera control, subject consistency, prompt-driven world generation, and stable real-time open-world interaction.

</details>


### [143] [FoundYou: A Unified Model for Personalized Segmentation and Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29917)
*Gabriele Trivigno,Marcos Alfaro,Claudia Cuttano,Gabriele Berton,Luis Payá,Carlo Masone*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出FoundYou，一个基于SAM 2的统一框架，利用其在视频帧间保持物体身份的能力，将个性化分割和个性化检索统一为同一个实例对齐过程。该方法冻结SAM 2-small模型，仅增加5.9M可训练参数（共52M），在PerMIS上提升+18.4 mIoU，在ILIAS上提升+17.8 mAP，比先前统一方案快75倍、小20倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化分割和个性化检索虽然共享实例级别的目标（识别不同图像中的同一物理对象），但这两个任务长期独立发展，采用不同的解决方案，缺乏统一的框架来利用它们共同的底层目标。

Method: 基于SAM 2在视频帧间保持物体身份的固有属性，利用其捕获实例级线索的能力，在独立图像间匹配对象。将分割和检索视为同一个实例对齐过程的两个输出结果，实现统一框架。整个SAM 2-small模型保持冻结，仅添加5.9M可训练参数。

Result: 在PerMIS上取得+18.4 mIoU提升，在ILIAS上取得+17.8 mAP提升；性能随参考图像数量增加而提升，对较弱提示保持鲁棒性；在类别级检索基准上达到SOTA；模型仅52M参数，比先前唯一统一方案快75倍以上、小20倍。

Conclusion: FoundYou证明通过共享实例对齐过程可以统一个性化分割与检索，解锁了少样本个性化检索和灵活提示的可提示个性化分割等新能力，同时保持高效和可扩展性。

Abstract: Personalized segmentation and personalized retrieval both aim to identify the same physical object across different images. While the former localizes the object within a target image, the latter retrieves images where it appears. Despite this shared instance-level objective, the two tasks have largely evolved separately and are addressed with distinct solutions. In this work, we introduce FoundYou, a unified framework built on the observation that Segment Anything 2 (SAM 2), trained to preserve object identity across video frames, inherently captures instance-level cues. We leverage this property to match objects across independent images, enabling segmentation and retrieval to emerge as two outcomes of the same instance alignment process. This unified view unlocks new capabilities beyond traditional benchmarks, including few-shot personalized retrieval and promptable personalized segmentation with flexible prompts. Extensive experiments show consistent gains over unified and task-specific methods, including +18.4 mIoU on PerMIS and +17.8 mAP on ILIAS. Performance scales with additional references and remains robust to weaker prompts. Beyond personalization, FoundYou achieves state-of-the-art results on category-level retrieval benchmarks. Notably, our approach keeps the SAM 2-small model entirely frozen and adds only 5.9 M trainable parameters, yielding a 52 M-parameter model that is over 75x faster and 20x smaller than the only prior unified solution. Code is available at https://github.com/ga1i13o/FoundYou .

</details>


### [144] [Continual Test-Time Adaptation via Entropy Sensitivity-Guidance in Strict Online Setting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29920)
*Chandler Timm C. Doloriel,Yunbei Zhang,Muhammad Salman Siddiqui,Tor Kristian Stevik,Fadi Al Machot,Kristian Hovde Liland,Habib Ullah*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SEGA方法，利用结构化擦除探测预测熵变化来生成灵敏度轨迹，用于严格在线持续测试时适应（CTTA），解决批次大小为1且无源数据等场景下的漂移或崩溃问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 严格在线TTA在批次大小为1且无法访问源数据时，容易发生漂移或模型崩溃；现有方法依赖原始熵或批次统计，缺乏可靠的反馈信号。

Method: SEGA通过少量结构化擦除来探测信息移除时预测熵的变化，生成每个样本的灵敏度轨迹，据此协调模型恢复和样本选择，替代原始熵或批次统计作为反馈信号。

Result: 在ImageNet-C、CIFAR10/100-C以及水产养殖腐败流等多个数据集上，SEGA相比强CTTA基线获得一致的鲁棒性和稳定性提升，并通过灵敏度门控减少了反向传播次数。

Conclusion: SEGA为长时程、批次大小为1的无重设、无模型储备的在线CTTA提供了实用的反馈信号，展示了灵敏度轨迹相比原始熵在适应质量上的优势。

Abstract: Test-time adaptation (TTA) promises robustness under distribution shift by updating a pretrained model on unlabeled test data, but strict online TTA with batch size one and no access to source data is especially prone to drift or collapse. We introduce Sensitivity-Guided Erasing Adaptation (SEGA), a method for strict online continual TTA (CTTA) on corruption-style streams.
