SEGA uses a small number of structured erasures to probe how predictive entropy changes as information is removed, and uses the resulting per-sample sensitivity trajectories to coordinate recovery and sample selection rather than relying on raw entropy or batch statistics. This yields a practical feedback signal for long-horizon batch-size-one adaptation without periodic resets or model reservoirs. In experiments on ImageNet-C, CIFAR10/100-C, and corruption-generated aquaculture streams treated as controlled corruption-style proxies, SEGA yields consistent robustness and stability gains over strong CTTA baselines while reducing backward passes through sensitivity-based gating.

</details>


### [145] [Towards Continual Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models in Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29923)
*Chandler Timm C. Doloriel,Yunbei Zhang,Sarthak Kumar Maharana,Muhammad Salman Siddiqui,Tor Kristian Stevik,Fadi Al Machot,Kristian Hovde Liland,Habib Ullah*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DAF是一个针对开放词汇语义分割在持续测试时分布偏移下的稳定化框架，通过边际多样性损失、跨模态锚定一致性和特征显著性过滤三个组件，防止熵最小化导致的类别坍缩和视觉-语言对齐退化，在五个数据集上显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放词汇语义分割依赖视觉-语言对齐来识别任意文本定义的类别，但这种对齐在持续测试时分布偏移下非常脆弱。诊断分析发现三个关键问题：熵最小化导致patch级类别坍缩、持续更新侵蚀视觉-语言对齐、低偏移样本产生冗余梯度浪费计算资源。

Method: 提出DAF框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) 边际多样性损失，抵抗熵最小化导致的类别坍缩；(2) 跨模态锚定一致性损失，相对冻结的源模型约束特征漂移；(3) 特征显著性过滤，跳过低价值的反向传播以抵消源模型锚定的额外计算开销。

Result: 在涵盖自然场景、自动驾驶、水下图像和遥感等五个数据集及其腐蚀变体上评估。相比源模型，DAF在Pascal VOC20-C上提升mIoU超过8点，在LoveDA上提升超过9点，在Foggy Cityscapes上提升超过3点，且对激进适配和学习率选择具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: DAF在熵最小化会崩溃的持续偏移场景下保持稳定，验证了通过显式约束特征多样性、锚定跨模态一致性以及过滤冗余梯度来稳定测试时适配的有效性。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) relies on vision-language alignment to recognize arbitrary text-defined categories, yet this alignment is fragile under continual test-time distribution shift. Our diagnostic analysis reveals that entropy minimization drives patch-level class collapse, continual updates erode vision-language alignment, and redundant gradients from low-shift samples waste computation. We propose Diversify, Anchor, and Filter (DAF), a stabilization framework that augments entropy-based adaptation with a marginal diversity loss that resists collapse, a cross-modal anchor consistency loss that constrains feature drift relative to a frozen source model, and feature salience filtering that skips low-value backward passes to offset part of the source-anchor overhead. We evaluate on five datasets spanning natural scenes, autonomous driving, underwater imagery, and remote sensing with their corrupted variants. Across the evaluated continual shifts, DAF remains stable where entropy minimization collapses, improving mIoU by over 8 points on Pascal VOC20-C, over 9 points on LoveDA, and over 3 points on Foggy Cityscapes compared to the source model, and is robust to aggressive adaptation and learning rate choices.

</details>


### [146] [Hallucination Mitigation for Large Vision-Language Models via Implicit Feature Stabilization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29924)
*Aditi Sarker,Rafi Ibn Sultan,Hui Zhu,Dongxiao Zhu,Prashant Khanduri*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出INFUSE框架，通过微调时将扰动不变性内建到大视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的权重中，隐式地对齐和稳定跨模态表示，从而在不增加推理开销的情况下显著降低幻觉率（AMBER CHAIR降低46-63%），同时保持视觉问答性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LVLMs容易产生幻觉——描述图像中不存在的对象、属性和场景。作者将部分幻觉失败归因于表征的"特征不稳定性"：语义保持的轻微输入扰动会导致嵌入发生较大变化，且幻觉率随这种变异性上升。现有基于稳定性的修复方法都是显式的（推理时干预，如潜在空间引导或约束解码），每条查询都需要付出额外代价。

Method: INFUSE框架分为两步：(1) 围绕扰动平均锚点和真实标签锚点稳定视觉与文本表征；(2) 通过双向对比目标对齐跨模态的稳定表征。该方法在微调阶段将扰动不变性内建到模型权重中，部署时无额外运行开销。理论部分证明了锚点与扰动均值表示之间的均方根偏差以1/√K速率缩小（K为视图数量），且在Lipschitz解码器假设下，这界定了任何扰动对模型幻觉行为的影响上限。

Result: 在LLaVA-1.5、LLaVA-1.6和Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct上，INFUSE将AMBER CHAIR相对各基础模型降低46-63%，在ObjHal、MMHal、HallusionBench和POPE上均有提升，同时保持VQA-v2和TextVQA的性能，且推理时无额外开销。

Conclusion: INFUSE通过隐式稳定化（权重内建扰动不变性）替代显式推理时干预，为缓解LVLM幻觉提供了一种高效且有效的思路，在显著降低幻觉的同时不牺牲通用能力，也不增加部署成本。

Abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) are prone to hallucinations: they fluently describe objects, attributes, and scenes that are not in the image. We connect part of this failure to a measurable property of their representations, feature instability, where mild semantics-preserving perturbations of the input cause large changes in the learned embeddings; hallucination rates rise together with this variability. Existing stability-motivated remedies are explicit, in the sense that they intervene at inference time through latent steering or constrained decoding, and pay for it on every query. We propose implicit stabilization instead: perturbation-invariance is built into the model weights during fine-tuning, and nothing extra runs at deployment. Our framework, INFUSE, first stabilizes visual and textual representations around perturbation-averaged and ground-truth anchors, then aligns the stabilized representations across modalities with bidirectional contrastive objectives. We prove that the anchor's root-mean-square deviation from the perturbation-mean representation shrinks at rate $1/\sqrt{K}$ in the number of views, and that under a Lipschitz decoder, this bounds how much any perturbation can change the model's hallucination behavior. On LLaVA-1.5, LLaVA-1.6, and Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, INFUSE reduces AMBER CHAIR by 46-63% relative to each base model, improves ObjHal, MMHal, HallusionBench, and POPE, and preserves VQA-v2 and TextVQA, all with no inference-time overhead.

</details>


### [147] [Dior: Drawing the Light of Image via Material-Decoupled Illumination Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29925)
*Xuanpu Zhang,Xuesong Niu,Haoxiang Cao,Ruidong Chen,Jianhao Zeng,Changqian Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Dior-Light，一种基于手绘笔迹控制的图像重打光方法。核心创新是提出一种"材质解耦的照明表示"（Lumi Map），在用户笔迹输入与重打光结果之间建立显式映射关系，从而同时提升重打光的准确性和可控性。通过渲染器合成三元组数据进行训练，并利用真实重打光对进行重建训练来缩小域差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于手绘笔迹的图像重打光方法无法在笔迹输入与重打光结果之间建立一致且有效的映射，导致对照明强度、色度以及复杂空间分布的控制能力受限。

Method: 1) 提出Lumi Map，一种材质解耦的照明表示，建立用户笔迹与照明结果之间的显式映射；2) 使用渲染器合成"源图像-Lumi Map-重打光图像"三元组来训练模型；3) 在真实重打光对上额外进行重建训练，以缓解合成数据引入的域差距，提升模型在真实图像上的泛化能力。

Result: 大量实验表明，该方法在重打光准确性上优于现有方法，并能有效控制真实世界图像中的照明强度和色度。

Conclusion: 通过Lumi Map表示和合成+真实数据联合训练策略，Dior-Light在提供高精度重打光的同时实现了对手绘笔迹输入的直观且有效的照明控制。

Abstract: Controllable image relighting is an important problem in image editing, and hand-drawn scribbles provide an intuitive interface for specifying the desired illumination. However, existing methods do not establish a consistent and effective mapping between scribble inputs and relighting results, limiting their ability to control illumination intensity, chromaticity, and complex spatial distributions. We address this limitation by introducing a material-decoupled illumination representation, termed the Lumi Map, which establishes an explicit mapping between user scribbles and the resulting illumination, thereby improving both relighting accuracy and controllability. Specifically, we use a renderer to synthesize source image-Lumi Map-relit image triplets and train the model to predict the target relighting result conditioned on the Lumi Map. To mitigate the domain gap introduced by synthetic data, we further perform reconstruction training on real relighting pairs, improving the model's generalization to real-world images. Finally, we present Dior-Light, an image relighting method controlled by hand-drawn strokes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches in relighting accuracy and enables effective control over illumination intensity and chromaticity on in-the-wild images.

</details>


### [148] [Everybody Tracking Every Body](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29927)
*Daeyun Shin,Yunhan Zhao,Shu Kong,Alexander C. Berg,Charless Fowlkes*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于扩散模型的多人三维人体姿态估计方法，通过融合第一人称（egocentric）相机运动推断的头部运动姿态和第三人称（exocentric）视觉观测，并结合观测可靠性条件，实现了多人在中央协调下的姿态估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多人在各自第一人称视角下相互交互时，每个人的相机仅能提供稀疏、间歇且可靠性变化大的他人观测，而单靠头部运动推断的姿态精度有限，需要一种能有效融合异构数据流的方法。

Method: 采用扩散模型（diffusion-based approach），将基于VIO SLAM的自我相机运动推断的头部姿态与第三人称的视觉姿态观测进行融合，同时以观测内容和可靠性为条件进行建模。模型使用单人动捕数据和多人视频的混合数据进行训练，以学习身体运动轨迹的先验以及视频观测可靠性。

Result: 在具有挑战性的多人数据集上进行评估，融合方法在绝对姿态精度和相对姿态精度上均优于仅运动（motion-only）和仅视觉（vision-only）的基线方法。

Conclusion: 所提出的基于扩散模型的融合策略有效解决了多人第一人称视角下姿态估计中数据稀疏和可靠性不确定的问题，验证了在自中心多人交互场景中融合多源信号的优势。

Abstract: We address the problem of 3D body pose estimation of multiple interacting people from their egocentric views with centralized coordination. Each individual wears a camera recording egocentric video and IMU data. Processing this video with VIO SLAM provides high-quality tracking of each egocentric camera through space. The first-person view from one individual provides third-person observations of other people, although these exocentric observations are sparse, intermittent, and of highly variable reliability as both cameras and subjects move. To integrate these synchronized data streams, we propose a diffusion-based approach that fuses estimates of pose based on head motion derived from egocentric camera motion with exocentric pose observations, conditioning on both observation content and reliability. Our model is trained on a mixture of single-person motion-capture data and multi-person video in order to learn rich priors for body motion trajectories and video observation reliability. Evaluation on challenging multi-person datasets suggests our fusion approach improves over motion-only and vision-only baselines in terms of both absolute and relative pose accuracy.

</details>


### [149] [Biomechanical 3D Body: Self-Supervised Distillation of Biomechanical Pose from a 3D Body Foundation Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29928)
*R. James Cotton,J. D. Peiffer,Lucinda Williamson,John Leske,Georgios Pavlakos*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文扩展了基础模型SAM-3D-Body，增加了一个生物力学预测头，从单张RGB图像回归生物力学模型的关节角度和比例。通过Levenberg-Marquardt求解器进行逆运动学拟合生成优化目标来监督训练，实现了从网格预测头向生物力学头的知识蒸馏，无需配对图像-生物力学数据集。模型在JAX/Equinox中实现，支持MuJoCoGPU优化模型，在MoVi、BioCV和临床队列数据上验证，优于直接回归方法，略逊于需要推理时优化的SOTA方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的单目人体恢复方法输出网格顶点和运动学树角度，但缺乏生物力学定义的关节角度，无法满足临床和生物力学分析等下游应用的需求。此外，配对图像与生物力学拟合的数据集极为有限，直接训练生物力学预测模型面临数据瓶颈。

Method: 在SAM-3D-Body基础上添加一个生物力学预测头，从单RGB图像回归生物力学模型的关节角度和尺度。使用Levenberg-Marquardt求解器对网格预测做逆运动学拟合，生成优化的生物力学目标用于监督训练，实现从网格头到生物力学头的知识蒸馏，可在无标注图像上训练。整个模型用JAX和Equinox实现，兼容MuJoCo中的GPU优化生物力学模型。

Result: 在MoVi、BioCV两个公开基于标记的数据集以及一个临床队列的多视角无标记动作捕捉数据上验证，模型优于现有的生物力学直接回归方法，仅略逊于在推理时对整个轨迹进行昂贵优化的SOTA单目生物力学方法。

Conclusion: 通过知识蒸馏的方式，可以从已有的网格预测模型中有效学习生物力学输出，无需大量配对标注数据。该方法在精度和推理效率之间取得了良好平衡，为临床和生物力学分析提供了可行的单目图像驱动方案。

Abstract: State-of-the-art monocular body recovery methods predict mesh vertices and angles on the corresponding kinematic tree, but their outputs lack biomechanically defined joint angles that downstream applications like clinical and biomechanical analyses require. We extend an existing foundation model, SAM-3D-Body, with an additional biomechanical prediction head that, from a single RGB image, regresses the joint angles and scales of a biomechanical model. Training this model presents a challenge, as there are limited datasets of paired images and biomechanical fits. To overcome this, we supervise biomechanical outputs with in-loop optimized targets from a Levenberg-Marquardt solver performing inverse kinematics fits against markers from the mesh predictions. This allows distilling the biomechanical head from the mesh head, even from unlabeled images. To make this work with GPU-optimized biomechanical models in MuJoCo, the entire model was implemented in JAX using Equinox. We trained this distilled output head on the publicly released SAM-3D-Body dataset. We then validated this model on biomechanical fits to two publicly available marker-based datasets, MoVi and BioCV, as well as movements from a clinical cohort captured with multiview markerless motion capture. The resulting model outperforms existing models for direct regression of biomechanics from images while only slightly underperforming the state-of-the-art monocular biomechanics method that performs more costly inference-time optimization of entire trajectories.

</details>


### [150] [Evaluating 2D and 3D-Aware Vision Foundation Models for Vehicle Attribute Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29929)
*Alexandre V. Delazeri,Gabriel E. Lima,Eduil Nascimento,Rayson Laroca,David Menotti*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文对14个2D和3D感知的视觉基础模型在车辆属性识别任务上进行了实证基准测试，使用UFPR-VeSV数据集进行评估。结果显示标准2D自监督模型（特别是DINOv3）在细粒度车辆识别上表现最佳（超过93% Macro-Accuracy），而3D感知模型Depth Anything v2在视角不变性上更有优势，作者提出混合2D和3D先验的混合方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 车辆属性识别在智能交通系统中至关重要，尤其在车牌识别不可用或不可靠时。尽管视觉基础模型展现了强大的跨域迁移能力，但其在细粒度车辆分类中的效果尚未被充分探索；同时由于车辆具有三维结构，3D感知基础模型是否优于标准2D架构尚不明确。

Method: 使用UFPR-VeSV真实世界数据集，对14个最先进的2D和3D感知视觉基础模型进行基准测试。将这些模型作为冻结特征提取器，通过线性探测（linear probing）进行车辆类型、品牌和型号识别；对表现最佳的模型进一步进行少样本学习和分布外（OOD）域偏移压力测试。

Result: 标准2D自监督模型（特别是DINOv3）在细粒度任务中显著优于3D感知模型，在品牌和型号识别上达到93%以上的Macro-Accuracy；而3D感知的Depth Anything v2在车辆类型分类中对视角变化表现出更强的不变性。

Conclusion: 2D和3D先验各有优势，未来的车辆识别系统应考虑结合2D与3D先验的混合方法来提升鲁棒性。代码已公开发布。

Abstract: Vehicle attribute recognition is an important task in intelligent transportation systems, particularly when Automatic License Plate Recognition (ALPR) is unavailable or unreliable. Although vision foundation models have shown strong transferability across domains, their effectiveness for fine-grained vehicle classification remains underexplored. Moreover, given the inherently three-dimensional structure of vehicles, it is unclear whether emerging 3D-aware foundation models offer advantages over standard 2D architectures. This paper presents an empirical benchmark of 14 state-of-the-art 2D and 3D-aware vision foundation models. Using the challenging real-world UFPR-VeSV dataset, we evaluate these models as frozen feature extractors via linear probing for vehicle type, make, and model recognition. We further stress-test the best-performing models under few-shot learning and Out-of-Distribution (OOD) domain shifts. Our results show that standard 2D self-supervised models, particularly DINOv3, substantially outperform 3D-aware models in fine-grained tasks, achieving over 93% Macro-Accuracy for make and model recognition. However, the 3D-aware Depth Anything v2 exhibits stronger invariance to viewing angles in vehicle type classification. These findings motivate hybrid approaches that combine 2D and 3D priors for robust vehicle recognition. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/UFPR-IPASPPR/3D-Vision-Benchmark/.

</details>


### [151] [On the Role of MRI Sequences in Cross-Dataset Generalization for Brain Tumor Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29944)
*Henrique Zan Grande,João G. Pitol,Lucas B. Schuck,Rafael V. Serenato,Rayson Laroca,Andre Gustavo Hochuli*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究系统评估了MRI各序列（模态）对脑肿瘤分割模型跨数据集鲁棒性的影响，发现T2f/FLAIR序列表现最佳（Dice超过75%），多序列训练可进一步提升性能，且少量目标域自适应即可带来快速提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管U-Net等深度学习架构在脑肿瘤分割中取得成功，但跨数据集性能下降仍是重大挑战，尤其是在域偏移和标注数据有限的情况下。现有研究缺乏对单个MRI序列如何影响模型鲁棒性的系统评估。

Method: 采用ResUNet框架，对每个MRI模态独立训练以隔离其影响，在两个公开数据集上进行受控的跨数据集评估协议，包括肿瘤大小分层、无目标域训练或有限域自适应。

Result: T2f/FLAIR序列取得最佳跨数据集性能（Dice超过75%），在大多数肿瘤大小范围内持续优于其他模态；多序列训练进一步提升了性能；即使有限的目标域自适应也能带来快速的初始性能提升。

Conclusion: T2f/FLAIR序列是跨数据集脑肿瘤分割中最具鲁棒性的单一模态，多序列训练和少量域自适应可以有效缓解域偏移问题，减少对大量标注和昂贵重训练的需求。

Abstract: Brain tumor segmentation in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is a critical task for diagnosis and treatment planning. Despite the success of deep learning architectures such as U-Net and its variants, performance degradation across datasets remains a major challenge, particularly under domain shift and limited annotated data. To address this issue, this study systematically evaluates how individual MRI sequences influence model robustness across two well-known datasets. A ResUNet-based framework is employed, where each modality is trained independently to isolate its effect under a controlled cross-dataset evaluation protocol with tumor size stratification, without target-domain training, or with limited domain adaptation. Results show that the T2f/FLAIR sequence achieves the best cross-dataset performance, with Dice scores exceeding 75%. It consistently outperforms other modalities across most tumor size ranges, while multi-sequence training further improves performance. Additionally, even limited target-domain adaptation yields rapid initial gains, reducing the need for extensive annotations and costly retraining. Our source code is publicly available at https://github.com/henrique-zan/brain_tumor_segmentation/.

</details>


### [152] [RIDGE: Region-Informed Derivative-Guided Evidence Selection for Long Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29958)
*Shanqing Xu,Meng Luo,Mengchen Qian,Yuhui Gao,Siyue Peng,Xiaohan Zhong,Xiaojin Zhang,Zhongyu Wei,Wei Chen,Xiang Bai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RIDGE是一个轻量级帧选择框架，将帧-查询相似度曲线视为时序信号，通过局部变化和曲率将时间线划分为结构区域（事件核心、过渡、铺垫、余波、上下文），并在固定视觉token预算下进行区域特定的帧选择，无需训练或迭代LVLM调用。在四个长视频基准和三个骨干网络上多数设置下取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有查询感知的帧选择器通常将相似度序列仅视为数值进行排序或采样，忽略了其形状作为时序信号的价值。这种处理方法会遗漏位于相关峰值两侧（上升或下降段）的关键帧，这些帧可能用于解释、情境化或延续一个事件，但绝对分数较低而被忽略。

Method: RIDGE将帧-查询相似度曲线作为时序信号读取：利用局部变化和曲率将时间线划分为不同的结构区域，包括事件核心、过渡、铺垫、余波和上下文帧；然后针对不同区域采用特定的选择策略，在固定预算下进行帧筛选。该方法是对预计算帧-查询分数的轻量级后处理步骤，无需训练也不需要迭代调用LVLM。

Result: 在四个长视频基准测试和三个骨干网络上的实验表明，RIDGE在大多数设置中取得最佳性能，其余设置中也保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 通过将相似度曲线视为结构化时序信号而非单纯数值序列，RIDGE能够有效保留长视频中查询相关证据的完整形态（包括峰值及两侧），在无需额外训练开销的前提下显著提升长视频理解性能。

Abstract: Long videos contain far more visual content than Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) can process under a fixed visual-token budget, making frame selection essential. Existing query-aware selectors usually estimate frame-query relevance and build a compact subset from high-scoring frames. Although their mechanisms differ, the similarity sequence is still often treated primarily as values to rank or sample from, rather than as an ordered signal whose shape reflects how query-relevant evidence emerges, peaks, and fades over time. This can obscure frames that explain, contextualize, or follow an event, because such evidence may lie on the rising or falling sides of a nearby relevance peak and receive lower absolute scores. We propose RIDGE, a frame selection framework that reads the frame-query similarity curve as a temporal signal. By using local changes and curvature, RIDGE partitions the timeline into structural regions and applies region-specific selection to preserve event cores, transitions, buildup, aftermath, and contextual frames under a fixed budget. It is a lightweight post-processing step on precomputed frame-query scores and requires neither training nor iterative LVLM calls. Across four long-video benchmarks and three backbones, RIDGE achieves the best performance in most settings and remains competitive in the others.

</details>


### [153] [Confidence-Aware Ensemble and Long-Word Refinement for Artistic Text Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29970)
*Lucas A. Dias,Henrique A. Schulz,Rafaela de Miranda,Guilherme L. Peres,Pedro L. Bittencourt,Rayson Laroca*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对艺术文本识别（ATR）这一挑战性任务，在WordArt-V1.5基准上评估了多种场景和艺术文本识别器，并提出了一种置信度感知的集成方法（结合SVTRv2、PARSeq、MAERec），配合基于Needleman-Wunsch对齐和词典校正的长词精炼阶段。在Test B测试集上达到89.90%的单词识别准确率，超过最佳单模型1.77个百分点，长词子集提升2.72个百分点。错误分析显示48.8%的剩余错误源于标注问题、视觉模糊或不可读样本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 艺术文本识别（ATR）极具挑战性，因为词图像常结合装饰性字体、弯曲布局、类物体字符、杂乱背景和严重变形。目前缺乏标准化的基准和统一协议来评估该场景下的识别器表现。

Method: 1) 在WordArt-V1.5官方训练集上对SVTRv2、PARSeq、MAERec三个模型进行微调；2) 提出置信度感知集成，在预测不一致的位置利用最小置信度选择最优预测，强调区分竞争假设的字符；3) 针对长词引入基于Needleman-Wunsch序列比对和词典引导校正的精炼阶段。

Result: 在WordArt-V1.5 Test B上达到89.90%的单词识别准确率，比最佳单模型提升1.77个百分点；长词精炼在全局增益有限，但对目标长词子集提升2.72个百分点；错误分析显示48.8%的剩余错误与标注问题、视觉模糊或不可读样本相关。

Conclusion: 置信度感知集成和长词精炼策略能有效提升艺术文本识别性能；诊断性错误报告对未来ATR基准和模型开发具有重要价值，因近一半剩余错误源于数据本身的质量问题而非识别器能力不足。

Abstract: Artistic Text Recognition (ATR) remains challenging because word images often combine decorative fonts, curved layouts, object-like characters, clutter, and severe distortions. This paper studies WordArt-V1.5 as a standardized benchmark for this setting and evaluates recent scene and artistic text recognizers under a common protocol. We propose a confidence-aware ensemble that combines SVTRv2, PARSeq, and MAERec after fine-tuning on the official training split. The ensemble selects predictions using the minimum confidence over disagreement positions, emphasizing characters that separate competing hypotheses. For long words, where a single character error can invalidate the whole prediction, we add a targeted refinement stage based on Needleman-Wunsch alignment and lexicon-guided correction. On the WordArt-V1.5 Test B split, the proposed system reaches 89.90% Word Recognition Accuracy, improving the best individual fine-tuned model by 1.77 percentage points. The long-word refinement produces a modest global gain, but improves the targeted long-word subset by 2.72 percentage points. Finally, an error analysis of all remaining mistakes shows that 48.8% are associated with labeling issues, visual ambiguity, or illegible samples, highlighting the value of diagnostic reporting for future ATR benchmarks and models. Our source code is available at https://github.com/lucas-azdias/Artistic-Text-Recognition/.

</details>


### [154] [SpanCalib-VLM: Calibrated Hallucination Span Detection in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29974)
*Amanuel Gizachew Abebe,Yasmin Moslem*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SpanCalib-VLM，一种用于大视觉语言模型幻觉检测的混合双系统。该系统结合了多模态序列标注器（XLM-RoBERTa-Large与SigLIP视觉编码器通过交叉注意力融合）和微调生成式VLM（Qwen3.5-4B-SHROOM-SFT），通过Union-Calibrated Fusion策略，用序列标注器的校准概率对生成模型候选跨度进行重新评分。在SHROOM-Visions英语评测集上，该集成方法实现了0.41的Pearson校准相关性和0.39的总体IoU，干净响应的IoU达0.91，总体检测准确率为70.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检测LVLM中的幻觉需要同时具备精确的跨度定位和良好校准的置信度分数，但现有的生成式VLM虽擅长识别幻觉文本跨度却存在过度自信和高推理延迟问题，而判别式序列标注器虽速度快且校准性好但跨度召回率保守。两种方法各有优缺点，需要取长补短。

Method: 构建混合双系统架构：(1) 多模态序列标注器：XLM-RoBERTa-Large通过交叉注意力与SigLIP视觉编码器融合，提供确定性速度和良好校准；(2) 微调生成式VLM：Qwen3.5-4B-SHROOM-SFT识别幻觉文本跨度。通过Union-Calibrated Fusion策略，利用序列标注器的校准概率对生成模型候选跨度重新评分，实现两个系统的协同。

Result: 在SHROOM-Visions英语评测集上，集成方法取得Pearson校准相关性0.41，总体IoU为0.39，其中干净响应（clean-response）IoU达到0.91，总体检测准确率为70.7%。

Conclusion: SpanCalib-VLM通过混合双系统架构成功兼顾了生成式模型的跨度识别能力和判别式模型的校准优势，展示了联合策略在LVLM幻觉检测中的有效性，并公开了模型权重和代码以促进后续研究。

Abstract: Detecting hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) requires both accurate span localization and well-calibrated confidence scores. Fine-tuned generative VLMs excel at identifying hallucinated text spans but suffer from overconfidence and high inference latency. Discriminative sequence taggers offer deterministic speed and superior calibration but exhibit conservative span recall. We present SpanCalib-VLM, a hybrid dual-system for the SHROOM-Visions Shared Task that combines a multimodal sequence tagger, consisting of XLM-RoBERTa-Large fused with a SigLIP vision encoder via cross-attention, with our fine-tuned generative VLM (Qwen3.5-4B-SHROOM-SFT). Through a Union-Calibrated Fusion strategy, candidate spans from the generative model are re-scored with calibrated probabilities from the sequence tagger. On the SHROOM-Visions English evaluation split, our ensemble achieves a Pearson calibration correlation of 0.41 and an overall IoU of 0.39, with a clean-response IoU of 0.91} and overall detection accuracy of 70.7%. We make our model weights and code publicly available.

</details>


### [155] [FIS-OT: Feature-Induced Optimal Transport for Unsupervised Action Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29980)
*Linxiang Peng,Xinyao Qin,Jinhan Li,Di Yang,Jiangtao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FIS-OT，一种特征引导的结构化最优传输框架，用于无监督动作分割。通过特征增强生成器（FEG）模块利用三元组损失捕获局部一致性，结合特征引导的残差结构先验保证时间连续性，并建立循环优化机制对齐局部特征学习与全局结构对齐。在三个数据集上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有最优传输（OT）方法在无监督动作分割中使用全局约束，忽视了局部信息；同时现有OT架构过度信任自身生成的伪标签，导致早期训练阶段学习到噪声，产生确认偏误。

Method: 1）提出特征增强生成器（FEG）模块，作为内部正则化器，通过三元组损失捕获局部一致性，提供独立于噪声伪标签的稳健监督；2）提出特征诱导残差结构先验，结合固定时间骨干网络与动态特征相似性，既保证时间连续性又使求解器适应复杂动作结构；3）建立循环优化循环，对齐局部特征学习与全局结构对齐。

Result: 在三个数据集上的大量实验表明该方法有效。

Conclusion: FIS-OT通过引入局部特征监督与自适应结构先验，解决了现有OT方法在无监督动作分割中忽视局部信息和确认偏误的问题，取得了有效成果。

Abstract: Unsupervised action segmentation is a challenging task. It involves finding action categories and boundaries in videos without labels. Existing Optimal Transport (OT) methods use global constraints. This causes them to overlook the use of local information. Furthermore, existing Optimal transport architectures are prone to confirmation bias because they overly trust the pseudo-labels they generate. This causes models to learn from noise in the early training stages. To address these issues, we propose FIS-OT. It is a novel Feature-Induced Structured Optimal Transport framework. First, we introduce a Feature Enhanced Generator (FEG) module. It serves as an internal regularizer. By using triplet loss, FEG captures local consistency. It provides robust supervision that is independent of noisy pseudo-labels. Second, we propose a Feature-Induced Residual Structural Prior. This combines a fixed temporal backbone with dynamic feature similarities. This design ensures temporal continuity. It also allows the solver to adapt to complex action structures. Finally, we establish a cyclic optimization loop. This aligns local feature learning with global structural alignment. Extensive experiments on the three datasets show the effectiveness of our method.

</details>


### [156] [SVI2LoD3: Agent-Driven Reconstruction of LoD3 Facade Openings in Semantic 3D City Models from Volunteered Street View Imagery using Large Language and Visual Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29992)
*Elmehdi Kanna,Lukas Arzoumanidis,Huynh Duc An Son Nguyen,Youness Dehbi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种端到端、代理驱动的管线，用于3D城市模型中立面开口的LoD3重建，直接生成符合CityGML标准的输出。该方法采用零样本分割策略替代监督式语义分割，大幅减少标注工作，并确保正确的部分层级关系。同时引入了一种新颖的评估指标——立面特征距离（FFD），用于更好地评估立面重建质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LoD3立面重建方法依赖监督式语义分割，需要大量人工标注的训练数据，成本高昂；且传统评估指标（如mIoU、FRDS）仅通过像素重叠评估相似性，无法充分捕捉语义正确性和建筑布局。

Method: 1) 采用零样本分割策略替代监督式语义分割；2) 强制实施正确的部分层级（partonomic）结构，生成符合CityGML标准的LoD3模型；3) 提出Facade Feature Distance (FFD)评估指标，基于视觉Transformer的高层特征空间衡量距离，同时捕获语义正确性和建筑布局。

Result: 在eTRIMS数据集基准测试中取得了强劲性能，大幅减少了标注工作量，同时验证了零样本策略和FFD指标的有效性。

Conclusion: 该管线与评估策略为自动化生成和分析语义丰富的3D城市模型提供了实用且可扩展的贡献，代码已开源。

Abstract: This paper presents an end-to-end, agent-driven pipeline for the LoD3 reconstruction of facade openings in 3D city models, producing directly usable CityGML-conform outputs. In contrast to existing approaches that rely on supervised semantic segmentation and therefore require large amounts of manually annotated training data, the proposed method employs a zero-shot segmentation strategy. This substantially reduces the annotation effort while still achieving strong performance in our benchmark on the eTRIMS dataset. A further key contribution is the enforcement of correct partonomic hierarchies, thereby producing CityGML-conform LoD3 building models. Beyond the reconstruction pipeline itself, this work also introduces a novel evaluation metric for facade reconstruction, termed Facade Feature Distance (FFD). Unlike conventional metrics such as mIoU or FRDS, which assess similarity primarily through pixel-wise overlap, FFD measures distance in a high-level feature space derived from a vision transformer. In doing so, it captures both semantic correctness and architectural layout, providing a more suitable assessment of facade reconstruction quality. The proposed pipeline and evaluation strategy together offer a practical and scalable contribution toward the automated generation and analysis of semantically enriched 3D city models. The developed code is published at: https://github.com/hcu-cml/citydb-SVI2LoD3-ai.

</details>


### [157] [Partition-Aware Unlearning for Removing Spurious Correlations in Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29996)
*Aditi Sarker,Nazreen Shah,Rafi Ibn Sultan,Rhongho Jang,Dongxiao Zhu,Prashant Khanduri*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PURGE框架，用于构造、评测和缓解LVLM中由虚假物体-背景相关性导致的预测错误。该框架包含结构化数据集构建策略和分区感知遗忘机制，通过在多个LVLM和基准上的实验验证，能持续减少幻觉和虚假相关性驱动的错误，同时保持或提升整体性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在多模态任务上表现优异，但常利用物体与背景之间的虚假相关性，导致预测依赖上下文捷径而非物体相关的视觉证据。现有基准对模型预测是基于目标物体还是被背景线索诱导缺乏有效控制，因此需要更精细的框架来诊断和缓解此类问题。

Method: PURGE框架包含两部分：(1)结构化数据集构建，通过三种互补的数据构建策略，按物体相关证据和虚假背景线索对示例进行分区，实现捷径依赖的可控诊断；(2)分区感知遗忘（Partition-aware Unlearning），利用这些分区选择性移除虚假的物体-背景关联，同时保留基于物体的推理能力。

Result: 在多个LVLM（LLaVA-1.6-7B、Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct、Qwen3.5-9B）及CLIP视觉语言编码器上，通过CHAIR、POPE、Causal-HalBench、MM-SpuBench、AMBER、MMHal、Waterbirds等基准评估，PURGE持续减少幻觉和虚假相关性驱动的错误，且在大多数评估场景中维持或提升整体性能。

Conclusion: PURGE既提供了可复用的评估协议，也为构建更可靠的LVLM提供了有效的缓解框架，在减少虚假相关性和幻觉方面表现一致且有效。

Abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) achieve strong performance across many multimodal tasks; however, they often exploit spurious object-background correlations, resulting in predictions driven by contextual shortcuts rather than object-relevant visual evidence. Despite growing interest in hallucination and robustness evaluation, existing benchmarks provide limited control over whether model predictions are grounded in the target object or induced by correlated background cues. In this work, we introduce PURGE (\underline{P}artition-aware \underline{U}nlearning for \underline{R}emoving spurious-correlation \underline{G}enerated \underline{E}rrors), a framework for constructing, benchmarking, and mitigating spurious-correlation-induced failures in LVLMs. The framework consists of: -- (1) Structured dataset construction wherein we develop three complementary structured data construction strategies that partition examples by object-relevant evidence and spurious background cues, enabling controlled diagnosis of shortcut reliance; and -- (2) Partition-aware unlearning, which uses these partitions to selectively remove spurious object-background associations while preserving object-based reasoning. We evaluate the \algo~framework across multiple LVLMs, including LLaVA-1.6-7B, Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, and Qwen3.5-9B, together with CLIP as a vision-language encoder, on a diverse suite of benchmarks, including CHAIR, POPE, Causal-HalBench, MM-SpuBench, AMBER, MMHal, and Waterbirds. Our results show that PURGE consistently reduces hallucinations and spurious-correlation-driven errors while maintaining or improving overall performance in most evaluated settings, providing both a reusable evaluation protocol and an effective mitigation framework for more reliable LVLMs.

</details>


### [158] [Discrete Diffusion Bridges for Spatiotemporally Aligned Image Translation and Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29997)
*Xing Xie,Jiawei Liu,Shijun Zhou,Huijie Fan,Zhi Han,Yandong Tang,Liangqiong Qu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出离散扩散桥（DDB）框架，解决标准离散扩散在图像翻译和生成中的时空错位问题。通过空间上引入混合吸收机制（将吸收态定义为掩码与源token的随机混合）保留源图像结构先验，时间上设计信息引导的噪声调度（优先破坏高信息区域）对齐"先易后难"的解码机制，从而在文本引导语义操作和纯结构图像翻译中实现编辑对齐与结构保真的平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准离散扩散的前向过程存在双重错位：(1) 空间上，将数据破坏为纯掩码状态完全丢弃了源图像的丰富结构先验；(2) 时间上，随机掩码顺序与推理时"先易后难"的解码机制内在矛盾。这两方面问题严重制约了离散扩散在图像翻译和生成任务中的性能。

Method: DDB框架包含两个核心设计：(1) 空间上提出混合吸收机制，重新定义吸收态为掩码与源token的随机混合，将源图像先验作为空间锚点注入潜在空间；(2) 时间上设计信息引导的噪声调度，通过量化语义变化来优先在早期时间步破坏高信息区域，使模型学会利用不变区域的鲁棒上下文来解析困难的语义变化。

Result: 大量实验验证了该框架在多种生成范式中的通用性和鲁棒性。DDB在文本引导语义操作和纯结构图像翻译中有效平衡了编辑对齐与结构保真，同时天然补充了文生图任务，并在极低采样步数下保证鲁棒的高质量解码。

Conclusion: DDB通过直接高效的域间轨迹构建，从空间和时间两个维度系统性地解决了离散扩散的错位问题，为图像翻译与生成提供了一个统一且灵活的框架，代码和模型已开源。

Abstract: We propose Discrete Diffusion Bridges (DDB), a novel framework designed to resolve the fundamental spatiotemporal misalignment of standard discrete diffusion in image translation and generation. By corrupting data into a pure mask state via a random schedule, the conventional forward process induces a twofold misalignment: spatially, this pure-mask destination entirely discards the rich structural priors of the source image; temporally, the random masking order inherently contradicts the ``easy-first, hard-last'' decoding mechanism used during inference. To address this, DDB constructs a direct and efficient trajectory between domains. Spatially, we introduce a hybrid absorption mechanism that redefines the absorbing state to a stochastic mixture of mask and source tokens, effectively injecting source prior as spatial anchors into the latent space. Temporally, we design an information-guided noise schedule that quantifies semantic variation to prioritize the corruption of high-information regions at earlier timesteps. This ensures the model learns to resolve difficult semantic changes using robust context from invariant regions. Extensive experiments validate the versatility and robustness of our framework across diverse generative paradigms. DDB effectively balances edit alignment with structural fidelity across both text-guided semantic manipulation and pure structural image translation, while inherently complementing text-to-image generation and guaranteeing robust high-quality decoding under extremely low sampling steps. Code and models are available at \href{https://github.com/HKU-HealthAI/DDB}{https://github.com/HKU-HealthAI/DDB}.

</details>


### [159] [OPAL: Orthonormal Prototype Alignment Learning for Interpretable Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30003)
*Ilán Carretero,Gustavo Jesús Angulo,Rocío del Amor,Valery Naranjo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出OPAL（正交原型对齐学习），一种单阶段端到端的可解释分类框架，通过预定义正交基锚定潜在空间，使每个类别嵌入由固定部分原型张成的专用子空间中，利用空间竞争机制实现精确部位定位，无需辅助损失即可完成分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的原型部分模型存在两个主要缺陷：一是依赖复杂多阶段的训练流程，二是过度依赖辅助正则化来防止原型崩溃。这些限制增加了训练复杂度和不稳定性，亟需更简洁高效的解决方案。

Method: OPAL采用单阶段端到端框架：1)使用预定义正交基锚定潜在空间，将每个类别嵌入由固定部分原型张成的专用子空间；2)通过特征图间的空间竞争机制实现精确的部位定位，隔离稀疏判别区域；3)引导每个原型在不同图像上一致关注相同语义概念；4)将分类问题转化为直接的表征对齐任务，消除辅助损失需求。

Result: 在细粒度基准数据集上的大量实验表明，OPAL在性能上超越了非可解释对应方法以及最先进的部分原型方法，并能提供细粒度的视觉解释，明确揭示每个预测所依据的具体图像区域。

Conclusion: OPAL通过巧妙的正交基设计和空间竞争机制，成功简化了可解释分类的训练流程，在保持可解释性的同时提升了分类性能，为原型学习方法提供了更简洁有效的替代方案。

Abstract: Prototypical part-based models provide explainable predictions by comparing input regions to learned prototypes. However, current approaches are burdened by complex, multi-stage training pipelines and heavily rely on auxiliary regularization to prevent prototype collapse. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Orthonormal Prototype Alignment Learning (OPAL), a single-stage, end-to-end framework that simplifies interpretable classification. Our approach anchors the latent space using predefined orthonormal bases, embedding each class within a dedicated subspace spanned by fixed part-prototypes. To achieve precise part localization, OPAL enforces spatial competition across feature maps. This mechanism isolates sparse, discriminative regions, directing each prototype to consistently attend to the same semantic concept across different images. By framing classification as a direct representation alignment task, our method eliminates the need for auxiliary losses. Extensive experiments on fine-grained benchmarks demonstrate that OPAL outperforms both its non-interpretable counterparts and state-of-the-art part-prototype methods, delivering granular visual explanations by explicitly revealing the specific image regions driving every prediction. Code is available at https://github.com/ilancarretero/OPAL.

</details>


### [160] [Input-Adaptive Gating of a Dehazing Front-End for On-Device Perception in Smoke-Obscured Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30034)
*Seongjun Kang,Ishaan Garg,Vishnu Bharadwaj*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究消防员辅助管道中"去雾网络+边缘检测"两阶段视觉流水线，发现去雾在浓烟下提升边缘提取但会损害清晰/轻雾帧，因此引入基于暗通道阈值门控机制，仅当雾浓度超标时才运行去雾器，在Raspberry Pi 4上平均ODS达到0.675，同时将平均每帧处理时间从569ms降至321ms。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统两阶段视觉管道通常假设"更干净的输入产生更好的输出"，盲目地在任务网络前放置增强网络。作者想验证这一假设在真实消防辅助场景（去雾+边缘检测）中是否成立，并寻求更高效的自适应方案。

Method: 构建一个355K参数的轻量去雾网络（18.60 dB PSNR）和一个23K参数的边缘检测器，均量化为UINT8部署于Raspberry Pi 4。通过暗通道雾度估计作为门控条件，仅当雾度超过阈值时才执行去雾阶段（阈值测试仅需10.1ms），否则跳过直接进行边缘检测。

Result: 去雾在浓烟下提升边缘提取，但损害清晰/轻雾帧。门控方案在四个雾度级别上的平均ODS为0.675，优于始终去雾（0.664）和永不去雾（0.630）；在Raspberry Pi上平均每帧时间从569ms降至321ms，清晰帧的帧率从1.8提升至9 fps（提升5倍）。

Conclusion: 两阶段管道的"干净输入更好"假设并非普遍成立；通过廉价的雾度估计门控，可以在不牺牲准确性的前提下显著节省计算资源，实现按需增强的自适应视觉管道设计。

Abstract: Two-stage vision pipelines often place an enhancement network before a task network, on the assumption that a cleaner input produces a better output. We evaluate this in a firefighter assistance pipeline, where a dehazer precedes an edge detector that renders smoke-filled rooms as structural outlines. Both were designed for a Raspberry Pi 4, at 355K and 23K parameters, and quantized to UINT8 via TensorFlow Lite. The float dehazer reaches 18.60 dB peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) on held-out real smoke against 13.60 dB unprocessed and 17.08 dB for an AOD-Net trained on the same data, and the edge detector reaches an F-measure at optimal dataset scale (ODS) of 0.738, outperforming an optimized Canny's result of 0.692. Dehazing improves edge extraction under dense smoke but degrades it on clear and lightly hazed frames, where the dehazer discards more detail than the haze obscures. We therefore run the dehazer only when a dark channel haze estimate exceeds a threshold, a 10.1 ms test that lets the pipeline save 469.6 ms on the dehazing stage. Averaged over four haze levels, gating is more accurate than either fixed decision, at 0.675 mean ODS against 0.664 for always dehazing and 0.630 for never dehazing. It reduces the mean per-frame time on the Raspberry Pi from 569 ms to 321 ms, and on clear frames increases the frame rate fivefold, from 1.8 to 9 frames per second.

</details>


### [161] [TAKE 85: Testing Audiovisual filmmaKer's intEnt across 85 Hours of Film](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30068)
*Kaishuu Shinozaki-Conefrey,Olivier Pascaud,Robin Courant,Xi Wang,Dimitris Samaras,Vicky Kalogeiton*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出TAKE 85基准，首个用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLM）对导演意图理解能力的基准，包含398部短片（85小时）及专家验证的问答对，覆盖视觉和音频意图。实验发现最强模型仅获58分，且感知识别与意图理解之间存在显著差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLM评估几乎只关注"发生了什么"（内容理解），而忽略了"为什么这样呈现"（导演意图理解）。人类能自然解读电影制作中的创意选择（灯光、色彩、构图、剪辑等）所传达的意图，但当前模型在这一维度上缺乏系统性评估。

Method: 构建TAKE 85基准：包含398部短片（85小时），由专家验证的问答对覆盖全局和细粒度的视觉与音频意图；通过受控模态消融实验实现多模态推理的系统评估。

Result: 对最先进的MLLM实验显示，模型能准确描述事件和叙事，但始终无法推断电影制作决策的沟通作用。最强模型仅得58/100分，且消融实验表明没有任何单一输入模态足以独立支撑意图理解。

Conclusion: 导演意图理解是此前被忽视的多模态理解维度，现有MLLM在感知识别与意图推断之间存在显著鸿沟，需要多模态协同推理才能实现真正的电影意图理解。

Abstract: Films communicate through deliberate creative choices, including lighting, color, composition, editing, dialogue, music, and sound. Humans naturally interpret these signals as directorial intent, yet current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are evaluated almost exclusively on understanding what happens rather than why it is presented that way. We introduce TAKE 85, the first benchmark for directorial-intent understanding, comprising 398 short films (85 hours) with expert-verified question-answer pairs spanning global and fine-grained visual and audio intent. Through controlled modality ablations, TAKE 85 enables systematic evaluation of multimodal reasoning. Experiments on state-of-the-art MLLMs reveal a substantial gap between perceptual recognition and intentional understanding: while models accurately describe events and narratives, they consistently fail to infer the communicative role of filmmaking decisions. Our results establish directorial intent as a previously overlooked dimension of multimodal understanding: even the strongest model reaches only 58 out of 100, and our ablations show that no input modality is sufficient on its own. All code, Q&As, and models are publicly available from https://github.com/KaiShinozakiConefrey/Take-85

</details>


### [162] [The Nearest Target Is the Wrong One: Target Separation in Arc2Face Identity Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30087)
*Zeynel Tok*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究人脸条件生成器（Arc2Face）中的身份遗忘（unlearning）问题，发现通过重定向条件嵌入来遗忘身份可能"静默失败"——即使重定向后输出仍被识别为原身份。作者证明失败与否取决于重定向目标在识别空间中距遗忘身份的距离，最近邻目标最容易失败，而最不相似的目标则能完美遗忘（30/30组，遗忘身份重识别率从51.9降至0.0），且保留能力不受影响、输出仍可验证（710/720到达目标），独立识别器AdaFace验证相关性r=0.94，表明目标分离度是身份遗忘的一阶可报告设计变量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 身份遗忘是生成模型合规与隐私保护的关键需求。已有方法通过重定向条件嵌入实现遗忘，但可能"静默失败"——输出仍被识别为原身份，这种失败机制此前未被系统研究。作者希望揭示失败根源并给出可控的设计变量。

Method: 以Arc2Face为对象，使用锁定的ArcFace识别协议和投影适配器在生成前重定向身份条件。构建"困难邻居压力测试"（最难的0.5%合格身份），对比四种目标选择策略：从最近硬目标到最不相似目标，并利用AdaFace进行双重验证。

Result: 四种目标选择策略呈现单调响应：清洁遗忘从最近硬目标的9/30组提升到最不相似目标的30/30组；遗忘身份平均重识别率从51.9降至0.0，保留率保持平稳。最不相似目标下710/720代输出精确到达目标身份，无泄漏。AdaFace独立验证结果与ArcFace高度相关（r=0.94），排除验证器伪影。

Conclusion: 重定向目标与遗忘身份在识别空间中的分离度是身份遗忘成功与否的一阶决定因素，应作为可报告的设计变量纳入身份遗忘协议。最直观的最近邻选择反而最易引发静默失败，这为后续身份遗忘方法的设计与评测提供了重要指导。

Abstract: Unlearning an identity from a face-conditioned generator by redirecting its conditioning embedding can silently fail if the redirected output is still verified as the original person. We show that this failure depends on a controllable choice of how far the redirection target lies from the forget identity in recognition space, and that the most intuitive target, the nearest neighbour, is the one most likely to cause it. We audit Arc2Face with a locked ArcFace protocol and a projection adapter that redirects identity conditioning before generation. On a hard-neighbour stress test built from the hardest 0.5% of eligible identities, four target-selection policies show a monotonic response: clean forgetting rises from 9/30 groups under the nearest hard target to 30/30 under the least similar one. Mean forget-identity re-identification falls from 51.9 to 0.0 while mean retention stays flat. This reflects successful redirection rather than outputs becoming unverifiable: 710 of 720 least-sim-hard generations arrive at the chosen target, with no leakage to unrelated identities. Re-verifying identical images with an independent recogniser (AdaFace) preserves that trend, correlating at r=0.94, arguing against a verifier artefact. Target separation is thus a first-order, reportable design variable for identity unlearning.

</details>


### [163] [A Hybrid State-Space Approach for Census-Tract Population Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30094)
*Jackson R. Ye,Alexandre V. Morozov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MambaPop是一种基于状态空间-注意力混合架构（MambaVision）的人口估计方法，将每个行政区单元视为一个多边形掩膜的卫星图像，把普查区级人口估计当作序列建模问题，直接学习行政单元图像与其人口标签的映射，消除了传统的人口网格化分解步骤。在2020年美国约84,000个普查区的评估中，MambaPop达到MAE 1,141人，与最强的卷积基线YOLOv11（MAE 1,122）相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有卫星影像人口估计系统（如WorldPop、LandScan）依赖辅助数据构建加权面将人口普查计数分解到统一栅格上，这会产生系统性空间偏差，且丢弃了人口普查实际收集时的行政单元结构。卷积神经网络逐格预测人口的方式没有利用行政单元本身的结构信息。

Method: MambaPop将每个行政单元渲染为单个多边形掩膜的卫星图像，将普查区级人口估计转化为对图像分块（patches）的序列建模问题。采用MambaVision混合骨干架构（结合状态空间模型与注意力机制），将每个行政单元图像直接与其人口标签配对，完全消除分解（disaggregation）步骤。

Result: 在2020年人口普查的约84,000个美国本土普查区上，MambaPop达到平均绝对误差1,141人/普查区，与最强卷积基线YOLOv11（MAE 1,122）表现相当。

Conclusion: MambaPop是首个直接从行政单元自身图像学习人口的方法，也是首个将基于状态空间的Mamba混合架构应用于人口估计任务的工作。该方法的性能与最强卷积基线相当，展示了序列模型在此类任务中的潜力。

Abstract: Sequence models---the architecture family behind large language models and, increasingly, state-of-the-art image recognition---have redefined how machines learn from high-dimensional data. Yet population estimation from satellite imagery, a task that underpins infrastructure planning, public health, and disaster response, has scarcely benefited: leading systems still bind population to a uniform raster, disaggregating census counts onto grid cells through weighting surfaces built from ancillary data (e.g., in WorldPop and LandScan), which can introduce systematic spatial bias, and predicting population per grid cell with convolutional neural networks. In this approach, the administrative-unit structure in which the census was actually collected is discarded. We close this gap with MambaPop, which renders each administrative unit as a single polygon-masked satellite image and treats tract-level population estimation as a sequence-modeling problem over its image patches, pairing each tract image directly with its population label and eliminating the disaggregation step entirely. Built on the hybrid state-space--attention MambaVision backbone, MambaPop is, to our knowledge, the first method to learn population directly from an administrative unit's own image as well as the first to apply a state-space based (Mamba) hybrid architecture to the population estimation task. Across all $\sim$84{,}000 contiguous-US census tracts of the 2020 census, MambaPop attains a mean absolute error (MAE) of $1{,}141$ persons per tract, matching the strongest convolutional baseline (YOLOv11, MAE $1{,}122$).

</details>


### [164] [Aligning Multi-Trajectory Supervision with Policy Optimization for VLA Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30122)
*Tian Zhang,Zhuo Huang,Hongrui Ye,Yu Wu,Zengmao Wang,Kaixuan Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个将多轨迹监督与策略优化对齐的框架，通过可行性优先的优势分配和动态蒸馏机制，解决VLA驾驶方法中GRPO策略优化因不可行噪声轨迹导致的梯度偏差问题。在NAVSIM v1和v2上分别达到91.4 PDMS和89.1 EPDMS，并恢复658个初始失败场景中的440个。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA驾驶方法结合多轨迹模仿学习与GRPO时，某些高分轨迹虽能改善模仿效果，但会使优势估计与当前策略的可行行为分布不匹配，从而将策略更新推向不安全不合规的行为。现有方法缺少对轨迹选择与策略优化之间对齐的机制。

Method: 1) 将增强轨迹约束在真实可行区域的邻域流形上；2) 采用帕累托最优准则替代传统聚合分数，仅保留非支配候选轨迹以在源头过滤冲突样本；3) 提出可行性优先优势分配机制，根据每个rollout组的可行性组成自适应调整帕累托信用，引导完全不可行组转向安全参考；4) 引入动态蒸馏机制，跨细化轮次更新教师轨迹，持续传递有效监督。

Result: 在NAVSIM v1和v2上分别达到91.4 PDMS和89.1 EPDMS（单轨迹推理）；成功恢复440个初始失败的场景（占比66.9%），比原始GRPO基线高11.1%。

Conclusion: 该框架通过将多轨迹监督与策略优化对齐，有效解决了不可行噪声轨迹引起的策略梯度偏差问题，并逐步将扩展监督的优势转化为策略改进，验证了轨迹选择与优化机制结合的有效性。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) driving methods increasingly combine multi-trajectory imitation learning with group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), making trajectory selection critical to final performance. However, some high-scoring trajectories that improve imitation can degrade subsequent GRPO by inducing advantage estimates misaligned with the current policy's feasible behavior distribution, driving updates away from safe and compliant behaviors. To address this, we propose a novel framework that aligns multi-trajectory supervision with policy optimization. To address the policy gradient bias induced by infeasible noisy trajectories outside the feasible region, augmented trajectories are constrained to a neighboring manifold of the ground-truth feasible region, and a Pareto-optimality criterion is adopted in place of the conventional aggregate score, retaining only non-dominated candidates and thereby filtering out conflicting samples at the source. To ensure that expanded trajectory supervision is effectively absorbed during policy optimization, we introduce two complementary mechanisms: feasibility-first advantage assignment and dynamic distillation. The former adapts Pareto credit to the feasibility composition of each rollout group and guides fully infeasible groups toward safe references. The latter updates teacher trajectories across refinement rounds to continually transfer useful supervision. Together, they progressively translate the benefits of expanded supervision into policy improvement. On NAVSIM v1 and v2, our method achieves 91.4 PDMS and 89.1 EPDMS, respectively, under single-trajectory inference, and recovers 440 of 658 initially failed scenes, 11.1\% higher than the original GRPO baseline.

</details>


### [165] [Efficient and High-Quality Depth Estimation via Pixel-Space Diffusion with Linear Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30129)
*Bingde Liu,Wu Ran,Jinglei Zhang,Huanhuan Yuan,Chao Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Lapis是一个基于线性注意力的像素空间生成框架，通过单步扩散实现高效且高保真的单目深度估计。它采用从粗到细的分层架构（Patch级一致性模块和Pixel级细化模块），并利用流形假设采用直接x预测策略，在保持SOTA精度的同时大幅降低推理延迟（1080P下7.6倍、1440P下10.9倍）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式框架在单目深度估计中展示了卓越的细节保真度，但标准注意力的O(N²)复杂度和多步去噪过程使得将其扩展到高分辨率应用时计算成本过高，亟需在保持质量的同时大幅提升推理效率。

Method: 1)提出线性注意力替代标准注意力以降低复杂度；2)采用粗到细的分层架构：Patch级一致性模块整合语义和空间先验恢复结构连贯性，Pixel级细化模块通过基于跳跃连接的像素对应恢复锐利几何边界；3)利用流形假设，采用直接x预测策略以缓解单步扩散中的采样噪声，直接瞄准干净数据流形。

Result: 在多个基准上，Lapis在各种分辨率下均达到SOTA精度和边界锐度，且在1080P分辨率下推理延迟降低7.6倍，1440P分辨率下降低10.9倍。

Conclusion: Lapis有效解决了线性注意力和单步预测直接应用时导致的结构一致性差、细节丢失和噪声问题，证明了在保持生成式深度估计高质量的同时实现高效推理的可行性。

Abstract: This work presents $\textbf{Lapis}$, a $\textbf{l}$inear-$\textbf{a}$ttention-based $\textbf{pi}$xel-$\textbf{s}$pace generative framework that achieves efficient and high-fidelity depth estimation with one-step diffusion. While generative frameworks have significantly advanced monocular depth estimation with superior detail fidelity, the $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ complexity of standard attention and the multi-step denoising process introduce prohibitive computational costs when scaling them to high-resolution image applications. Although linear attention and one-step prediction are intuitively viable, directly applying them leads to poor structural consistency, detail loss, and noise. Lapis rectifies these limitations through a coarse-to-fine hierarchy. Specifically, a Patch-level Consistency Module restores structural coherence by integrating semantic and spatial priors. Subsequently, a Pixel-level Refinement Module recovers sharp geometric boundaries via skip-connection-based pixel correspondence. Furthermore, to mitigate sampling noise inherent in one-step diffusion, we leverage the manifold assumption and adopt a direct $\mathbf{x}$-prediction strategy to target the clean data manifold. Extensive evaluations on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that Lapis consistently achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) accuracy and boundary sharpness across various resolutions, reducing inference latency by up to 7.6$\times$ at 1080P and 10.9$\times$ at 1440P resolution compared to previous SOTA generative models.

</details>


### [166] [Repeatability Characterisation and Error Budget of a Consumer Structured-Light Scanner for 3-D Wound Geometry:A Rigid-Phantom Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30143)
*Pushkal Kumar,Aadit Aggarwal,Karlen Aleksanyan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究评估了一款手持消费级结构光三维扫描仪在重建伤口几何描述符时的测量误差。基于23次扫描、9个部位、单一扫描仪的数据，发现重建表面积的95%重复性界限高达4.8倍（置信区间3.0-7.0），45个描述符中44个的组内相关系数低于0.50，且所有248种描述符与管线组合均未达0.75。误差预算分析表明，操作者捕获表面范围的差异主导了多数描述符的误差，而更好的传感器收益有限。研究还指出，与临床四周期面积缩减比的比较（约2.1）是对未分割管线的噪声下限估计，标准化分析区域可将其降至2.13，但统计离群值剔除会引入约11%的系统性面积偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 伤口的三维几何描述符被广泛用于临床评估和预测愈合，但消费级结构光扫描仪的测量误差尚未被充分表征。由于刚性伤口护理假体不会变化，重复扫描间的差异即为纯测量误差，这为量化此类设备的可信度提供了独特机会，从而判断其临床可用性与可靠性。

Method: 使用单一自由手持消费级结构光扫描仪，对9个部位的刚性伤口护理假体进行23次重复扫描，所有差异归因于测量误差。计算95%重复性界限、组内相关系数（ICC），并通过固定分析区域、保持传感器与重建不变的方式构建误差预算，将方差归因于操作者捕获范围等因素。同时比较了不同分析管线和描述符组合，评估统计离群值剔除的影响。

Result: 重建表面积95%重复性界限为4.8倍（CI: 3.0-7.0），可将读数从79%缩减偏移至377%增长；45个描述符中44个ICC低于0.50，无一组合达到0.75。操作者捕获区域差异解释表面面积75%、凸包面积91%、包围盒对角线95%的方差（仅凸包体积以48%为主受传感器限制）。与四周期面积缩减比率的比较（约2.1）为下限估计；标准化分析区域降至2.13但仅持平该比率；离群值剔除引入约11%系统性面积赤字。

Conclusion: 消费级结构光扫描仪的三维伤口描述符测量误差极大，尤其是受操作者捕获范围影响显著的描述符。当前管线在不引入更高级处理（如标准化分析区域、分割）的情况下，难以达到临床所需的可靠性。改进传感器并非主要杠杆，规范化的操作流程和区域界定才是提升可重复性的关键。

Abstract: We characterise the measurement error of a free- hand consumer structured-light scanner used to derive three- dimensional geometric wound descriptors. Rigid wound-care phantoms cannot change, so every difference between repeat scans of one site is measurement error; all repeats come from a single scanner unit, nine sites and 23 scans, so this charac- terises one instrument. The 95 percent repeatability limit for reconstructed surface area is a factor of 4.8, with a confidence interval from 3.0 to 7.0, so rescanning an unchanged site can shift the reading from a 79 percent decrease to a 377 percent increase. Forty-four of 45 descriptors fall below an intraclass correlation of 0.50, and none of 248 descriptor and pipeline combinations reaches 0.75. An error budget formed by holding the analy- sis region fixed, leaving sensor and reconstruction untouched, bounds the share of variance attributable to how much surface the operator captured at 75 percent for surface area, 91 percent for hull area and 95 percent for bounding-box diagonal; only hull volume is majority instrumental, at 48 percent, so a better sensor would buy little. No wound is delineated anywhere in the chain, so the comparison against the four-week area reduction used clinically to predict healing, a ratio near 2.1, is a lower bound on the noise an unsegmented pipeline must overcome, not a measurement of wound-area reproducibility. Standardising the analysis region cuts the limit to 2.13, meeting that ratio rather than clearing it. Statistical outlier removal imposes a measured systematic area deficit near 11 percent.

</details>


### [167] [CedarCypress3D: an annotated UAV-LiDAR dataset of individual trees in planted cedar and cypress forests](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30149)
*Katsuto Shimizu,Fumiaki Kitahara,Tomohiro Nishizono,Hideki Saito,Masayoshi Takahashi,Shingo Obata,Shunsuke Tei,Naoyuki Furuya,Tomoya Goto,Eiji Kodani,Yusuke Yamada*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍了CedarCypress3D，一个在日本柳杉和日本扁柏人工林中采集的手动标注UAV-LiDAR数据集，包含34个圆形样地、1,627棵实测树木以及部分样地的地面LiDAR数据，可用于个体树分割和语义分割的研究与开发。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习在点云个体树分割上的进展增加了对标注数据集的需求，但温带森林中公开可用的UAV-LiDAR标注数据集非常有限，亟需补充高质量数据集以支持算法开发与评估。

Method: 在日本两个不同地形特征的样地中采集UAV-LiDAR点云，结合野外调查对1,627棵树进行手动标注匹配；对22个样地的子集补充地面LiDAR数据，并为树点添加语义标签（树干与非树干）。

Result: 构建了包含UAV-LiDAR点云、野外实测数据及部分地面LiDAR数据的CedarCypress3D数据集，提供高质量标注用于个体树实例分割和语义分割任务。

Conclusion: CedarCypress3D可为温带人工林中个体树分割和语义分割方法的开发与评估提供支持，也可用于树木属性预测和多平台LiDAR分析研究，数据集已公开供研究者使用。

Abstract: Individual tree measurements derived from Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) mounted on Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV) provide valuable information for forest inventory, ecosystem monitoring, and sustainable forest management. Recent advancements in machine learning have increased the demand for annotated datasets to develop and evaluate point cloud-based approaches, especially for individual tree segmentation. However, publicly available annotated UAV-LiDAR datasets in temperate forests are limited. In this article, we present CedarCypress3D, a manually annotated UAV-LiDAR dataset collected in Japanese cedar (Cryptomeria japonica) and Japanese cypress (Chamaecyparis obtusa) plantations in Japan. The dataset consists of UAV-LiDAR point clouds and field survey measurements from 34 circular plots across two sites with different topographic characteristics, along with terrestrial LiDAR point clouds available for a subset of 22 plots. A total of 1,627 trees were measured in the census field survey and manually annotated to match the corresponding trees in the UAV-LiDAR point clouds. For the subset of plots with terrestrial LiDAR data, semantic labels (i.e., stem and non-stem) were additionally assigned to tree points in the UAV-LiDAR data. CedarCypress3D provides high-quality annotated UAV-LiDAR data for developing and evaluating individual tree instance segmentation and semantic segmentation methods in temperate planted forests. The dataset can also support research on tree attribute prediction and multi-platform LiDAR analysis. The dataset is publicly available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22168721.

</details>


### [168] [AI-enabled Low-Cost 3D Maize Ear Morphometry Platform at Breeding Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30161)
*Therin Young,Elijah Rodriguez,Lisa Coffey,Talukder Zaki Jubery,Adarsh Krishnamurthy,Patrick Schnable,Baskar Ganapathysubramanian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文开发并验证了一种低成本玉米果穗3D表型高通量管线：仅需消费级单反相机配合电动转盘拍摄20秒视频，通过COLMAP初始化NeRF重建水密3D网格，利用已知直径的圆柱夹具实现自动度量标定。在300个果穗中83.3%通过自动处理与质控，骨架长度与卡尺测量高度一致(R²=0.964)，凸包体积与水置换法高度吻合(R²=0.982)。硬件成本约607美元，操作时间从5分钟降至1分钟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 玉米果穗几何特征（长度、宽度、曲率、体积）与产量和灌浆结果密切相关，但现有高通量表型管线受限于成本高、劳动密集和需要专用硬件，缺乏低成本、可推广的解决方案。

Method: 采用COLMAP多视角重建初始化NeRF（神经辐射场）从单段20秒视频中重建水密3D网格；使用每帧可见的已知直径圆柱夹具提供自动度量缩放和几何质量控制；整体流程在电动转盘和均匀LED照明下使用消费级DSLR拍摄。

Result: 300个果穗中250个（83.3%）通过自动处理和质控；骨架长度与卡尺测量R²=0.964、RMSE=4.68mm；凸包体积与水置换法R²=0.982、RMSE=5.26mL；残差长度误差随曲率增长，但源于测量定义差异（卡尺测弦长、骨架测弧长）；硬件约607美元，人工操作从5分钟降至1分钟。

Conclusion: 该低成本管线为育种规模的三维果穗表型分析提供了可行基础，显著降低了成本和时间开销，且揭示了测量定义对几何指标评估的重要影响。

Abstract: Maize ear geometry (length, width, curvature, and volume) is closely tied to yield and grain-filling outcomes, but existing high-throughput phenotyping pipelines remain constrained by the cost, labor, and specialized hardware they require. We developed and validated a low-cost pipeline that reconstructs a watertight 3-D mesh of a maize ear from a single 20-second video captured with a consumer-grade DSLR on a motorized turntable under uniform LED illumination. Camera poses from a multi-seed COLMAP procedure initialize a Neural Radiance Field (NeRF), and a cylindrical holder of known diameter, visible in every frame, provides automatic metric scaling with downstream geometric quality control. Applied to 300 ears spanning a diverse maize inbred panel, 250 (83.3%) passed automated processing and quality control. Skeleton length agreed with manual caliper measurements across all 250 ears (R^2 = 0.964, RMSE = 4.68 mm), and convex-hull volume agreed with water-displacement volume on a 15-ear subset spanning the full size range (R^2 = 0.982, RMSE = 5.26 mL). Residual length error grew with ear curvature, whereas bounding-box height, which records the same straight-line chord as calipers, showed no such trend; the discrepancy therefore originates in the measurement definition, since calipers record the chord while skeleton length traces the geodesic arc. The capture hardware costs approximately 607 USD, and operator involvement fell from roughly five minutes to one minute per ear, with all downstream processing running unattended. The platform provides a foundation for breeding-scale 3-D ear phenotyping.

</details>


### [169] [ATGS: Anchored Temporal Gaussian Splatting for Long Volumetric Video Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30184)
*Jiahao Wu,Jie Liang,Die Hu,Jiayu Yang,Kaiqiang Xiong,Xiang Li,Xiaoyun Zheng,Chao Wang,Ronggang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ATGS，一种基于高斯溅射的体视频重建框架，通过时间条件锚点组织和时间窗口策略来解决长序列复杂运动视频中的时间不稳定和视觉伪影问题，并在实验中优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有体视频方法在处理长序列和复杂运动时表现不佳，常出现时间不稳定和视觉伪影。根本原因在于用单个高斯图元显式追踪长期复杂运动本质上是不稳定的。

Method: 1) 将高斯组织在时间条件锚点周围，锚点限定其空间与时间支持范围，降低长距离运动复杂度；2) 引入时间窗口策略，仅激活与查询时间相关的锚点，提升可扩展性和时间一致性；3) 设计紧凑的多层级锚点特征（全局特征、局部空间特征、局部时间特征），联合约束高斯生成以保证时空稳定性。

Result: 大量实验表明，ATGS在长序列、复杂运动的体视频上一致优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 通过锚点化高斯表示与时间窗口机制，有效解决了长序列体视频重建的时空稳定性问题，为动态场景的沉浸式自由视点渲染提供了更可靠的方案。

Abstract: Volumetric video enables immersive free viewpoint rendering of dynamic real world scenes, yet existing methods struggle with long sequences and complex motions, often leading to temporal instability and visual artifacts. To address these challenges, we propose \ourname, a Gaussian splatting based framework for volumetric video reconstruction. Our key insight is that explicitly tracking long term complex motion with individual Gaussian primitives is inherently unstable. Instead, we organize Gaussians around time conditioned anchors that localize their spatial and temporal support, thereby reducing long range motion complexity. We further introduce a temporal windowing strategy to activate only anchors relevant to the queried time, which improves scalability and temporal coherence. In addition, to ensure spatial and temporal stability, we design a compact set of multi level anchor features that encode global features, local spatial features, and local temporal features, jointly constraining Gaussian generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \ourname \ consistently outperforms prior methods on long sequence volumetric videos with complex motions. Project page: https://github.com/WuJH2001/ATGS.

</details>


### [170] [NoisEasier: Test-Time Noise Optimization for Text-to-Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30194)
*Yujiang Pu,Yu Kong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: NoisEasier是一个测试时扩展框架，通过可微分的奖励引导噪声优化来提升文本到视频（T2V）生成的细粒度组合对齐能力，无需修改底层模型。它结合高效短步生成器和多目标奖励公式，在现实推理预算下实现稳定的测试时优化，在VBench和T2V-CompBench上平均提升超过10%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在T2V生成中仍难以处理细粒度组合对齐（如属性绑定、空间关系和对象交互）。现有的基于奖励的微调方法容易遭受奖励黑客攻击（reward hacking），且对新提示分布适应性差。因此需要一种不修改底层模型、可扩展的测试时优化方案。

Method: 提出NoisEasier框架，核心思路是：(1)利用高效短步生成器降低测试时优化的计算成本；(2)采用多目标奖励公式同时优化多维度对齐；(3)关键洞察是联合优化整个随机轨迹而非仅优化初始潜变量，这样可以加速奖励收敛并提升组合对齐效果，且额外计算和时间成本可忽略。

Result: 在VBench和T2V-CompBench基准上，跨多个骨干模型均取得一致的改进，在属性绑定、对象交互和计数等挑战性维度上平均提升超过10%。

Conclusion: NoisEasier既可作为奖励微调方法的灵活替代方案，也可作为其互补增强。该工作确立了测试时扩展作为可控文本到视频生成的有效范式。

Abstract: Diffusion models have recently advanced text-to-video (T2V) generation, yet they still struggle with fine-grained compositional alignment, such as attribute binding, spatial relations, and object interactions. While reward-based fine-tuning improves alignment, it is susceptible to reward hacking and adapts poorly to new prompt distributions. In this work, we propose NoisEasier, a test-time scaling framework that improves T2V generation through differentiable reward-guided noise optimization without modifying the underlying model. By combining efficient short-step generators with a multi-objective reward formulation, NoisEasier enables stable and practical test-time optimization under realistic inference budgets. Our key insight is that jointly optimizing the entire stochastic trajectory accelerates reward convergence and improves compositional alignment over optimizing only the initial latent, with negligible additional computational and time cost. Experiments on VBench and T2V-CompBench demonstrate consistent improvements across multiple backbones, achieving over 10% average gains on challenging dimensions such as attribute binding, object interaction, and numeracy. Overall, NoisEasier serves as both a flexible alternative and a complementary enhancement to reward-based fine-tuning, establishing test-time scaling as an effective paradigm for controllable text-to-video generation.

</details>


### [171] [DICS: Exploring Data Intrinsic Consistency for Visual Instruction Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30209)
*Yuyang Hong,Jinhui Guo,Jiaqi Gu,Lubin Fan,Ruixiang Wang,Kun Ding,Yue Wu,Shiming Xiang,Jieping Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出数据内在一致性（DIC）度量及基于此的自适应数据选择方法（DICS），用于在视觉指令微调中筛选高质量子集。DIC包含视觉信息一致性（VIC）和响应信息一致性（RIC）两个模块，分别评估视觉内容与指令的对齐程度以及响应与指令的连贯性。实验表明，DICS在多种数据集规模和模型架构上均优于现有方法，仅用LLaVA-1.5-665K的25%数据即可超越全量微调效果，并构建了DICS-6M大规模指令集验证方法的可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉指令微调对提升VLM的视觉-语言对齐和指令遵循能力至关重要，但在固定比例约束下从快速膨胀的数据集中识别最优子集是重大瓶颈。现有方法大多依赖分布多样性或启发式过滤，忽略了单个样本内部各组件之间的一致性，因此需要提出一种能捕捉样本内部内在一致性的选择方法。

Method: 提出DIC（Data Intrinsic Consistency）自评分度量，包含两个模块：VIC评估视觉内容与指令的对齐度，RIC评估响应与指令的连贯性。在此基础上提出DICS（Data Intrinsic Consistency Selection）自适应数据选择方法，在高样本内一致性与全局分布多样性之间进行权衡优化，适应不同数据预算。

Result: 大量实验表明，DICS在多种数据集规模和模型架构上一致优于现有最先进方法。使用仅25%的LLaVA-1.5-665K数据即可超越全量数据微调的性能。此外，构建的DICS-6M数据集支持了迄今最大规模的视觉指令选择研究，DICS仅用官方InternVL3-8B-Instruct不到25%的训练数据即达到其94.52%的性能。

Conclusion: 样本内部一致性是数据选择中一个此前被忽视但至关重要的维度。DICS通过融合样本内一致性与全局多样性，实现了在极小数据比例下超越全量微调的效果，为大规模视觉指令数据的高效筛选提供了新范式，并验证了其在更大规模数据集上的实用性和可扩展性。

Abstract: Visual instruction tuning is crucial for advancing the vision-language alignment and instruction-following capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs). However, identifying optimal subsets under a fixed ratio constraint from rapidly expanding datasets remains a significant bottleneck. While existing methods largely depend on distribution diversity or heuristic filtering, they often overlook the internal coherence within individual samples. To bridge this gap, we propose Data Intrinsic Consistency (DIC), a self-scoring metric designed to quantify the sample-level inter-component consistency. DIC consists of two modules: Visual Information Consistency (VIC), evaluating the alignment between visual content and instructions, and Response Information Consistency (RIC), assessing response coherence relative to the instruction. Building upon DIC, we introduce Data Intrinsic Consistency Selection (DICS), an adaptive data selection method that optimizes the trade-off between high intra-sample consistency and global distributional diversity under varying data budgets. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DICS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across diverse dataset scales and model architectures, surpassing full-dataset fine-tuning while using only 25% of the LLaVA-1.5-665K data. We further curate DICS-6M, a 6M-sample multi-modal instruction corpus that enables the largest-scale visual instruction selection study to date; remarkably, DICS reaches 94.52\% of the official InternVL3-8B-Instruct performance using less than 25\% of its reported training data. Code can be seen at https://github.com/cqu-student/DICS

</details>


### [172] [Towards a Joint Khmer Text Recognition and Word Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30213)
*Marry Kong,Rina Buoy,Sovisal Chenda,Nguonly Taing,Masakazu Iwamura,Koichi Kise*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种统一的柬文文本识别与分词联合框架，使用CTC解码器支持并行解码，可通过指令在有无分词（b=1/b=0）两种模式下工作，在多种文档模态基准上同时实现字符识别与词边界定位，消除了传统识别-分词串联流程中额外的分词步骤。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 柬语没有可见的词分隔符，传统的"先识别后分词"串联流程需要两个独立的顺序模型，不仅容易累积错误，而且在大规模文档处理中会引入显著的延迟开销。

Method: 提出一个统一的柬文文本识别与分词联合模型，采用CTC解码器实现快速并行解码，通过指令机制控制模型在带分词（b=1）和不带分词（b=0）两种模式下工作。

Result: 在文档、场景和手写图像等多种模态的基准数据集上，该模型不仅能识别文档图像中的字符，还能定位词边界，消除了传统串联流程中对额外分词步骤的需求。

Conclusion: 联合识别与分词框架在统一模型中同时完成两项任务，既降低了误差累积风险，又减少了处理延迟，为柬文等无分隔符语言文字的文档处理提供了更高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Text recognition, or extracting electronic text from document images, has been indispensable for knowledge retrieval tasks, such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). For Khmer, extracted text is subject to an extra word segmentation step, as Khmer does not use any visible word delimiters to denote word boundaries. Thus, a recognition-then-segmentation pipeline for Khmer requires two separate sequential models; this is not only error-prone but also adds significant latency for large-scale document processing. This paper proposes a novel joint Khmer text recognition and word segmentation framework in a unified model. The proposed model, using a connectionist-temporal-classification (CTC) decoder for fast, parallel decoding, can be instructed to recognize Khmer text with ($b=1$) and without ($b=0$) word segmentation. Experimental results on different benchmark datasets of different document modalities (document, scene, and handwritten images) show that the proposed model can not only recognize characters in document images but also locate word boundaries, removing the need for an extra word segmentation step in a conventional sequential pipeline.

</details>


### [173] [Amortized Anchor Refinement for Deployable Continuous-Time 4D Gaussian Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30218)
*Jingong Chen,Qingwen Zhang,Sanghyeon Jun,Chulwoo Pack,Kyle Gao,Kwanghee Won*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出"摊销锚点精化"(Amortized Anchor Refinement)方法，结合冻结骨干网络的快速前馈预测与短时优化，在固定计算预算下实现连续时间4D重建，并通过持久同调约束剪枝不稳定高斯，最终在独立XR头显上实现实时播放。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续时间4D重建在独立XR头显上仍不现实：逐场景优化需要部署端不可行的计算量，且降低预算会导致重建完全崩溃而非性能逐渐下降；前馈预测速度快但难以恢复场景特定细节。

Method: 1) 使用冻结骨干网络预测初始高斯表示；2) 在固定计算预算下进行短时优化以特化该表示，并设置容量下限(capacity floor)保持表示密度；3) 无需训练的持久同调约束用于剪枝不稳定高斯，保留拓扑持久结构；4) 将生成的轨迹直接作为场景流进行流式播放。

Result: 在Stage-Capture基准上达到24.31±2.22dB的PSNR；部署实验表明能在单张消费级GPU上于目标预算内完成重建，并在独立XR头显上实现播放。

Conclusion: 该方法证明了4D重建可以在独立XR头显的硬件约束下实现，通过摊销优化与拓扑感知的剪枝策略，兼顾了重建质量与部署可行性。

Abstract: Continuous-time 4D reconstruction remains impractical on standalone XR headsets. Per-scene optimization demands deployment-infeasible compute, and lower budgets cause collapse rather than degrade gradually. Feed-forward prediction is fast, but struggle to recover scene-specific detail. We present Amortized Anchor Refinement, which uses a frozen backbone to predict an initial Gaussian representation and a short optimization to specialize it under a fixed compute budget, with a capacity floor preserving representational density. A training-free stage then applies a persistent-homology constraint to prune unstable Gaussians while preserving topologically persistent structures, and streams the resulting trajectories directly as scene flow. On the Stage-Capture benchmark, Amortized Anchor Refinement achieves 24.31$\pm$2.22dB, while our deployment experiments demonstrate reconstruction within the target budget on a single consumer GPU and playback on a standalone XR headset.

</details>


### [174] [Semantic-Spatial Discriminability Enhancement for Generalized Visual Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30233)
*Kaiyan Lei,Xu-Yao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个名为SSDE（语义-空间判别性增强）的框架，用于广义视觉定位任务。该框架通过SeDE模块增强细粒度语义判别能力（利用空间引导的跨注意力解耦目标相关视觉属性），以及SpDE模块增强空间判别能力（通过实例中心密度图构建实例分离结构），在十个数据集上取得了优越性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 广义视觉定位（GVG）任务在复杂多目标场景下，现有方法依赖全局语义匹配或粗粒度区域交互，容易混淆视觉相似的目标，难以建立稳定的实例级决策边界。

Method: 提出了SSDE框架，包含两个核心模块：(1) SeDE模块：通过空间引导的跨注意力解耦细粒度目标相关视觉属性，并与文本主语语义整合，增强查询表征的语义判别性；(2) SpDE模块：建模实例中心密度图以刻画目标空间分布，并作为辅助监督信号显式构建空间域中的实例分离结构。

Result: 在经典和广义视觉定位任务的十个数据集上，SSDE均取得了优于现有方法的性能。

Conclusion: 同时增强细粒度语义判别和空间定位判别能力，可以有效解决多目标场景下的视觉混淆问题，提升实例级定位精度。

Abstract: Generalized Visual Grounding (GVG) task aims to localize targets in an image based on referring expressions, extends the classical visual grounding paradigm by integrating multi-target and non-target scenarios. Previous methods typically rely on global semantic matching or coarse-grained region interactions for localization, where the discriminative cues are primarily derived from sentence-level semantics or regional context. In complex multi-target scenarios, such approaches tend to confuse visually similar targets, making it difficult to establish stable instance-level decision boundaries. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a novel Semantic-Spatial Discriminability Enhancement (SSDE) framework for generalized visual grounding, which aims to enhance the discriminative ability on fine-grained semantics and spatial localization, improving both cross-modal understanding and instance-level grounding. Specifically, to enhance the semantic discriminability of query representations at the fine-grained level, we propose a Semantic Discriminability Enhancement (SeDE) module, which leverages spatially guided cross-attention to disentangle fine-grained target-relevant visual attributes and integrates them with the textual subject semantics. Furthermore, to strengthen the spatial discriminability of the referred targets, we introduce a Spatial Discriminability Enhancement (SpDE) module, which models an instance center density map to characterize the spatial distribution of targets, and explicitly constructs instance separation structures in the spatial domain by employing them as an auxiliary supervision signal. Extensive experiments show that SSDE achieves superior performance on ten datasets across both classic and generalized visual grounding tasks.

</details>


### [175] [OPUS: A Simple yet Effective Unified Framework for Open-Vocabulary Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30247)
*Xiaoyan Wei,Zhimin Yao,Ruilin Yang,Wei Zhang,Yong Dai,Yi Zhang,Wei Ge*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 OPUS，一个统一开放词汇检测（OVD）框架，通过语义丰富的视觉表示和可扩展的接地监督，在无需复杂跨模态融合、分阶段训练或迭代注释管线的情况下，同时支持文本、交互式视觉、通用视觉和混合提示。在 COCO、LVIS-minival 和 ODinW35 上取得 SOTA 性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有统一开放词汇检测方法虽支持异构提示（文本、视觉样本及其组合），但往往依赖日益复杂的设计，如重度跨模态融合、分阶段训练和迭代注释管线。作者质疑在更强的基座模型时代，这些复杂性是否仍然必要，目标是证明统一 OVD 可以在保持强大提示能力的同时大幅简化。

Method: OPUS 采用简洁的三部分设计：(1) 模型架构结合基于 DINOv3-ConvNeXt-B 骨干的语义丰富视觉编码器与高效混合编码，以及避免提示特定分支的提示感知解码器；(2) 采用带实例级对比对齐（ICA）的单阶段文本-视觉训练策略；(3) 基于 SAM3 的单遍数据引擎生成异构接地监督。

Result: 在 COCO、LVIS-minival 和 ODinW35 上，OPUS 在 Visual-I 性能上达到 SOTA（68.1/69.2/54.7 AP），同时保持均衡的 Text 和 Visual-G 精度。混合提示从干扰变为互补，优于单独使用文本或视觉提示。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，简洁性和强大的统一提示能力可以同时实现。这挑战了统一 OVD 需要复杂设计的传统观点，展示了在更强基座模型支持下，简单设计足以达到甚至超越复杂方法的效果。

Abstract: Recent unified open-vocabulary detection (OVD) supports heterogeneous prompts, including text queries, visual exemplars, and their combinations, but often rely on increasingly complex designs such as heavy cross-modal fusion, staged training, and iterative annotation pipelines. We revisit whether such complexity is necessary in the era of stronger foundation models. Our finding is that unified OVD can be made substantially simpler with semantic-rich visual representations and scalable grounding supervision. We present OPUS (\textbf{O}pen-vocabulary, \textbf{P}rompt-\textbf{U}nified, \textbf{S}imple), a unified detector supporting text, interactive visual, generic visual, and mixed prompting within one framework. OPUS adopts a simple three-part design. Its model architecture combines a semantic-rich visual encoder, built on a DINOv3-ConvNeXt-B backbone with efficient hybrid encoding, with a prompt-aware decoder that avoids prompt-specific branches for unified prompt reasoning. OPUS is trained with a one-stage text-visual training strategy with Instance-level Contrastive Alignment (ICA), and is supported by a SAM3-based single-pass data engine for heterogeneous grounding supervision. Experiments on COCO, LVIS-minival, and ODinW35 show that OPUS achieves state-of-the-art Visual-I performance, reaching 68.1/69.2/54.7 AP, while maintaining balanced Text and Visual-G accuracy. OPUS also turns mixed prompting from interference into complementarity, improving over text or visual prompt alone. These results show that simplicity and strong unified prompting capability can be achieved together.

</details>


### [176] [Centering before Pruning: Lightweight Geometry Correction for Diversity-Based Visual Token Pruning in LVLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30263)
*Shunjie Wen,Jaeyeon Lee,Dong-Wan Choi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Cen-Prune方法，通过对视觉token特征进行中心化后再计算余弦相似度来衡量子集多样性，同时保留原始空间中token的显著性偏好作为补充，从而改进基于多样性剪枝的大视觉语言模型推理效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大视觉语言模型（LVLMs）因冗长且高度冗余的视觉token序列产生高昂推理成本。基于多样性的剪枝虽能缓解此问题，但原始视觉token的成对余弦相似度高度集中在正区间，难以有效区分非冗余token。中心化虽能揭示更丰富的成对结构，但单独使用时反而降低剪枝性能，需要理解这一矛盾并设计更优方案。

Method: 提出Cen-Prune（Centered Geometry Pruner）：1）使用中心化后的余弦相似度度量子集多样性，以获得更精细的多样性分辨能力；2）保留原始空间中的全局显著性（distinctiveness）作为互补的token级偏好；3）该方法为轻量级即插即用模块，不改变底层选择机制，额外开销可忽略。

Result: 在多个图像和视频理解基准及多种LVLM架构上的大量实验表明，Cen-Prune能够在现有基于多样性的剪枝器基础上提供稳健的性能提升。

Conclusion: 原始几何空间同时编码了多样性和显著性两种信号，且二者相互纠缠。Cen-Prune通过分离这两种信号并分别利用，有效提升了视觉token剪枝的性能，且几乎不增加计算开销。

Abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) incur substantial inference costs due to their long and highly redundant visual-token sequences. Diversity-based pruning mitigates this cost by selecting token subsets based on pairwise cosine similarity. We find, however, that similarities between raw visual tokens are strongly concentrated in the positive range, limiting their ability to distinguish non-redundant tokens. A natural way to improve this resolution is to center token features before computing cosine similarity. Centering indeed reveals a substantially richer pairwise structure, yet unexpectedly degrades pruning performance when used alone. We show that this apparent contradiction arises because the raw geometry does more than represent pairwise diversity: it also implicitly favors globally distinctive tokens, which tend to contain semantically informative content. Centering better resolves subset diversity but loses this useful token-wise preference, revealing that diversity and distinctiveness are entangled in the raw geometry. Based on this analysis, we propose the \textbf{Cen}tered Geometry \textbf{Prune}r (Cen-Prune), which measures subset diversity using centered cosine similarity while retaining raw-space distinctiveness as a complementary token-wise preference. This lightweight, plug-and-play correction leaves the underlying selection mechanism unchanged and incurs negligible computational overhead. Extensive experiments across multiple image- and video-understanding benchmarks and LVLM architectures demonstrate that Cen-Prune provides robust improvements in overall performance across existing diversity-based pruners.

</details>


### [177] [Motion-Saliency Complementary Masked Modeling for Point Cloud Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30279)
*Wei Wang,Yiding Sun,Yuyan Wang,Zhuoyue Zhang,Zhengqiao Li,Dongfu Yin,Chen Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MoSaiC是一个用于点云视频自监督表示学习的运动-显著性互补掩码建模框架，通过三种组件的协同作用有效捕获外观和运动动态信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 点云视频表示学习对于3D动态场景理解至关重要，需要有效捕获外观和运动信息。

Method: MoSaiC耦合三个组件：(1) CMSM-课程运动显著性掩码，在课程调度下引导掩码过程关注运动显著性token；(2) NFM-法向流运动建模，在so(3)李代数中监督每个token的局部刚体旋转作为显式几何运动目标；(3) CTCP-跨视图token一致性预测，在token级别强制两个互补掩码视图间的一致性。

Result: 在动作识别、时间动作分割和点级语义分割等多个下游任务上的大量实验证明了该方法的有效性。

Conclusion: MoSaiC通过将运动显著性掩码、几何运动建模和跨视图一致性预测相结合，能够有效捕获外观和运动动态，为点云视频自监督表示学习提供了有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Point cloud video representation learning is crucial for 3D dynamic scene understanding. In this paper, we propose MoSaiC, a novel Motion-Saliency Complementary masked modeling framework for self-supervised point cloud video representation learning. MoSaiC couples three components: Curriculum Motion-Saliency Masking (CMSM), which guides the masking process toward motion-salient tokens under a curriculum schedule; Normal-Flow Motion (NFM) modeling, which supervises the local rigid rotation of each token in the Lie algebra so(3) as an explicit geometric motion target; and Cross-view Token Consistency Prediction (CTCP), which enforces consistency between two complementary masked views at the token level. Together, these components allow MoSaiC to effectively capture both appearance and motion dynamics. Extensive experiments on multiple downstream tasks, including action recognition, temporal action segmentation, and point-level semantic segmentation, demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

</details>


### [178] [SELECT: SELEctive Context Transfer for Class-Incremental Semantic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30281)
*Avi Gupta,Saurabh Yadav,Koteswar Rao Jerripothula,Tammam Tillo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SELECT是一种针对类增量语义分割（CISS）的新方法，通过选择性上下文迁移来克服灾难性遗忘和背景偏移问题。其核心是上下文迁移注意力机制，将新类仅从少数语义相似的历史类别中聚合学习token作为结构化初始化，并辅以受控噪声扰动和基于边距的上下文迁移损失来保护借用表示。在Pascal VOC和ADE20K上，SELECT分别取得2.2%和2.8%的mIoU提升，优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CISS方法在处理稳定性-可塑性困境时，依赖不加区分的知识迁移或模糊的初始化，会稀释关键语义信息，未能有效利用先验知识。作者希望通过选择性地迁移与目标类别语义相似的历史类别知识，来避免信息稀释问题。

Method: SELECT提出选择性上下文迁移框架，包含三个关键组件：（1）上下文迁移注意力机制，从语义相似的过往类别中聚合学习token为新类构建结构化初始化；（2）受控噪声扰动，防止迁移过程破坏借用表示；（3）基于边距的上下文迁移损失，强制新类token与其源token之间保持分离。

Result: 在Pascal VOC和ADE20K两个基准上的大量实验表明，SELECT持续优于先前工作，分别实现了2.2%和2.8%的mIoU提升，有效处理了稳定性-可塑性困境。

Conclusion: SELECT通过选择性而非全量或模糊的知识迁移，为CISS问题提供了有效解决方案，验证了利用相似类别语义先验进行结构化初始化的可行性。

Abstract: Class-Incremental Semantic Segmentation (CISS) is fundamentally challenged by catastrophic forgetting and background shift, where learning new concepts degrades performance on previously seen classes. While existing methods attempt to balance stability (retaining old knowledge) and plasticity (learning new knowledge), they often fail to leverage prior knowledge effectively. These approaches typically rely on indiscriminate knowledge transfer or ambiguous initializations, which can dilute crucial semantic information. To overcome this limitation, we propose SELECT, a novel approach for Selective Context Transfer, which instead grounds each new class in a small set of semantically similar past classes. Its core is a Context Transfer Attention mechanism that aggregates the learned tokens from similar classes into a structured initialization for the new class. To ensure this transfer does not corrupt the borrowed representations, we add a controlled noise perturbation and a margin-based context-transfer loss that enforces separation between the new class token and its source tokens.
