Extensive experiments on Pascal VOC and ADE20K show that SELECT consistently outperforms prior work, achieving mIoU of 2.2% on VOC and 2.8% on ADE, providing an effective handle on the stability-plasticity dilemma. Code is available at https://github.com/avigupta2798/SELECT.

</details>


### [179] [Dynamic Hub-and-Spoke Memory for Streaming Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30294)
*Xinru Jiang,Lin Zhao,Xi Xiao,Yunbei Zhang,Janet Wang,Chenrui Ma,Haolin Li,Yanzhi Wang,Yifan Gong,Octavia Camps*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: D-HSM是一种无需训练的流式视频理解框架，将历史视频压缩为结构化文本记忆并存入以实体为中心的枢纽-辐条记忆结构中，动态检索与问题相关的紧凑记忆子集，结合近期视觉窗口进行回答预测。在流式和长视频基准上显著优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式视频理解需要在不断增长的视觉流上任意时刻回答问题。核心挑战是如何紧凑地记住长期历史，同时有效检索与问题相关的证据。现有方法难以在这两者之间取得良好平衡。

Method: D-HSM将选定的历史视频片段转化为类型化文本观察，存入以实体为中心的枢纽-辐条记忆（实体为枢纽，相关证据为辐条）。回答问题时会动态检索紧凑的问题感知记忆子集，通过枢纽-辐条链接扩展，并结合近期视觉窗口进行冻结VLM的答案预测。

Result: 在流式和长视频基准上的大量实验表明，D-HSM持续且显著地提升了VLM骨干模型的性能，并超越了其他最先进的在线和离线视频理解基线。

Conclusion: 该框架证明了以实体为中心的文本记忆结构能够有效解决流式视频理解中长程历史记忆与问题相关证据检索之间的平衡难题，且无需额外训练即可提升VLM性能。

Abstract: Streaming video understanding requires answering questions at arbitrary times over a continuously growing visual stream. The central challenge is to compactly remember long-range history while effectively retrieving question-relevant evidence. We propose Dynamic Hub-and-Spoke Memory (D-HSM), a training-free framework that represents distant history as structured textual memory while preserving the recent frames as visual tokens for fine-grained perception. Specifically, D-HSM turns selected historical video chunks into typed textual observations and stores them in an entity-centered hub-and-spoke memory, with entities as hubs and related evidence as spokes. When answering a question, D-HSM dynamically retrieves a compact question-aware memory subset, expands it through hub-and-spoke links, and combines it with the recent visual window for frozen-VLM answer prediction. Extensive experiments on both streaming and long video benchmarks show that D-HSM consistently and substantially improves VLM backbones and outperforms other state-of-the-art online and offline video understanding baselines.

</details>


### [180] [Learning to Restore More: Continual Capability Expansion for Pretrained Image Restoration Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30305)
*Hu Gao,Yulong Chen,Lizhuang Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RestoreMore 是一个持续能力扩展框架，通过冻结预训练复原模型作为能力锚点，学习残差扩展模块来获取新退化处理能力，并利用能力导向的双层路由机制在多个特征阶段选择相关退化专家，实现新任务选择性复用历史复原知识，不断丰富专家库。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像复原模型通常以固定能力集训练，当出现新的复原需求时，要么训练额外模型，要么联合重训原模型，成本和遗忘问题突出。作者希望探索如何让一个已训练好的复原模型持续获取新能力而不遗忘旧能力，避免重新设计骨干网络。

Method: RestoreMore 框架：(1) 将预训练复原模型冻结为能力锚点；(2) 为新增退化学习残差扩展模块；(3) 提出能力导向的双层路由机制，在多个特征阶段运作——第一层识别与当前输入相关的复原能力，第二层选择并组合稀疏的互补退化专家；(4) 新任务可选择复用历史复原知识，逐步丰富专家库供后续任务使用。

Result: 在广泛的复原基准上的大量实验表明，RestoreMore 能够持续获取新的复原能力，同时保持并提升先前学到的能力。

Conclusion: 作者证明了在不重新设计骨干网络的前提下，通过冻结能力锚点加残差扩展模块与双层路由机制，可以有效实现图像复原模型的持续能力扩展，且新能力获取与旧能力保持/提升可兼顾。

Abstract: Image restoration models are typically trained with a fixed set of capabilities. When new restoration requirements emerge, existing solutions usually train additional models or jointly retrain the original model with both new and historical data. Instead of designing another restoration backbone, we investigate how a trained restorer can continually acquire new capabilities without forgetting those learned previously. We propose RestoreMore, a continual capability-expansion framework that preserves the pretrained restoration model as a frozen capability anchor and learns residual expansion modules for newly arriving degradations. RestoreMore introduces a capability-oriented bi-level routing mechanism at multiple feature stages. The first routing level identifies restoration capabilities relevant to the current input, while the second selects and combines a sparse set of complementary degradation experts. This design enables newly introduced tasks to selectively reuse historical restoration knowledge and progressively enriches the expert bank available for subsequent restoration tasks. Extensive experiments on a wide range of restoration benchmarks demonstrate that RestoreMore consistently acquires new restoration abilities while preserving and improving previously learned capabilities.

</details>


### [181] [ScenePilot: Grow-and-Repair Policy for Text-Driven 3D Indoor Scene Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30307)
*Jiawei Zhang,Hongsong Wang,Pan Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ScenePilot是一个检索增强的Grow-and-Repair框架，用于文本驱动的3D室内场景生成。它将场景生成建模为基于先验引导的增量生长与学习矫正过程，通过层次检索增强规划（HRAP）获取room/group/anchor级别的布局先验，再通过强化多模态修复（RMR）模块在每步插入后和最终完成后进行轻量级局部矫正，有效解决了现有方法中几何布局无效、优化成本高、缺乏可复用先验等问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本驱动3D室内场景生成方法存在三大局限：一次性生成器往往产生几何无效的布局；重型后置优化成本高且不稳定；纯提示规划器缺乏可复用的布局先验来支持功能分组和物体关系建模。

Method: 提出ScenePilot框架，包含两个核心模块：1) HRAP（Hierarchical Retrieval-Augmented Planning）：检索room、group、anchor三个层面的布局先验，支持功能组规划；2) RMR（Reinforcement Multimodal Repair）：文本驱动的基座生成器逐步插入物体组后，执行轻量级局部矫正，最后进行全局修复。训练数据来自构建的SceneReverse-17k数据集，通过对高质量3D场景进行位置、旋转、尺度扰动，再使用逆操作为可执行的修复目标。策略从渲染视图、场景状态、检索先验和编辑历史预测结构化的move-rotate-scale动作。

Result: ScenePilot相比一次性生成和重型全场景优化方法，在物理合理性、功能连贯性和可控性方面都有提升，同时保持了生成多样性，是更高效的方法。

Conclusion: 通过结合HRAP与RMR，ScenePilot为文本驱动的3D室内场景生成提供了一种高效替代方案，克服了一站式生成和全场景优化各自的局限，实现了先验引导的增量式生成与轻量级矫正的有机结合。

Abstract: Text-driven 3D indoor scene generation has advanced from dataset-bound layout modeling to open-vocabulary synthesis with large language and vision-language models. Yet existing methods remain limited: one-pass generators often yield geometrically invalid layouts, heavy post-hoc optimization is costly and unstable, and prompt-only planners lack reusable layout priors for functional grouping and object relations. We propose \textbf{ScenePilot}, a retrieval-augmented \textbf{Grow-and-Repair} framework that formulates scene generation as prior-guided incremental growth with learned rectification. Given a prompt, the Hierarchical Retrieval-Augmented Planning (HRAP) module retrieves room-, group-, and anchor-level layout priors to support functional group planning. A text-driven base generator then inserts object groups sequentially, while the Reinforcement Multimodal Repair (RMR) module performs lightweight local correction after each insertion and a final global repair after completion. To train this policy, we construct \textbf{SceneReverse-17k}, a repair-trajectory dataset built by perturbing high-quality 3D scenes in position, rotation, and scale, then using inverse operations as executable rectification targets. The policy predicts structured \emph{move--rotate--scale} actions from rendered views, scene state, retrieved priors, and edit history. By combining HRAP with RMR, ScenePilot offers an efficient alternative to one-shot generation and heavy full-scene optimization, improving physical plausibility, functional coherence, and controllability while preserving diversity.

</details>


### [182] [Knowing Beyond the Known: Reinforced Knowledge Specification for Multi-Label Class-Incremental Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30316)
*Aoting Zhang,Dongbao Yang,Chang Liu,Xiaopeng Hong,Can Ma,Yu Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出KBK（Knowing Beyond the Known）框架，用于解决多标签类别增量学习（MLCIL）中因标签共现和不完整标签导致的已知与未知知识边界模糊问题。通过层次化特征净化模块、不确定性感知回忆增强策略、语义相关性合成未知特征以及类别平衡梯度补偿损失，统一了历史、当前和未来学习，在多个基准上超越了此前最优方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的类别增量学习方法在多标签场景（MLCIL）中效果不佳，根本原因在于标签共现和不完整标签带来的学习目标内在矛盾。核心障碍是模型对已知与未知知识的边界模糊，这破坏了历史知识保留、增加了当前任务学习难度，并限制了对未来概念的适应性。

Method: KBK框架包含四个关键组件：（1）层次化特征净化模块，从全局特征中分离细粒度类别特定特征，并用低级视觉特征强化高级语义抽象；（2）不确定性感知回忆增强策略，基于分布先验抑制不可靠预测，提升历史回忆质量；（3）利用语义相关性在共现条件下合成信息丰富的未知特征，为未来学习保留嵌入空间；（4）类别平衡梯度补偿损失，根据遗忘速度动态重新加权梯度反向传播，缓解异构遗忘。

Result: 在多个基准上的实验验证了KBK的有效性和鲁棒性。在MS-COCO B0-C10设置下，即使不依赖任何回放缓冲区，平均准确率仍比此前最优方法高出2.7%。

Conclusion: KBK通过显式建模"已知"与"未知"知识，成功统一了历史、当前和未来的学习目标，有效解决了多标签类别增量学习中的核心矛盾，且具有无需回放缓冲区即可取得优异表现的实用优势。

Abstract: Existing class-incremental learning methods struggle in multi-label scenarios (MLCIL) due to the inherent contradiction of learning objectives arising from co-occurring and incomplete labels. We argue that the core obstacle is the model's ambiguous boundary between known and unknown knowledge, which undermines historical knowledge retention, complicates current task learning, and limits adaptability to future concepts. To address this, we propose KBK (Knowing Beyond the Known), a reinforced knowledge specification framework that explicitly models what is known or not to unify historical, current, and prospective learning. Specifically, to clarify known knowledge, we develop a hierarchical feature purification module that disentangles fine-grained class-specific features from global features, where high-level semantic abstraction is reinforced with low-level visual features. Additionally, an uncertainty-aware recall enhancement strategy suppresses unreliable predictions based on distribution priors, improving the quality of historical recall. For probing the unknown, KBK leverages semantic correlations to synthesize informative unknown features under co-occurring, preserving embedding space for future learning. Furthermore, to mitigate heterogeneous forgetting, we design a category-balanced gradient compensation loss that dynamically reweights gradient backpropagation according to forgetting speeds. Experiments on multiple benchmarks validate the effectiveness and robustness of KBK, which surpasses prior best methods by 2.7% in Avg. Acc on MS-COCO B0-C10 setting even without any replay buffers.

</details>


### [183] [CapFrame: Text-Instructed Viewpoint Grounding in 3D Gaussian Scenes via Geometric Pseudo Labels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30342)
*Jirong Li,Satoshi Ikehata,Shuhei Kurita,Ikuro Sato*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出新任务TIVG（文本引导的视点定位），即在3D高斯场景中根据文本指令寻找匹配的6自由度相机位姿。为此提出CapFrame框架，采用"检索-翻译-细化"流程，将语言转化为几何伪标签并进行可微位姿优化，在38个真实场景和135条指令上优于启发式搜索和轨迹生成基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的语言引导3D场景方法主要聚焦于物体中心的定位（决定看什么），但很少控制单帧中物体如何呈现（如朝向或构图）。放置虚拟相机以捕捉期望画面仍主要依赖手动操作，缺乏根据文本指令自动确定相机位姿的方法。

Method: CapFrame采用Retrieve-Translate-Refine流水线：(1) 检索相关视图并通过MLLM的问答评估排序；(2) 将文本指令翻译为朝向和布局的几何伪标签；(3) 在3DGS中通过带有布局损失和朝向损失的可微优化细化相机位姿。框架为部分可微。

Result: 在38个真实场景、135条指令上的实验表明，CapFrame生成的视点比启发式视点搜索和改编轨迹生成基线更好地与文本对齐，通过VLM指标、MLLM评判和用户研究得到验证。

Conclusion: CapFrame有效解决了文本指令引导的视点定位任务，通过将语言转换为几何约束并利用3DGS的可微性质进行位姿优化，实现了比现有基线更符合文本语义的视点生成。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables photorealistic real-time novel view synthesis, yet placing a virtual camera to capture a desired frame remains largely manual. Existing language-guided approaches in 3D scenes mainly focus on object-centric grounding, determining what to observe but rarely controlling how it should appear in a single frame, such as subject orientation or frame layout. To address this limitation, we introduce a new task, Text-Instructed Viewpoint Grounding (TIVG), which aims to identify a 6-DoF camera pose in a 3D Gaussian scene whose rendered frame aligns with a text instruction. To solve this task, we propose CapFrame, a partially differentiable framework that converts language into geometric pseudo labels for camera pose optimization. CapFrame follows a Retrieve-Translate-Refine pipeline: it retrieves relevant views and ranks them through a Question-Evaluation process with MLLMs, translates the instruction into orientation and layout pseudo labels, and refines the camera pose via differentiable optimization with layout and orientation losses in 3DGS. Experiments on 38 real-world scenes with 135 instructions indicate that CapFrame produces viewpoints better aligned with texts than heuristic viewpoint search and adapted trajectory generation baselines, validated by VLM metrics, MLLM judges, and user studies. Code is available at: https://github.com/jirongli/CapFrame

</details>


### [184] [Proximity3D: Shape from Capacitive Proximity on Sensing Manifold](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30344)
*Hao Chen,Chenming Wu,Chun Ping Lam,Xiangjia Chen,Guoxin Fang,Charlie C. L. Wang,Yeung Yam,Juncong Lin,Chengkai Dai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出利用弯曲电容纺织品作为形状传感器，将其表面视为非平面感知流形，通过多视图前馈重建模型聚合电容近场信号，实现物体形状重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大多数形状重建方法依赖平面感知域（如RGB图像或深度图），而忽略了非平面、弯曲表面的传感可能性。作者希望探索利用弯曲电容纺织品在非平面感知流形上进行形状重建的新途径。

Method: 将弯曲电容纺织品的表面建模为非平面感知流形，每次扫描表示为该流形上的电容近场，由弯曲电极布局与附近物体几何之间的交互产生。引入多视图前馈重建模型，跨已知传感器视图聚合这些电场并恢复物体形状。

Result: 模拟与物理实验均证明了在弯曲感知表面上获取的电容近场信号能够实现鲁棒的对象形状重建。

Conclusion: 该方法开辟了通过具身感知实现机器人近场几何感知的新路线，表明弯曲感测表面可用于可靠的形状重建。

Abstract: Most shape reconstruction methods assume measurements defined over planar sensing domains, such as RGB images or depth maps. In this paper, we use a curved capacitive textile as a shape sensor, treating its surface as a non-planar sensing manifold. Each scan is represented as a capacitive proximity field on this manifold, induced by the interaction between the curved electrode layout and nearby object geometry. We introduce a multi-view feedforward reconstruction model that aggregates these fields across known sensor views and recovers the observed object shape. Simulated and physical experiments demonstrate robust reconstruction from capacitive proximity signals acquired on curved sensing surfaces, pointing toward a new route to robotic near-field geometric awareness via embodied sensing.

</details>


### [185] [Seeing the Unseen: Camouflaged Object Detection Beyond the Visible Spectrum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30355)
*Avi Gupta,Trasha Gupta*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MSFormer，一种端到端的多光谱伪装目标检测（COD）框架，利用多光谱图像捕获细粒度光谱信息以克服传统RGB图像光谱范围有限的局限性，实验证明该方法优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有COD方法主要依赖传统三通道RGB图像，限制了可用于检测的光谱信息范围。多光谱图像能提供更丰富的场景光谱特征，有助于提升低可见性场景下的伪装目标检测性能。

Method: 提出端到端框架MSFormer，输入多光谱伪装图像并预测对应的二值掩码，同时通过实证验证多光谱波段整合对复杂低视觉任务的有效性。

Result: 大量实验表明该方法的有效性，性能优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 多光谱图像为COD提供更丰富的信息来源，MSFormer作为首个利用多光谱进行伪装目标检测的框架，证明了该方法在该领域的优越性和可行性。

Abstract: Recent advances in camouflaged object detection (COD) have led to substantial progress in challenging low-visibility scenarios, with pioneering studies demonstrating notable success in localizing objects in camouflaged scenes. Despite these achievements, existing approaches predominantly rely on conventional three-channel RGB imagery, thereby constraining the available visual information to a limited spectral range. Multispectral images offer a wide range of information about a scene by capturing fine-grained spectral signatures. Hence, by leveraging multispectral images for COD, we introduce a novel approach to detect camouflaged objects from the corresponding multispectral inputs. In particular, we propose an end-to-end framework, \textbf{\textit{MSFormer}}, that takes a multispectral camouflaged image as input and predicts a binary mask for it. Additionally, we also provide empirical justification for integrating multispectral bands for this complex low-vision task. Our extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, which outperforms existing methods.

</details>


### [186] [MCSeg: Pre-training and Fine-tuning Volumetric Pyramid Transformer for Multi-modal Cardiac Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30371)
*Zhiyu Ye,Hairong Zheng,Tong Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MCSeg，一种基于体积Transformer的多模态心脏分割网络。通过新颖的Scaling Feature Pyramid (SFP)桥接单尺度3D ViT编码器与多尺度CNN解码器，结合掩码图像建模自监督预训练和区域互信息损失，在多个CT/MRI心脏数据集上超越11种SOTA方法，并在少样本场景中表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动心脏图像分割对心脏疾病诊断和治疗至关重要，但现有混合网络存在架构不匹配问题：单尺度的3D ViT编码器与多尺度CNN解码器之间缺乏有效的特征桥接机制，导致全局上下文信息无法被充分利用。

Method: 1) 提出Scaling Feature Pyramid (SFP)替代传统跳跃连接，将ViT输出转换为层次化特征金字塔，桥接编码器与解码器；2) ViT编码器先通过掩码图像建模进行自监督预训练；3) 在下游任务微调时集成区域互信息(RMI)损失以提升边界分割精度。

Result: 在CT数据集ImageCHD、多模态数据集MM-WHS、MRI数据集HVSMR-2.0和MSD Heart上一致超越11种SOTA方法；在少样本实验中表现优异，展示了在有限数据场景下的适应潜力。

Conclusion: MCSeg通过SFP有效解决了混合网络中编码器与解码器的架构不匹配问题，结合自监督预训练和RMI损失，在多模态心脏分割任务中实现了SOTA性能，且具备良好的少样本泛化能力。

Abstract: Automatic cardiac image segmentation is pivotal for diagnosing and treating cardiac diseases. In this work, we introduce MCSeg, a volumetric transformer-based network tailored for multi-modal cardiac segmentation. To overcome the architectural mismatch inherent in existing hybrid networks, we propose a novel Scaling Feature Pyramid (SFP). Unlike conventional skip connections, the SFP effectively bridges the single-scale 3D Vision Transformer (ViT) encoder and the multi-scale CNN decoder by transforming the ViT's output into a hierarchical feature pyramid, ensuring that global contextual information is effectively leveraged. For the training paradigm, the ViT encoder first undergoes self-supervised pre-training via masked image modeling. Subsequently, the network is fine-tuned on downstream tasks, during which a regional mutual information (RMI) loss is integrated to improve boundary segmentation accuracy. In experiments, MCSeg consistently outperforms eleven SOTA methods on CT dataset ImageCHD, multi-modal dataset MM-WHS, MRI dataset HVSMR-2.0 and MSD Heart, highlighting the effectiveness of our MCSeg for multi-modal cardiac segmentation tasks. Furthermore, MCSeg's superior performance in few-shot experiment showcases its significant potential in adapting to limited data scenarios. Codes and pre-trained ViT-B weights are open-sourced at https://openi.pcl.ac.cn/OpenMedIA/MCSeg

</details>


### [187] [PRISM: Predictive Recomposition via Semantic Latent Decomposition for View-invariant Video Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30388)
*Youngchae Chee,Hosu Lee,Sungjune Park,Junho Kim,Yong Man Ro*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PRISM是一种跨视角视频表示学习方法，通过将视频分解为视角不变和视角变化两种潜在特征，并在语言监督下进行重组，实现视角不变视频特征的干净解耦，在多个数据集上达到最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有跨视角视频方法将每个视频编码为统一嵌入，导致视角不变与视角变化语义在共现情况下不可避免纠缠；即使显式训练视角不变性的方法也存在此失败模式。

Method: 关键见解是：一个视角不变特征只有在能与任意视角变化特征充分重组并保持各自独立语义时，才真正实现解耦。基于此，PRISM将视频分解为视角不变与视角变化两个潜在表示，并在语言监督下促使两条流干净分解并重组。

Result: PRISM在EgoExo4D、EgoExoLearn、AE2数据集上达到最先进结果，甚至在零样本设置下超越领域内训练的模型。

Conclusion: 通过分解-重组范式并借助语言监督，PRISM实现了跨视角视频表示学习中视角不变特征的真正解耦，验证了该方法的有效性和泛化能力。

Abstract: Cross-view video representation learning aims to capture viewpoint-invariant action semantics despite substantial appearance changes across egocentric and exocentric videos. However, existing methods encode each video as a unified embedding, where view-invariant and view-variant semantics inevitably entangle under co-occurrences - a failure mode we show persists even in cross-view methods explicitly trained for view-invariance. Our key insight is that a view-invariant feature is truly disentangled when it can be sufficiently recomposed with an arbitrary view-variant feature while preserving their independent semantics. Building on this, we propose PRISM, that decomposes video into view-invariant and view-variant latents and recompose them under language supervision encouraging clean decomposition of the two streams. PRISM achieves state-of-the-art results on EgoExo4D, EgoExoLearn, AE2, even surpassing in-domain models under zero-shot setting. Code is available at https://github.com/litcoderr/prism.

</details>


### [188] [Real-Time Scene-Adaptive Tone Mapping for High-Dynamic Range Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30400)
*Gongzhe Li,Linwei Qiu,Peibei Cao,Fengying Xie,Xiangyang Ji,Qilin Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种新颖的色调映射方法，将高动态范围（HDR）RAW图像与低动态范围（LDR）sRGB检测网络需求之间的差距进行桥接，并实现与下游任务的端到端优化。该方法引入神经光度校准和尺度不变局部色调映射模型，支持性能迁移微调，在自动驾驶HDR场景中优于传统色调映射算法和先进的AI-ISP方法，并能在NVIDIA Jetson平台上实时处理4K高比特深度HDR输入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HDR图像包含丰富的色调和细节信息，对自动驾驶等计算机视觉系统具有重要潜力。然而，大多数面向嵌入式系统的神经网络基于LDR输入训练，在处理高比特深度的HDR图像时因极端动态范围而性能显著下降。

Method: 提出一种新的色调映射方法：1）引入神经光度校准来规范化动态范围；2）设计尺度不变局部色调映射模型来保留图像细节；3）架构支持性能迁移微调，能以最小成本从LDR sRGB图像高效适配到HDR RAW图像；4）摒弃传统ISP流水线，实现与下游任务的端到端联合优化。

Result: 在具有挑战性的汽车HDR场景中，所提方法优于传统色调映射算法和先进的AI-ISP方法。此外，该流水线能在NVIDIA Jetson平台上实现4K高比特深度HDR输入的实时处理。

Conclusion: 本文通过端到端优化的色调映射方法成功弥合了HDR RAW输入与LDR sRGB检测网络之间的差距，在保持实时性能的同时显著提升了HDR场景下的检测网络性能，为资源受限的嵌入式自动驾驶平台提供了可行的HDR处理方案。

Abstract: High-dynamic-range (HDR) images, with their rich tone and detail reproduction, hold significant potential to enhance computer vision systems, particularly in autonomous driving. However, most neural networks for embedded systems are trained on low-dynamic-range (LDR) inputs and suffer substantial performance degradation when handling high-bit-depth HDR images due to the challenges posed by extreme dynamic ranges. In this paper, we propose a novel tone mapping method that not only bridges the gap between HDR RAW inputs and the LDR sRGB requirements of detection networks but also achieves end-to-end optimization with downstream tasks. Instead of relying on the traditional image signal processing (ISP) pipeline, we introduce neural photometric calibration to regularize dynamic ranges and a scaling-invariant local tone mapping model to preserve image details. In addition, our architecture also supports performance transfer finetuning, enabling efficient adaptation from the LDR sRGB images to the HDR RAW images with minimal cost. The proposed method outperforms traditional tone mapping algorithms and advanced AI-ISP methods in challenging automotive HDR scenes. Moreover, our pipeline achieves real-time processing of 4K high-bit-depth HDR inputs on NVIDIA Jetson platforms.

</details>


### [189] [ImageCAS-X: a dataset and benchmark for coronary artery segmentation and centerline extraction in coronary CT angiography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30404)
*Kit M. Bransby,Esther Øksnebjerg,Kristoffer Kjær,Jacob Kirkeby,Yasmin El Youssef,Aïda Jiménez,Philip R. Pedersson,Martina C. de Knegt,Klaus F. Kofoed,Rasmus R. Paulsen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提供了一个基于ImageCAS数据集的大规模冠状动脉管腔分割标注数据集（800个扫描），包含体素级管腔标注、冠脉节段、中心线和网格表面，并基于该数据集对现有管腔分割方法进行了基准测试，按疾病、图像质量、冠脉优势型、节段、血管直径和管腔衰减等多个临床维度分层评估分割性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 冠状动脉管腔的准确分割是CCTA中动脉粥样硬化斑块和血管周围脂肪组织定量评估的前提，但现有自动方法缺乏大规模高质量公开数据集进行验证，且分割精度通常以单一聚合分数报告，缺乏解剖和临床背景下的分层评估。

Method: 从公开的ImageCAS数据集中选取800个扫描，提供体素级管腔标注、冠脉节段、中心线和网格表面标注；基于该数据集对既有管腔分割方法进行基准测试，并与观察者间变异进行比较，按疾病、图像质量、冠脉优势型、冠脉节段、血管直径和管腔衰减等因素分层评估性能。

Result: 提供了大规模高质量标注数据集，并完成了对现有管腔分割方法的系统基准测试，揭示了不同临床和解剖条件下的分割性能差异。

Conclusion: 该数据集支持管腔分割、斑块和血管周围定量分析以及血流动力学建模方法的开发与验证，使分割精度能在解剖和临床背景下得到全面描述。

Abstract: Accurate segmentation of the coronary vessel lumen is a prerequisite for quantitative assessment of atherosclerotic plaque and perivascular adipose tissue in coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA). Cardiologists rely on semi-automated methods for this task because manual vessel tracing and segmentation are labour-intensive. Although many automated methods have been proposed, their validation remains limited by the lack of large, high-quality publicly available datasets. We provide a new dataset of voxel-wise annotations of the vessel lumen and coronary segments, alongside centerlines, and mesh surfaces for 800 scans from the publicly available ImageCAS dataset. Using this dataset, we benchmark established lumen segmentation methods against inter-observer variability, stratifying performance by disease, image quality, coronary dominance, coronary segment, vessel diameter, and lumen attenuation. These labels allow segmentation accuracy to be described in anatomical and clinical context rather than reported as a single aggregate score. The dataset supports the development and validation of methods for lumen segmentation, plaque and perivascular quantification, and haemodynamic modelling.

</details>


### [190] [SePArate: Segmenting Patterns from Defects in Wafer Manufacturing Using Weak Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30410)
*Dain Kwon,Changmin Shin,Sunjong Park,Kanghyun Choi,Hyeyoon Lee,Jaewon Jang,Minseok Choi,Jinho Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SePArate，一种面向半导体晶圆缺陷分割的弱监督方法，仅利用图像级标注即可实现像素级缺陷模式分离。该方法通过三阶段训练（编码器预训练、知识迁移学习空间线索、合成混合缺陷数据训练）实现精确分割，实验表明其性能优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 半导体制造中的缺陷分析至关重要，但人工检测无法规模化，现有自动化检测方法在根本原因分析和工艺优化方面仍能力不足，需要更精细的像素级缺陷分割能力。

Method: SePArate采用弱监督学习框架，仅需图像级标注即可完成像素级缺陷分割。其核心是三个阶段：（1）编码器预训练；（2）知识迁移以学习空间线索；（3）在合成的混合缺陷数据上训练以实现精确分割。

Result: 实验证明SePArate在缺陷分割任务上优于所有基线方法。

Conclusion: SePArate通过弱监督方式有效解决了晶圆缺陷像素级分割问题，为半导体制造中的根本原因分析和工艺优化提供了更可行的自动化方案。

Abstract: In semiconductor manufacturing, defect analysis is essential, but manual inspection cannot scale. However, existing automated inspection methods remain insufficient for root-cause analysis and process optimization. To this end, we present SePArate, a weakly supervised wafer defect segmentation method. SePArate enables pixel-level separation of patterns by leveraging only image-level annotations. It consists of a three-phase training: encoder pretraining, knowledge transfer to learn spatial cues, and training on synthetic mixed-defect data for accurate segmentation. Experiments demonstrate that SePArate outperforms the baselines.

</details>


### [191] [Whole-Slide Image Analysis under Realistic Few-Shot Annotation Protocols](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30420)
*Tiffanie Godelaine,Maxime Zanella,Karim El Khoury,Benoit Macq,Christophe De Vleeschouwer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了SlideCRF方法，将条件随机场（CRF）适配到全切片图像（whole-slide images）分析中，用于改进视觉-语言模型在病理图像上的打补丁级零样本预测。同时提出了更符合真实病理学家标注行为的注释协议（点击和涂鸦），实验表明在四个数据集上SlideCRF显著优于现有转导方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的少样本转导方法在评估时忽略了全切片图像的关键特性：(i)忽略了多切片间的复杂组织结构；(ii)数据集多为平衡的，而单个全切片存在严重的类别不平衡且部分类别缺失；(iii)注释是随机采样的，不符合病理学家的真实标注方式。这些不匹配导致现有方法在实际临床场景中的性能被高估。

Method: 提出SlideCRF，将条件随机场适配到全切片图像场景：结合空间线索（相邻补丁的空间关系）和生物学线索（组织语义信息），同时处理单个切片中可能缺失的类别。此外，设计了基于空间定位点击和涂鸦的注释协议，模拟病理学家的多种交互方式，包括对模型错误的迭代修正。

Result: 在四个数据集上，SlideCRF在macro F1指标上优于现有转导方法。与零样本预测相比，每个存在的类别使用1个点击时提升+24.2%，使用16个点击时提升+37.5%。

Conclusion: 将转导范式与真实全切片图像设置对齐是提升病理图像分析性能的关键。SlideCRF通过融合空间与生物学线索并考虑类别缺失问题，在少样本标注下显著改善了视觉-语言模型在病理图像上的预测质量。

Abstract: Automating the analysis of whole-slide images has high clinical value, since characterizing cancers requires examining them in detail. Such analysis increasingly relies on vision-language models that provide patch-level zero-shot predictions. However, these predictions remain noisy and must be refined with a few annotations. A promising paradigm for this refinement is few-shot transduction. Rather than treating each patch independently, these methods leverage the relations between patches, together with a few annotations, to refine all predictions jointly. However, current transductive methods are evaluated under conditions that overlook key properties of whole-slide images: (i) datasets consist of independent patches extracted from multiple slides, ignoring the complex tissue organization; (ii) datasets are mostly balanced, whereas a single whole-slide image exhibits severe class imbalance, with several classes absent; and (iii) annotations are sampled at random, without reflecting how a pathologist annotates a limited number of regions. To align the transduction paradigm to realistic whole-slide settings, we introduce the following contributions. First, we propose SlideCRF, which adapts conditional random fields for whole-slide images by combining spatial and biological cues while accounting for classes that may be absent from a given slide. Second, we provide a set of realistic annotation protocols, based on spatially localized clicks and scribbles, modeling different pathologist interactions, such as the iterative correction of model errors. Across four datasets, we show that SlideCRF outperforms current transductive methods in macro F1, improving over the zero-shot predictions by +24.2% and +37.5% with one and 16 clicks per present class, respectively.

</details>


### [192] [ObjectSplat: Improving Mesh Fidelity and Interactivity for 3D Scenes via Object-Level Mesh Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30423)
*Minhas Kamal,Hiranya Garbha Kumar,Mahedi Kamal,Balakrishnan Prabhakaran*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种"先分解后重建"的3D场景重建方法，将场景分割为多个实例和背景，分别用网格泼溅(mesh splatting)独立重建后再组合，从而提升网格保真度和新视角合成质量，并支持对象级编辑与交互。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于泼溅的重建算法将场景表示为单一的整体场，缺乏对象级结构，难以支持下游编辑和交互；同时，未被直接观测的区域会被周围纹理污染且无法修正，限制了网格保真度和新视角合成的质量。

Method: 采用"分解-重建"策略：首先对每帧图像进行实例分割，将剩余部分视为背景并进行修复(inpaint)；然后使用网格泼溅(mesh splatting)分别独立重建每个实例和背景；最后将所有部分组合成单一场景。

Result: 该方法显著提升了网格重建保真度（F-score提升超过5%），并改善了新视角合成质量，同时支持对象级可编辑性和交互性。

Conclusion: 通过将场景分解为独立对象再进行重建与合成，克服了单一整体场表示在结构保真度和可编辑性方面的局限，代码将公开发布。

Abstract: Splatting-based algorithms reconstruct photorealistic, real-time-renderable, and mesh-exportable 3D scenes from regular images, but they represent a scene as a single monolithic field. Therefore, the reconstruction has no object-level structure, leaving it infeasible for downstream editing or interaction. Moreover, regions that are never directly observed in the input scans are contaminated by the surrounding texture and left uncorrected, capping both mesh fidelity and novel-view synthesis. We propose a decompose-before-reconstruct approach: we segment the instances out of every frame, consider the remaining as background and inpaint it, reconstruct each instance and the background independently with mesh splatting, and compose them into a single scene. Our method significantly improves mesh fidelity (over a 5\% gain in F-score) and novel-view synthesis, while supporting object-wise modifiability and interactivity. The code will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [193] [FlowVVTON: Flow-Guided Mask-Free Video Virtual Try-On](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30450)
*Shengyao Chen,Xianbing Sun,Liqing Zhang,Jianfu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FlowVVTON是一个无需人体解析掩码的视频虚拟试穿框架，利用光流作为训练时的监督信号，通过跨层流扭曲潜在损失实现多尺度时间一致性，在TikTokDress数据集上大幅超越基线（时间一致性VFID-R比SwiftTry提升5.7倍），且整个流程无需分割掩码、姿态关键点或区域标注。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频虚拟试穿方法依赖人体解析掩码或姿态关键点，在大运动和遮挡场景下容易失败，产生边界伪影和时间不一致问题；此外多数方法仅依赖注意力机制进行时间建模，缺乏显式的运动监督。

Method: 提出FlowVVTON框架：(1)完全消除解析掩码依赖，实现无掩码框架；(2)光流仅作为训练时监督信号，在生成模型所有层施加流扭曲潜在损失，通过显式物理运动约束对齐相邻帧特征；(3)采用两阶段训练策略，先建立无掩码空间对齐，再引入光流引导的时间监督。

Result: 在TikTokDress数据集上，FlowVVTON在时间一致性方面（VFID-R）比SwiftTry提升5.7倍，整体性能大幅超越现有基线方法。

Conclusion: FlowVVTON证明了无需任何掩码或姿态标注即可实现高质量的视频虚拟试穿，通过将光流作为训练监督信号而非推理依赖，有效解决了大运动和遮挡场景下的边界伪影与时间不一致问题。

Abstract: Video virtual try-on aims to transfer a target garment onto a moving person across video frames. Current methods rely on human parsing masks or pose keypoints that frequently fail under large motions and occlusions, causing boundary artifacts and temporal inconsistency. A further limitation is that most approaches rely solely on attention mechanisms for temporal modeling, providing no explicit motion supervision. We propose FlowVVTON, a mask-free framework that eliminates parsing mask dependency entirely. Optical flow is used solely as a training-time supervision signal: a flow-warped latent loss, applied across all layers of the generation model, enforces multi-scale temporal consistency by aligning adjacent-frame features under explicit physical motion constraints. A two-stage training strategy establishes mask-free spatial alignment before introducing flow-guided temporal supervision. Experiments on TikTokDress show that FlowVVTON outperforms baselines by substantial margins, particularly in temporal consistency (5.7$\times$ VFID-R improvement over SwiftTry), while requiring no segmentation masks, pose keypoints, or region annotations at any stage.

</details>


### [194] [SeqAlign3DVG: A Sequence-Aligned Benchmark and Voxel Reasoning Framework for 3D Visual Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30451)
*Yi Zhang,Yi Wang,Yueting Wu,Kaiyue Yang,Yuejiao Su,Lap-Pui Chau*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SeqAlign3DVG基准，专注于时间有序且严格观察对齐的图像式3D视觉定位，并设计了基于体素的统一流程（ROVM+PLVF），在深度自由协议下取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像式3D视觉定位基准存在文本与观察对齐松散、忽视时间顺序的问题，缺乏严格对齐和时序感知的评测基准。

Method: 提出SeqAlign3DVG基准（9,622个单视图和14,493个序列样本），并设计统一体素流程：ROVM（相关性排序体素记忆）动态排序和聚合多视图证据以缓解噪声，PLVF（渐进式语言-体素融合）进行从粗到细的空间-语言推理以精确消歧。

Result: 在深度自由协议下达到SOTA性能，显著提升了对复杂关系和外观线索定义目标的定位精度。

Conclusion: 通过严格观察对齐和时间排序的基准以及统一体素流程，有效解决了图像式3D视觉定位中的对齐与消歧难题。

Abstract: Image-based 3D visual grounding is critical for embodied agents, yet existing benchmarks suffer from loose text-observation alignment and neglect temporal ordering. We introduce SeqAlign3DVG, a novel benchmark dedicated to temporally ordered and strictly observation-aligned image-based 3D visual grounding. Unlike prior works using order-agnostic views or global point clouds, SeqAlign3DVG ensures all expressions are human-verified and strictly grounded in the provided RGB observations (single frames or ordered observation sequences). It comprises 9,622 single-view and 14,493 sequence samples featuring rich descriptions, complex relations, and multi-instance ambiguities. To tackle this benchmark, we propose a unified voxel-based pipeline featuring Relevance-Ordered Voxel Memory (ROVM) and Progressive Language-Voxel Fusion (PLVF). ROVM dynamically ranks and aggregates multi-view evidence via a conservative memory to mitigate noisy observations, while PLVF performs coarse-to-fine spatial-linguistic reasoning for precise disambiguation. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance under the depth-free protocol, significantly improving localization for targets defined by complex relations and appearance cues.

</details>


### [195] [Federated Multi-Task Learning for Bladder Tumor Segmentation and MIBC Classification Using a Hybrid CNN-Transformer Architecture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30458)
*Malhar Udmale,Divyanshu Dwivedi,Aarohi Dhand,Sachin Dudda Nagaraju,Mayank Rai,Bagesh Kumar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种联邦多任务学习框架，用于跨四个临床中心的T2加权MRI膀胱肿瘤分割和MIBC/NMIBC分类。采用Swin Hybrid模型（ResNet-34 + Swin-Tiny Transformer），并利用分割引导的分类机制提升肌层浸润预测。在FedBCa数据集上，联邦训练配合Geo+Elastic增强获得DSC 0.8100和AUC 0.8931的优异结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 膀胱肿瘤的准确分割和肌层浸润评估对治疗规划至关重要，但跨机构的模型开发面临两个挑战：患者数据无法集中共享（隐私限制），以及不同扫描仪和采集协议导致的成像差异。需要一种无需集中数据即可训练的鲁棒模型。

Method: 提出联邦多任务学习框架，联合进行肿瘤分割和MIBC/NMIBC二分类。核心架构Swin Hybrid结合ResNet-34分支（捕捉局部纹理和边界信息）与Swin-Tiny Transformer（捕捉全局解剖上下文）；采用分割引导分类机制，利用肿瘤定位信息辅助MIBC预测；同时研究了多种数据增强策略在集中式和联邦训练下的效果。

Result: 在FedBCa数据集上，Swin Hybrid在分割和分类之间取得了最佳平衡。联邦训练中，Geo+Elastic增强策略实现DSC 0.8100和患者级AUC 0.8931，综合得分0.8474为最高。

Conclusion: 研究表明，通过联邦训练可以在不集中患者数据的前提下，跨多个机构有效实现膀胱肿瘤的联合分割与分类任务，为多中心医学影像的隐私保护协作提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Accurate bladder tumor segmentation and assessment of mus- cle invasion from T2-weighted MRI are important for treatment plan- ning, but developing robust models across institutions is challenging be- cause patient data cannot be centrally pooled and imaging characteristics vary across scanners and acquisition protocols. We propose a federated multi-task learning framework for joint bladder tumor segmentation and MIBC/NMIBC classification across four clinical centers. The proposed Swin Hybrid model combines a ResNet-34 branch for local texture and boundary information with a Swin-Tiny Transformer for global anatomi- cal context. A segmentation-guided classification mechanism further uses tumor localization information to support MIBC prediction. We also investigate several augmentation strategies under both centralized and federated training to improve robustness to multi-center variability. Ex- periments on the FedBCa dataset show that the Swin Hybrid provides the best overall balance between segmentation and classification among the evaluated architectures. Under federated training, Geo+Elastic aug- mentation achieved a DSC of 0.8100 and a patient-level AUC of 0.8931, yielding the highest combined score of 0.8474. These results demonstrate that joint segmentation and classification can be effectively performed across multiple institutions using federated training without centralizing patient data.

</details>


### [196] [Beyond Accuracy: Quantifying Pulmonary Attribution in Anatomy-Guided Chest X-Ray Classification Under Domain Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30467)
*Abdullah Al Mamun,Md. Nasif Osman Khansur,Md Ashraful Hossen Akash,Md. Kishor Morol,Tze Hui Liew*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DBCA-SegNet-MGAP多任务框架，通过双向交叉骨干注意力和掩模引导自适应全局平均池化，将肺部解剖先验融入胸部X光分类，并引入ALR和cALR@0.9指标量化肺部分配包含性。实验表明该方法在保持诊断性能不变的同时大幅提升肺部归因可靠性，但外部迁移时诊断性能与归因可靠性呈不同变化趋势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习模型在胸部X光分类上达到高诊断性能，但无法确认其预测是否主要依赖肺部图像内容。现有评估缺乏将解剖相关可靠性（肺部分配包含性）作为独立于诊断性能的属性进行系统评估的研究。

Method: 提出DBCA-SegNet-MGAP多任务框架，包括：(1) CNN-Transformer双骨干架构通过双向交叉骨干注意力融合互补特征；(2) 预测软肺掩模作为解剖先验；(3) 通过Mask-Guided Adaptive Global Average Pooling (MGAP)将解剖先验直接融入分类。同时提出Anatomical Local Energy Ratio (ALR)和高强度累积ALR (cALR@0.9)来量化肺部分配包含性。

Result: 在COVID-19数据集上达到加权F1 0.9615和宏ROC-AUC 0.9906。用MGAP替代GAP使ALR从0.3878提升至0.7086，cALR@0.9从0.5265提升至0.9905，而F1基本不变。在零样本外部迁移到Montgomery时，ROC-AUC保持0.9080，肺部ALR保持0.6466，但F1降至0.7528，ECE增至0.1683。

Conclusion: 诊断判别能力、校准和肺部分配包含性是三个独立的模型属性，需要在内部测试和外部域偏移下联合评估，仅靠诊断性能无法保证模型的解剖可靠性。

Abstract: Deep-learning models can achieve strong chest X-ray (CXR) classification performance without establishing whether their predictions predominantly rely on pulmonary image content. This study evaluates pulmonary attribution containment as an anatomy-related reliability property distinct from diagnostic performance. We propose DBCA-SegNet-MGAP, a multi-task anatomy-guided CNN-Transformer framework that combines complementary feature representations through bidirectional cross-backbone attention, predicts a soft lung mask, and incorporates this anatomical prior directly into classification through Mask-Guided Adaptive Global Average Pooling (MGAP). Pulmonary attribution containment is quantified using the Anatomical Local Energy Ratio (ALR) and high-intensity cumulative ALR (cALR@0.9). Experiments were repeated across three training seeds using the COVID-19 Radiography Database for four-class internal testing and a locked Shenzhen-to-Montgomery protocol for zero-shot external tuberculosis testing. On COVID-19, the proposed model achieved a weighted F1 of $0.9615 \pm 0.0015$ and macro ROC-AUC of $0.9906 \pm 0.0007$. In an architecture-matched dual-bridge comparison, replacing conventional GAP with MGAP increased ALR from $0.3878 \pm 0.0098$ to $0.7086 \pm 0.0104$ and cALR@0.9 from $0.5265 \pm 0.0101$ to $0.9905 \pm 0.0018$, while weighted F1 remained essentially unchanged ($0.9618 \pm 0.0015$ vs. $0.9615 \pm 0.0015$). Under locked external transfer to Montgomery, ROC-AUC remained $0.9080 \pm 0.0043$ and pulmonary ALR remained $0.6466 \pm 0.0081$, whereas weighted F1 decreased to $0.7528 \pm 0.0080$ and ECE increased to $0.1683 \pm 0.0055$. These findings show that diagnostic discrimination, calibration, and pulmonary attribution containment are distinct model properties and support their joint evaluation under internal testing and external domain shift.

</details>


### [197] [HorizonNet for visual terrain navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30471)
*Bertil Grelsson,Andreas Robinson,Michael Felsberg,Fahad Shahbaz Khan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于360度全景图像地平线提取的无人水面艇（USV）位置估计方法，通过两级CNN架构分别估计相机姿态和提取像素级地平线，并将地平线与数字高程模型（DEM）数据进行傅里叶域MOSSE相关匹配，最终在搜索区域内寻找最大相关得分来确定USV位置，在群岛实地试验中达到GPS级精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 沿海或群岛区域中USV的定位问题具有挑战性，传统GPS定位可能受到干扰或信号遮挡，需要探索替代或补充的定位方法。

Method: 1) 在360度全景图像中提取地平线；2) 设计第一个CNN架构确定近似地平线并隐式估计相机俯仰角和横滚角；3) 对全景图像进行扭曲以补偿相机姿态，生成水平相机视角图像；4) 设计第二个CNN架构在扭曲图像中逐像素提取地平线；5) 将提取的地平线与DEM数据在傅里叶域通过MOSSE相关滤波器进行关联；6) 在搜索区域内确定最大相关得分位置作为USV位置估计。

Result: 在群岛区域进行实地试验，位置估计精度达到GPS级别，结果具有前景。

Conclusion: 提出的基于全景图像地平线与DEM匹配的方法能够实现GPS级精度的USV位置估计，为沿海/群岛环境提供了一种有效的视觉定位方案。

Abstract: This paper investigates the problem of position estimation of unmanned surface vessels (USVs) operating in coastal areas or in the archipelago. We propose a position estimation method where the horizon line is extracted in a 360 degree panoramic image around the USV. We design a CNN architecture to determine an approximate horizon line in the image and implicitly determine the camera orientation (the pitch and roll angles). The panoramic image is warped to compensate for the camera orientation and to generate an image from an approximately level camera. A second CNN architecture is designed to extract the pixelwise horizon line in the warped image. The extracted horizon line is correlated with digital elevation model (DEM) data in the Fourier domain using a MOSSE correlation filter. Finally, we determine the location of the maximum correlation score over the search area to estimate the position of the USV. Comprehensive experiments are performed in a field trial in the archipelago. Our approach provides promising results by achieving position estimates with GPS-level accuracy.

</details>


### [198] [VisER: Visual Evidence and Reliance for Object Hallucination Detection in LVLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30480)
*Afsaneh Hasanebrahimi,Hanxun Huang,Christopher Leckie,Sarah Erfani*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出VisER，一种无需训练的、双侧度的目标级幻觉检测方法，通过视觉证据（Visual Evidence）和视觉依赖（Visual Reliance）两个互补视角，区分模型内部支持来自图像证据还是文本前缀，从而更准确地检测LVLM中的目标幻觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有训练无关的幻觉检测器使用的内部信号（如token似然、注意力、视觉置信度、图文相似度）存在来源混淆问题——它们无法区分支持度来自目标特定的视觉证据还是生成的文本前缀。在困难场景下，幻觉目标可能因场景契合、邻近视觉线索或文本前缀自然延续而获得高内部支持，导致误判。

Method: VisER从两个互补视角评估每个生成的目标提及：(1) 视觉证据（Visual Evidence）——衡量目标-上下文兼容性是否由图像token中目标特定的证据所支撑；(2) 视觉依赖（Visual Reliance）——衡量目标更多由图像支持还是由生成的前缀支持。两者结合得到更具来源感知的接地分数，无需额外进行目标级验证生成。

Result: 在多个LVLM和基准测试上，VisER相比一系列基线方法在AUROC和AUPR指标上均取得改进。

Conclusion: 通过区分内部信号来源（图像证据 vs 文本前缀），VisER提供了更可靠的幻觉检测方法，且无需额外训练或验证生成，具备良好的实用性与普适性。

Abstract: Object hallucination remains a persistent reliability issue in large vision-language models, where generated object mentions may sound plausible but lack visual grounding. Recent training-free detectors use internal signals such as token likelihood, attention, visual confidence, or image-text similarity to identify hallucinated objects. These signals are useful, but they are often source-confounded. They measure how strongly an object is supported inside the model without distinguishing whether that support comes from object-specific visual evidence or the generated text prefix. In difficult cases, a hallucinated object can still receive high internal support because it fits the scene, is associated with nearby visual cues, or follows naturally from the generated text prefix. We propose VisER, a training-free two-sided metric for object-level hallucination detection. VisER evaluates each generated object mention from two complementary views. Visual Evidence measures whether object-context compatibility is backed by object-specific evidence from image tokens. Visual Reliance measures whether the object is supported more by the image than by the generated prefix. Combining these views gives a more source-aware grounding score, while avoiding additional object-level verification generations. Across multiple LVLMs and benchmarks, VisER improves AUROC and AUPR over a range of baselines.

</details>


### [199] [Lot Machine: Multimodal Lot Extraction from Auction Catalogs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30510)
*Mathias Zinnen,Alisha Mund,Sabine Lang,Lukas Hüttner,Thomas Gorges,Vincent Christlein*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的自动化流水线，用于从德国19-20世纪历史拍卖目录中提取结构化的拍品级元数据，并系统评估了不同部署模式（商业API、机构网关、本地量化模型）下的性能表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 拍卖目录是溯源研究和艺术市场研究的重要资源，但由于历史目录格式高度可变且缺乏机器可读的拍品表示，大规模分析受到限制。

Method: 提出VLM流水线，在人工标注的测试集上评估不同提示策略和约束解码框架；并跨商业提供商、机构网关和本地量化模型等多种部署模式进行基准测试。

Result: 商业端点达到性能上限；机构网关是可行的隐私保护替代方案；本地部署可行但必须强制执行输出结构以保证有效的JSON格式。

Conclusion: 虽然仍需不同程度的人工介入校正，但基于VLM的流水线能成功解锁历史拍卖目录，实现大规模自动化分析。

Abstract: For provenance research and art market studies, auction catalogs are an essential resource to trace specific objects over time and space. While historical auction catalogs follow established domain conventions, their internal formatting remains highly variable, and their large-scale analysis is currently restricted by the lack of machine-readable representations of the auction lots. We propose a pipeline to automatically extract structured lot-level metadata from German Sales, a large database of historical auction and sales catalogs from the 19th and 20th centuries. Using a manually annotated test set of representative catalog pages, we evaluate Vision-Language Models (VLMs) under varying prompt strategies and constrained decoding frameworks. To reflect the practical constraints faced by cultural heritage institutions, including budget, compute resources, and data privacy requirements, we benchmark the methods across different deployment modes ranging from commercial providers to locally hosted, quantized models. We find that commercial endpoints establish the performance ceiling, while institutional gateways offer a viable, privacy-preserving alternative. Local deployments remain feasible, but strictly require enforcing the output structure during generation to guarantee a valid JSON format. While varying degrees of human-in-the-loop correction are still necessary, this work demonstrates that a VLM-based pipeline can successfully unlock historical auction catalogs for large-scale automated analysis.

</details>


### [200] [MEOM: Multi-View Expected-OKS Maximization for Human Pose Triangulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30521)
*Ziliang Xiong,Henglin Shi,Per-Erik Forssen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于多视角期望OKS最大化（MEOM）的3D人体姿态估计方法，利用整个热图而非仅解码峰值点来估计3D姿态，并引入最高密度区域（HDR）校准来评估热图可靠性。该方法在无3D监督和有3D监督两种设置下均表现优异，在Human3.6M上达到19.11mm的绝对MPJPE，超越SOTA体积法且推理成本减半。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的代数三角化方法依赖从预测热图中解码2D关键点，但热图在多遮挡情况下可能是多模态的，将其折叠为单一峰值会丢失空间分布信息，导致估计不可靠。因此需要利用完整热图信息进行3D姿态估计，同时解决跨视角热图融合和热图可靠性评估两个核心问题。

Method: 1) 提出多视角期望OKS最大化（MEOM）目标函数，在概率质量上定位多视角一致的3D关节点；2) 采用最高密度区域（HDR）校准作为热图质量的诊断工具，独立于距离度量；3) 框架覆盖两种设置：无3D监督时从预训练热图预测器优化3D姿态，有3D监督时采用MEOM与MSE联合损失端到端训练。

Result: 无3D监督时，该方法在性能上与依赖更大骨干网络、时序融合和模拟3D数据的SOTA方法相当，在模糊的Human3.6M（H36MA）和遮挡的CMU Panoptic数据集上优势显著。有3D监督时，在Human3.6M上达到19.11mm绝对MPJPE，超越SOTA体积法，且推理成本仅为后者一半。

Conclusion: 利用完整热图分布而非单一峰值，结合MEOM目标与HDR校准，可以在3D人体姿态估计中实现更准确、更稳健的结果，同时在不同监督条件下均保持竞争力。

Abstract: Conventional algebraic triangulation solves 3D human pose estimation (HPE) from multi-view 2D keypoints. The typical approach, decoding 2D keypoints from predicted heatmaps, is unreliable as heatmaps can be multimodal under occlusion, and collapsing them into single peaks discards their spatial distribution. We seek to use the entire heatmap to estimate 3D poses more accurately, which requires solving two problems: how to robustly fuse heatmaps across views, and how to assess the reliability of heatmaps. For the former, we introduce a novel objective, Multi-viewExpected-OKS Maximization (MEOM), that locates a 3D joint where the views agree in probability mass. For the latter, we adopt highest-density-region (HDR) calibration as a diagnostic of that mass, independently of distance-based metrics. The proposed framework covers two settings, with and without 3D supervision. Without 3D supervision, we optimize 3D poses from pretrained heatmap predictors by maximizing MEOM, achieving comparable performance with state-of-the-art methods that rely on larger backbones, temporal fusion, and simulated 3D data. On ambiguous Human3.6M (H36MA) and occluded CMU Panoptic frames, the advantage is substantial. When 3D labels are available, we train the model end-to-end with a combined MEOM and MSE loss, achieving 19.11 mm absolute MPJPE on Human3.6M outperforming the state-of-the-art volumetric approach on absolute MPJPE at half the inference cost.

</details>


### [201] [Minerals in the Wild: A Hyperspectral-XRF Dataset for Elemental Composition Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30537)
*Eleftheria Tetoula-Tsonga,George Arvanitakis,Theodoros Giannakas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了"Minerals in the Wild"数据集，包含1,132个欧洲岩石样本的高光谱图像和XRF元素表征数据，并定义了一项元素表征任务，提出了一种基于USGS光谱字典剪枝和凸优化的矿物匹配方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 矿物快速表征对矿产勘探和工业选矿至关重要。尽管高光谱成像（HSI）具有精细光谱分辨率，是很有前景的矿物感知手段，但缺乏带可靠标注的公开数据集，严重阻碍了基于HSI的矿物识别方法的发展与评估。

Method: 1) 构建包含1,132个岩石标本的数据集，每个标本提供HSI采集和XRF元素表征；2) 定义元素表征任务；3) 提出剪枝机制，从USGS光谱字典中移除远距离特征；4) 采用凸优化方法将HSI像素与USGS光谱签名进行匹配。

Result: 实验表明，所提出的方法在元素表征任务上优于更简单的基线方法，验证了USGS字典剪枝配合凸优化匹配策略的有效性。

Conclusion: 该数据集填补了HSI矿物识别领域公开数据稀缺的空白，所提出的方法为矿物快速表征提供了有效方案，有助于推动该领域的进一步研究与应用。

Abstract: Rapid mineral characterization is essential for applications ranging from mineral exploration to industrial ore processing. To this end, Hyperspectral Imaging (HSI) has emerged as a promising sensing modality thanks to its fine spectral resolution, enabling mineral discrimination in both close-range and remote sensing settings. However, the scarcity of publicly available datasets with reliable ground-truth labels hinders the development and evaluation of HSI-based mineral identification methods. We release Minerals in the Wild, a multi-purpose dataset comprising 1,132 rock specimens collected across Europe. For each specimen, we provide an HSI acquisition together with an elemental characterization obtained via an XRF sensor. We define the task of elemental characterization on our dataset and propose a pruning mechanism that removes distant signatures from the USGS dictionary prior to a convex optimization approach for matching HSI pixels with USGS spectral signatures. Finally, we empirically show that our approach outperforms simpler baselines.

</details>


### [202] [Modality Disentangled Learning for Incomplete Multimodal Emotion Recognition: A Primitive Memory Distillation Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30563)
*Jiaqi Zhang,Zheng Pang,Mengting Li,Yiqi Wang,Guangyuan Dong,Chao Xue,Yusen Wu,Zihao Li,Huy Phan,Sicheng Zhao,Björn W. Schuller,Jiachen Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Primitive Memory Distillation (PriMD)框架，从模态内视角出发，将跨模态共享语义与模态特有表示解耦，并将特有信息离散化为可学习的语义基元构建记忆库。在模态缺失时，通过教师-学生框架，用可用模态的共享语义作为查询动态检索基元，在受限记忆空间内补偿缺失的模态特有信息，在IEMOCAP、CMU-MOSI和CMU-MOSEI上取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态情感识别（MER）方法在模态缺失时将缺失模态作为整体进行生成、对齐或蒸馏，忽视了每种模态内部信息的异质性。这种整体式处理将可推断的共享语义与不确定的模态特有细节混在一起，导致表示不稳定、鲁棒性下降。

Method: PriMD框架首先在模态内视角下将跨模态共享语义从模态特有表示中解耦，再将特有部分离散化为可学习的语义基元，构建模态特有的记忆库。在模态缺失时采用教师-学生框架，学生模型以可用模态的共享语义作为查询，动态检索记忆库中的基元，在受限记忆空间中补偿缺失的模态特有信息并与教师模型对齐。

Result: 在IEMOCAP、CMU-MOSI和CMU-MOSEI三个基准数据集上，PriMD在广泛的缺失模态设置下取得了最先进的性能，并表现出持续更强的鲁棒性，同时减轻了整体式特征推断带来的不稳定性。

Conclusion: 该工作验证了从模态内视角区分信息可恢复性对于处理模态缺失问题的有效性，通过语义基元记忆库的检索式补偿机制显著提升了多模态情感识别在缺失场景下的鲁棒性和稳定性。

Abstract: Multimodal Emotion Recognition (MER) systems often suffer from missing modalities in real-world scenarios. Existing methods usually generate, align, or distill missing modalities as a whole, overlooking the heterogeneous nature of the information carried by each modality. Such holistic treatment mixes inferable shared semantics with uncertain modality-specific details, yielding unstable representations and degrading robustness. To address this issue, we propose the Primitive Memory Distillation (PriMD) framework. Unlike existing methods, PriMD takes an intra-modal perspective and focuses on how different types of information within a modality differ in recoverability within each modality. PriMD first disentangles cross-modal shared semantics from modality-specific representations, and then discretizes the latter into learnable semantic primitives to construct modality-specific memory banks. When modalities are missing, PriMD is a teacher-student framework that the student model uses the shared semantics of available modalities as queries to dynamically retrieve primitives. It compensates for missing modality-specific information within a constrained memory space and aligns with the teacher model. Extensive experiments on IEMOCAP, CMU-MOSI, and CMU-MOSEI demonstrate that PriMD achieves state-of-the-art performance and consistently stronger robustness across a wide range of missing-modality settings, while mitigating the instability caused by holistic feature inference. Our code and project website are available at https://github.com/JiaqiZhang-Sengoku/PriMD and https://jiaqizhang-sengoku.github.io/PriMD/, respectively.

</details>


### [203] [Learning Compositional Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding with Synthetic Curriculum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30584)
*Xingjian Wang,Shijian Wang,Yibo Wang,Zihao Yu,Runhao Fu,Xuelian Cheng,Zongyuan Ge*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CompSTVG任务，针对现有视频时空定位（STVG）方法在处理组合式查询（需联合推理属性与关系）时性能骤降的问题。作者构建了基于时空场景图的合成数据引擎，通过约束编程实现难度可控的查询合成，并推出按显式难度分层（时间复杂度+空间干扰）的基准STVG-CompBench。评估11个代表性模型后发现其在组合查询上表现差，且该差距常被数据集平均指标掩盖。最后提出CurrSTVG课程强化学习框架，在最具挑战的组合查询上取得最大提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有STVG的评估与训练数据主要面向简单查询，忽略了真实场景中需要联合推理属性与关系的组合式查询，导致模型在该类查询上性能严重退化且未被现有评测体系充分暴露。

Method: 1) 定义CompSTVG任务；2) 构建以时空场景图为难度度量、将难度可控查询合成建模为约束编程问题的合成数据引擎，产出难度分级数据；3) 构建按显式难度（时间复杂度和空间干扰）分层的基准STVG-CompBench；4) 提出基于课程学习的强化学习框架CurrSTVG，并构造合成训练数据辅助训练。

Result: 对11个代表性STVG模型的评估显示其在组合式查询上表现差、性能骤降，且该退化常被数据集级平均指标掩盖。CurrSTVG课程强化学习框架带来一致增益，在最具挑战的组合式查询上提升最大。

Conclusion: 组合式查询是STVG模型当前的主要短板，需要通过难度分级的基准与评测方式以及课程式训练策略来解决，CurrSTVG验证了这一方向的有效性。

Abstract: Despite the impressive progress of recent MLLMs on spatio-temporal video grounding (STVG), existing evaluations and training data focus primarily on simple queries. They largely overlook the compositional queries prevalent in real-world scenarios, where a target must be disambiguated by jointly reasoning about its attributes and relations to other entities. To bridge this gap, we propose Compositional Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding (CompSTVG), a task that requires models to process complex textual queries where every intertwined attribute and relational cue is essential for disambiguation. To facilitate this task at scale, we build a synthetic data engine that leverages a spatio-temporal scene graph as a difficulty measure and casts difficulty-controlled query synthesis as a constraint programming problem, producing difficulty-graded data for both evaluation and training. Built on this engine, we introduce STVG-CompBench, a benchmark stratified by explicit difficulty levels that jointly capture temporal complexity and spatial interference. Evaluating 11 representative STVG models on STVG-CompBench reveals that current models perform poorly on compositional queries, exhibiting a sharp performance drop that is typically obscured by overall dataset-level averages. We further construct synthetic training data and propose CurrSTVG, a curriculum reinforcement learning framework that delivers consistent gains, with the largest improvements observed on the most challenging compositional queries.

</details>


### [204] [DiffSAC: Diffusion-guided Sampling for Consensus-based Robust Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30603)
*Chang Nie,Guangming Wang,Zhe Liu,Hesheng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DiffSAC框架，利用扩散模型学习有效最小集合的分布，通过细化每个数据点的置信度来引导采样，仅需评估几十个假设即可达到甚至超越传统方法评估上万个假设的性能，显著提升鲁棒估计的效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的基于样本共识（sample consensus）的鲁棒估计方法在假设评估前难以识别有效的极小子集，导致采样效率低下，需要评估大量糟糕的假设集合才能找到最优解。

Method: DiffSAC引入扩散模型学习有效极小子集的分布，通过细化每个数据点的置信度（而非对数据点排序）来判断其是否属于好的极小子集，并将几何特征作为条件约束细化方向，最终输出少量高质量极小子集。

Result: 相比传统方法需评估上万条假设，DiffSAC仅需评估几十条假设即达到最先进性能；在五个经典计算机视觉任务上的实验证明了其优越性；扩散模型的采样加速器支持实时运行，且可作为即插即用模块改进现有方法。

Conclusion: DiffSAC通过扩散模型引导采样大幅提升了鲁棒估计的效率与性能，仅需少量高质量极小子集即可识别最优假设，同时具备实时性和可扩展性。

Abstract: Robust estimation is a core computer vision task frequently tackled using sample consensus. However, traditional methods suffer from inefficient sampling as they struggle to identify effective minimum sets before hypothesis evaluation. To address these challenges, we propose a novel Diffusion-guided Sampling for Consensus-based Robust Estimation (DiffSAC) framework. DiffSAC introduces a diffusion model to learn the distribution of effective minimum sets. It refines the confidence for each data point, indicating whether it belongs to a good minimum set, rather than ranking the data points as in previous work. This significantly reduces the need to process numerous bad sets. To constrain the refinement direction, geometric features are incorporated as conditions within our diffusion model. Consequently, DiffSAC outputs a small number of high-quality minimum sets, enabling identification of the best hypothesis via consensus evaluation. Notably, compared to previous works requiring evaluating over ten thousand hypotheses, DiffSAC achieves state-of-the-art performance with only dozens, significantly boosting efficiency. Extensive experiments across five classic computer vision tasks demonstrate the superiority of DiffSAC. The diffusion model's sampling accelerators enable real-time operation, and DiffSAC can be used as a plug-and-play module to improve existing sample consensus methods.

</details>


### [205] [OCR-Based Field Extraction for Archaeological Pottery Metadata: The CENTURIA Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30616)
*Gissu Valentina Naghavi,Dominik Hagmann,Martin Kampel,Irene Ballester*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文探讨了能否用先进的文档分析模型将手写的陶器考古记录自动转化为结构化元数据。作者引入了CENTURIA数据集（包含507条来自罗马Carnuntum遗址的陶器记录，涵盖转录文本、边界框和七个元数据类别的结构化标签），并基准测试了五个OCR模型。研究发现零样本转录误差高达15-32%，领域特定字段恢复率不足3%，但仅用57个样本进行LoRA微调即可将转录误差降至1.5%以下，字段级准确率超过87%。研究表明少量专家验证的微调数据足以将手写陶器文档转化为可用于考古数据库的结构化可检索元数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 考古学家通过技术图纸和手写元数据记录陶器发现，这些元数据对断代、来源归属和跨遗址比较至关重要，但仍是手写形式，无法被计算分析直接利用，每次记录都需要人工转录。作者希望探究最先进的文档分析模型能否自动化这一转录任务，以释放考古数据计算分析的潜力。

Method: 作者构建了CENTURIA数据集，包含507条来自罗马Carnuntum遗址的陶器记录，提供转录文本、边界框和七个元数据类别的结构化字段标签。随后基准测试了五个OCR模型，并评估其零样本性能；接着采用LoRA（低秩适配）微调方法，仅使用57个样本（模拟现实的档案注释预算）对模型进行领域适应训练，以缩小领域差距。

Result: 零样本转录误差显著，SpACER-M指标下达到15-32%，远高于印刷档案文档的水平，领域特定字段恢复率不到3%。但通过LoRA在57个样本上微调后，转录误差降至1.5%以下，整体字段级准确率恢复至87%以上。

Conclusion: 少量专家验证的微调数据集足以将手写的陶器文档转化为结构化、可搜索的元数据，可直接用于考古数据库。这验证了文档分析模型在考古学特定手写文档领域的实用价值，为大规模自动化考古记录数字化提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Pottery is a primary source for reconstructing the chronological and economic dimensions of past societies. Archaeologists often document ceramic finds through technical drawings and handwritten metadata. This metadata is critical for dating, provenance attribution, and cross-site comparison, but remains inaccessible to computational analysis, requiring manual transcription of every record. We investigate whether state-of-the-art document analysis models can address this task, and introduce CENTURIA, a dataset of 507 pottery records from the Roman site of Carnuntum, providing transcriptions, bounding boxes, and structured field-level labels across seven metadata categories. Benchmarking five OCR models reveals a substantial domain gap: zero-shot transcription error reaches 15-32% SpACER-M, far exceeding rates on printed archival documents, with domain-specific fields recovered in fewer than 3% of cases. LoRA fine-tuning on just 57 samples, reflecting a realistic archival annotation budget, closes this gap, reducing transcription error to below 1.5% and recovering overall field-level accuracy above 87%. Our results show that a small expert-validated fine-tuning set suffices to convert handwritten pottery documentation into structured, searchable metadata ready for archaeological databases.

</details>


### [206] [RealCAD: Towards Real-World Image-to-CAD Reconstruction under Domain Shift and Parameter Bias](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30617)
*Yihe Sun,Ziyu Lu,Kaihua Tang,Xian-Sheng Hua*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出RealCAD框架，解决图像到CAD重建中的两大耦合问题：合成图像与真实图像之间的外观域差距，以及广泛使用的CAD数据中未被发现的参数偏差。RealCAD在表示层、图像层和特征层三个层面进行改进，并引入OpenRealCAD数据集（392个3D打印物体的四视角照片及对应的命令序列），显著提升真实域的命令和参数精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像到CAD方法主要在合成渲染图像上开发，面临两个耦合障碍：一是合成图像与真实图像之间存在显著的外观域差距；二是广泛使用的CAD数据（如DeepCAD）中存在被忽视的参数偏差——局部归一化使几何参数集中在少量离散值上，模型可以通过利用高频值而非从图像推断几何来获得虚高的参数精度。

Method: RealCAD在三个层面统一解决上述问题：(1) 表示层：将尺度信息重新分配到对应的几何参数中，在共享尺度空间内产生更不集中的参数分布；(2) 图像层：使用几何约束的转换方法，以物体轮廓为条件将合成渲染图像转换到真实图像域；(3) 特征层：采用多正样本对比学习目标，对齐同一CAD模型跨视角和跨图像域的表示，使每个单独视角都能进行CAD序列预测。

Result: 实验表明：(1) 修订后的表示显著降低了可从参数频率先验获得的精度，使参数精度成为图像条件几何推断的可靠指标；(2) RealCAD在真实域的命令和参数精度上均有提升；(3) 在合成域上保持了有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: RealCAD通过同时解决表示偏差和域差距问题，为图像到CAD重建提供了更可靠且实用的方案，并引入OpenRealCAD数据集为真实场景下的评估奠定基础。

Abstract: Reconstructing editable Computer-Aided Design (CAD) models from images is essential for downstream modification, manufacturing, and design reuse. However, existing image-to-CAD methods are developed predominantly on synthetic renderings and face two coupled obstacles: a substantial appearance domain gap between synthetic and real images, and a previously overlooked parameter bias in widely used CAD data. We show that the local normalization adopted by DeepCAD concentrates several geometric parameters around a few discrete values while encoding substantial information in a single scale factor. Consequently, a model can achieve deceptively high parameter accuracy by exploiting these frequent values rather than inferring geometry from the input image. In this paper, we propose RealCAD, a unified framework that addresses these limitations at the representation, image, and feature levels. At the representation level, we redistribute scale information to the corresponding geometric parameters, producing less concentrated parameter distributions in a shared scale space. At the image level, geometry-constrained translation converts synthetic renderings toward the real-image domain while conditioning on object contours. At the feature level, a multi-positive contrastive objective aligns representations of the same CAD model across viewpoints and image domains, enabling CAD sequence prediction from each individual view. We further introduce OpenRealCAD, comprising four-view photographs of 392 3D-printed objects paired with ground-truth command sequences. Experiments show that the revised representation substantially reduces the accuracy attainable from parameter-frequency priors, making parameter accuracy a more reliable measure of image-conditioned geometric inference. RealCAD further improves real-domain command and parameter accuracy, while retaining competitive synthetic-domain performance.

</details>


### [207] [AQ3D: Adaptive Query Transformer for 3D Instance Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30618)
*Keno Moenck,Thorsten Schüppstuhl*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AQ3D提出了一种适应场景规模的3D实例分割解码器方法，通过按超点比例实例化查询集、使用3D RoPE替代学习式位置编码，并改进解码器组件，在ScanNetV2、ScanNet200和ScanNet++V2数据集上取得了新的最先进结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于Transformer的解码器在3D实例分割中固定使用预设数量的查询和学习式位置编码，无法适应室内扫描场景在空间范围和物体数量上的巨大差异。固定查询集在小场景中过度初始化、在大场景中初始化不足，而学习式位置编码受限于训练场景的范围且可能饱和。

Method: 1) 查询按场景超点数的固定比例实例化，形成过完备查询集，背景拒绝完全交由解码器处理；2) 使用3D RoPE对量化度量坐标进行位置编码，替代先前的学习式有界查找表；3) 改进解码器本身，包括基于归因的超点池化、掩码细化分支，以及用于背景拒绝的余弦分类器。

Result: 在ScanNetV2、ScanNet200和ScanNet++V2数据集的验证集和隐藏测试集上，在不使用额外数据增强的编码器方法中达到了最新的最先进性能。

Conclusion: AQ3D通过场景自适应的查询实例化和3D RoPE位置编码，有效解决了固定查询数和有界位置编码带来的泛化问题，证明了该方法在处理不同规模室内场景时的优越性。

Abstract: Transformer-based decoders for 3D instance segmentation typically commit to a fixed number of queries and positional modeling calibrated on the training distribution rather than on the scene at hand. Indoor scans vary widely in spatial extent and object count, so a fixed query set over-initializes small scenes and under-initializes large ones, while learned absolute and relative encodings are bound to the training scenes' extents and can saturate. We present AQ3D, which is designed to handle scenes of various sizes during training and inference. Queries are instantiated at a fixed ratio of the scene's superpoints, forming an overcomplete set whose background rejection is entirely left to the decoder. Positional information is encoded using 3D RoPE over quantized metric coordinates, replacing learned bounded lookup tables of prior decoders. Further, we improve the decoder itself by using attribution-based superpoint pooling, a mask refinement branch, and a cosine classifier for background rejection. Experiments show our method sets a new state-of-the-art on validation and hidden test splits across the datasets ScanNetV2, ScanNet200, and ScanNet++V2 among decoder methods trained without additional data augmentation. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/kenomo/aq3d}{github.com/kenomo/aq3d}.

</details>


### [208] [Cost-efficient Active Learning for Referring Image Segmentation and Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30621)
*Junbeom Hong,Seonghoon Yu,Hyung Rok Jung,Sundong Kim,Jeany Son*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种在仅有原始图像（无文本标注）的真实场景下，针对视觉定位（VG）任务的主动学习框架。利用基础模型生成辅助的区域-文本对，并提出一种新的采集函数"指称区域模糊度"（Referred Region Ambiguity）来度量模型置信度在多个候选区域间的分散程度，从而优先选择具有较强跨区域竞争的模糊图像进行标注。同时设计了一个高效的指称表达式标注界面，实验表明该方法在RIS和REC基准上优于多种主动学习基线，且用户研究显示标注速度提升最高达1.6倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 收集自然语言指称表达式及对应的区域标注（掩码或框）是视觉定位任务的主要瓶颈，因为标注者需要写出能将目标区域与视觉相似区域区分开的描述。现有的主动学习方法缺乏在无文本情况下的样本选择策略，因此需要一种仅基于原始图像就能判断哪些图像包含模糊区域（需要判别性描述）的方法。

Method: 1) 使用基础模型生成辅助的区域-文本对来弥补标注缺失；2) 提出新的采集函数"Referred Region Ambiguity"，通过测量模型置信度是集中在一个区域还是分散在多个候选区域来评估图像的模糊性；3) 设计了一个高效的指称表达式标注界面，帮助标注者以少量点击快速聚焦于书写判别性语言。

Result: 在Referring Image Segmentation (RIS) 和 Referring Expression Comprehension (REC) 基准测试上，该主动学习框架一致性地优于多种主动学习基线；用户研究表明标注速度提升最高达1.6倍。

Conclusion: 通过将视觉模糊性作为主动学习的采样信号，并结合基础模型生成的辅助数据和高效标注界面，可以有效降低视觉定位任务中指称表达式标注的成本和难度，同时提升模型的标注效率。

Abstract: Collecting natural-language referring expressions along with region annotations, such as masks or boxes, is a major bottleneck in visual grounding (VG), as annotators must write descriptions that distinguish target regions from visually similar ones. We tackle this by formulating active learning (AL) for VG under the realistic setting where only raw images are available without accompanying text. Since ground-truth text is unavailable, sample selection must estimate which images contain ambiguous regions that would require discriminative referring expressions. To address this, we generate auxiliary region-text pairs using foundation models, and introduce Referred Region Ambiguity, a new acquisition function that measures whether the model's confidence collapses onto a single region or disperses across multiple candidates. It allows our method to prioritize images with strong cross-region competition, which are more informative due to their visual ambiguity. We also design a referring-expression annotation interface that helps annotators quickly focus on writing discriminative language with a few clicks. Experiments on RIS and REC benchmarks show that our AL framework consistently outperforms several AL baselines, while a user study shows up to 1.6X faster description labeling of ours.

</details>


### [209] [Quantum-Grassmann-Plucker Token Mixing for Deep Learning-Based Post-Disaster Damage Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30633)
*Kooroush Farahkhah,Umut Lagap,Taha Rezaei,Saman Ghaffarian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文首次将Grassmann-Plucker (GP) token混入技术应用于计算机视觉，提出QGP和HQML-GP两种扩展头，用于灾后卫星图像建筑物损毁评估。在xBD龙卷风数据集上，QGP在见过和未见事件测试集上均取得最佳准确率和宏F1分数，验证了GP token混入可作为传统Transformer的有竞争力的免注意力替代方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灾后卫星图像建筑物损毁评估是关键的工程决策支持任务，但面临类别不平衡、中间损毁状态模糊以及跨事件迁移性有限三大挑战，需要更有效的图像分类方法。

Method: 提出三种基于GP token混入的分类头：(1) GP头，通过Plucker坐标编码token对形成的子空间来表征图像patch token间的多尺度关系；(2) QGP头，在GP基础上用振幅衍生的概率特征丰富坐标；(3) HQML-GP头，将模拟量子电路产生的期望值融入几何token表征。使用冻结的六通道Vision Transformer基础编码器处理xBD龙卷风数据集的前后事件图像patch。

Result: QGP在两项测试集上全面领先：见过事件(Joplin和Moore)准确率83.46%、宏F1 64.50%；未见事件(Tuscaloosa)准确率66.45%、宏F1 52.70%。HQML-GP虽取得最高验证宏F1 65.63%，但未在任何测试集上超越QGP，且每轮训练时间显著更长。

Conclusion: GP token混入被确立为传统Transformer token混入在配对卫星图像损毁分类中的具有竞争力的免注意力替代方案，其中QGP头表现最优。

Abstract: Timely post-disaster building damage assessment from satellite imagery is a critical engineering decision support task, yet it remains constrained by class imbalance, ambiguous intermediate damage states, and limited cross-event transferability. This study presents, to our knowledge, the first application of Grassmann-Plucker (GP) token mixing to computer vision and introduces two extensions for image classification: the Quantum-inspired Grassmann-Plucker (QGP) head and the Hybrid Quantum Machine Learning Grassmann-Plucker (HQML-GP) head. The GP head represents multiscale relationships among image patch tokens by encoding subspaces formed by token pairs with Plucker coordinates; QGP enriches these coordinates with amplitude-derived probability features, whereas HQML-GP incorporates expectation values generated by a simulated quantum circuit into the geometric token representation. Paired pre- and post-event image patches from the xBD tornado dataset were processed using a frozen six-channel Vision Transformer base encoder with 16 x 16-pixel patches. The three GP-based heads were compared with multilayer perceptron and Transformer baselines under identical training, checkpoint selection, and evaluation protocols. Joplin and Moore tornado samples were used for model development and seen-event testing, while Tuscaloosa was reserved for unseen-event evaluation. QGP led both test sets in accuracy and macro-F1: 83.46% and 64.50% for the seen events, and 66.45% and 52.70% for the unseen event. Although HQML-GP obtained the highest validation macro-F1 of 65.63%, it did not surpass QGP on either test set and required substantially more training time per epoch. These results establish GP token mixing as a competitive attention-free alternative to conventional Transformer-based token mixing for paired satellite image damage classification.

</details>


### [210] [Fine-Grained Multi Image Object Hallucination Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30653)
*Joonki Min,Chaeyun Kim,Hyungwook Choi,Yejin Kim,Kihyun Kim,Yohan Jo,Joonseok Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MIOH，一个细粒度的多图像物体幻觉基准，通过四个基础任务（存在性、计数、属性、位置）、三种多图像推理模式（综合、比较、选择性）和三种对抗性压力（视觉上下文规模、感知难度、上下文偏差）系统评估多模态大语言模型在多图像场景中的物体幻觉问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLM在多图像场景中面临物体幻觉问题，但现有基准主要针对单图像设计，或仅提供高层的多图像评估，无法系统诊断视觉复杂性和推理需求如何触发幻觉。需要细粒度、可控的多图像幻觉评估框架。

Method: 提出MIOH基准，从四个基础任务维度（存在、计数、属性、位置）出发，设计三种多图像推理模式（综合、比较、选择性），并在三种受控的对抗性压力条件（视觉上下文规模、感知难度、上下文偏差）下进行评估，以系统剖析幻觉产生的条件与根源。

Result: 对29个模型进行评估后发现，即使是GPT-5和Gemini-2.5-Pro等最先进的系统，在不同推理模式和任务上也表现出不同的失败模式。幻觉不仅仅源于感知失败，更多源于多图像间维持物体表征时的整合阶段局限。

Conclusion: MIOH提供了一个受控的多图像物体幻觉分析框架，可作为开发更可靠多模态AI系统的关键评估工具，揭示了多图像推理中幻觉的核心瓶颈在于跨图像的对象表征整合阶段。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-image scenarios requiring complex reasoning across visual contexts. However, current MLLMs remain fundamentally limited by object hallucination-generating plausible yet factually inconsistent descriptions about objects. Existing benchmarks, designed primarily for single-image settings or providing only high-level multi-image assessments, cannot systematically diagnose how visual complexity and reasoning demands trigger hallucination. To address this gap, we introduce MIOH, a fine-grained multi-image object hallucination benchmark that systematically evaluates object hallucination across four foundational tasks (existence, counting, attribute, position) through three multi-image reasoning patterns (comprehensive, comparative, selective) under three controlled adversarial pressures (visual context scale, perceptual difficulty, contextual bias). Through evaluation of 29 models, we reveal that even state-of-the-art systems like GPT-5 and Gemini-2.5-Pro exhibit distinct failure patterns across different reasoning patterns and tasks. Our evaluation reveals that hallucination stems not merely from perceptual failures but from integration-stage limitations when maintaining object representations across multiple images. MIOH provides a controlled framework for analyzing multi-image object hallucination and serves as a critical evaluation tool for developing more reliable multimodal AI systems.

</details>


### [211] [APT: Anchor-aligned Perturbations for Tamper Localization in Fully Regenerated Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30656)
*Suhyeon Ha,Woo Jae Kim,Joonsung Jeon,Sooel Son,Sung-eui Yoon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了APT，一种半脆弱性的潜在空间扰动方法，用于在扩散修复（完全重建）场景下实现像素级篡改定位。通过对齐空间特征向量到固定锚定方向，APT在COCO上达到0.92的FR IoU，远超现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有篡改定位方法假设拼接（SP）设置，即合成区域直接覆盖在原始背景上，嵌入信号保持完整。但真实世界的扩散修复是在完全重建（FR）设置下运行的，整个图像都经过去噪过程，破坏了背景信号，使现有框架失效。因此需要一种能够在FR设置下仍然有效的篡改定位方法。

Method: 提出APT，一种半脆弱性潜在空间扰动方法。具体包括：(1) 在潜在空间中嵌入密集的逐向量定位信号，将每个空间特征向量对齐到固定锚定方向；(2) 通过合成前景与锚定对齐背景特征之间的对齐差异来定位篡改；(3) 使用困难负样本挖掘损失和噪声扰动分支来强制实现均匀对齐。

Result: 在COCO数据集上，APT实现FR IoU为0.92，优于最强基线WAM（0.84），而现有方法在FR设置下性能崩溃至接近随机（AUC 0.5）。APT可泛化至测试时未知的篡改类型。

Conclusion: APT建立了实用的取证框架，能够在完全重建（扩散修复）场景下实现有效的像素级篡改定位，并且可泛化到测试时未知的各种篡改类型，弥补了现有方法在FR设置下的失效问题。

Abstract: Proactive tamper localization embeds an imperceptible signal into an image prior to distribution, enabling pixel-level manipulation detection. Existing methods assume a spliced (SP) setting, where synthesized regions are composited onto the original background, leaving embedded signals intact. However, real-world diffusion-based inpainting operates in a fully regenerated (FR) setting, where the entire image undergoes denoising, disrupting background signals and rendering existing frameworks ineffective. We propose APT, a semi-fragile latent-space perturbation that embeds a dense, vector-wise localization signal. By aligning each spatial feature vector toward a fixed anchor direction, APT localizes tampering via the alignment disparity between synthesized foreground and anchor-aligned background features after inpainting. The proposed hard negative mining loss and noisy perturbation branch further enforce uniform alignment. Experiments on COCO demonstrate that APT achieves an FR IoU of 0.92, outperforming the strongest baseline (WAM, 0.84), while existing methods collapse to near-random performance (AUC 0.5), establishing APT as a practical forensic framework generalizable across tampering types unknown at test time.

</details>


### [212] [InfraOcc: An Infrastructure Occupancy Benchmark with Static-to-Dynamic Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30657)
*Lei Yang,Xiaokai Bai,Boqi Li,Chunmian Lin,Li Wang,Ziying Song,Jiahuan Zhang,Enhui Ma,Haibao Yu,Jiaqi Ma,Kaicheng Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了InfraOcc，据作者所知首个真实世界路侧（固定视角）语义占用基准，包含290个多模态序列的稠密体素标注，并提出了ProSD-Occ方法，将占用重建重构为渐进式静态到动态证据推理。该工作揭示了路侧占用中静态-动态的结构性不对称（静态填充97.3%占用体素，而动态中位数仅1.8%），ProSD-Occ在所有赛道（整体、动态、静态、几何）均取得第一，如相机-only动态mIoU相对最强基线提升23.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有占用基准和方法均围绕移动自车感知构建，将占用视为扁平的一次性体素分类，既未度量也未利用路侧固定视角下占用所特有的结构：静态骨架近乎持久存在，叠加着稀疏短暂的动态事件。这一结构性差异在数据和方法层面都未被解决。

Method: 从数据和模型两方面着手：（1）构建InfraOcc基准，包含290个固定路侧坐标系下的多模态序列，采用静态-动态解耦标注流程，提供统一的相机-only、LiDAR-only和多模态评测及静态/动态诊断；（2）提出ProSD-Occ方法，将占用建模为渐进式静态到动态证据推理——先解释持久布局，再在静态置信度引导下暴露残余动态证据，最后将静态、动态和自由空间证据重组为统一场。

Result: InfraOcc揭示了静态-动态的结构性不对称：静态基础设施占据97.3%的占用体素且跨帧持久，动态参与者的中位占用帧率仅1.8%。ProSD-Occ在所有赛道（整体、动态、静态、几何）均排名第一，例如相机-only动态mIoU相对最强基线提升23.5%，多模态整体mIoU达到65.87。

Conclusion: 路侧固定视角占用是一个区别于移动自车感知的独特问题，需要其自身的推理范式。本文通过首个路侧占用基准和ProSD-Occ方法确立并验证了这一新问题，代码和基准将公开。

Abstract: Fixed-viewpoint infrastructure sensors repeatedly observe the same traffic space, making roadside 3D occupancy structurally different from ego-vehicle perception: a near-persistent static scaffold is overlaid with sparse, short-lived dynamic events. Existing occupancy benchmarks and methods, however, are built around moving ego vehicles and neither measure nor exploit this structure, instead treating occupancy as flat one-shot voxel classification. We address this gap from both data and model perspectives. We build InfraOcc, to our knowledge, the first real-world infrastructure-side semantic occupancy benchmark, with dense voxel annotations for 290 multi-modal sequences in a fixed roadside frame, a static-dynamic decoupled annotation pipeline, unified camera-only, LiDAR-only, and multi-modal evaluation, and diagnostics for static and dynamic occupancy. InfraOcc shows that static infrastructure fills 97.3% of occupied voxels and persists across frames, whereas dynamic participants have a median occupied-frame ratio of only 1.8% per location, revealing a structural static-dynamic asymmetry beyond semantic long-tailedness. We further propose ProSD-Occ, which reformulates occupancy as progressive static-to-dynamic evidence reasoning: it explains persistent layout, exposes residual dynamic evidence under static-confidence guidance, and recomposes static, dynamic, and free-space evidence into a unified field. ProSD-Occ ranks first in overall, dynamic, static, and geometric occupancy on every track, e.g., a 23.5% relative camera-only dynamic-mIoU gain over the strongest baseline and 65.87 multi-modal overall mIoU, establishing fixed-viewpoint roadside occupancy as a distinct problem with its own reasoning paradigm. The benchmark and code will be publicly available at https://github.com/yanglei18/InfraOcc

</details>


### [213] [UFPR-PEs: A Brazilian Face Recognition Benchmark with Self-Declared Race/Color Labels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30688)
*Alexandre Diano,Bernardo Biesseck,Gabriel Polo,Vinicius Gregorio,Laura Lopes,Diego Addan,David Menotti*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了UFPR-PEs基准数据集，用于评估人脸识别系统在人口统计维度上的偏差。该数据集使用巴西民选政治家的公开视频，并采用巴西人口普查的种族/肤色分类法（包含美国或欧洲分类体系中没有直接对应的"parda"类别），在真实的压缩视频条件下进行人脸识别的验证和识别任务评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的人脸识别偏差评估基准大多采用美国或欧洲中心主义的种族分类体系，且缺乏在真实、非受控视觉条件下（如压缩视频）的评估。这导致对系统在人口多样性和现实场景中的可靠性理解不足。需要一个新的基准来弥补这一差距。

Method: 作者从巴西公开视频中构建了包含民选政治家的人脸识别基准，使用官方自我声明的种族/肤色类别进行标注（采用巴西人口普查分类法，包括parda类别）。基准保留困难样本以模拟真实条件，并分别在人脸验证、闭集识别和开集识别三种设定下进行性能评估，同时按种族/肤色和难度级别进行亚组分析。

Result: 结果显示人脸识别性能随图像质量变化显著，种族/肤色亚组之间的性能差异必须与视觉难度联合解读，而不能孤立看待。这表明单纯的亚组差距指标可能具有误导性。

Conclusion: UFPR-PEs提供了一个可复现的、基于人口统计学背景的基准，用于在具有挑战性的公共视频条件下研究人脸识别偏差，为更全面地理解和缓解人脸识别系统中的偏见提供了重要工具。

Abstract: While face recognition systems are widely deployed, ensuring their demographic reliability and robustness under uncontrolled visual conditions remains a critical challenge. To bridge this gap, we present UFPR-PEs, a benchmark for face recognition bias evaluation using public videos of elected Brazilian politicians annotated with official self-declared race/color categories. The dataset adopts the Brazilian census taxonomy, including the parda category, which has no direct equivalent in the U.S.- or Europe-centric schemas commonly used in prior benchmarks. Our benchmark is built from compressed public video and preserves difficult samples so that performance can be analyzed under realistic conditions. We describe the construction pipeline, report dataset statistics, and evaluate face recognition performance across verification and (closed- and open-set) identification settings, including subgroup analysis by race/color and difficulty level. The results show that recognition performance varies substantially with image quality, and that subgroup gaps must be interpreted jointly with visual difficulty rather than in isolation. Overall, UFPR-PEs provides a reproducible and demographically grounded setting for studying face recognition bias under challenging public video conditions.

</details>


### [214] [CANVAS: Consistency-Aware Navigation via Visual Adaptive Sampling for Long-Context Text-to-SVG Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30689)
*Yichen Wu,Haoxuan Qu,Yihang Lou,Hossein Rahmani,Jun Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CANVAS是一个无需训练、渲染感知的推理框架，通过功率锐化轨迹似然与渲染未来视觉反馈相结合，推导出笔画级导航规则，在有限生成与渲染预算下估计候选笔画的未来价值，并按不确定性、决策影响力和回滚成本自适应分配样本，从而提升自回归SVG生成中的全局一致性（几何、布局、遮挡、构图）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归大模型虽已推动Text-to-SVG从简单图标走向复杂长上下文图形，但标准自回归解码常在几何、布局、遮挡和构图上难以维持全局一致性。

Method: 提出CANVAS框架：（1）结合功率锐化轨迹似然与渲染未来视觉反馈；（2）推导笔画级导航规则；（3）在有限生成与渲染预算下估计候选笔画未来价值；（4）根据候选不确定性、决策影响力和回滚成本自适应分配采样。

Result: 在多个自回归SVG骨干网络和互补基准上的实验表明，该方法在无需额外训练的情况下，在几何关系、空间布局、遮挡顺序和整体构图等全局一致性指标上均有提升，验证了其有效性与泛化能力。

Conclusion: CANVAS作为训练自由的即插即用推理框架，能有效改善自回归SVG生成的全局一致性，且具备良好的跨模型泛化性。

Abstract: Autoregressive large models have recently advanced Text-to-SVG generation from simple icons to complex, long-context graphics, yet standard autoregressive decoding often fails to maintain global consistency across geometry, layout, occlusion, and composition.
