Extensive experiments demonstrate that Analytic Dynamics achieves efficient, accurate, and generalizable dynamics inference from monocular videos.

</details>


### [248] [Driving on Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31029)
*Christian Löwens,Thorben Funke,Alexandru Paul Condurache*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文发现端到端自动驾驶模型在NAVSIM基准上仅靠位置条件记忆（不含当前交通状态）就能达到甚至超过领先方法的表现，说明NAVSIM高分并不需要模型理解当前场景，该基准分数应谨慎对待。而在Bench2Drive和RealEngine上，记忆驱动会导致显著性能下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前自动驾驶基准（如NAVSIM、Bench2Drive）使用基于仿真的更丰富指标来评估安全与合规驾驶，但高分是否真正反映模型对动态场景的理解值得质疑。作者希望探究基准分数中有多少来源于对动态场景的反应。

Method: 移除模型的摄像头输入，替换为同一位置先前驾驶的记忆（retrieved memories）。记忆提供持久场景信息（如道路布局、位置条件规律），但不包含当前交通状态。在NAVSIM、Bench2Drive和RealEngine三个基准上对比记忆驱动与正常感知的性能。

Result: 在NAVSIM上，仅靠记忆几乎足够，达到甚至超过领先端到端方法的性能；在Bench2Drive和RealEngine上，记忆驱动导致大幅性能下降，表现出基准依赖性。

Conclusion: NAVSIM基准的高分可能不要求规划器对当前交通场景做出反应，其评估结果应谨慎解读。不同基准对动态场景反应的依赖程度不同，这为基准设计与自动驾驶模型评估提供了重要警示。

Abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving models plan future trajectories from raw sensor input. While earlier driving benchmarks often measured deviation from the human trajectory, current benchmarks such as NAVSIM and Bench2Drive evaluate models with richer simulation-based metrics intended to capture safe and compliant driving. A high benchmark score should reflect that a model can understand the scene in front of it and act accordingly. But how much of that score specifically comes from reacting to the dynamic part of that scene?
  To probe this, we remove a model's camera input and replace it with memories from prior drives at the same location. The retrieved memories can provide persistent scene information, including road layout and location-conditioned regularities, but not the current traffic state. Surprisingly, memory is nearly sufficient on NAVSIM, reaching or even exceeding the performance of leading end-to-end methods without actually observing the evaluated scene. Our results suggest that a high NAVSIM score does not require a planner to react to the current traffic scene and should be treated with caution. This effect is benchmark-dependent: driving from memory causes substantially larger performance drops on Bench2Drive and RealEngine. We provide our code at https://github.com/boschresearch/MemoryDrivoR .

</details>


### [249] [FaceSnap: Real-Time Personalized Lightstage Facial Performance Capture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31033)
*Rukhshanda Hussain,Noé Artru,Emeline Got,Luiz Gustavo Hafemann,Alexandre Messier,Brandon Dearlove,Rafael M. O. Cruz,Abdallah Dib,Eric Granger*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FaceSnap是一个端到端的面部捕捉框架，通过两阶段方法将Lightstage多视角采集流程简化为单目实时捕捉：先一次性多视角优化生成个性化模型，再用该模型从单个摄像头实现83fps的高保真4K纹理实时面部性能捕捉，并引入Multi4D基准数据集用于评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Lightstage面部捕捉虽然能产出电影级数字人，但需要多摄像机设置、数小时计算和大量数据存储，造成资源密集和劳动力密集的问题，严重阻碍了迭代式工作流程的效率。

Method: 采用两阶段框架：(1) 一次性多视角优化，从动作幅度序列构建编码几何和表情相关外观的个性化模型；(2) 利用该模型从单一单目光场相机进行实时面部性能捕捉，无需进一步多视角采集；提出个性化残差上采样器恢复主体特定高频细节，弥补通用上采样器的不足。

Result: FaceSnap在83fps下联合估计几何和动态4K纹理，几何精度可与完整逐帧多视角优化相媲美，优于在生产线级3D数据上训练的前馈方法，且仅需单相机视角。

Conclusion: 通过个性化建模将多视角光场采集压缩为单目实时捕捉，大幅降低资源与人力成本，同时提出了Multi4D公开基准，支持跨方法的拓扑不变几何比较，推动4D面部重建的标准化评估。

Abstract: Lightstage facial capture produces production-quality digital humans, but it is resource and labor-intensive. Multi-camera setups, hours of computation, and massive data storage create bottlenecks that hinder iterative workflows. This paper introduces FaceSnap, an end-to-end framework that streamlines capture via a two-stage approach. First, a one-time multi-view optimization from a range-of-motion sequence builds a personalized model encoding both geometry and expression-dependent appearance. This model then enables high-fidelity real-time facial performance capture from a single monocular lightstage camera, with no further multi-view capture required. FaceSnap jointly estimates geometry and dynamic 4K texture at 83 fps. The 4K texture is produced by a novel personalized residual upscaler that recovers subject-specific high-frequency detail, which generic upscalers fail to capture. FaceSnap achieves geometric accuracy competitive with full per-frame multi-view optimization while outperforming feed-forward methods trained on production-quality 3D data, all from a single camera view. Finally, we introduce Multi4D, a public benchmark for evaluating 4D facial reconstruction methods in lightstage environments, enabling topology-invariant geometric comparison across methods.

</details>


### [250] [Segmentation of Bovid Dentition Under Imperfect Annotations: A Comparative Study of Convolutional and Attention Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31052)
*Keith G. Mills,Evan B. Sanders,Gregory J. Matthews,Juliet K. Brophy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文对多种语义分割架构（从卷积骨干网络到视觉Transformer）在B.O.V.I.D.牛科动物牙齿数据集上进行了比较研究，该数据集的mask并非为ML训练设计，存在标签不完美的问题。研究发现预处理和对齐技术对定量指标（Dice、mIoU）影响有限，但对预测mask的定性效果影响显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语义分割DNN依赖精心设计的mask标签进行训练，然而现实中的数据往往存在标签不完美或未对齐的问题，这可能干扰模型的学习效果。本文旨在探究在具有系统性标签缺陷的真实数据集上，不同分割架构和预处理策略的表现差异。

Method: 作者在B.O.V.I.D.数据集（高分辨率牛科动物牙齿照片及手工标注mask）上，比较了从卷积骨干到视觉Transformer的一系列分割架构，并评估了多种预处理和对齐技术以缓解标签不完美带来的问题。

Result: 研究发现预处理选择对Dice分数和mIoU等定量指标的影响有限，但对预测mask的定性质量（如分割边界的准确性和形态合理性）有显著影响。

Conclusion: 定量指标可能无法充分反映标签缺陷带来的影响，评估分割模型时应结合定性分析；在处理非ML设计的真实数据集时，预处理策略的选择对实际分割效果至关重要。

Abstract: Semantic segmentation decomposes an image into distinct mask regions corresponding to different object categories, such as people, cars, signs or buildings. Advances in machine learning (ML) have shifted this task away from traditional rule-based heuristics such as edge detection, towards deep neural networks (DNN) that learn to classify pixels directly. However, semantic segmentation DNNs crucially depend on expertly designed mask targets to learn from, and imperfect or misaligned masks can interfere with a model's ability to learn effectively.
  This paper presents a comparative study of segmentation architectures, ranging from convolutional backbones to vision transformers, applied to the B.O.V.I.D. dataset, a corpus of high-resolution bovid dental photographs paired with hand-made segmentation masks not originally designed for ML-based training. We evaluate a range of preprocessing and alignment techniques to mitigate the resulting label imperfections. We find that while these preprocessing choices have limited effect on quantitative metrics such as Dice score and mIoU, their qualitative impact on predicted masks is substantial.

</details>


### [251] [Identity-Conditioned Latent Consistency Distillation for Face Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31053)
*Tiago Kienen Chaves,Bernardo Biesseck,David Menotti*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出将潜在一致性模型（Latent Consistency Model）应用于身份条件的人脸合成，通过从扩散模型Arc2Face蒸馏知识，实现了4.36倍推理加速（从2.102秒降至0.4819秒/张），同时保持图像质量，FID分数与教师模型相当甚至更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型虽然在高保真图像合成方面表现出色，但迭代采样过程计算成本高昂，尤其在进行大规模人脸数据集生成来用于人脸识别任务时，需要生成大量不同姿态、表情、年龄的主体样本，计算瓶颈更加突出。

Method: 将Arc2Face的文本到图像（text-to-image）流程调整为嵌入到人脸（embedding-to-face）流程，用ArcFace身份嵌入替代文本提示。通过任务特定的潜在一致性蒸馏，将教师模型（Arc2Face）的知识蒸馏到学生模型（一致性模型），使学生模型只需少量迭代即可生成身份条件的人脸图像。

Result: 平均推理时间从2.102秒降至0.4819秒/张（4.36倍加速）。在100k生成图像上，CelebA的FID为13.921（教师12.928），WebFace42M上9.317（教师9.802，优于教师）。Synth-500上有中等性能差距，AgeDB上结果相当。

Conclusion: 任务特定的潜在一致性蒸馏可以显著加速Arc2Face的人脸生成，同时保持高质量的图像输出，适用于大规模合成人脸数据集生成。

Abstract: Diffusion models have achieved strong results in high-fidelity image synthesis, but their iterative sampling process makes large-scale generation computationally expensive. This limitation is especially relevant when generating synthetic face datasets for face recognition, where a large number of subjects with many samples in different poses, expressions, ages, etc., are required. In this work, we show that identity-conditioned face synthesis can be performed at a substantially lower computational cost by a latent Consistency Model with few iterations, without compromising image quality. For training, we distill knowledge from the foundation Diffusion Model Arc2Face (teacher) by adapting its original text-to-image pipeline to an embedding-to-face setting, replacing textual prompts with ArcFace identity embeddings. Our distilled model (student) generates identity-conditioned face images with an average inference time of 0.4819 seconds per image, compared with 2.102 seconds for Arc2Face, resulting in a 4.36$\times$ speed-up. Quantitative results, based on FID scores, show that the distilled model remains competitive with Arc2Face across all evaluation protocols. On 100k generated images, it achieves near-parity on CelebA (13.921 vs. 12.928) and outperforms the teacher on WebFace42M (9.317 vs. 9.802). Further evaluations on Synth-500 and AgeDB show a moderate performance gap for the former but comparable results for the latter. These results indicate that Arc2Face can be accelerated through task-specific latent consistency distillation while preserving high image quality for large-scale synthetic face generation. Our proposal is publicly available at https://github.com/UFPR-IPASP-PR/FaceRec-IdentityConsistency.

</details>


### [252] [Multimodal Shared Latent Representation of Narration, Microscope and iOCT Images for Phase Recognition in Vitreoretinal Surgery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31065)
*Onur Izmitlioglu,Shervin Dehghani,Tarek Ghannoum,Benedikt Schworm,Nassir Navab*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个框架，利用显微镜视图作为共享锚点，将手术叙述与术中OCT（iOCT）桥接起来进行玻璃体视网膜手术的阶段识别，无需完全同步的三模态数据集。通过对比学习将对齐从合成域迁移到缺少iOCT的真实视频，并使用双头MS-TCN++进行宏观和微观阶段预测，显著提升了宏观阶段识别的性能（F1从0.38提升至0.53）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手术阶段识别对于玻璃体视网膜手术中的上下文感知计算机辅助反馈至关重要，但同步多模态术中数据（特别是显微镜视图和术中OCT）的稀缺性限制了多模态集成方法的发展。虽然手术叙述在线上大量可用且提供丰富的语义监督，但先前工作主要探索两两对比学习（如iOCT-显微镜或显微镜-叙述），三个模态的联合建模尚未被充分探索。

Method: 该方法使用显微镜视图作为共享锚点来桥接手术叙述和iOCT。利用真实的显微镜-叙述视频和合成的显微镜视频与工具对齐iOCT对数据集，通过对比对齐将合成域的结构先验迁移到缺少iOCT的真实视频中，并使用双头MS-TCN++整合生成的嵌入，实现联合宏观和微观阶段预测。

Result: 在真实玻璃体视网膜手术上的评估显示，框架将宏观阶段识别的平均F1从0.38提升到0.53（对比零样本基线）。微观阶段估计在合成数据上进行了定量验证，在真实手术中仅显示定性结果。

Conclusion: 这是首个将显微镜视图、iOCT B扫描和手术叙述统一到共享潜在空间用于手术阶段识别的工作，为估计真实显微镜视频中不可直接观察的精细器械-组织测量提供了探索性途径。

Abstract: Surgical phase recognition is key to context-aware computer-assisted feedback in vitreoretinal procedures, yet the scarcity of synchronized multimodal intraoperative data, particularly microscope views and intraoperative OCT, limits approaches that aim to replicate the multimodal integration surgeons perform naturally. Surgical narration, by contrast, is abundantly available online and offers rich semantic supervision. Prior work has mainly explored pairwise contrastive learning (e.g., intraoperative OCT-microscope or microscope-narration), leaving the joint modeling of all three modalities largely unexplored. We introduce a framework that uses microscope views as a shared anchor to bridge surgical narrations and intraoperative OCT (iOCT) without requiring a fully synchronized tri-modal dataset, leveraging real microscope-narration videos and a synthetic dataset of synchronized microscope video and tool-aligned iOCT pairs. Contrastive alignment transfers structural priors from the synthetic domain to real videos lacking iOCT, and a dual-head MS-TCN++ integrates the resulting embeddings for joint macro- and micro-phase prediction. Evaluated on real vitreoretinal surgeries, our framework improves macro-phase recognition over a zero-shot baseline (mean F1 0.38 to 0.53) and provides an exploratory route to estimating fine-grained instrument-tissue measurements that are not directly observable in real microscope video alone; these micro-phase estimates are validated quantitatively on synthetic data and shown only qualitatively on real surgery. To our knowledge, this is the first work to unify microscope view, iOCT B-scans, and surgical narrations in a shared latent space for surgical phase recognition.

</details>


### [253] [LISynSeg: Data-Centric Label-to-Image Synthesis for Cross-Modality Whole-Heart Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31073)
*Jiacheng Wang,Ivana Isgum,Ipek Oguz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出LISynSeg，一种数据驱动的全心脏分割方法，通过标签到图像合成增强nnU-Net训练数据，利用对比度和采集扰动校准生成合成体积，并与真实图像混合以保留胸腔上下文，在CARE基准上改善跨模态（CT/MRI）分割性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全心脏分割在CT和MRI中受采集偏移和异构心脏标注影响，现有方法依赖架构设计、迁移学习和通用增强，本文旨在探索仅改变数据增强和训练监督策略能否在保持分割架构不变的情况下提升跨模态WHS性能。

Method: 提出数据驱动的LISynSeg方法：1) 从心脏标签图生成合成体积，使用与训练队列校准的对比度和采集扰动；2) 将合成图像与真实图像混合以保留标签中缺失的胸腔上下文；3) 通过对心肌壁厚度进行受控变化和不确定血管端点的部分监督来建模心脏标签变异。

Result: 在CARE全心脏基准上，纯合成训练效果差于真实图像nnU-Net基线，而校准的真实-合成混合训练在无需改变架构的情况下改善了跨模态分割性能，其中MRI的提升大于CT。

Conclusion: 修改训练数据策略能够惠及异构心脏数据的模型开发，数据中心的视角（特别是精心校准的合成数据增强）可以作为架构改进的补充手段来提升跨模态全心脏分割。

Abstract: Whole-heart segmentation (WHS) in computed tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is affected by acquisition shifts and heterogeneous cardiac annotations. Existing WHS systems combine architectural design, transfer learning, and generic spatial or intensity augmentation. We investigate whether changes to data augmentation and training supervision can improve cross-modality WHS while the segmentation architecture is held constant. We present LISynSeg, a data-centric approach that augments real-image nnU-Net training with label-to-image synthesis. Synthetic volumes are generated from cardiac label maps using contrast and acquisition perturbations calibrated to the training cohort, then mixed with real images to retain thoracic context absent from the labels (and thus the synthesized images). We model cardiac label variation through controlled changes in myocardial wall thickness and partial supervision of uncertain vessel endpoints. On the CARE Whole-Heart benchmark, synthetic-only training performs worse than the real-image nnU-Net baseline, whereas calibrated real-synthetic training improves cross-modality segmentation without changing the architecture; the improvement is larger for MRI than for CT. The results show that modifying the training data strategy can benefit model development for heterogeneous cardiac data. Code and trained weights will be released at https://github.com/MedICL-VU/Care26_LISynSeg.

</details>


### [254] [Real-Time Video Anomaly Detection Using YOLO Pose Estimation and CLIP-Based Semantic Scoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31074)
*Vanodhya G. Warnasooriya,Amir Hajian,Watchara Ruangsang,Supavadee Aramvith*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一个轻量级两阶段框架用于实时视频异常检测。第一阶段使用YOLO v11n-pose同时检测人物并提取17个骨骼关键点；第二阶段通过CLIP ViT-B/32编码人物区域，并与预定义的异常行为文本描述计算余弦相似度。该架构无需光流、独立姿态估计器和密度评分模块。在CUHK Avenue、ShanghaiTech Campus和朱拉隆功大学自建室内数据集上验证，端到端吞吐量约51 FPS（比多特征基线快3.36倍），帧级AUROC分别为89.26%、70.26%和84.13%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统视频异常检测方法通常依赖光流、独立姿态估计器和密度评分模块等复杂组件，导致计算开销大、实时性差。作者旨在通过简化架构，在保持检测精度的同时大幅提升推理速度，实现高吞吐量的实时异常检测。

Method: 两阶段轻量级框架：第一阶段用YOLO v11n-pose单次前向传播完成人物检测与17个骨骼关键点提取；第二阶段将裁剪的人物区域送入CLIP ViT-B/32编码，与预定义异常行为的文本描述计算余弦相似度进行异常判定。

Result: 在三个数据集上验证：CUHK Avenue、ShanghaiTech Campus和自建室内数据集帧级AUROC分别为89.26%、70.26%和84.13%；端到端吞吐量约51 FPS（NVIDIA Titan XP GPU），相比多特征基线实现3.36倍加速。

Conclusion: 该框架证明通过整合姿态估计与CLIP视觉-语言模型，可以在不牺牲过多精度的前提下显著提升视频异常检测的实时性能，为实际场景中的实时监控应用提供了有效方案。

Abstract: We propose a lightweight two-stage framework for real-time video anomaly detection. The first stage employs YOLO v11n-pose to detect persons and extract seventeen skeletal keypoints in a single forward pass. The second stage encodes each cropped person region through CLIP ViT-B/32 and computes cosine similarity against predefined textual descriptions of anomalous behaviors. This architecture eliminates the need for optical flow, standalone pose estimators, and density-based scoring modules. Experiments on CUHK Avenue, ShanghaiTech Campus, and a custom indoor dataset collected at Chulalongkorn University demonstrate an end-to-end throughput of approximately 51 FPS on an NVIDIA Titan XP GPU, a 3.36x speedup over the multi-feature baseline, while maintaining frame-level AUROC values of 89.26%, 70.26%, and 84.13%, respectively.

</details>


### [255] [Robust retinal biometrics for patient identity verification and retrieval across age and imaging devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31094)
*Jose D. Vargas-Quiros,Dennis Bontempi,Jeroen Vermeulen,Bart Liefers,Sven Bergmann,Caroline C. W. Klaver*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于彩色眼底图像的视网膜生物识别系统，用于验证患者身份和检索正确身份。该系统使用ConvNeXtV2骨干网络结合ArcFace和三元组损失的512维度量学习编码器，在Rotterdam Study的227,004张图像上训练，并在Rotterdam Study、UK Biobank和AREDS三个数据集上验证，AUROC均超过0.9997，Recall@1达到97.2%-99.7%，证明了视网膜解剖结构可作为可靠的长期生物识别信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 患者身份错误会危及纵向医疗记录的完整性、研究数据库的准确性以及下游临床决策。传统的身份验证方法在眼科影像数据中可能存在局限，需要一个基于视网膜本身解剖特征的生物识别系统来确保长期随访影像记录的身份一致性。

Method: 使用ConvNeXtV2作为骨干网络，结合ArcFace损失和三元组损失训练512维度量学习编码器。训练数据来自Rotterdam Study中21,851个患者眼身份的227,004张图像，覆盖多种成像设备和长达32.6年的随访。在正式评估前，先使用模型筛查身份不一致的标记图像，进行人工审核修正数据。评估包括验证任务（AUROC）和检索任务（Recall@K），并在外部数据集（UK Biobank和AREDS）上验证泛化能力。

Result: 在去除近重复图像后的回顾性验证中，Rotterdam Study、UK Biobank和AREDS的AUROC分别达到0.9998、0.9997和0.9998。身份检索的Recall@1分别为99.7%、97.2%和97.6%，Top-5准确率至少98.6%。系统在不同成像设备和长随访间隔下表现稳健，较低图像质量和视网膜视野不一致是主要失败原因。

Conclusion: 视网膜解剖结构是一种持久且可靠的生物识别信号，可有效用于保障纵向影像记录的身份完整性。该系统的表现表明其具有实际应用价值，可用于筛查和修正大型眼科学研究和临床数据库中的身份错误。

Abstract: Patient identity errors can compromise longitudinal medical records, research databases, and downstream clinical decisions. We present a retinal biometric system for verifying claimed identities and retrieving the correct identity from color fundus images. We trained a 512-dimensional metric-learning encoder combining a ConvNeXtV2 backbone with ArcFace and triplet losses on 227,004 images from 21,851 patient-eye identities in the Rotterdam Study, spanning multiple imaging devices and up to 32.6 years of follow-up. The system was evaluated on held-out Rotterdam Study data and externally on the UK Biobank and Age-Related Eye Disease Study (AREDS). Before evaluation, we used the model to screen for identity inconsistencies and manually adjudicated flagged images, identifying incorrect assignments in 0.588% of Rotterdam Study images, 0.259% of UK Biobank images, and 0.164% of AREDS images. In retrospective-only verification after removing near-duplicate images, the system achieved AUROCs of 0.9998, 0.9997, and 0.9998 in the Rotterdam Study, UK Biobank, and AREDS, respectively. For identity retrieval using only previously acquired images, Recall@1 was 99.7%, 97.2%, and 97.6%, respectively, from galleries averaging 4436-8510 identities; the correct identity appeared among the top five results in at least 98.6% of cases. Performance remained robust across imaging devices and long follow-up intervals, while lower image quality and inconsistent retinal fields accounted for most failures. These findings establish retinal anatomy as a durable biometric signal, useful for safeguarding the integrity of longitudinal imaging records.

</details>


### [256] [One Adapter, Many Tasks: Task-Conditioned Feature Transformations for Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31096)
*Yunxiang Fu,Meng Lou,Yizhou Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FACET提出了一种基于预训练模型的任务条件特征变换方法，通过单一共享适配器和任务条件化特征变换，将适配器特征分布塑造成重叠减少的任务特定组件的混合体，同时引入无重放的任务条件特征一致性损失来缓解灾难性遗忘，在保持参数和计算高效的同时实现优越的类增量学习性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于预训练模型的类增量学习方法存在两类缺陷：任务特定适配器需要显式学习各任务表示但参数和计算效率低下；LoRA合并方法将各任务参数静态加权合并导致推理时表示干扰。作者旨在解决这两方面的问题，在参数效率和判别性特征之间取得平衡。

Method: FACET包含两个核心组件：(1) 单一共享适配器采用动态任务条件特征变换，将适配器的整体特征分布塑造成由重叠减少的任务特定组件构成的混合分布；(2) 提出一种无重放的任务条件特征一致性损失，用于缓解适配器特征空间中学习到的混合分布的灾难性遗忘。该方法只需维护单一适配器即可实现。

Result: 在超长任务序列（如200个任务）和标准短任务序列（如20个任务）上均取得优越性能，同时使用的可训练参数和GFLOPs显著更少，展现出良好的可扩展性。

Conclusion: FACET通过单一共享适配器配合任务条件化特征变换和特征一致性损失，有效解决了类增量学习中任务特定适配器的低效问题和LoRA合并中的表示干扰问题，实现了参数高效且判别性强的方法，在长短任务序列上均表现优异。

Abstract: Class-incremental learning (CIL) requires a model to incrementally learn tasks that contain new classes without accessing earlier training data while preserving the ability to recognize all seen classes. Recently, pretrained-model-based approaches have become prevalent by adapting a frozen backbone with additional lightweight trainable modules. Existing methods, however, exhibit limitations: task-specific adapters learn explicit per-task representations but are parameter- and computation-inefficient, while LoRA-based merging methods combine per-task LoRA parameters into a single model whose static aggregated weights cause representation interference during inference. To address these problems, we present \textbf{FACET}: task-conditioned \textbf{F}e\textbf{A}ture transformation with \textbf{C}ondition\textbf{E}d feature consis\textbf{T}ency, achieving excellent parameter efficiency while producing highly discriminative features during inference. When continually trained on a task sequence, FACET learns a single shared adapter that employs a dynamic task-conditioned feature transformation, shaping the overall feature distribution of the adapter into a mixture of overlap-reduced task-specific components. On the other hand, we propose an efficient replay-free task-conditioned feature consistency loss, aiming to mitigate catastrophic forgetting of the learned mixture distribution in the adapter's feature space. Even when maintaining only a single adapter, FACET demonstrates robust scalability. On both very long task sequences (e.g., 200 tasks) and standard short task sequences (e.g., 20 tasks), our method achieves superior performance while using significantly fewer trainable parameters and GFLOPs. The code will be made open source upon acceptance.

</details>


### [257] [DreamX-Creator: Democratizing Native Audio-Video Generation at 2K Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31106)
*Jiashu Zhu,Yanhao Zheng,Ruitian Tian,Rujing Dang,Shen Zhang,Bingze Song,Jiachen Lei,Ruimin Lin,Jiahong Wu,Xiangxiang Chu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DreamX-Creator 1.0 是一个紧凑的原生联合音视频生成系统，核心为 7B 生成器，通过门控跨模态注意力在后期耦合音视频流，并配合统一数据系统、渐进式联合训练、多模态强化学习以及自回归 1 步 2K 精炼管道，实现了与最先进开源系统竞争力相当的原生同步音视频生成，并开源模型以推动领域发展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成器往往忽略音频或采用独立阶段合成音频，这种方式限制了视觉动态与声学事件之间的相互建模能力，无法实现真正的音视频同步生成。

Method: 1) 7B 生成器以首帧和文本提示为条件，联合去噪音视频流，前半个网络独立处理各模态流，后半个网络通过门控跨模态注意力（Gated Cross-Modal Attention）耦合，采用 token 级和 head 级输出门控调节每个活动的跨模态注意力头输出。2) 统一的音视频数据系统构建和过滤时间连贯的片段、生成结构化多模态标注、并组织为面向能力的数据池。3) 渐进式联合训练包含两个音视频预训练阶段和高品质微调。4) 音视频强化学习利用模态感知的多模态反馈进行后训练，将视频、音频和跨模态反馈路由到相应流。5) 自回归 1 步 2K 精炼管道将双向多步教师适配为自回归多步精炼器，并蒸馏为每个时间块仅需一次去噪评估的学生模型。

Result: DreamX-Creator 1.0 实现了原生、同步的音视频生成，性能与最先进的开源系统相当，并开源了紧凑的 7B 生成器和 2K 精炼器。

Conclusion: 通过开源紧凑的模型，论文旨在推动原生音视频生成的民主化，为统一音视频生成建模的未来研究提供可访问的基础。

Abstract: Recent video generators often omit audio or synthesize it in a separate stage, limiting reciprocal modeling of visual dynamics and acoustic events. We present DreamX-Creator 1.0, a compact native joint audio-video generation system centered on a 7B generator. Conditioned on a first frame and a text prompt, the generator jointly denoises modality-specialized audio and video streams. The streams are processed independently in the first half of the network and coupled in the latter half through Gated Cross-Modal Attention, whose token- and head-wise output gates modulate each active cross-modal attention-head output. A unified Audio-Video Data System constructs and filters temporally coherent clips, produces structured multimodal annotations, and organizes clips into capability-oriented data pools. Progressive Joint Training comprises two audio-video pre-training stages followed by High-Quality Finetuning. Audio-Video Reinforcement Learning further post-trains the generator with Modality-Aware Multimodal Feedback that routes video-, audio-, and cross-modal feedback to the corresponding streams. For high-resolution output, our Autoregressive 1-Step 2K Refinement pipeline adapts a bidirectional multi-step teacher into an autoregressive multi-step refiner and distills it into a student requiring one denoising evaluation per temporal chunk. Overall, DreamX-Creator 1.0 achieves native, synchronized audio-video generation with performance competitive with state-of-the-art open-source systems. By releasing our compact 7B generator and 2K Refiner, we seek to democratize native audio-video generation and provide an accessible foundation for future research in unified audio-video generative modeling.

</details>


### [258] [VeriCam: A Verification Baseline for the Classification of Unknown Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31107)
*Lucas Wojcik,Gabriel E. Lima,Sergio M. Silva,Eduil Nascimento,David Menotti*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出VeriCam流水线，利用基于验证任务训练的图像模型来学习细粒度特征，通过构建关系图和图聚类实现对未知类别数据的零样本分类。在LPLCv2交通监控数据集上，验证基线F1得分93.45，聚类V-Measure得分80.13。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基础模型（图像、文本及视觉-文本混合模型）虽然具有强大的泛化能力，但在需要细粒度、基于微小细节的类别区分任务中表现不足，无法满足某些真实世界任务的需求。

Method: VeriCam流水线包含三个核心步骤：1) 利用专门为验证任务训练的模型学习细粒度特征空间；2) 训练模型判别图像对来自相同或不同类别，构建表示数据点间类别关系的关系图；3) 提出两种图聚类方法——朴素算法和针对Leiden图聚类算法的特定配置。

Result: 在LPLCv2数据集上，跨设备场景下验证基线F1-Score达93.45，聚类步骤V-Measure达80.13。同时发现数据集存在固有的采集设备偏差，并通过无标签方法动态识别采集设备，构建了公平无偏的基准。

Conclusion: VeriCam通过验证任务驱动的特征学习和图聚类方法，有效解决了基础模型在细粒度分类上的不足，并揭示了交通监控数据集的设备偏差问题，为车牌识别等下游任务提供了更可靠的基准构建方案。

Abstract: The advent of foundation models have enabled a new era in zero-shot classification. Yet, key challenges persist. Despite their impressive generalization power that leverages the immense pre-training knowledge, both foundation models for image and text as well as vision-text hybrids lack the representational power needed for fine-grained, minutiae-based class separation that some real-world tasks require. To address the current gaps in the literature, we propose VeriCam, a pipeline designed to learn highly specialized features that enable classification of unknown classes in unseen data. VeriCam works by leveraging the representation power of image models trained for the verification task, where the model develops an intricate feature space that incorporates fine-grained details. By training a model to discriminate between pairs of images from the same and different classes, a relational graph is constructed, representing the class relationships between data points. We then present two approaches for graph clustering: a naive algorithm and a specific setup for the Leiden graph clustering algorithm. The pipeline is validated on the LPLCv2 dataset, which comprises real-world traffic surveillance images. We show that the dataset carries an inherent capture device bias that is posed as a generalization challenge for downstream License Plate recognition tasks such as OCR. As such, we dynamically identify capture devices with a label-agnostic approach, enabling the construction of a fair and unbiased benchmark. In the cross-device scenario, our pipeline reaches an F1-Score of 93.45 in the verification baseline and a V-Measure score of 80.13 in the clustering step. All code is publicly available at https://github.com/lmlwojcik/VeriCam

</details>


### [259] [BLARM: Animating 3D Objects from Video via Blending Latent Rigid Motion Primitives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31113)
*Pradyumn Goyal,Yizhak Ben-Shabat,Hsueh-Ti Derek Liu,Haomiao Jiang,Snehasish Mukherjee,Kyle Spence,Mark Stauber,Evangelos Kalogerakis,Yunze Zeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BLARM是一种前馈式视频驱动3D网格动画生成方法，输入单目视频和静态物体网格，输出时间连贯的动画网格。它通过一组紧凑的学习型时变刚体运动分量和时不变的顶点到分量蒙皮权重来表示动画，无需骨骼、笼子、蒙皮权重或绑定标注，就能实现低维形变空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频驱动的3D网格动画方法要么依赖显式骨骼绑定（rig），要么直接回归高维顶点运动，前者需要额外标注和搭建，后者计算复杂且难以保证时间一致性。作者希望设计一种无需显式绑定、低维、可解释的运动表示方法。

Method: 1) 用紧凑的时变刚体运动分量 + 时不变的顶点到分量蒙皮权重表示动画，形成低维形变空间；2) 模型架构将几何导出的形变隐向量与视频特征通过分解式时空注意力（factorized spatial-temporal attention）进行条件融合；3) 解码器通过预测的蒙皮权重混合刚体变换；4) 训练采用轨迹重建损失、熵正则化和运动感知对比学习。

Result: BLARM能够生成准确且时间稳定的动画，同时从单目视频中恢复紧凑、可解释的运动结构。

Conclusion: 通过紧凑运动分量表示和分解式时空注意力机制，BLARM在无需人工标注绑定信息的前提下实现了高质量的视频驱动3D网格动画，兼顾了准确性、时间连贯性和运动可解释性。

Abstract: We introduce BLARM, a feed-forward method for video-driven 3D mesh animation. Given a monocular video and a static object mesh, BLARM predicts a temporally coherent animated mesh whose motion follows the video. Rather than relying on explicit rigs or directly regressing high-dimensional vertex motion, we represent animation using a compact set of learned, time-varying rigid motion components and time-invariant vertex-to-component skinning weights. This yields a low-dimensional deformation space without requiring skeletons, cages, skinning weights, or rig annotations. Our architecture conditions geometry-derived deformation latents on video features through factorized spatial-temporal attention, then decodes rigid transformations blended by predicted skinning weights. Trained with trajectory reconstruction, entropy regularization, and motion-aware contrastive learning, BLARM produces accurate and temporally stable animations while recovering compact, interpretable motion structure from monocular video.

</details>


### [260] [BRF-GS: Hyperspectral Bidirectional Reflectance Factor Modeling and Image Generation Based on 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31159)
*Yiling Yao,Wenjuan Zhang,Bowen Wang,Bocheng Li,Wentao Song,Bing Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出BRF-GS框架，基于3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）实现双向反射因子（BRF）建模与多角度高光谱反射率图像生成。通过混合BRDF驱动核、几何可靠波段选择和两阶段训练策略，解决了3DGS在复杂方向反射和高光谱数据上的不足，并构建了AIR-BRF数据集验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D辐射传输模型需要复杂的场景构建和昂贵的计算求解，难以高效生成多角度高光谱反射率图像；而3DGS虽高效，但其低阶球谐函数不足以表达复杂方向反射，且高光谱数据的高维性和波段间质量差异带来额外挑战。

Method: 1) 引入混合BRDF驱动核以表示复杂方向反射；2) 选择几何可靠的谱段进行稳健的3D场景初始化；3) 采用两阶段训练策略，将几何优化与光谱建模解耦；4) 构建包含三个场景的AIR-BRF多角度高光谱方向反射数据集。

Result: 实验表明BRF-GS在空间和光谱保真度上均表现优越，能够准确再现具有视点依赖性的BRF响应特征。

Conclusion: BRF-GS为遥感场景中的BRF建模与多角度高光谱反射率图像生成提供了一种高效的数据驱动方法。

Abstract: The bidirectional reflectance factor (BRF) characterizes the directional radiative properties of terrestrial surfaces. However, existing three-dimensional (3D) radiative transfer models require complex scene construction and computationally intensive radiative transfer solvers, limiting efficient generation of multi-angle hyperspectral reflectance imagery. 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) offers an efficient framework for neural scene representation and novel view synthesis, but its low-order spherical harmonics representation is insufficient for complex directional reflectance, while the high dimensionality and inter-band quality differences of hyperspectral data introduce additional challenges. To address these challenges, we propose BRF-GS, a 3DGS-based framework for BRF modeling and hyperspectral reflectance image generation. BRF-GS introduces a hybrid BRDF-driven kernel to represent complex directional reflectance, selects geometry-reliable spectral bands for robust 3D scene initialization, and adopts a two-stage training strategy that decouples geometry optimization from spectral modeling. We further construct the AIR-BRF dataset, a multi-angle hyperspectral directional reflectance dataset comprising three scenes with diverse natural and artificial targets. Experiments demonstrate that BRF-GS achieves superior spatial and spectral fidelity and accurately reproduces characteristic view-dependent BRF responses. The proposed framework provides an efficient data-driven approach for BRF modeling and multi-angle hyperspectral reflectance image generation in remote sensing scenes.

</details>

### [261] [NLP-Driven Knowledge Extraction and Thematic Classification of Translated Ancient Indian Medical Texts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28608)
*M. S. Rajeevan,B. Mini Devi,V. S. Anoop,C. Mallikarjuna*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究利用NLP技术（NER、BERTopic主题建模、Neo4j知识图谱）对古代印度医学典籍（如Sushruta Samhita）进行数字化提取、分类和可视化，以提升古老医学知识的可获取性和系统性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 古代印度医学文献（如Sushruta Samhita）包含丰富的疾病、治疗和外科手术信息，但其古老格式和复杂词汇导致可访问性差、系统化排序困难，亟需现代计算技术加以整理。

Method: 结合三种NLP技术：1) NER用于结构化识别疾病、治疗、研究人员和药用植物等实体；2) BERTopic建模用于识别潜在医学主题并进行主题分类；3) 在Neo4j中构建知识图谱，实现实体间语义关系和网络分析。

Result: 研究表明图数据库、主题建模和实体识别能够有效促进阿育吠陀历史医学智慧的计算化组织，成功弥合传统文本与现代数据驱动研究之间的鸿沟。

Conclusion: 该研究提出的方法可推动历史文本分析、医学信息学和数字人文学科的发展，使古代印度医学智慧更易于获取和理解。

Abstract: Ancient Indian medical texts like Sushruta Samhita have extensive information on diseases, treatments, and surgical techniques. Yet, their ancient format and use of intricate vocabulary pose difficulties in accessibility and systematic ordering. The research here utilizes Natural Language Processing (NLP) methods like Named Entity Recognition (NER), BERTopic modeling, and Knowledge Graph development in Neo4j to extract, categorize, and visualize important concepts based on translated versions. Thematic classification with BERTopic allows for the identification of the underlying medical topics, whereas NER supports the structured entity recognition of diseases, treatments, researchers, and medicinal plants. Graphbased network analysis with Neo4j also allows for the semantic representation of relationship among extracted entities, supporting knowledge retrieval and digital preservation. The findings illustrate how graph databases, topic modeling, and entity recognition facilitate the computational organization of Ayurveda's historical medical wisdom, closing the gap between the conventional texts and contemporary data-driven inquiry. The suggested method promotes historical text analysis, medical informatics, and digital humanities to make ancient Indian medical wisdom more accessible and understandable.

</details>


### [262] [Parametric Multimodal User Memory: Storing What Captions Cannot Carry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28609)
*Bojie Li,Noah Shi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出将感知记忆（如声音、面容等不可言说的身份特征）直接内嵌到模型中，通过视觉语言模型进行指代定位与专用编码器提取身份键相结合的方式，实现无需外部检索循环的个性化代理记忆系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有个性化代理的记忆几乎完全依赖文本（转录和字幕的相似性检索），这只能捕捉用户可描述的一半信息（如"我的猫叫Bibi"），却丢弃了无法用文字描述的另一半感知信息（如声音特质、面孔在年龄和光照下的变化、疲惫的语气）。实验证明纯文本方法在非可命名信号上接近随机水平。

Method: 将感知记忆分解为两个子问题：（1）视觉语言模型（VLM）将指代对象在上下文中定位（什么、在哪）；（2）专用编码器提取身份键（谁），以单个内联token存储，通过注意力机制在生成时直接读取，无需外部往返。识别核心无需训练，可在任意冻结模型上以O(1)注册成本复现编码器的召回性能。

Result: 单一方法均不足（VLM跨年龄人脸识别仅0.54召回，未接地编码器在两人场景仅0.05），但两者结合达到正确区域上限0.96，并泛化到多说话人音频和视频。在PerceptMem基准（12个域、1,080个任务）上，感知身份受容量限制，准确事实受绑定限制。

Conclusion: 感知身份应存储在参数化记忆库中，事实应存储在文本库中，两种记忆可以清晰组合：拥有两者的代理不仅能记住用户说了什么，还能记住用户是什么样的人。

Abstract: A personalized agent needs a user memory: a persistent model of who its user is. Today it is almost always text -- transcripts and captions retrieved by similarity. This serves the captionable half of a person ("my cat is named Bibi"), but discards the perceptual half no caption can hold: how a voice sounds, how a face reads across age and lighting, how tired someone sounds. We measure this loss across five modalities: a strong caption-based re-identifier recovers as little as 0.11 of a dedicated encoder's recall, collapsing toward chance on non-nameable signals.
  We instead ground perceptual memory in the model, decomposing recall into two subproblems: a vision-language model grounds the referent in context (what and where), and a dedicated encoder extracts an identity key (who), stored as one inline token read by attention at generation with no external round-trip. Neither suffices alone -- the VLM identifies cross-age faces at only 0.54 recall where a face encoder reaches 0.81, and an ungrounded encoder recognizes a two-person-scene referent at 0.05 -- yet together they reach correct-region oracle (0.96), generalizing to multi-speaker audio and video. The recognition core is training-free: it reproduces the encoder's recall on any frozen model at O(1) registration cost. On PerceptMem (12 domains, 1,080 tasks) perceptual identity is capacity-limited while exact facts are binding-limited: identity belongs in a parametric bank, facts in a text store. The two memories compose cleanly: an agent with both can remember not only what its user said, but also what they are like.

</details>


### [263] [Gurukul AI: An Interactive AI-Driven Educational Platform for Indian Education System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28611)
*Isha Narang,Sneh Gosai,Mayank Singh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了GurukulAI，一个基于NCERT教材（9-12年级）构建的印度课程对齐QA数据集（18,720对问答对，涵盖5个学科），并在此基础上微调LLaMA 3.1 8B模型，部署在RAG框架中，支持英语和印地语交互，为印度学生提供聊天答疑、练习题和情境化回答的开放平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM（如ChatGPT、LLaMA）主要基于西方中心化数据训练，不适合印度等地区的区域性课程体系。印度教育系统语言多样、以考试为导向、围绕标准化教学大纲组织，现有的数据集和工具未覆盖这些需求。

Method: 1) 基于NCERT教材（9-12年级）构建课程对齐的QA数据集（18,720对，5个学科）；2) 使用该数据集微调LLaMA 3.1 8B模型；3) 将模型部署在面向教育场景设计的检索增强生成（RAG）框架中；4) 构建GurukulAI开放访问平台，支持英语印地语双语交互。

Result: 成功构建了18,720个QA对的课程对齐数据集并公开于HuggingFace，微调后的模型部署于RAG框架中，实现了面向印度学生的GurukulAI开放平台，支持答疑、练习题练习、情境化回答及双语交互。

Conclusion: 通过将AI本地化适配印度课堂，该工作弥合了全球LLM能力与区域教育需求之间的鸿沟，展示了将LLM定制化到特定地区教育体系的可行性与价值。

Abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) like ChatGPT and LLaMA have transformed AI-driven education, but these systems are predominantly trained on Western-centric data, making them ill-suited for regional curricula like India's. The Indian education system is linguistically diverse, exam-oriented, and structured around standardized syllabi, not addressed by existing datasets or tools. In this work, we curate a syllabus-aligned QA dataset based on NCERT (National Council of Educational Research and Training) textbooks for classes 9-12, capturing the content, context, and teaching style of Indian curricula. The final dataset, comprising 18,720 question-answer pairs across five subjects, is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/LingoIITGN/Gurukul. We fine-tune the LLaMA 3.1 8B model using this dataset and deploy it in a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework tailored to educational needs. We introduce GurukulAI, an open-access platform that enables Indian students to chat with the model, get doubts cleared, practice exam-style questions, receive contextual answers, and interact in both English and Hindi. By localizing AI for Indian classrooms, our work bridges the gap between global LLM capabilities and regional educational demands. The code is available at https://github.com/lingo-iitgn/GurukulAI.

</details>


### [264] [STAGEET: Stage-wise Typed Edit Tagging for Grammatical Error Correction with Arabic as a Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28614)
*Wenjie Lou,Alaa Mamdouh Akef*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出STAGEET，一种分阶段的类型化编辑标注框架，将序列到编辑（Seq2Edit）的语法纠错任务分解为有序的中粒度类型化阶段，每个阶段使用独立标签空间预测并重写中间句子，在保持竞争力的同时提供更可检查的纠错轨迹，并在QALB-2014上达到最先进效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Seq2Edit方法通过预测编辑标签实现高效和局部可解释性，但这种可解释性主要停留在操作层面（标签只说明字符串如何改变），无法揭示纠错的类型。单一编辑词汇表难以区分不同类别的纠正。

Method: 将纠错分解为有序的中粒度类型化阶段序列；每个阶段拥有自己的标签空间，对当前假设重写一次，并将中间结果传给下一阶段。实现两种变体：端到端共享编码器多头模型（带阶段特定适配器）和完全特化的独立标签器模型。

Result: 在QALB-2014和ZAEBUC上，类别感知的分阶段纠错保持了具有竞争力的编辑式GEC性能，同时暴露了更可检查的纠错轨迹；在QALB-2014上取得最先进结果。

Conclusion: STAGEET证明了将类型化阶段引入Seq2Edit框架的可行性，在不大幅损失性能的前提下增强了纠错过程的可解释性和可检查性，实现了性能与可解释性的良好平衡。

Abstract: Sequence-to-edit approaches make grammatical error correction (GEC) efficient and locally interpretable by predicting edit labels over the input rather than generating a full corrected sentence. Their interpretability, however, is primarily operational: a label specifies how the string should change, but a single edit vocabulary does not always reveal the type of correction being made. We propose STAGEET, a stage-wise typed edit-tagging framework that reorganizes Seq2Edit supervision into typed executable stages and extends edit operations to correction categories. STAGEET decomposes correction into an ordered sequence of medium-grained typed stages; each stage predicts from its own label space, rewrites the current hypothesis once, and passes the resulting intermediate sentence to the next stage. We instantiate the framework as both an end-to-end shared-encoder multi-head model with stage-specific adapters and a fully specialized variant with one independent tagger per stage. Experiments on QALB-2014 and ZAEBUC show that category-aware staged correction retains competitive edit-based GEC performance while exposing a more inspectable correction trajectory, and attains state-of-the-art results on QALB-2014.

</details>


### [265] [From GenAI Virtual Patient Dialogue Logs to Teacher-Interpretable Process Evidence: A Learning Analytics Study in Higher Education](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28619)
*Xinyu Li,Zijian Li,Mengyu Xia,Luzhen Tang,Naping Chen,Changmin Lin,Danijela Gasevic,Dragan Gasevic,Yizhou Fan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究分析了1030个由生成式AI虚拟病人产生的问诊对话，通过行为频率、Epistemic Network Analysis和Transition Network Analysis三层分析，发现高评分问诊不仅活动量更大，更重要的是信息收集与沟通、核查、组织、综合等行为的连接模式更紧密，摘要和组织行为更常引导出验证或机制导向的追问，为医学教育提供过程性反馈依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学病史采集是对话式的临床推理任务，AI虚拟病人虽能提供大量可扩展的对话训练，但完整对话记录对教师审阅过于冗长，而最终分数又掩盖了学习者是否跟进患者线索、核查不确定信息或使用摘要引导后续提问等过程性表现，因此需要一个能为教师提供可解释过程证据的分析方法。

Method: 研究收集210名二年级医学生五周胸痛案例的1030个AI虚拟病人对话，每个对话由教师基于完整病史采集对话进行评分，并按周中位数分为高低分组。随后对同一编码对话数据应用三层分析：行为频率分析（行为流行度）、Epistemic Network Analysis（局部共现分析）和Transition Network Analysis（序列转换分析）。

Result: 高评分对话涉及更多病史采集活动，但差异不仅体现在数量上。高评分对话更常将信息收集和症状探索与沟通、核查、组织和综合行为连接在一起；摘要和组织行为更常导致验证或机制导向的后续提问。

Conclusion: 对GenAI虚拟病人对话日志的分层分析能够揭示与高评分病史采集相关的过程模式，支持医学教育中以过程为导向的反馈。

Abstract: Medical history taking is a dialogue-based clinical reasoning task in which learners must gather, organise, and integrate patient information while the consultation unfolds. Generative AI-powered virtual patients (GenAI VPs) make repeated history taking practice scalable and preserve full turn by turn dialogue. However, these logs are educationally difficult to use directly. Complete transcripts are too detailed for routine teacher review, whereas final scores obscure whether learners followed up patient cues, checked uncertainty, or used summaries to guide later questioning. This study examined whether coded GenAI VP dialogues can provide teacher-interpretable process evidence of clinical reasoning. We analysed 1{,}030 GenAI VP dialogues from 210 second-year medical learners across five weeks chest-pain cases. Each consultation was teacher-scored using a rubric assessing the full history taking dialogue, and consultations were classified within each week as high- or low-rated using the weekly median score. To explain how rated performance was reflected in the dialogue process, we applied three analytic layers to the same coded dialogue data: behavioural prevalence, local co-occurrence using Epistemic Network Analysis, and sequential transition using Transition Network Analysis. High-rated consultations involved more history taking activity, but differences were not simply about volume. High rated consultations more often connected information gathering and symptom exploration with communication, checking, organisation, and synthesis. Summarising and organising moves more often led to verification or mechanism-oriented follow-up. These findings show how layered analysis of GenAI VP dialogue logs can reveal process patterns associated with high rated history taking and support process-focused feedback in medical education.

</details>


### [266] [Looking Again: Measuring Sycophancy in the Reasoning Chains of Multimodal Models Under Pressure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28623)
*Mahir Numayeer Islam,Gakuto Okuyama,Nikolaus Siauw,Shivank Garg,Madhur Panwar,Vasu Sharma*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文首次提出用于评估大型多模态推理模型（LMRMs）谄媚行为（sycophancy）的基准和数据集。该基准将四个视觉接地数据集（数学、临床、时间、人口推理）与五种压力条件配对，在单轮和多轮设置中评估最终答案及推理链中的谄媚现象。研究发现谄媚在压力下普遍存在，且推理链层面的谄媚可独立于最终答案发生，因此仅评估答案层面是不够的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型已被观察到在生成显式思维链后表现出谄媚倾向（即倾向于同意用户而非遵循证据），但对于多模态推理模型（LMRMs），目前尚缺乏可靠的方法来量化这种谄媚行为。作者旨在填补这一评估空白。

Method: 构建了一个结合四个视觉接地数据集（数学、临床、时间、人口推理）与五种压力条件的基准，涵盖单轮和多轮设置。评估最终答案中的谄媚以及推理链内部的谄媚出现情况。此外引入了故障分类体系，区分推理链层面与答案层面的谄媚，并补充了句子级分类法以定位推理链中谄媚首次出现的漂移位置。

Result: 谄媚在压力条件下普遍存在：陈述压力（Statement pressure）引发最高谄媚率，信念压力（Conviction）最低（除Mistral-Small-4外）。在多轮压力下，临床视觉判断的推理层谄媚急剧加剧，受影响最严重的模型达到95.7%。谄媚可以独立于最终答案损害推理链，因此仅评估答案层面是不够的。

Conclusion: 谄媚行为可以在推理链层面独立于最终答案发生，使得答案层面的评估不足以全面衡量模型的谄媚倾向。需要同时评估推理链内部的一致性。

Abstract: Large multimodal reasoning models (LMRMs) are getting increasingly capable, primarily through generating explicit chain-of-thought reasoning before answering. In language models it has been observed that this performance often comes with sycophancy, the tendency of a model to agree with the user over the evidence. However, for LMRMs no reliable method to measure sycophancy yet exists. We bridge this gap by introducing a benchmark and dataset for evaluating LMRM sycophancy when confronted with a wrong answer from a user. Our benchmark pairs four visually grounded datasets spanning mathematical, clinical, temporal, and demographic reasoning with five pressure conditions in single-turn and multi-turn settings. We evaluate sycophancy in the final answer as well as its emergence within the reasoning chain. We find that sycophancy is prevalent under pressure, with Statement pressure eliciting the highest rates and Conviction the lowest for all models except Mistral-Small-4, and under multi-turn pressure reasoning-level sycophancy intensifies sharply in clinical visual judgement, reaching 95.7% for the most affected model. We further introduce a failure taxonomy separating reasoning-chain from answer-level sycophancy, and a complementary sentence-level taxonomy locating where in the chain drift first emerges. Our results show that sycophancy can corrupt the reasoning chain independently of the final answer, so answer-level evaluation alone is insufficient.

</details>


### [267] [MA-RAG: Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Query-Driven Summarization of Longitudinal Parkinson's Disease Assessments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28624)
*Sana Alamgeera,Denise Goberta,Muhammad Irshad,Anne H. H. Ngu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出MA-RAG，一个查询驱动的多智能体检索增强生成框架，用于帕金森病结构化纵向临床评估数据的准确摘要生成。通过领域专门的智能体分解临床推理、结合结构化事实提取和最终验证阶段，在事实精确度上相对提升122%（0.436到0.990），幻觉率降低98%（0.564到0.010），并获得了临床专家的高度评价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 帕金森病的单次就诊和纵向临床评估数据解读耗时且依赖专家经验。虽然LLM能生成自然语言摘要，但缺乏领域特定的临床依据，难以对结构化纵向评估数据产生事实正确且时间一致的响应。

Method: 提出MA-RAG框架：1) 查询驱动的多智能体检索增强生成架构，将临床推理分解为领域专门的智能体；2) 结合结构化事实提取；3) 通过最终验证阶段合成临床依据充分的摘要。支持四类临床分析任务：单次会话、轨迹、比较和队列摘要。

Result: 使用事实精确度、幻觉率、时间保真度和语义相似度等客观指标及临床专家主观评价进行评估。相比传统、仅RAG和单智能体RAG基线，MA-RAG在事实精确度上相对提升122%（0.436→0.990），幻觉率降低98%（0.564→0.010），并在组织性和临床实用性方面获得临床专家最高评分。

Conclusion: 领域专门化的多智能体推理能够实现对结构化纵向临床评估数据的可靠查询驱动摘要生成，显著提升了事实正确性和临床实用性。

Abstract: Accurate interpretation of single-visit and longitudinal clinical assessments for Parkinson's disease is time-consuming and often depends on specialist expertise. Although large language models (LLMs) can generate natural language summaries, they frequently lack domain-specific clinical grounding and struggle to produce factually correct and temporally consistent responses for structured longitudinal assessment data. To address these limitations, we propose MA-RAG, a query-driven multi-agent retrieval-augmented generation framework that decomposes clinical reasoning into domain-specialized agents, combines structured fact extraction, and synthesizes clinically grounded summaries through a final verification stage. The framework supports four clinical analysis tasks: single-session, trajectory, comparison, and cohort summarization. We evaluate MA-RAG using objective metrics, namely Fact Precision, Hallucination Rate, Temporal Fidelity, and Semantic Similarity, together with subjective evaluations conducted by clinical experts. Compared to Traditional, RAG-only, and Single-agent RAG baselines, MA-RAG substantially improves factual correctness, achieving up to a 122% relative increase in Fact Precision (from 0.436 to 0.990) and reducing the Hallucination Rate by up to 98% (from 0.564 to 0.010), while consistently receiving top ratings from clinical experts for organization and clinical usefulness. These results demonstrate that domain-specialized multi-agent reasoning enables reliable query-driven summarization of structured longitudinal clinical assessment data.

</details>


### [268] [Asymmetric Within-Document Predictive Learning for Scientific Document Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28625)
*You Zuo,Éric de la Clergerie,Benoît Sagot*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SciJEPA，一种免引用的科学文档表示框架，利用论文的话语结构进行非对称文档内预测预训练。预测式训练效果不如对照的对比式基线，但引入切片各向同性高斯正则化（SIGReg）后性能显著提升并缩小了这一差距，表明文档内预测学习在精细控制嵌入几何的前提下是有前景的免引用方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有科学文档表示学习方法通常依赖引文关系，但引用信息并不总是可用或充足。作者希望探索免引用的学习范式，利用论文自身的语篇结构（标题、摘要、方法、结论）作为监督信号来进行预训练。

Method: 提出SciJEPA框架，采用非对称文档内预测：用标题和摘要表示预测方法表示，再用方法表示预测结论表示。同时引入Sliced Isotropic Gaussian Regularization（SIGReg）来约束嵌入几何，并比较了预测式训练与使用相同节对的对比式基线。

Result: 在RELISH、高影响力引文预测、SciDocs和引文预测等任务上，纯预测式训练可行但弱于受控的对比基线；加入SIGReg后性能显著提升，缩小了差距。正则化效果依任务而异：适度的SIGReg有助于细粒度排序，过强的正则化可能削弱局部对齐。不同编码分支支持不同的检索模式。

Conclusion: 文档内预测学习是一种有前景的免引用科学文档表示补充方案，但需要仔细控制嵌入几何（如通过SIGReg正则化）才能充分发挥其潜力。

Abstract: We study predictive pretraining for scientific document representation using the discourse structure of papers. We propose SciJEPA, a citation-free framework that learns through asymmetric within-document prediction: title and abstract representations are used to predict method representations, and method representations are used to predict conclusion representations. Experiments on RELISH, high-influence citation, SciDocs, and cite prediction show that plain predictive training is viable but weaker than a controlled contrastive baseline using the same section pairs. Adding Sliced Isotropic Gaussian Regularization (SIGReg) substantially improves performance and narrows this gap. The effect of regularization is task-dependent: moderate SIGReg helps fine-grained ranking, while stronger regularization can weaken local alignment. We further show that different encoding branches support different retrieval regimes. These results position within-document predictive learning as a promising citation-free complement for scientific document representation, provided that embedding geometry is carefully controlled.

</details>


### [269] [Do large language models scrutinise what they review? A multimodal audit of scoring calibration, error detection, and author-identity effects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28626)
*Emad Alharbi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究评估了两个多模态大语言模型（Qwen2.5-VL-72B和Pixtral-Large-124B）作为论文审稿人的能力，在2026年ICLR的165篇投稿上进行测试。结果显示LLM评分（7.0-8.1）远高于人类评分（3.4-6.8），错误检测率低（自然提示12.1%，验证提示22.2%），78%的错误未被发现，且图表反而降低错误检测率。作者身份不影响评分，但LLM会虚构不存在的图表内容。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM越来越多地被用于生成同行评审意见，有必要系统评估其批判性评价能力。本研究旨在检验LLM作为审稿人的实际表现，特别是在错误检测、评分偏差和图表理解方面的能力。

Method: 选取165篇投稿，使用两个多模态LLM（Qwen2.5-VL-72B和Pixtral-Large-124B）作为审稿人。控制变量包括：作者身份（盲审/高声誉机构/低声誉机构）、输入格式（纯文本/文本加图表）。在55篇稿件中插入145个可验证的错误，分别使用自然提示和验证导向提示评估错误检测能力。

Result: LLM评分范围7.0-8.1，远高于人类评分3.4-6.8；错误检测率在自然提示下仅12.1%，验证指令下提升至22.2%，仍有78%错误未检出；提供图表降低错误检测但提高评分；没有视觉错误能被可靠验证；半数纯文本审稿描述了未提供的图表；作者身份不影响评分。

Conclusion: 当前多模态LLM尚不具备可靠的批判性同行评审能力，存在系统性评分偏高、错误检测能力不足、幻觉图表描述等问题。LLM审稿结果不可直接用于编辑决策。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate peer reviews, prompting examination of their capacity for critical evaluation. This study evaluates two multimodal LLMs, Qwen2.5-VL-72B and Pixtral-Large-124B, as reviewers across 165 submissions to the 2026 International Conference on Learning Representations, a venue that postdates both models' training cutoffs. Manuscripts were presented to both models with author identities blinded, replaced with high-prestige affiliations, or replaced with low-prestige affiliations, and in either text-only or text-with-figure format. Additionally, 145 verifiably detectable errors were inserted into 55 manuscripts to assess error identification under natural and verification-oriented prompts. Across all manuscript groups, including rejected submissions, LLM scores ranged from 7.0 to 8.1, whereas human mean scores ranged from 3.4 to 6.8. The models detected 12.1\% of the verified errors under natural prompting, and a one-sentence verification instruction increased detection to 22.2\%; however, 78\% of the errors remained undetected. Providing figures reduced error detection while increasing review scores. No visual error was reliably verified against its corresponding figure, and half of the text-only reviews described figures that were not provided. Author identity did not influence either review scores or error detection. LLM editorial decisions exactly matched those produced by simple score averaging.

</details>


### [270] [Intelligent Identification and Repair of Design Defects in BIM via Domain-Specific Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28629)
*Jia-Rui Lin,Yun-Hong Cai,Xiang-Rui Ni,Peng Pan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究提出一个集成框架，通过领域特定大语言模型（LLMs）高效识别和修复BIM中的各类设计缺陷。框架包括BIM-to-Text转换（组件平衡分块）、提示学习（规则注入、少样本、RAG）以及幻觉控制策略。实验显示缺陷识别准确率达85%（优于传统规则检查的70%），修复建议合理率达94%，幻觉控制使准确率从64%提升至85%，单轮干预消除了92.5%的幻觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法缺乏一种通用的方法来高效识别和解决BIM中多样化的设计缺陷，需要一种更全面、可扩展的解决方案。

Method: 1) 提出BIM-to-Text方法，采用组件平衡分块技术桥接BIM数据与LLM；2) 提出结合规则注入、少样本提示和RAG的提示学习方法用于缺陷识别和修复建议生成；3) 引入结合关键标识验证和token长度阈值的幻觉控制策略确保可靠性。

Result: 缺陷识别准确率达85%（传统规则检查为70%），修复建议合理率达94%；幻觉控制将准确率从64%提升至85%，单轮干预消除92.5%的幻觉。

Conclusion: 该研究建立了从原始BIM数据输入、缺陷识别到修复建议生成的端到端原型，为BIM设计缺陷管理提供了一种通用且可靠的LLM驱动方案。

Abstract: Existing methods lack a generalized approach to efficiently identify and resolve the diversity of design defects in BIM. Therefore, this study proposes an integrated framework to identify and repair various defects in BIM via domain-specific LLMs. Firstly, a BIM-to-Text method with component-balanced chunking is introduced to bridge BIM data with LLMs. Then, prompt learning with rule injection, few-shot prompting and RAG is proposed to identify defects and generate repair suggestions. Meanwhile, a hallucination control strategy combining key identifier validation and token-length thresholds is introduced to ensure reliability. Experiments show capability expansion yields 85% identification accuracy versus 70% for traditional rule checking, achieving a 94% rate of reasonable repair suggestions. Moreover, the proposed hallucination control further increased accuracy from 64% to 85%, eliminating 92.5% of hallucinations in a single intervention round. This study establishes an end-to-end prototype from raw BIM data input, through defect identification, to repair suggestion generation.

</details>


### [271] [Enabling Proactive Spoken Turns via a Generalized Style-Aware Full-Duplex Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28630)
*Tianrui Pan,Qinglin Zhang,Chong Deng,Luyao Cheng,Qian Chen,Wen Wang,Jie Tang,Gangshan Wu,Jie Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出LPS-TC，一个轻量级主动语音轮次控制器，可将半双工对话系统升级为全双工能力；同时构建了约2981小时的WildTurn真实世界数据集，并引入双层评估方案，在时序精度和交互质量上均优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全双工对话系统要求智能体实时主动行动（如打断和反馈），但现有系统难以同时优化说话时机和回复质量。作者指出当前方法缺乏现实场景下的主动轮次控制能力，亟需一个通用且风格可控的框架来解决这一关键挑战。

Method: 提出三部分组成的风格感知全双工框架：(1) LPS-TC轻量级主动轮次控制器，具有细粒度动作空间，支持即插即用式集成；(2) WildTurn大规模真实英语数据集，含2981小时立体声对话，标注五种轮次和五种反馈风格；(3) 双层评估方案，分别评估块级时序精度和轮次级交互质量。

Result: 将LPS-TC集成到半双工模型Qwen2.5-Omni和全双工模型Freeze-Omni中，在时序恰当性和回复质量上均表现优越；框架展现出细粒度风格可控性和强泛化能力。

Conclusion: 该框架能赋予半双工模型全双工能力并增强现有全双工模型，实现更自然、更类人的口语交互，填补了现有静态基准无法捕捉丰富口语动态的空白。

Abstract: Compared with half-duplex dialogue systems where the system waits for user turn completion before it responds, natural full-duplex dialogue systems require agents to act proactively in real time, including timely interruptions and backchannels. This creates a key challenge: improving turn timing without sacrificing response quality. To address limitations in realistic proactive turn-taking, we build a generalized style-aware full-duplex framework with three key components. Firstly, we propose LPS-TC, a Lightweight Proactive Speech Turn Controller for plug-and-play integration. It features a fine-grained action space covering both reactive and proactive turn behaviors, enabling half-duplex models with full-duplex capabilities and enhancing existing full-duplex models with superior timing control. Secondly, we construct WildTurn, a large-scale, real-world English dataset containing approximately 2,981 hours of filtered multi-turn stereo conversations from face-to-face and telephone conversations, annotated with five turn-taking and five backchanneling styles. Trained on WildTurn, LPS-TC exhibits rich spoken dynamics that are not captured by existing static full-duplex benchmarks. Thirdly, we introduce a two-tier evaluation scheme that assesses both chunk-level timing precision and turn-level interaction quality under realistic streaming constraints. Our experiments, integrating LPS-TC with half-duplex models like Qwen2.5-Omni and full-duplex models like Freeze-Omni, showcase its superior performance in timing appropriateness and response quality. Our framework also demonstrates fine-grained style controllability and strong generalizability, enabling more natural and human-like spoken interactions.

</details>


### [272] [PAUSE: Editable Strategy Artifacts for Long-Form Cultural Story Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28633)
*Taaha Kazi,Vasu Sharma,Mohammad Saifullah,Abdur Rahman*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出PAUSE（Pause-And-Update Strategy Editing）干预方法，在长篇小说文化改编中，将隐藏的文化决策暴露为可编辑、可检查的适配策略，作为人类操控文化决策的控制面。在两部中文源小说中，人类对策略的编辑能有效传播到章节级文本（9/9读者选择、8/9标记审计通过、禁用标记全部规避），但作者强调这是冒烟级（smoke-scale）的编辑遵从性研究，而非声称文化权威性或文学质量提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI日益介入文化改编，但其文化决策往往隐藏在提示词、临时模型计划或最终文本中，不可见、不可审查、不可干预。这导致人类难以在文化决策传播到长文本之前对其进行监督或修正。

Method: 提出PAUSE干预框架：将适配策略设计为结构化工件，可作为人类控制面进行检查与编辑，并通过下层角色、实体、章节定位各阶段将编辑后的策略投射到章节级文本。在两部中文源序列化小说上进行编辑vs对照实验。

Result: 在9组编辑vs对照章节比较中，评审全部9组选择编辑后策略输出；标记审计显示目标标记出现在8/9编辑输出（0/9对照），禁用标记在编辑输出中缺失、在所有对照中出现。

Conclusion: PAUSE提供了一种实用方式，使AI中介的文化改编在决策通过长文本生成传播之前，变得更具可检查性和可争议性。但结果仅为冒烟级编辑遵从性证明，不宣称文化权威性或文学质量改善。

Abstract: Generative AI systems increasingly mediate cultural adaptation, but their cultural decisions are often hidden inside prompts, transient model plans, or final prose. We study PAUSE (Pause-And-Update Strategy Editing), an intervention that exposes an editable adaptation strategy as a human control surface for cultural decisions in long-form story adaptation. The strategy is a structured artifact that can be inspected, edited, and then projected through downstream character, entity, and chapter-localization stages. In two Chinese-source serialized novels, we test whether human edits to this strategy propagate into chapter-level prose. Across 9 edited-vs-control chapter comparisons, judges select the edited-strategy output in all 9; a marker audit shows target markers in 8/9 edited outputs and 0/9 controls, with forbidden markers absent from edited outputs and present in all controls. We frame these results as a smoke-scale edit-adherence study, not a claim that the outputs are culturally authoritative or literary-quality improvements. PAUSE offers one practical way to make AI-mediated cultural adaptation more inspectable and contestable before decisions propagate through long-form generation.

</details>


### [273] [Do MLLMs Really Understand Low-Resource Khmer Documents? A Pilot Study on Khmer Document VQA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28635)
*Nimol Thuon,Panhapin Theang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文对开放多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在高棉语（Khmer）表单文档理解任务上进行了试点诊断评估。研究构建了基于KH-FUNSD数据集的评估子集，涵盖发票、收据、报价单等商业表单，包含英语和高棉语问题。结果显示，直接使用Qwen3-VL-8B达到51.9%的准确率，外部OCR辅助配置（Tesseract 61.9%、PaddleOCR 61.6%）效果最佳，但高棉语脚本回答的准确性仍显著低于英语和数字字段，说明可靠的原生高棉语文档理解仍是开放挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在文档理解方面取得显著进展，但在低资源、非拉丁语场景下的可靠性尚不明确。高棉语表单文档因其复杂脚本形式、高棉语-英语混合字段以及双货币（柬埔寨瑞尔和美元）数值而具有独特挑战，同时高棉语文档VQA的可用资源有限，亟需系统评估现有模型的能力和失败模式。

Method: 从KH-FUNSD数据集中构建评估子集，包含高棉语和英语问题的商业表单文档。采用三种配置进行评估：（1）对代表性开放Qwen-VL模型进行直接基于图像的提示评估；（2）解析器辅助配置；（3）外部OCR辅助配置（Tesseract和PaddleOCR），并将Qwen3-VL-8B作为主要评估对象。

Result: 直接使用Qwen3-VL-8B超越更小模型，总体准确率达51.9%，但高棉语脚本和混合脚本回答的性能仍有限。外部OCR辅助配置效果最佳：Tesseract达61.9%，PaddleOCR达61.6%。高棉语脚本回答的难度显著高于英语和数字字段。

Conclusion: 当前MLLMs能够处理视觉清晰的英语内容和结构化数字信息，但可靠的原生高棉语文档理解仍是悬而未决的挑战。该研究作为试点性诊断评估，为未来构建完整的高棉语文档理解基准和改进模型性能指明了方向。

Abstract: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced document understanding, visual question answering, and text extraction. However, their reliability in low-resource, non-Latin settings remains uncertain. Khmer form documents present particular challenges because they contain complex script forms, mixed Khmer-English fields, and monetary values in both Cambodian Riel and US Dollars. Available resources for Khmer Document VQA are also limited. This paper presents a pilot diagnostic evaluation of open MLLMs on Khmer document images. We construct an evaluation subset from the previously introduced KH-FUNSD collection, covering invoices, receipts, quotations, and other business forms. The subset includes questions in English and Khmer, with answers retained in their original English, Khmer, mixed-script, or numeric forms. Rather than introducing a full public benchmark, this study examines the capabilities and failure modes of existing models. We evaluate representative open Qwen-VL models using direct image-based prompting and compare parser-assisted and external OCR-assisted configurations with Qwen3-VL-8B. Direct Qwen3-VL-8B outperforms smaller models, achieving 51.9% overall accuracy, although performance remains limited for Khmer-script and mixed-script answers. External OCR produces the strongest results, reaching 61.9% with Tesseract and 61.6% with PaddleOCR. Nevertheless, Khmer-script answers remain substantially more difficult than English and numeric fields. The results indicate that current MLLMs can process visually clear English and structured numeric content, but reliable native Khmer document understanding remains an open challenge.

</details>


### [274] [Learning to Evaluate Before Improving: Automatic Rubric Induction for Automatic Research Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31076)
*Xuehai Wang,Haowei Qin,Tongxin Liu,Junkai Li,Buqiang Xu,Jintian Zhang,Yijun Chen,Zirui Xue,Shumin Deng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: AutoSciRub是一个"评估优先"框架，用于自动化学术研究代理。它通过在研究执行前诱导出任务特定的可执行评分标准(rubric)来指导整个过程，包括执行、标准级验证和迭代修订。该框架在ResearchClawBench和AstaBench基准上均显著提升了多个后端LLM和代理框架的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放式的科研任务通常缺乏对分析方法、实验步骤和成功标准的明确说明，导致自主科研代理可能遗漏关键分析、使用不恰当的方法或得出证据不足的结论。

Method: AutoSciRub采用评估优先框架：1) 将模糊指令分解为原子科学目标；2) 在相关文献和任务可见数据中寻找依据；3) 综合生成具体、可操作、可验证的评分标准。该rubric在实验前期就显式化隐性的实验和证据要求，在修订阶段通过rubric引导的验证识别未达标标准并针对性地完善研究报告及其支持产物。

Result: 在ResearchClawBench上，AutoSciRub平均提升2.08分（固定Codex框架、三个骨干LLM）和2.95分（固定DeepSeek-V4-Flash骨干、三个代理框架）。在AstaBench E2E Discovery的随机20任务子集上，平均提升16.8分，同时保持或增加成功完成的任务数量。

Conclusion: 评估优先的引导为自主科学研究提供了一种有效且可泛化的控制机制，能够在不损失任务完成数量的前提下显著提升研究质量。

Abstract: Autonomous scientific research agents are increasingly applied to end-to-end scientific workflows, including literature review, data analysis, experimentation, and report generation. However, open-ended research tasks often do not clearly specify the analyses, methods, and success criteria required to complete the task. As a result, agents may miss important analyses, use inappropriate methods, or draw conclusions that are insufficiently supported by evidence. To address the problem, we present AutoSciRub, an evaluation-first framework that induces a task-specific executable rubric before research execution, and uses it to guide execution, criterion-level verification as well as iterative revision. AutoSciRub decomposes an underspecified instruction into atomic scientific goals, grounds them in relevant literature and task-visible data, and synthesizes specific, actionable, and verifiable criteria. The resulting rubric makes implicit experimental and evidential requirements explicit, providing guidance for experiments and analyses. During revision, rubric-guided verification identifies unmet criteria and enables targeted refinement of the research report and its supporting artifacts. On ResearchClawBench, AutoSciRub consistently improves all tested configurations, with an average gain of 2.08 points across three backbone LLMs under the fixed Codex harness and 2.95 points across three agent harnesses using a fixed DeepSeek-V4-Flash backbone. On a randomly sampled 20-task subset of AstaBench E2E Discovery, AutoSciRub further achieves an average improvement of 16.8 points across three agent harnesses, while maintaining or increasing the number of successfully completed tasks. These results demonstrate that evaluation-first guidance provides an effective and generalizable control mechanism for autonomous scientific research (Code: https://github.com/zjunlp/AutoSciRub).

</details>


### [275] [PromptKWS: A Novel Prompt-Guided Open-Vocabulary Keyword Spotting Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28640)
*Gaopeng Xu,Chengfei Li,Xianliang Wang,Lin Zhu,Juan Wei,Wenpeng Li,Jianwei Niu,Jie Gao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出PromptKWS，一个基于提示词引导的开放词汇关键词唤醒（KWS）框架，通过Prompt Phrase Prediction Network（PPN）提取关键词提示嵌入，并利用提示-声学多头交叉注意力机制将提示嵌入注入到KWS编码器中，在唤醒率和复杂环境适应性上均有显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放词汇KWS系统在复杂真实环境（噪声、发音变化）中的准确性不足，纯声学模型难以有效利用关键词提示信息来适应这些场景。

Method: 提出PromptKWS框架：(1) 设计PPN编解码器架构提取关键词提示嵌入；(2) 利用PPN编码器编码关键词提示；(3) 通过Prompt-acoustic多头交叉注意力（MHCA）将提示嵌入注入KWS编码器。

Result: 相比基线系统，唤醒率提升超过10%；相比纯声学模型，在复杂环境测试集上平均准确率提升超过15%。

Conclusion: PromptKWS证明了提示词引导机制能有效提升开放词汇KWS系统的性能，尤其在噪声和发音变化等复杂真实环境中表现出色。

Abstract: In this paper, we present PromptKWS, a novel Prompt-guided keyword spotting (KWS) framework to improve the accuracy of open vocabulary KWS systems. In specific terms, we introduce the Prompt Phrases Prediction Network (PPN), an encoder-decoder architecture designed to effectively extract keyword prompts embeddings. we employ the PPN encoder to encode the keyword prompts and infuse the prompt embedding into the Prompt-guided KWS encoder by utilizing a Prompt-acoustic Multi-head Cross-attention (MHCA). Experiments show that PromptKWS improves the wakeup rate by over 10% compared to baseline system. Notably, another strength of PromptKWS is its ability to effectively leverage keyword prompts for adapting to complex real-world environments involving noise and pronunciation variations. In comparison to purely acoustic models, which often struggle in such situations, PromptKWS demonstrates remarkable performance, with an average accuracy improvement of over 15% in test sets.

</details>


### [276] [Terminal-Bench-LILT: Multilingual Agentic Coding Benchmark Grounded in Language, Region, and Culture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28641)
*Yunsu Kim,Kaden Uhlig,Ashwin Purohit,Milind Agarwal,Patrick Simianer,Anil Arslan,Kiarash Mokhtari,Thomas Zenkel,Johannes Mosig,Gabriel Bretschner,Shamik Bose,Joern Wuebker,John DeNero*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了Terminal-Bench-LILT基准，包含300个覆盖10种非英语语言的真实编码任务，聚焦国际化、编码、文本规范化和文化约定等无直接英文对应的编程问题，评估发现最强模型仅63.1%通过率，且多语言编码能力与通用基准排名不相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有编码智能体评估几乎全部基于英文，无法反映现实世界中多语言部署的需求，多语言编码能力作为一个独立的能力维度尚未被充分探索和评估。

Method: 构建了覆盖阿拉伯语、捷克语、德语、西班牙语、印地语、日语、韩语、塞尔维亚语、土耳其语和中文共10种语言的300个真实编码任务，任务由母语程序员编写，并经过多阶段质量控制流程验证。每个任务针对非英语软件开发特有的问题（如国际化、编码、文本规范化和文化惯例），且无直接英文对应物。

Result: 对六个前沿模型的评估显示，最强模型通过率仅为63.1%，许多任务没有任何模型能解决。性能因语言不同而差异显著，且与通用编码基准排名不一致。

Conclusion: 多语言编码能力是与通用编码能力不同的独立能力轴，目前尚未被充分探索。Terminal-Bench-LILT为评估和推动模型的多语言软件开发能力提供了新基准。

Abstract: Most evaluations for coding agents are conducted exclusively in English, which does not reflect real-world multilingual deployment. We present Terminal-Bench-LILT, a suite of 300 authentic coding tasks in ten languages: Arabic, Czech, German, Spanish, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Serbian, Turkish, and Chinese. Each task targets issues specific to non-English software development that have no direct English equivalent, e.g., internationalization, encoding, text normalization, and cultural conventions. All tasks are authored by native-speaker programmers and validated through a multi-stage quality control pipeline. Evaluation of six frontier models reveals that even the strongest model reaches only 63.1\% pass rate, with many tasks unsolved by any model. Performance varies substantially by language and does not track general coding benchmark rankings, highlighting that multilingual coding competence is a distinct and underexplored capability axis. Sample tasks are available at https://github.com/lilt/terminal-bench-lilt

</details>


### [277] [Redesigning and Auditing Deep Research Writing for Faithful Reports](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28643)
*Hiroaki Hayashi,Pranav Narayanan Venkit,Prafulla Kumar Choubey,Chien-Sheng Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出CLAIMPROBE，一个基于声明（claim）级别的审计框架，用于细粒度评估深度研究（deep-research）系统生成报告中的事实性错误。研究发现强DR流水线即使在rubric评分稳定时也存在关键证据遗漏和错误归因问题。作者进一步提出CLAIMWRITER，一个层级化的基于声明的报告生成器，通过提取源事实、映射到查询大纲并基于源链接的声明表示起草各章节，显著降低幻觉率（2.6-4.5倍）并提高必要事实召回率（1.2-1.7倍），同时支持高效且成本更低的局部修订。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于rubric（评分标准）的评估方式会掩盖深度研究系统生成的报告中细粒度的事实性错误，无法准确反映系统在幻觉、错误归因、引用卫生和事实召回等方面的真实表现。

Method: 1) CLAIMPROBE：将DR报告分解为声明，对照检索证据测量幻觉、错误归因、引用卫生和必要事实召回。2) CLAIMWRITER：层级化声明式写作器，提取源事实，映射到查询派生的大纲，并从源链接的声明表示起草各章节。

Result: 在三个先前的DR框架中，仅将报告编写器替换为CLAIMWRITER即可将幻觉率降低2.6至4.5倍，必要事实召回率提高1.2至1.7倍，同时基本保持整体报告质量。CLAIMWRITER在源变更时能以最高比率传播变更的源事实到修订报告中，且更具成本效益。

Conclusion: 声明级别的审计（CLAIMPROBE）能够揭示rubric评估掩盖的细粒度事实缺陷；将报告编写器替换为声明级的CLAIMWRITER是提升DR系统事实可靠性、支持局部修订并降低成本的有效途径。

Abstract: Rubric-based evaluations of deep-research (DR) systems often obscure fine-grained factual failures in generated reports. We introduce CLAIMPROBE, a claim-level audit that decomposes DR reports into claims and measures hallucination, misattribution, citation hygiene, and necessary-fact recall against retrieved evidence. Using CLAIMPROBE, we find that strong DR pipelines can omit key evidence and misattribute claims even when their rubric scores remain stable. We then propose CLAIMWRITER, a hierarchical claim-based writer that extracts source facts, maps them to a query-derived outline, and drafts each section from a source-linked claim representation. Across three prior DR frameworks, replacing only the report writer with CLAIMWRITER reduces hallucination by 2.6 to 4.5 times and improves necessary-fact recall by 1.2 to 1.7 times, while largely preserving overall report quality. CLAIMWRITER also enables localized revision: when sources change, it propagates changed source facts into revised reports at the highest rate among update methods, while also being more cost-effective.

</details>


### [278] [Cross Lingual Transfer in Tulu Legal Comprehension: Script-Dependent Improvement and RAG-Induced Knowledge Conflict](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28645)
*Sindhu Shetty,Spurthi Setty,Natan Vidra*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文探讨了低资源语言（以印度达罗毗荼语系图卢语为例）在法律领域的跨语言理解能力，测试了三种模型在基于RAG框架下对法律投诉文本分类的表现。研究发现：音译查询能在有限程度上帮助模型理解，但与文字系统强相关（卡纳达语效果最佳）；RAG检索结果好坏参半，失败模式集中在事实替换和胡编乱造两类；推理失败的根源在于模型对信息的解析和推理过程，而非语料库内容本身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低资源语言缺乏足够的训练语料，通常借助相关的高资源语言作为理解支架，但缺乏严格的评估方法来识别模型在跨语言低资源环境中的失败。需要建立系统的评估框架来判断模型何时以及为何在低资源跨语言场景中失效。

Method: 以法律领域为背景，选择三种模型（Llama3、Hex-1、Sarvam），测试其对低资源达罗毗荼语（图卢语）法律投诉的分类能力。方法包括：跨达罗毗荼文字系统的音译查询、基于卡纳达语法律语料库的RAG检索框架、推理轨迹分析以及统计诚实性框架评估。

Result: 音译可让模型获得初步理解但效果高度依赖文字系统（卡纳达语产生最强的正面趋势）；RAG框架下结果参差不齐，部分条件下有弱正面趋势；失败集中在两个维度：事实替换（过度关注特定段落扭曲推理）和胡编乱造（与查询和语料无关的幻觉）；模型对信息的解析与推理是失败根源，而非语料内容。

Conclusion: 低资源多语言RAG评估中，文字系统依赖的理解能力和RAG鲁棒性之间存在关联。推理轨迹分析与统计诚实性框架提供了更广泛适用的低资源多语言RAG评估方法，指出模型推理能力（而非语料质量）是低资源环境下系统失败的关键瓶颈。

Abstract: Low-resource languages without an adequate training corpus often use a related, higher-resource language as a scaffold for comprehension. Still, there is a need to develop rigorous evaluation methods to identify when models fail in cross lingual low-resource environments. Using the legal domain as a backdrop, three models (Llama3, Hex-1, Sarvam) were tested on the ability to classify legal complaints written in a low resource Dravidian language (Tulu). Transliterating queries across Dravidian scripts allowed models to gain a preliminary understanding of speakers' complaints without the use of wide scale training, though the level of comprehension was heavily script dependent (with Kannada - another relatively low-resource language - producing the strongest positive trend). Retrieving from a corpus of Kannada legal papers across a RAG framework caused mixed results. Some models had a weak positive trend in comprehension under certain conditions, but when models failed, it was often across two axes: fact substitution (fixating on specific passage excerpts that skewed reasoning) and confabulation (hallucination that had no basis in either query or corpus). Within low resource domains, results identify the model's parsing of information and subsequent reasoning as the source of reasoning failure, rather than corpus contents. Script-dependent comprehension and RAG robustness also seem to travel together. This is further supported by the reasoning-trace analysis and a statistical-honesty framework deployed - techniques that are more broadly applicable to low-resource multilingual RAG evaluation.

</details>


### [279] [Can Large Language Models Identify Meaningful Touchpoints in Conversion Attribution?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28649)
*Jinqi Wu,Sishuo Chen,Zhangming Chan,Yong Bai,Chao Yi,Han Zhu,Shuodian Yu,Lei Zhang,Sheng Chen,Chenghuan Hou,Jian Xu,Chaoyou Fu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了转化归因中的触点选择问题，发现现有的基于协同过滤的启发式方法存在语义鸿沟，无法识别用户感知的隐含语义相关触点。作者系统评估了LLM在识别这些隐藏关联方面的能力，并通过LLM归因标签提升工业CVR模型训练效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前转化归因的触点选择方法依赖协同过滤启发式规则，与用户感知的语义意图不一致。通过人工标注发现大量隐含相关但语义相关的触点在现有规则下被遗漏，需要新的方法来弥合这一语义鸿沟。

Method: 首先通过人工标注揭示现有规则的语义鸿沟；然后系统评估LLM在识别隐含相关触点方面的能力，包括不同提示策略和基础模型选择对识别性能的影响；最后利用LLM归因的转化标签来增强工业CVR模型的训练。

Result: LLM能够有效揭示大量隐含相关的触点，但选择性能仍有较大提升空间。同时，利用LLM归因的转化标签在工业CVR模型训练中取得了显著的离线性能提升。

Conclusion: 研究为转化归因从机械规则匹配向人类对齐的语义推理过渡提供了新路线图，展示了LLM在转化归因中的潜力和改进方向。

Abstract: Touchpoint selection in conversion attribution, namely identifying meaningful touchpoints contributing to conversions, is essential for e-commerce recommendation and online advertising. Current selection methods rely heavily on collaborative-filtering-based heuristics, which fail to align with user-perceived semantic intent. Through human annotation, we reveal a significant semantic gap: many implicitly-related, semantically relevant touchpoints remain undetected by existing rules. Therefore, we systematically evaluate the capability of Large Language Models (LLMs) in identifying these hidden associations. Our evaluation shows that while LLMs effectively uncover a substantial portion of implicitly-related touchpoints, significant room for improvement remains in their selection performance. Furthermore, we analyze the impact of different prompting strategies and foundation model choices on identification performance, providing valuable insights into their reasoning patterns and effectiveness. These insights offer a new roadmap for transitioning conversion attribution from mechanical rule-matching to human-aligned semantic reasoning. Moreover, we leverage the LLM-attributed conversion labels for enhancing industrial CVR model training and achieve significant offline performance gains, showing the potential of LLMs in conversion attribution.

</details>


### [280] [Test-Time Scaling for Scientific Equation Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28660)
*Haowei Lin,Hubert Lim,Xiangyu Wang,Letian Huang,Di He*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究测试时计算分配（TTS）在开放式自动方程发现任务中的应用，将LLM驱动的方程发现统一为迭代搜索过程，发现搜索宽度是主导分配参数，合理选择宽度可提升计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前TTS研究主要聚焦数学、编程等封闭式任务，而开放式方程发现场景中，模型需搜索候选方程并依赖观测数据反馈。本文旨在探究TTS在开放场景下的计算分配策略，并隔离提示工程等启发式因素的干扰。

Method: 将LLM驱动的方程发现形式化为统一迭代搜索框架，涵盖Best-of-N、顺序精炼、树搜索和进化式方法；在固定预算下比较多种最小化并行控制器，并在LLM-SRBench任务上扫描不同分配参数（宽度、种群-分支比例等）。

Result: 搜索宽度是主导分配参数：最优宽度通常随计算预算增加而增大；种群-分支分配和控制器的选择影响较小；合适的宽度选择还可通过提升并行度改善墙钟时间效率。

Conclusion: 在具备有效验证器的情况下，控制探索与利用的平衡（即宽度选择）是扩展LLM方程发现能力的关键。

Abstract: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves language model reasoning by allocating additional test-time compute, but prior work mainly studies closed-ended tasks such as math and coding. We study TTS for automated equation discovery, an open-ended setting where models search over candidate equations and rely on observed datapoints for feedback. We formulate LLM-driven equation discovery as an iterative search process that unifies Best-of-N, sequential refinement, tree search, and evolution-style methods under a common compute-allocation view. To isolate allocation effects from prompt engineering and other heuristics, we compare minimal parallel controllers under fixed budgets. On LLM-SRBench equation-discovery tasks, we find that search width is the dominant allocation parameter: the best width in our sweep generally increases with the compute budget, while the population--branching split and controller choice matter less. Appropriate width selection also improves wall-clock efficiency by increasing parallelism. These results suggest that, given an informative verifier, controlling exploration and exploitation is central to scaling LLM-based equation discovery.

</details>


### [281] [GreenBench: Benchmarking Energy Efficiency and Carbon Footprint of Open-Source LLM Inference on Apple Silicon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28667)
*Rajeswari Kannan,Raj Firke,Shreya Bengle,Srushti Deshmukh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了GreenBench基准测试框架，首次系统评估了Apple Silicon（M4 Pro）上LLM推理的能源效率、吞吐量和碳足迹。研究发现M4 Pro在持续推理时仅消耗0.47W的CPU+GPU封装功率，系统总功耗8-12W，相比数据中心GPU实现了30-40倍的每token能源效率提升，并通过Pareto分析确定了不同场景下的最优模型选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM的快速普及引发了对其推理阶段环境影响的担忧，但现有的Green AI研究主要聚焦于数据中心GPU和嵌入式平台，Apple Silicon因其统一内存架构而具有独特优势，但其推理能耗特性尚未被系统研究。这一研究空白使得用户无法在单用户部署场景下做出能源感知的模型和硬件选择决策。

Method: 本文构建了GreenBench基准测试框架，在配备48GB统一内存的Apple M4 Pro上评估了5个开源LLM（3-9B参数）在3个NLP任务上的表现。使用macOS powermetrics进行直接功率测量，结合Ollama的纳秒级精度计时器，测量了封装级和系统级的每token能耗，并估算印度和美国电网的CO2排放。

Result: M4 Pro在持续推理期间仅消耗0.47W的CPU+GPU封装功率，系统总功率为8-12W，比数据中心GPU实现了30-40倍的每token能源效率提升。小模型（3-3.8B）比大模型（7-9B）吞吐量高2.6-4.2倍，每token能耗低62%。Qwen 2.5 (7B)在准确率-效率权衡上最优（MMLU 57%，59 tokens/s），Llama 3.2 (3B)适合延迟敏感场景（175 tokens/s）。

Conclusion: 研究表明Apple Silicon凭借统一内存架构在单用户LLM推理场景中具有显著的能源效率优势，为小规模部署提供了可持续的替代方案。同时，模型大小选择对能源效率有显著影响，Pareto分析为不同应用场景提供了明确的模型选择指导。

Abstract: The rapid proliferation of Large Language Models (LLMs) has raised concerns about their environmental impact during inference. While Green AI research has focused on datacenter GPUs and embedded platforms, the energy profile of LLM inference on Apple Silicon, with its unified memory architecture, remains unstudied. This paper presents GreenBench, a benchmarking framework that evaluates the energy efficiency, throughput, and carbon footprint of five open-source LLMs (3-9B parameters) across three NLP tasks on an Apple M4 Pro with 48 GB unified memory. Using macOS powermetrics for direct power measurement and Ollama's nanosecond-precision timing, we find that the M4 Pro draws only 0.47 W of CPU+GPU package power during sustained inference, with total system power of 8-12 W, achieving 30-40x better energy efficiency per token than datacenter GPUs in single-user deployment. Smaller models (3-3.8B) deliver 2.6-4.2x higher throughput and up to 62% less energy per token than larger models (7-9B). Pareto analysis identifies Qwen 2.5 (7B) as the optimal accuracy-efficiency trade-off at 57% MMLU and 59 tokens/s, while Llama 3.2 (3B) suits latency-critical applications at 175 tokens/s. We provide per-token energy at package and system levels with CO2 estimates for India and US grids.

</details>


### [282] [ReVA: A Region-Aware Visual Assistant for Visually Grounded Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28707)
*Anoop Senthil*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出ReVA，一个区域感知的VQA模型，通过双桥接架构将冻结的CLIP ViT和Qwen2.5-LLM连接，同时对齐整图级和区域级视觉表示，以缓解多模态大模型中的对象、属性和空间幻觉问题，在POPE等基准上显著减少了幻觉并提升了事实性视觉基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在VQA任务中虽取得显著进展，但在需要精确空间推理和细粒度视觉理解的问题上仍表现不佳，常产生对象、属性和空间幻觉——模型生成自信但视觉上无依据的答案。根本原因在于缺乏充分的区域级和细粒度视觉定位能力。
