Method: ReVA采用冻结的CLIP ViT-L/14作为视觉编码器、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct作为LLM，通过双桥接架构连接：图像桥将最终Transformer块特征映射为图像tokens；区域桥将来自各ViT块增强中间特征的裁剪特征（融合早期纹理和后期对象线索）映射为每个边界框的K个区域tokens。检测器栈（RAM++、spaCy和Grounding DINO）提供零样本边界框，包括问题无关和问题相关两种类型。图像tokens与区域tokens拼接作为LLM提示前缀，联合编码场景级上下文和细粒度区域证据。

Result: 在VQAv2、MMBench、POPE和SEED-Bench上进行评估，ReVA在POPE上达到82.85%的平均F1分数，而仅使用图像tokens的基线为81.14%，验证了显式区域感知表示能减少对象幻觉并提升事实性视觉基础。

Conclusion: 显式的区域感知视觉表示能够有效减少多模态大语言模型的对象幻觉，提升其事实性视觉基础能力，为细粒度视觉问答提供了可行的架构方案。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in Visual Question Answering (VQA), yet they continue to struggle with questions requiring precise spatial reasoning and fine-grained visual understanding. These limitations often manifest as object, attribute, and spatial hallucinations, where models generate confident but visually unsupported responses due to insufficient region-level and fine-grained visual grounding. To address this challenge, we propose ReVA, a region-aware VQA model that employs a frozen CLIP ViT-L/14 Vision Transformer (ViT) and a Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct large language model (LLM) connected through a dual bridge that aligns both whole-image and region-level representations with the LLM's embedding space. The image bridge maps final transformer block features into image tokens. The region bridge maps cropped features from enriched intermediate features across ViT blocks so early texture and later object cues are more evident, into K region tokens for every bounding box. ReVA uses a detector stack that supplies automatic zero-shot bounding boxes that are both question-agnostic and question-dependent, using RAM++ (Recognize Anything Model), spaCy, and Grounding DINO. The image tokens and region tokens are concatenated as an LLM prompt prefix to jointly encode scene-level context and fine-grained regional evidence when answering questions. Evaluated on VQAv2, MMBench, POPE, and SEED-Bench, ReVA achieves 82.85% mean F1 on POPE, compared with 81.14% for an image-token baseline without region tokens. These results demonstrate that explicit region-aware visual representations reduce object hallucination and improve the factual grounding of MLLMs.

</details>


### [283] [Evaluating Multilingual Sentence Embeddings for Translation Error Detection:An English--Greek Contrastive Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28776)
*Eleftherios Kalogeros,Athanasios Ntalakas,Manolis Gergatsoulis,Paschalis Nikolaou,Sotiria-Lito Alexaki*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了多语言句子嵌入模型在区分正确与错误英希翻译方面的敏感度。通过构建1,850个对比样本（涵盖10个核心及5个探索性错误类别），评估了五种嵌入模型和COMETKiwi基线。结果显示BGE-M3准确率达89.30%，COMETKiwi达94.49%，嵌入模型对显式事实和词汇错误敏感，但对时态和代词指代错误不敏感，两者呈现互补性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多语言句子嵌入广泛用于跨语言语义相似度估计，但其对细粒度翻译错误的敏感度尚未被充分理解。研究者希望系统地评估这些模型能否区分正确的翻译与经过最小修改的错误翻译，以理解其局限性和适用场景。

Method: 基于FLORES+句对齐参考翻译构建对比数据集，由两位翻译专家审核，覆盖事实性、词汇语义、语法、关系、指代和语篇层面等1,850个样本。评估五种嵌入模型（BGE-M3、Multilingual E5、Multilingual MPNet、LaBSE、Jina Embeddings v3）及COMETKiwi（无参考MT质量估计基线），使用余弦相似度、对比准确率和评分边际进行衡量。

Result: BGE-M3在嵌入模型中准确率最高（89.30%），COMETKiwi达94.49%。嵌入模型对显式事实和词汇变化检测更可靠，对时态体和代词共指错误检测较弱。COMETKiwi在多个困难类别（时态体、代词共指、语义角色）上表现更好，但对日期时间错误敏感度低，且在数字错误上不如嵌入模型。

Conclusion: 多语言句子嵌入和MT质量估计模型具有互补的错误敏感度特征。句子嵌入能提供有用的语义充分性信号，但更适合作为更广泛的翻译评估框架的组件，而非独立度量标准。

Abstract: Multilingual sentence embeddings are increasingly used to estimate semantic similarity across languages, yet their sensitivity to fine-grained translation errors remains insufficiently understood. This study investigates whether general-purpose multilingual embedding models can distinguish correct English-Greek translations from minimally modified erroneous alternatives. A contrastive dataset was developed from FLORES+ sentence-aligned reference translations and reviewed by two translation experts. It contains 1,850 examples across ten core and five exploratory error categories, covering factual, lexical-semantic, grammatical, relational, referential, and discourse-level phenomena.
  Five multilingual sentence-embedding models (BGE-M3, Multilingual E5, Multilingual MPNet, LaBSE, and Jina Embeddings v3) were evaluated using cosine similarity between each English source sentence and its correct and erroneous Greek translations. A reference-free COMETKiwi model was also evaluated as an MT quality-estimation baseline. Performance was assessed through contrastive accuracy and score margins for category-specific sensitivity. BGE-M3 achieved the highest accuracy among embedding models at 89.30 percent, while COMETKiwi achieved 94.49 percent. Embedding models detected explicit factual and lexical changes more reliably than tense-and-aspect and pronoun-coreference errors. COMETKiwi improved performance on several difficult categories, including tense and aspect, pronoun and coreference, and semantic-role errors, but showed lower sensitivity to date-and-time errors and underperformed the embedding models on numbers. The results show complementary error-sensitivity profiles: multilingual sentence embeddings provide useful semantic adequacy signals but are better suited as components of broader translation-evaluation frameworks than as standalone metrics.

</details>


### [284] [A rigor-matched audit of periodic-step layer skipping for efficient llm inference: conflayers versus swift, with a supplemental analysis of trained routing alternatives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28846)
*Prateek Kumar Sikdar,Arpan Ghosh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文对两种周期步进式层跳过方法（ConfLayers和SWIFT）及两种训练路由方法（LayerRoute和LayerDrop）进行了严格匹配的三种子审计，在两种模型规模和两个任务上评估了准确性、速度及搜索开销，发现SWIFT在准确性和真实推理速度上普遍占优，并发布了审计协议模板。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 层跳过方法声称能提升LLM推理效率，但现有比较缺乏严格匹配的审计协议，导致公平性不足。作者希望建立一个精细分离搜索开销与纯推理成本、使用真实逐输入门控和完整模型基线的审计框架，以客观评估不同层跳过方法的真实性能。

Method: 采用三种子审计协议，对比：(1) 周期性步进式搜索方法——ConfLayers（置信度门控早退基线）与SWIFT（自推测解码）；(2) 训练路由方法——LayerRoute与LayerDrop作为补充分析。在Qwen2.5-0.5B和Qwen2.5-1.5B上，评估GSM8K推理和CNN/DailyMail摘要任务。关键创新是分离在线搜索开销与纯推理成本，并验证门控、基线和计算跳过的真实性。

Result: SWIFT在四个单元格中的三个取得最高准确率；ConfLayers在所有场景中被全面压制，尤其在GSM8K 1.5B上劣势明显。分离搜索开销后，SWIFT的真实推理速度在四个单元格中均快于ConfLayers（5-21%），推翻了三个单元格中的朴素端到端排名。ConfLayers的搜索开销小而稳定（1-2%），SWIFT的则更大且波动（最高28.7%）。LayerRoute和LayerDrop仅有1.08-1.33x的适度加速，且准确率远低于周期步进方法，LayerRoute在GSM8K 1.5B上近乎崩溃（平均精确匹配0.003）。

Conclusion: SWIFT是当前审计中综合表现最强的层跳过方法；ConfLayers虽搜索开销低但准确率不足；粗粒度的训练路由方法在效率和准确率权衡上均不及周期步进方法。作者开源完整审计协议，作为未来效率比较的模板，强调应将搜索开销与纯推理成本分离评估，并验证协议的真实性。

Abstract: Layer-skipping methods for efficient LLM inference decide, at some granularity, which transformer layers to execute for a given input. We present a rigor-matched, three-seed audit of two periodic-step, search-based methods that make this decision online at inference time and re-evaluate it every few generation steps: a confidence-gated early-exit baseline (ConfLayers) and genuine self-speculative decoding (SWIFT, Xia et al. 2024), together with vanilla autoregressive decoding, across two model scales (Qwen2.5-0.5B and Qwen2.5-1.5B) and two tasks (GSM8K reasoning and CNN/DailyMail summarization). SWIFT is the strongest method on accuracy in three of four cells; ConfLayers is dominated everywhere, with particularly large deficits on GSM8K at 1.5B. Once online-search overhead is separated from pure inference cost, SWIFT's true inference speed is faster than ConfLayers's in all four cells (5-21%), reversing the naive wall-clock ranking in three of them. ConfLayers's search overhead is small and stable (1-2% of cost), while SWIFT's is larger and more variable (up to 28.7%). We additionally examine two trained-routing methods, LayerRoute (Sikdar, 2026) and LayerDrop (Fan et al. 2020), as a supplemental analysis because they operate at coarser decision granularities. Under a verified protocol with genuine per-input gating, a genuine full-model baseline, and genuine inference-time compute skipping, both show modest speedups (1.08-1.33x) but accuracy well below the periodic-step methods, including a near-total collapse for LayerRoute on GSM8K at 1.5B (0.003 mean exact-match across three seeds). We release the full audit protocol as a template for rigor-matched efficiency comparisons.

</details>


### [285] [Latent-Space Intervention for Cross-Lingual Factual Consistency: Consistency Improvements without Accuracy Drops](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28860)
*Faeze Ghorbanpour,Constanza Fierro,Alexander Fraser,Anders Sogaard*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究跨语言潜在空间干预是否能减少LLM在不同语言间回答同一事实问题的差异。通过训练层特定的自编码器于平行多语言表示，并在推理时对事实QA提示进行修正，发现潜在干预改善了语言间的几何对齐，并显著提升跨语言一致性（如英语-阿拉伯语和英语-俄语的Spearman相关性分别提升0.16和0.20），且不损害事实准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型在不同语言下回答同一事实问题时往往产生不一致的结果，这种跨语言不一致性会影响模型在多语言场景下的可靠性和可用性。作者希望探究是否可以通过潜在空间干预来减少这种不一致。

Method: 在平行多语言表示上训练层特定的自编码器（autoencoders），然后在推理时对事实QA提示应用修正（inference-time corrections）。通过对比AE重建、PCA投影和均值平移（mean-shift）等多种干预方式的效果，评估其对跨语言一致性的影响。

Result: 潜在干预改善了语言间的几何对齐，并转化为跨语言一致性的持续提升（英语与其他语言），涵盖开放式和多项选择QA格式，且不降低事实准确性。开放QA中English-Arabic提升0.16，English-Russian提升0.20；多项选择QA中KLAR和mParaRel的答案一致性均有改善。消融实验显示AE重建稳定有效，PCA贡献有限，mean-shift在开放式QA中一致性增益更大但牺牲部分准确性。

Conclusion: 跨语言潜在空间干预（尤其是基于自编码器的表示修正）是一种有效减少LLM跨语言不一致性的方法，能在不损害准确性的前提下提升一致性。不同干预方法的权衡（如mean-shift的一致性-准确性折衷）为进一步研究提供了方向。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often answer the same factual question differently across languages. We study whether cross-lingual latent-space intervention can reduce this inconsistency. We train layer-specific autoencoders on parallel multilingual representations and apply inference-time corrections to factual QA prompts. We find that latent intervention improves geometric alignment between languages, and that this improvement translates into consistent gains in cross-lingual consistency with English across both open-ended and multiple-choice QA formats, without degrading factual accuracy. In open-ended QA, Spearman's rank correlation between English and non-English languages improves substantially, with gains of 0.16 for English-Arabic and 0.20 for English-Russian pairs. In multiple-choice QA, answer agreement with English improves consistently across both KLAR and mParaRel. Ablations show that AE reconstruction yields consistent gains at no accuracy cost, while PCA projection contributes marginally, and mean-shift produces substantially larger consistency gains in open-ended QA at the cost of some accuracy.

</details>


### [286] [No Detectable Change in Side-Level WER from Prompt-Level Context: A Preregistered Ablation on a Production Oral-History Corpus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28875)
*Theodore O. Cochran,Stephanie Dodson,Keith Nore*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究在生产环境的口述历史转录工具中，测试了在推理时为大型多模态模型提供上下文提示能否降低单词错误率（WER）。通过预先注册的配对消融实验，对19个卡带面（约10.6小时的1970-80年代劣化音频）使用gpt-4o-transcribe和gemini-2.5-flash两种配置进行测试。结果显示，完整上下文提示并未显著改变侧级WER，四项预注册假设均未得到支持。后验分析发现管线运行间变异性大于确认实验中的差异，说明该量级的效应无法通过每单元单次转录来分辨。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 早期研究表明，在推理时为语音转录模型提供上下文提示能显著提升领域适应性，但此前的结论基于较小模型。作者希望在真实生产环境中验证这一机制是否仍然有效，特别是在生产级多模态模型（如GPT-4o和Gemini）已经足够强大的情况下，上下文提示是否还能带来收益。

Method: 采用条目内配对消融设计，预注册并冻结分析代码。19个卡带面的约10.6小时音频通过生产代码路径处理，在三个提示臂（完整上下文、无上下文等）与两个商业配置（gpt-4o-transcribe和gemini-2.5-flash）交叉组合下进行转录，与操作员修正的逐字参考文本比对。使用侧重采样区间估计WER差异，并进行实施审计和序列对齐分析。

Result: gpt-4o-transcribe的完整上下文与无上下文臂的配对中位数差异为+0.6 WER点（95%区间[-1.1, +1.0]），差异不显著。Gemini估计不稳定，无法支持可比推断。四项预注册假设均未获支持。序列对齐分析发现上下文对完整列出短语有小幅改善，但对Gemini同时存在未列出token错误恶化。

Conclusion: 在生产级多模态转录模型中，提示级上下文并未带来可检测的侧级WER改善，与早期小模型的结论不同。评估上下文机制需要序列对齐的词级、插入和说话人标签指标，而非仅依赖聚合准确率指标。提示条件化机制的效果可能已被现代模型的内置能力所掩盖。

Abstract: Supplying context at inference time to a large multimodal model is an inexpensive lever for adapting speech transcription to a domain, and earlier results on smaller models reported large gains. This work tested that mechanism where it ships, in the prompt-conditioning layer of a production oral-history transcription tool, on a sample from its own production corpus. Full prompt-level context did not detectably change side-level word error rate (WER), and none of the four preregistered hypotheses was supported. The design was a within-item paired ablation, preregistered with the analysis code frozen by hash before the confirmatory batch was scored; two disclosed gpt-4o pilot sides had been scored earlier, during scorer development. Nineteen cassette sides, about 10.6 hours of degraded 1970s-80s interview audio, were reprocessed through the production code path under three prompt arms, crossed with two deployed commercial configurations, gpt-4o-transcribe and gemini-2.5-flash, and scored against operator-corrected verbatim references. For gpt-4o-transcribe the median paired difference between the full-context and no-context arms was +0.6 WER points, with a side-resampled interval of [-1.1, +1.0]; the Gemini estimates were too unstable to support a comparable negative inference. A post-hoc rerun found run-to-run pipeline variability larger than the confirmatory differences, so effects of that size cannot be resolved from one transcription per cell. An implementation audit verified the manipulation was live, and sequence-alignment analysis found a small improvement on complete context-listed phrases, too small to materially change side-level WER, and for Gemini coexisting with worsened unlisted-token error. Evaluating context mechanisms therefore requires sequence-aligned term-level, insertion, and speaker-label measures alongside aggregate accuracy.

</details>


### [287] [Moving the Mean Toward the Known Good, Not Beyond It: What Inference-Time Interventions and Weight Consolidation Buy in Open-Ended Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28886)
*Roberto I. Ono Filho*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了在线装箱任务中"生成-验证-选择-LoRA整合"这一自举循环的效果。训练于价值过滤候选样本可以显著提升模型在保留集上的表现（超额降低1.7-3.1个点），但最佳候选收敛于经典启发式水平且无法超越。三次独立复现确认了结果的可复制性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究自生成数据循环（在自身验证成功的样本上学习）究竟能给生成循环带来什么增益，以及模型能否超越经典启发式算法的水平。

Method: 采用生成-验证-选择-LoRA整合的迭代循环：对候选解进行价值过滤选择，通过LoRA进行模型整合；并设置随机整合对照、SFT-only对照及三次独立种子的确认电池实验。

Result: 价值过滤整合使保留集超额降低1.7点（p=0.008）及相对随机对照降低3.1点（p=0.004）；三次复现均值几乎一致（-2.0,-1.8,-1.9），七个变体中全部倾向整合（p=0.008）；最优候选精确收敛于经典启发式水平（0.021028）而从未超越；整合降低了更优候选的每候选率（10%→3.9%），但因产量更大绝对数更多（5:1）。

Conclusion: 质量提升可以购买并复现，但观察到的"最优"只能到达经典启发式水平而从未超越它。SFT对照表明是监督锚定而非对坏候选的排斥导致了集中效应（96%候选精确落在经典水平）。推理时账本显示模型写的摘要有助于判断文档整合，但流中验证器被模仿导致每笔记本16.4行捏造结论行。

Abstract: What does a generation loop gain from learning on its own verified successes? In cycles of generate, verify, select and LoRA-consolidate on online bin packing, training on value-filtered candidates shifts what the model writes on held-out variants toward value (-1.7 points of excess, p=0.008; -3.1 against a random-consolidation control, p=0.004) while the best observed candidate converges to the classic heuristic's level and no further. A confirmation battery replicates the whole procedure three times, with fresh seeds and a never-consulted held-out set read exactly once: the mean was nearly identical in all three lineages (-2.0, -1.8, -1.9), and after aggregating within held-out variant all seven evaluable variants favored consolidation (p=0.008). The best observed candidate moved to the classic heuristic's level, exactly (0.021028 in all three lineages, for attract and for the random control alike), and never beyond it. A matched SFT-only control shows the supervised anchor, not repulsion from bad candidates, does the concentrating (96% of candidates land exactly at the classic heuristic's level). The tails cut both ways: consolidation lowers the per-candidate rate of better-than-classic candidates (10% to 3.9%) while its larger production yields more such candidates absolutely (5 against 1, on few events). As motivation we report the inference-time ledger that led here: a model-written schematic recap buys judged document integration and nothing buys development; a verifier written into the stream is imitated, 16.4 fabricated verdict lines per notebook. Mean quality among valid candidates can be bought and replicated; the observed best goes to the classic and, so far, never beyond it.

</details>


### [288] [VoiceCodeBench: Evaluating Exact Structured-Token Recovery in Automatic Speech Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28916)
*Tyler Baumgartner,Brandon Tai,Lisa Kaelin-Martin,Candice Fan,Luc Debaupte,Bill Wang,Yi Zhong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: VoiceCodeBench是一个用于评估英文语音识别系统精确结构令牌恢复能力的基准测试，包含300段人工录制的职场语音、1,482个经审计的目标实体，覆盖26种实体类型。实验表明WER与结构化令牌恢复存在相关但非完全决定关系（Spearman相关系数-0.73），最好的基线系统TSR仅为68.7%，凸显了实体敏感评估指标的必要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统ASR系统以WER作为主要评估指标，但许多语音工作流依赖于精确的书面值（如标识符、路径、测量量）。低WER且流畅的转录可能破坏下游系统必须解析、存储或执行的数值，仅用WER无法充分反映ASR在关键实体恢复上的真实能力。

Method: 构建包含300段人工录制的职场语音片段的基准数据集，覆盖8个工作流领域和1,482个经审计的目标实体（26种实体类型）。采用仅原始音频的协议（无额外上下文或元数据），除WER外引入Canonical Token/Entity Match (CTEM)、Task Success Rate (TSR)和按类型的精确恢复率作为评估指标。

Result: 对12个基线ASR系统的评估显示，WER与结构化令牌恢复呈负相关（WER vs CTEM和WER vs TSR的Spearman相关系数均为-0.73），但WER并不能完全决定令牌恢复表现。最强基线系统的TSR仅达68.7%，近三分之一的录音至少有一个工作流关键值未被恢复。

Conclusion: 现有ASR系统的精确值恢复能力仍不理想，需要引入实体敏感的评估指标来衡量ASR输出是否保留了生产系统必须解析、路由、存储、比较或执行的精确值。

Abstract: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems are commonly evaluated with word error rate (WER), yet many voice workflows depend on exact written values for identifiers, paths, and measured quantities. A transcript can appear fluent and achieve low WER while corrupting a value that a downstream system must parse, store, or execute.
  We introduce VoiceCodeBench, a benchmark for evaluating exact structured-token recovery in English ASR. It contains 300 human-recorded workplace segments spanning eight workflow domains and 1,482 audited target entities across 26 entity types, each with a canonical written form recoverable from the audio. Under a raw-audio-only protocol, systems receive audio bytes without additional context or metadata. Alongside WER, we evaluate Canonical Token/Entity Match (CTEM), Task Success Rate (TSR), and per-type exact recovery.
  Across 12 baseline ASR systems, lower WER generally corresponded to better structured-token recovery but did not fully determine it: Spearman correlations were -0.73 for both WER versus CTEM and WER versus TSR. The strongest baseline by TSR reached only 68.7%, leaving nearly one third of recordings with at least one unrecovered workflow-critical value. These results show that entity-sensitive metrics are needed to assess whether ASR output preserves exact values that production systems must parse, route, store, compare, or execute.

</details>


### [289] [Causal Interventions Reveal Typologically Organized Syntactic Mechanisms in Multilingual Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28924)
*Sasha Boguraev,Toshiki Nakai,Kyle Mahowald,Julius Steuer*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文利用机械可解释性技术研究多语言语言模型中的跨语言句法机制迁移，发现四种模型和三种句法结构中都存在一致的跨语言机制迁移，且迁移程度与语言类型学相似度呈正相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言学理论长期假设跨语言的句法规律由相似机制处理，但由于缺乏对人类处理机制精细且可操控的访问途径，这一假设难以得到实证检验。

Method: 采用机械可解释性技术，首先隔离语言内部的处理机制，再尝试将其跨语言迁移。研究覆盖四种模型和三种句法结构（主谓数一致、照应代词性一致、填充词-空位宾语提取），并比较类型学上相似与不相似语言之间的迁移程度。

Result: 在四种模型和三种句法结构中发现一致的跨语言机制迁移，且迁移是分级的——类型学上更相似的语言之间迁移程度更高。

Conclusion: 该研究为跨语言句法结构和多语言处理提供了新的假设，并展示了语言模型研究如何为语言学理论提供启示。

Abstract: Linguistic theory has long recognized cross-linguistic syntactic regularities, leading to claims that these similar structures are processed by similar mechanisms. However, this hypothesis has been difficult to test empirically due to our lack of fine-grained, manipulable access of human processing mechanisms. In this work, we take advantage of techniques from mechanistic interpretability to study such a question in multilingual LMs. We first isolate language-internal mechanisms before attempting to transfer them cross-lingually. Across four models and three well-studied constructions (subject--verb number agreement, anaphoric pronoun gender agreement, and filler--gap object extraction) we find consistent cross-lingual mechanism transfer. We further find transfer to be graded, with more transfer between more typologically similar languages. We believe our work provides novel hypotheses about cross-linguistic syntactic structures and multilingual processing, and more broadly shows how the study of language models can help inform linguistic theory.

</details>


### [290] [Leveraging Turn-taking Dynamics for Intent Recognition in Multi-party Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28926)
*Galo Castillo-López,Alexis Lombard,Gaël de Chalendar,Nasredine Semmar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出一种多任务学习方法，通过辅助任务建模多方对话中的话轮转换动态（turn-taking dynamics），引入自监督目标"话轮转换熵"来量化互动模式的可预测性，从而提升多方对话意图识别的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有意图识别方法忽视了多方对话中的互动动态（multi-party interaction dynamics），而话轮转换模式可能包含对理解参与者意图有价值的信息。

Method: 采用多任务学习框架，主任务为多方对话意图识别，辅助任务为预测话轮转换熵（turn-transition entropy）——这是一个从说话人转换序列中计算的自监督连续目标，用于量化互动模式的可预测性。

Result: 在多个预训练模型上进行实验，结果表明加入该辅助任务能提升意图识别性能，优于忽略多方互动动态的现有方法。此外，该连续目标可作为单任务目标学习，说明其确实携带有效信息。

Conclusion: 话轮转换熵是一个有效的信号，通过多任务学习将其纳入模型训练可以显著提升多方对话意图识别的效果，验证了建模互动动态对理解多方对话的重要性。

Abstract: We propose a multi-task learning approach for multi-party dialogue intent recognition that leverages an auxiliary task that models turn-taking dynamics. Specifically, we introduce turn-transition entropy, a self-supervised target computed from the sequence of speaker transitions, which quantifies the predictability of interaction patterns. Experiments on multiple pre-trained models demonstrate that incorporating this auxiliary task improves intent recognition performance, outperforming existing approaches which ignore multi-party interaction dynamics. We find that our proposed continuous target can be learned as a single-task objective, suggesting that it is an actual signal carrying useful information.

</details>


### [291] [The Hallucination Signal Is a Mean Shift: Why Simple Probes Suffice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28930)
*Jungseob Lee,Jaehyung Seo,Heuiseok Lim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过配对样例范式，在三个7B规模模型和三个数据集上系统刻画了LLM幻觉检测中隐藏状态信号的几何结构。研究发现该信号主要由单一均值位移分量主导，移除该方向后检测性能降至随机水平。收缩线性判别分析（sLDA）能弥合1D与全维分类器之间约73%的差距，表明看似复杂的架构设计主要源于高维协方差估计困难，而非可利用的非线性结构。简单的L2正则化逻辑回归（0.952 AUROC）即可达到或超越十二种受控架构变体，多层级聚合优于CLAP跨层注意力探测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有隐藏状态探针能有效检测LLM幻觉，但信号几何结构尚未被充分表征，这导致探针架构日益复杂。作者旨在理解幻觉信号的真实几何特性，从而判断复杂架构是否必要。

Method: 采用配对样例范式，在3个7B规模模型与3个数据集上进行实验。使用均值位移分析识别主导方向，通过移除该方向测试检测性能；采用收缩LDA比较1D与全维分类器；并对比L2正则化逻辑回归与十二种受控架构变体，提出LayerMix方法进行多层级聚合。

Result: 信号由单一均值位移主导；移除该方向后检测失效。sLDA弥合1D与全维分类器间约73%差距。简单L2逻辑回归达到0.952 AUROC，超越十二种架构变体。LayerMix无需oracle访问即可匹配oracle层性能。

Conclusion: LLM幻觉检测信号的几何结构本质上是线性的、低维的，主要由单一方向主导。复杂探针架构的收益主要来自更好的高维协方差估计而非捕获非线性结构。LayerMix为多层级聚合提供了无需oracle的实用方案。

Abstract: Hidden-state probes effectively detect LLM hallucinations, but the geometry of the signal remains poorly characterized, driving increasingly complex probe architectures. Across three 7B-scale models and three datasets in a paired-example paradigm, we find the signal overwhelmingly dominated by a single mean-shift component, and removing this direction collapses detection to chance. Shrinkage linear discriminant analysis closes about 73% of the gap between 1D and full-dimensional classifiers, so apparent architectural complexity largely reflects high-dimensional covariance estimation difficulty rather than exploitable non-linearity. A simple L2-regularized logistic regression (0.952 AUROC) bounds or outperforms twelve controlled architectural alternatives, and our multi-layer aggregation exceeds CLAP cross-layer attention probing under matched paradigm. Because the signal spans a contiguous layer band, LayerMix aggregates it to match oracle-layer performance without oracle access. Our claims characterize the geometry within the controlled paired-example paradigm. Our code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/LayerMix.

</details>


### [292] [VocalAffectBench: Evaluating Vocal Emotion Recognition in AI Audio Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28932)
*Models Luc Debaupte,Tyler Baumgartner,Brandon Tai,Candice Fan,Bill Wang,Yi Zhong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了VocalAffectBench，一个用于评估AI音频模型从原始语音中识别表达性情感能力的公开测试基准，包含273个英语语音片段、7种情感标签，实验表明当前最强基线仅达到46.5%的准确率，情感识别仍不稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语音产品日益需要语音中存在的、文本转录中缺失的情感线索，但目前缺乏公开基准来系统评估AI音频模型从原始音频中识别表达性语音情感的能力。

Method: 构建包含273个人类录制的英语WAV片段（来自51个说话人账户，共1.95小时）的基准集，覆盖愤怒、厌恶、恐惧、快乐、中性、悲伤、惊讶七类标签，每类39个片段。所有基线仅基于音频评估，不含转录或上下文元数据，并引入效价桶分析作为次级评估视角。

Result: 六个已发布基线平均准确率为35.5%；最强基线gemini_3_5_flash在七分类任务上达到46.5%，远高于14.3%的随机基线但远非稳健。效价桶分析（积极/中性/消极）下聚合准确率为50.9%。各类别召回率差异巨大：中性识别最可靠达75.6%，而惊讶和恐惧仅分别达到10.7%和15.4%。

Conclusion: 现有基线能提取部分语音情感信号，但离散表达性情感识别仍很脆弱，尤其是在语音代理工作流中通常最重要的非中性情感类别上表现不佳。

Abstract: Voice products increasingly need affective cues that are present in speech but absent from transcripts. We introduce VocalAffectBench, a public, test-only benchmark for evaluating whether AI audio models can identify expressed vocal emotion from raw audio. The benchmark contains 273 human-recorded English WAV clips from 51 speaker accounts totaling 1.95 hours across seven labels: angry, disgusted, fearful, happy, neutral, sad, and surprised, with 39 clips per class. All baselines are evaluated from audio alone, without transcripts or contextual metadata. Across six released baselines, average accuracy is 35.5%. The strongest baseline, gemini_3_5_flash, reaches 46.5% on the seven-way task, above the 14.3% random baseline but far from robust emotion recognition. A secondary valence-bucket analysis maps labels into positive, neutral, and negative classes, excluding surprised because its valence is ambiguous. Aggregate accuracy under this coarser view is 50.9%. Performance is highly uneven across classes. By recall, neutral is identified most reliably at 75.6% averaged across baselines, while surprised and fearful reach only 10.7% and 15.4%, respectively. These results show that the evaluated baselines can extract some affective signal from speech, but discrete expressed-emotion recognition remains fragile, especially for non-neutral emotions that are often most important in voice agent workflows.

</details>


### [293] [CoVA-SFT: A Large-Scale Dataset for Chain of Visual Abstractions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28958)
*Tsung-Han Wu,Heekyung Lee,Anya Ji,Haoming Chen,Trevor Darrell,Joseph E. Gonzalez,David M. Chan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出CoVA-SFT，一个包含51.9K样本、222K多模态推理步骤的结构化数据集，以及配套的CoVA-Bench基准测试集，用于教多模态语言模型在纯文本推理问题中构建和维持内部视觉工作空间，通过交错文本与视觉抽象来提升推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然CoT推理在语言任务上效果显著，但纯文本CoT迫使模型将视觉问题序列化为笨拙的文本描述。现有架构虽能处理视觉输入，但缺乏大规模、多步骤、自校正的数据集来教会模型在纯文本推理问题中构建内部视觉工作空间。

Method: 构建CoVA-SFT数据集（51.9K样本，涵盖5种布局族、17个复杂任务，包含超过222K多模态推理步骤），提供显式推理公式、智能体渲染和验证循环，教导多模态语言模型交错使用文本和视觉抽象。

Result: 在CoVA-SFT上微调的模型在CoVA-Bench上平均超过所有交错CoT基线2倍以上，但仍不及强文本CoT基线，揭示了未来工作的开放挑战。

Conclusion: CoVA-SFT和CoVA-Bench为多模态推理提供了宝贵的数据资源和评估基准，展示了交错视觉推理的潜力，但同时也表明该方向仍存在需要克服的挑战，为未来研究指明了方向。

Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has dramatically improved large language models (LLMs) by allowing them to decompose problems into intermediate steps. While CoT is widely effective for linguistic tasks, text-only CoT forces models to serialize visual problems into awkward prose. Although architectural solutions exist to process visual inputs, the community lacks a massive, multi-step, self-corrected dataset to teach models how to build and maintain internal visual workspaces when solving purely textual reasoning problems. To address this limitation, we introduce CoVA-SFT, a highly structured corpus of 51.9K samples containing over 222K multimodal reasoning steps across 5 distinct layout families and 17 complex tasks, and CoVA-Bench, a companion benchmark of 1,700 held-out test samples spanning the same tasks for reproducible evaluation. By providing explicit rationale formulations, agentic renderings, and verification loops, CoVA-SFT teaches multimodal language models to interleave text and visual abstractions. We validate the dataset by demonstrating that models fine-tuned on CoVA-SFT outperform all interleaved CoT baselines by more than 2x on average on CoVA-Bench, though they still fall short of strong text-only CoT baselines, highlighting open challenges for future work.

</details>


### [294] [The Illusion of Replacement: Rethinking Specialized Machine Learning Models in the Foundation Model Era](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28980)
*Kiyan Rezaee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过回顾159篇论文（2016-2026年）跨九个模态的研究，系统探讨了语言模型能否取代传统为结构化数据设计的专门架构。研究发现语言介导模型在特定场景下极具竞争力，但在结构表示或计算的直接评估中，没有证据表明可以完全取代专门架构，结构专门化更多是"转移"而非"消失"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究一个关键问题：机器学习传统上为结构化数据构建的专门架构（如图神经网络等）是否可以被基于语言的模型所替代？这一问题同时涉及预测准确性与结构表示、计算能力两个维度。

Method: 对159篇跨九个模态的论文进行系统综述，区分"执行任务"与"保留并计算使任务可解的结构"两个层面；将现有方法组织为八种表示范式，从纯语言系统到完全专门架构；综合评估预测准确性与结构表示/计算能力。

Result: 语言介导模型在极端少样本预测、离散符号任务、文本标注知识图谱和大规模单模态预训练中表现出高度竞争力；然而，当直接评估结构表示或计算（而非仅看准确率）时，未发现通用架构替代的证据。跨独立研究社区反复出现同一模式：语言不足时，通过图模块、结构token、专门注意力等非语言组件重新引入缺失的结构。扩展规模可提升语言模型性能，但能否最终消除与结构感知架构的差距仍未得到验证。

Conclusion: 专门化架构更多是从一个位置转移到另一个位置而非消失，语言模型与结构感知架构之间的差距是否可通过规模扩展消除仍是一个开放问题。

Abstract: Can the specialized architectures that machine learning has traditionally built for structured data be replaced by language-based models? This question is examined through a review of 159 papers (2016--2026) across nine modalities, with predictive accuracy considered alongside structural representation and computation. A distinction is made between performing a task and preserving and computing the structure that makes the task tractable, and existing approaches are organized into eight representational regimes, ranging from language-only systems to fully specialized architectures. Language-mediated models are found to be highly competitive in specific settings, including extreme few-shot prediction, discretized symbolic tasks, textually annotated knowledge graphs, and large-scale single-modality pretraining. However, whenever structural representation or computation is directly evaluated rather than accuracy alone, no evidence of general architectural replacement is found. Instead, a recurring pattern is observed across independent research communities: when language alone is insufficient, the missing structure is reintroduced through a graph module, structural tokens, specialized attention, or another non-linguistic component. In this sense, specialization more often relocates than disappears. Moreover, although performance of language-based models is improved by scaling, whether the gap to a structure-aware architecture can eventually be eliminated remains untested.

</details>


### [295] [Detecting and Guiding LLM-Generated Korean Poetry with Interpretable Form-level Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28986)
*Keunhyeung Park,Seunguk Yu,YoungBin Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对LLM在韩国现代诗创作中表现不佳（产出类似"断行散文"）的问题，提出两个耦合任务：检测诗歌是人类还是LLM创作的，以及引导LLM生成更接近人类形式的诗歌。作者定义了四个形式层面的语言维度（篇幅、结构变化、节奏不规则性、规范性），将其操作化为五个可解释特征。在检测任务中，基于这五个特征的逻辑回归分类器在七个未见过的LLM的零样本分布外检测中达到83.60的平均AUC-ROC，比最强基线KatFishNet（75.84）高出7.76个AUC点。在生成任务中，专家评估显示特征引导的诗歌优于无约束基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在现代韩国诗歌创作上表现不佳，生成的文本类似于"断行散文"而非真正的诗歌。作者希望弥合这一差距，通过可解释的语言特征来同时解决检测（区分人机创作）和生成（引导LLM产出更像人类诗歌）两个问题，而不是依赖黑箱方法。

Method: 作者定义了四个形式层面的语言维度：篇幅（Volume）、行末形式的多样性与连接使用（Structure Variation）、行长不规则性（Rhythmic Irregularity）和标准正字法遵循度（Normative Adherence），并操作化为五个可解释特征。检测任务使用逻辑回归分类器；生成任务则利用这些特征引导LLM（GPT-5.2和Gemini-3）进行诗歌生成。

Result: 检测方面：逻辑回归分类器在零样本分布外检测中达到83.60的平均AUC-ROC（跨七个未见过LLM），比最强基线KatFishNet（75.84）绝对提升7.76个AUC点，相对提升10.23%。存在一个超出其特征分类体系边界的生成器特定标点模式。生成方面：专家评估显示特征引导的诗歌优于无约束基线；跨GPT-5.2和Gemini-3的分析表明，针对性的篇幅、节奏和结尾统计特征向人类分布靠拢。

Conclusion: 可解释的、语言特定的特征能够同时弥合LLM诗歌的检测与生成引导之间差距。这些结果提示，基于形式层面语言学维度的可解释特征有望成为诊断和改进LLM诗歌生成的有效工具。

Abstract: LLMs often struggle with modern Korean poetry, producing outputs that resemble "line-broken prose." We address two coupled tasks: detecting whether a Korean poem is human- or LLM-authored, and guiding LLMs to generate poetry closer in form to human writing. We quantify the human-LLM gap along four form-level linguistic dimensions: output length (Volume), the diversity and connective use of line-final forms (Structure Variation), the irregularity of line lengths (Rhythmic Irregularity), and adherence to standard orthography (Normative Adherence). We operationalize these dimensions as five interpretable features. For detection, a logistic regression classifier over these five features attains an average AUC-ROC of 83.60 in zero-shot out-of-distribution detection across seven unseen LLMs, versus 75.84 for the strongest baseline in our comparison, KatFishNet, an absolute gain of 7.76 AUC points and a 10.23% relative improvement; one generator-specific punctuation pattern outside our taxonomy remains a boundary case. For generation, expert evaluation on GPT-5.2 prefers feature-guided poems over the unconstrained baseline, and analyses across GPT-5.2 and Gemini-3 show that targeted length, rhythm, and ending statistics move toward the human distribution. These results suggest that interpretable, language-specific features can bridge the diagnosis and guidance of LLM-generated poetry.

</details>


### [296] [A Unifying Perspective on Language Model Representations: From Filler-Role Structure to Mechanistic Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29034)
*Zhang Enyan,R. Thomas McCoy*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出使用张量积表示（TPRs）作为统一假设来解释语言模型的内部结构，从数学和实验两个层面证明TPRs能够统一多种可解释性方法（加法类比、线性探测、稀疏自编码器、激活修补），并认为这是迈向统一解释神经网络本质的一步。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的语言模型可解释性方法多种多样，但各自得到的见解相对孤立，缺乏一个统一的底层理论框架来解释"为什么这些方法都能奏效"。作者希望找到一个统一假设，能够解释不同可解释性方法背后的共同结构。

Method: 提出TPRs（张量积表示）作为统一假设，将组合结构表示为填充符-角色绑定（filler-role bindings）。在数学上推导证明加法类比、线性探测、稀疏自编码器、激活修补等方法均可从TPRs中衍生出来；在实验上将这些推导应用于从玩具模型到LLM的多种模型，构建上述各可解释性方法的变体并进行性能比较。

Result: 数学上证明了多种可解释性方法可从TPRs统一推导；实验上构建的基于TPR推导的各方法变体与标准变体性能相当，验证了统一框架的有效性。

Conclusion: TPRs能够作为语言模型可解释性的统一理论框架，将不同的解释方法联系起来。这项工作朝着可解释性研究的终极目标迈进——不仅提供孤立的观察，还能解释各观察结果之间的内在联系，形成对神经网络本质的统一认识。

Abstract: A wide range of methods have been proposed for interpreting language models, delivering important insights into their inner workings. However, different methods and their resulting insights stand in relative isolation: what could the underlying structure of language models be, such that they give rise to all our interpretations? In this work, we propose using Tensor Product Representations (TPRs) as a unifying hypothesis. TPRs give a concrete proposal for how compositional structure could be represented in vector space --- as filler-role bindings. We show, both mathematically and empirically, that TPRs can unify several prior interpretability methods: additive analogies, linear probing, sparse autoencoders, and activation patching. Mathematically, we show that these methods can all be derived from TPRs. Empirically, we apply the derivations to a range of different models --- from small toy models to LLMs --- to construct instances of each of the above interpretability methods; these constructed variants perform comparably to their standard variants. We view this work as a step toward what interpretability will ideally provide: a unified account of the nature of neural networks, corroborated not just by individual observations but also by an explanation of the connections between them.

</details>


### [297] [RouteSparse: Input-Conditional Pattern Routing for Budgeted Long-Context Prefilling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29058)
*Chao Zhang,Yifan Ji,Ziyan Zhang,Kai Song,Fei Lin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出RouteSparse，一种输入自适应的动态稀疏注意力路由方法。它通过低开销探针估计每个注意力头在提示词片段上的模式效用和不确定性，再由延迟感知路由器在少量GPU高效稀疏模式库中选择模式和稀疏度预算，不确定情况回退到更稠密的掩码。相比固定每头单一模式的MInference，RouteSparse实现了更好的质量-延迟权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MInference为每个注意力头离线分配单一稀疏模式，但忽略了不同输入下头的偏好模式和稀疏预算会变化这一事实，导致质量损失。作者希望打破固定模式的假设，实现输入自适应的稀疏路由。

Method: 1) 构建一个小型GPU高效稀疏模式库；2) 用低代价探针估计每个头在每个提示词片段上的模式效用和不确定性；3) 延迟感知路由器选择模式和稀疏预算，并将不确定情况回退到更稠密掩码；4) 将路由形式化为约束风险最小化，并从省略的概率质量中推导注意力输出误差证书。

Result: 在Llama 3.1-8B-Instruct的128K token提示上，RouteSparse达到6.5倍稠密预填充加速，RULER仅下降0.2分；相比之下，固定每头路由为7.3倍加速但RULER下降1.6分。消融实验证实输入条件路由、硬件分析和选择性稠密回退均对质量-延迟权衡有贡献。

Conclusion: RouteSparse通过输入自适应的稀疏模式路由，在保持极高预填充加速的同时显著减小了与稠密注意力的质量差距，验证了动态路由相对固定模式的优越性。

Abstract: Dynamic sparse attention can reduce the quadratic cost of long-context prefilling without changing model weights. MInference assigns each attention head one pattern offline and estimates that pattern's sparse indices for every prompt. This design is efficient, but it assumes that a head's preferred pattern and sparsity budget remain suitable across inputs. We introduce RouteSparse, which routes each head and prompt segment among a small library of GPU-efficient sparse patterns. A low-cost probe estimates pattern utility and uncertainty; a latency-aware router then selects a pattern and budget, while uncertain cases fall back to a denser mask. We formulate routing as constrained risk minimization, derive an attention-output error certificate from omitted probability mass, and evaluate the method on long-context retrieval, question answering, summarization, and language modeling. On Llama 3.1-8B-Instruct with 128K-token prompts, RouteSparse achieves $6.5\times$ dense prefill speed with a 0.2-point RULER drop relative to dense attention, compared with $7.3\times$ speed and a 1.6-point drop for fixed per-head routing. Ablations confirm that input-conditional routing, hardware profiling, and selective dense fallback each contribute to the quality--latency tradeoff.

</details>


### [298] [Not All or None: Dynamic Construction of Target-aware Memory Graph for Conversational Stance Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29066)
*Yifan Xiang,Bin Liang,Yuqi Huang,Ruifeng Xu,Kam-Fai Wong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出TamGraph，一种目标感知记忆图方法，通过熵引导的逐步回溯机制从历史对话中选择性激活与目标相关的记忆，构建目标感知图来建模话语间的立场关系，从而提升对话立场检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话立场检测比传统立场检测更具挑战性，需要利用跨会话的历史目标相关陈述来判断用户立场。然而，使用全部历史对话会引入噪声，完全不使用历史信息又会丢失关键上下文，因此需要一种选择性利用目标相关信息的方法。

Method: 提出Target-aware Memory Graph（TamGraph）：1）采用逐步的熵引导回溯机制，从历史对话中选择性激活与目标相关的记忆；2）动态构建目标感知图，建模话语间的立场关系；3）利用图结构信息增强LLM在对话立场检测中的表现。

Result: 在英文和中文基准数据集上的实验表明，TamGraph显著提升了LLM在对话立场检测任务上的性能。

Conclusion: TamGraph通过动态、选择性利用目标相关的历史对话信息，有效避免了噪声引入，验证了目标感知记忆图方法在对话立场检测中的有效性和可推广性（跨语言、跨LLM）。

Abstract: Stance detection is crucial for understanding the underlying attitude of an expression towards a target. Conversational stance detection is a more challenging stance detection task in real-world social media scenarios, as it involves detecting the user's stance by leveraging the target-related historical statements across conversational sessions. In this paper, we propose target-aware Memory Graph TamGraph, a novel method that dynamically leverages target-related statements for conversational stance detection. Instead of considering all preceding historical conversations or using no prior conversation information for stance detection, our TamGraph employs a stepwise, entropy-guided backtracking mechanism to selectively activate memory from historical conversations and dynamically constructs a target-aware graph to model the stance relations among utterances. This allows the exploitation of target-related information from the conversation history for stance detection while preventing the introduction of noise. Experimental results on both English and Chinese benchmarks demonstrate that our TamGraph substantially improves LLM performance on conversational stance detection.

</details>


### [299] [Recognition-Refusal Misalignment in LLMs: Why Models Answer Structurally Unanswerable Questions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29109)
*Yucheng Du,Xiyang Hu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过分析1.7B到70B参数规模的指令微调模型，揭示了大语言模型在回答结构性不可回答问题时（如cot(-540°)）的失败机制。研究发现模型内部存在一个线性方向能区分可回答与结构性不可回答的问题，表明模型在生成之前就已识别到"不可回答"。然而，这个识别方向与安全拒绝（safety-refusal）方向几乎正交，导致模型虽然拥有"无有效答案"信号，却无法将其路由到拒绝行为上。这被解释为路由失败而非编码失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型经常在回答结构性不可回答的问题时给出自信的答案而非选择弃答。需要理解这一失败究竟是模型根本没有识别出问题不可回答（编码失败），还是识别了但未能将识别结果转化为弃答行为（路由失败）。这对改进模型可靠性和安全机制至关重要。

Method: 作者从1.7B到70B参数的多种指令微调模型中进行研究，使用线性探针（hidden state中的单一线性方向）来检验模型是否区分可回答与不可回答的数学和代码提示。通过计算识别方向与安全拒绝方向之间的余弦相似度来分析两者的对齐程度，并通过生成时沿识别方向进行steering来验证因果影响。同时对比基座模型与指令微调模型，考察正交性几何结构的来源。

Result: 发现：1）模型在生成前就已通过隐藏状态中的线性方向表示"不可回答"的识别，说明识别能力存在；2）该识别方向与安全拒绝方向几乎正交（低余弦相似度），但与行为定义的无效感知方向部分对齐；3）在生成时沿识别方向进行steering可以双向、剂量响应式地改变数学和代码单元格上的无效感知行为；4）低余弦几何在预训练结束时就已存在，指令微调并未改变这一结构。

Conclusion: 模型在结构化不可回答问题上的自信错误回答，根因是路由失败而非编码失败。模型确实拥有可用的"无有效答案"信号，但安全拒绝通路并未与之对齐，无法将其转化为弃答行为。这为改进模型提出了新的干预方向：不是增强识别能力，而是建立识别到弃答之间的正确路由。

Abstract: Large language models often answer structurally unanswerable questions, such as computing cot(-540°) or evaluating (1).startswith("1"), instead of abstaining. We ask whether this failure reflects missing recognition or failed routing from recognition to abstention. Across instruction-tuned models from 1.7B to 70B parameters, a single linear direction in the hidden state separates answerable from structurally impossible math and code prompts, showing that models represent impossibility before generation. Yet this recognition direction is nearly orthogonal to the canonical safety-refusal direction that mediates trained harmful-content refusal. An in-domain behavior-defined invalidity-aware direction is closer to recognition, but only partially aligned with it, and remains near-orthogonal to safety refusal. Generation-time steering along the recognition direction changes invalidity-aware behavior bidirectionally and dose-responsively on structural math and code cells, while random directions do not. Base/instruct comparisons further show that the low-cosine geometry is already present at the pretraining endpoint. The confident-on-impossible failure is therefore better explained as a routing failure than as an encoding failure: the model has a usable "no admissible answer" signal, but the safety-refusal pathway is not aligned to use it.

</details>


### [300] [HEAR Who Said What: Unlocking Speaker-Attributed Reasoning via Counterfactual Voice Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29120)
*Dongwook Lee,Sangkwon Park,Eunwoo Song,Che Hyun Lee,Youngho Cho,Junho Kim,June Young Yi,Heeseung Kim,Sungroh Yoon*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出HEAR基准测试，用于诊断语音语言模型(SLM)在多说话人环境下的说话人归因推理能力，并提出了A2R模型，通过在反事实音频和说话人级别硬负样本上训练，使模型优先关注声学线索而非语言先验，从而显著提升说话人归因和推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SLM越来越多地部署在多说话人环境中，但其将语音正确归因给说话人并基于说话人身份进行推理的能力尚不明确。现有模型往往依赖语义先验而非真实的声学线索，缺乏系统性的基准测试来诊断这一核心能力。

Method: 1) 构建HEAR基准：包含2.4K人工验证样本、887个多样化多说话人音频片段，从概念层次上诊断说话人归因推理能力。2) 提出A2R模型（30B参数），在CASH（反事实音频+说话人级别硬负样本）数据集上优化，引导模型优先利用声学声音线索而非语言信号。3) 通过反事实设计和说话人级硬负样本训练，迫使模型真正区分说话人身份。

Result: 在20个领先SLM上的评估显示它们在这些基础任务上表现不佳，往往依赖语义先验。A2R在HEAR上取得强性能，并在多种多说话人下游任务上展现出零样本泛化能力。

Conclusion: 学习到的说话人归因能力可以解锁模型潜在的说话人感知推理能力，验证了以声学线索优先的训练策略对提升SLM多说话人环境推理的有效性。

Abstract: Speech Language Models (SLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-speaker environments, yet their ability to attribute speech to the correct speaker and reason over speaker identities remains unclear. Hence, we introduce HEAR, a conceptually hierarchical benchmark diagnosing the foundational capabilities of speaker-attributed reasoning, comprising 2.4K human-verified samples from 887 diverse multi-party audio clips. Evaluating 20 leading SLMs on HEAR reveals they struggle with these foundational tasks, often relying on semantic priors rather than actual vocal cues. To address this, we present A2R, a 30B model optimized on Counterfactual Audio with Speaker-level Hard negatives (CASH), a dataset designed to guide the model to prioritize acoustic vocal cues over linguistic signals. A2R achieves strong performance on HEAR and exhibits zero-shot generalization to diverse multi-speaker downstream tasks, demonstrating that learned speaker attribution unlocks the model's latent capacity for speaker-aware reasoning. All resources are available at https://attributetoreason.github.io/AttributeToReason/

</details>


### [301] [AI Historian: Helping historians organize and verify person-centred temporal clues from dispersed historical narratives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29133)
*Yifeng Lu,Zijie Yang,Jie Li,Qingkai Min,Yue Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了AI Historian (AIH)，一个帮助历史学家从分散的传记叙事中整理人物-时间证据的AI代理系统。该系统以源句子为证据单元，识别人物与时间线索，验证跨文本关联并推断可比较的时间范围，同时保留可追溯的源文本证据。在《史记》六个案例中，AIH的时间定位MicroIoU达86.2%（人类标注81.3%，直接LLM提示仅17.1%），耗时约14分钟（人类标注需1小时32分钟），并已应用于二十四史及其他东亚历史文献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 历史记录并非以完整连续的形式保存，人物活动、关系与历史背景分散在不同文本、章节和叙事视角中。历史学家必须检索、识别和比较这些材料来重建时间序列并验证来源，这一过程费时费力，亟需自动化工具辅助。

Method: AIH采用AI代理系统架构，将源句子作为证据单元，自动识别其中的人物与时间线索，验证候选的跨文本关联，并推断可比较的时间范围，同时确保保留可追溯的源文本证据以供核验。

Result: 在《史记》六个案例（涉及刘邦、项羽、萧何）中，AIH的时间定位MicroIoU为86.2%，优于人类标注的81.3%和直接LLM提示的17.1%；耗时约14分钟，远低于人类标注的1小时32分钟。系统已成功应用于二十四史及其他古代中日韩历史与现代历史材料。

Conclusion: AIH能够以更低成本大规模整理历史材料，将因章节叙事而割裂的关联转化为可追溯、可修订的研究问题，供协作验证，有效降低历史研究的组织成本。

Abstract: History is not preserved in complete, continuous form. Accounts of a person's activities, relationships and historical contexts are scattered across texts, chapters and narrative perspectives; historians must retrieve, identify and compare these materials to reconstruct temporal sequences and verify them against sources. Here we present AI Historian (AIH), an AI agent system that helps historians organize person-time evidence from dispersed biographical narratives. It takes source sentences as evidence units, identifies people and temporal cues, verifies candidate cross-text associations and infers comparable temporal ranges while preserving traceable source-text evidence. We evaluated AIH on six Shiji cases concerning Liu Bang, Xiang Yu and Xiao He. AIH Agent achieved a temporal-localization MicroIoU of 86.2%, compared with 81.3% for human-only annotation and 17.1% for direct large-language-model prompting; it required about 14 min, versus 1 h 32 min for human-only annotation. We further applied AIH to the Twenty-Four Histories and other ancient Chinese histories, ancient Japanese and Korean histories, and modern and contemporary historical materials, and released the results through Westlake Historian. These results indicate that AIH can reduce the cost of organizing historical materials at scale while turning connections obscured by chapter-based narration into traceable, revisable research questions for collaborative testing.

</details>


### [302] [Quantifying Error Tolerance in Synthetic Data: An Atomic-level Operand vs. Operator Perturbation Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29144)
*Jiaxiang Liu,Chenhao Yuan,Shuwen Xu,Boxuan Xing,Xiusheng Huang,Yinhao Xu,Hao Liu,Wenhao Teng,Xiangwen Liao,Pengfei Cao,Jun Zhao,Kang Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出ATOM框架，将合成数据分解为函数单元f(x)→y，区分良性操作数x扰动与致命操作符f扰动，通过优先关注操作符多样性而非操作数精度，使合成数据在多个基准上表现更优（如相比LIMA提升3.1%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成数据生成对大型语言模型至关重要，但缺乏对错误容忍度的定量分析成为关键瓶颈。现有过滤策略存在两难：过于激进会排除有价值样本，过于宽松则无法有效剔除错误样本。

Method: 提出原子树操作建模（ATOM）框架，将数据分解为功能单元f(x)→y。该框架区分良性操作数x扰动（可被容忍）与致命操作符f扰动（会导致模型崩溃），并据此指导数据过滤与合成策略。

Result: 实验揭示双重分离现象：模型对操作数扰动具有鲁棒性，但在操作符扰动下会崩溃。通过优先操作符多样性而非操作数精度，ATOM合成数据在严格基准上表现更优，相比LIMA提升3.1%。

Conclusion: 操作符多样性比操作数精度更重要，ATOM框架通过精准区分两类扰动，为合成数据的过滤策略提供了更合理的替代方案。

Abstract: Synthetic data generation has become a cornerstone for advancing large language models. However, the lack of the quantitative analysis for error tolerance became a critical bottleneck. Consequently, current filtering strategies fluctuate between two extremes: they are either overly aggressive, risking the exclusion of potentially valuable samples, or overly permissive, failing to eliminate erroneous samples effectively. To bridge this gap, this paper introduces Atomic Tree Operation Modeling (ATOM), a framework that decomposes data into functional units ($f(x)\rightarrow y$). ATOM distinguishes benign Operand $x$ perturbations from fatal Operator $f$ perturbations. The former are needlessly discarded by aggressive filtering, while the latter slip through permissive filtering. Our experiments reveal a double dissociation: models are robust to operand perturbations but collapse under operator perturbations. By prioritizing operator over aggressive operand precision, our ATOM-synthesized data outperforms rigorous baselines (e.g., +3.1% gain over LIMA), suggesting that operator diversity matters more than operand precision. Our code is available at https://github.com/Lut-hub/ATOM.

</details>


### [303] [Toward a Cross-Lingual Romanization Ecosystem for Sinitic Languages: A Paired Mandarin-Cantonese Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29170)
*Zijie Zhang,Tan Lee,Yong Cao,Benyou Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"汉语方言罗马化生态系统"（Sinitic Romanization Ecosystem），一个跨语言汉语方言罗马化设计方案及其配套数字基础设施与开源社区工作流。通过四条设计原则（音系对应、历史音韵对应、一音一符、基本拉丁字母使用）实现跨方言罗马化的系统对齐。以粤语（CantRomZJ1）和普通话（MandRomZJ1）为主要案例，并推广至客家话、上海吴语和南京江淮官话。实验表明基于该框架的方案相比Pinyin+Jyutping基线，在语音转罗马化任务中粤语WER降低7.80%、CER降低10.61%，验证了跨语言罗马化对齐能改善低资源汉语方言语音技术的迁移效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有各汉语方言的罗马化方案（如拼音、粤拼等）缺乏系统性跨语言对齐，导致不同方言之间的罗马化字符串无法关联对应，难以利用数据资源较丰富方言（如普通话）的知识来帮助低资源方言（如粤语）的语音处理任务。

Method: 提出包含四条设计原则的罗马化设计框架：1）音系对应（相似音用相似符号）；2）历史音韵对应（同源词罗马化字符串对齐）；3）一音一符；4）基本拉丁字母使用；并权衡这些原则间的冲突。基于此框架开发粤语和普通话罗马化方案及其他多种方言方案，同时构建开源基础设施（结构化存储、转换、解析、词典构建、输入法生成），最后通过MMS微调进行语音转罗马化实验评估。

Result: 在语音转罗马化实验中，MandRomZJ1+CantRomZJ1方案相比Pinyin+Jyutping基线，粤语词错误率（WER）降低7.80%，字符错误率（CER）降低10.61%，表明跨语言罗马化对齐显著改善了低资源汉语方言的语音技术表现。

Conclusion: 跨语言的系统性罗马化对齐设计能够有效促进低资源汉语方言语音技术中的知识迁移，该设计框架和开源基础设施为汉语方言的自然语言处理和语音技术研究提供了系统化的资源支撑。

Abstract: This paper proposes the Sinitic Romanization Ecosystem, a cross-lingual Sinitic romanization design framework with supporting digital infrastructure and a community-driven open-source workflow. The design framework addresses the lack of systematic cross-lingual romanization alignment among Sinitic languages through four design principles: phonetic correspondence for representing similar sounds with similar romanized symbols, historical-phonological correspondence for aligning cognate romanization strings, one-phoneme-one-symbol, and basic Latin-letter use, with a balancing consideration recognizing trade-offs among these principles. For the main paired case study, we devel-op CantRomZJ1 and MandRomZJ1, Cantonese and Manda-rin romanization schemes following the design framework, respectively. We also develop schemes for several other Sinitic languages, including Meixian Hakka, Shanghai Wu, and Nanjing Jianghuai Mandarin, following the same de-sign framework. To bring the romanization schemes into practical use, we develop open-source infrastructure for structured romanization storage, conversion, parsing, dic-tionary construction, and input-method generation. Finally, we evaluate the design framework through speech-to-romanization experiments based on Meta's Massively Mul-tilingual Speech (MMS) fine-tuning. Compared with the Pinyin+Jyutping baseline, our Man-dRomZJ1+CantRomZJ1 condition reduces Cantonese WER and CER by 7.80% and 10.61%, respectively. These results suggest that cross-lingual romanization alignment can improve transfer in low-resource Sinitic speech technology.

</details>


### [304] [Toward Cultural Alignment: Human-Centered Evaluation of Multimodal AI Stories Across Five African Communities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29209)
*Millicent Ochieng,Felermino D. M. A. Ali,Elizabeth A. Ankrah,Najeeb Gambo Abdulhamid,Migisha Boyd,Stephanie Nyairo,Mercy Muchai,Samuel Chege Maina,Aditya Vashistha,Anja Thieme,Jacki O'Neill*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过19位来自五个非洲社区的文化代表，采用混合方法（定量标注+定性焦点小组）评估AI生成的多模态故事的文化对齐程度，提出包含五类文化标记和八种错位机制的文化对齐分类法，并发现多模态LLM裁判在不同社区的可靠性和校准差异显著，主张"社区校准"的评估管线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI生成内容评估多关注技术质量（如连贯性、真实性），鲜少考虑文化对齐——即生成内容是否符合特定社区的生活实践、关系、语言、价值观和视觉期望。随着多模态生成模型普及，缺乏与文化语境对齐的评估方法可能导致生成内容对少数或边缘社区造成文化冒犯或失真。

Method: 采用社区扎根的混合方法评估：招募19位来自五个非洲社区的文化代表，结合定量注释（对生成内容的文化对齐进行评分）与定性焦点小组讨论（深入理解错位原因）；基于评估结果构建文化对齐分类法（五类文化标记、八种机制性错位）；进一步评估五种多模态LLM裁判，检验其能否规模化近似社区判断。

Result: 文化对齐不仅依赖可识别的文化标记本身，更取决于这些标记如何嵌入社会、语言、程序性和视觉语境中；LLM裁判的可靠性和分数校准在不同社区间差异很大，没有单一裁判能在全部五个社区中表现一致。

Conclusion: 应建立社区校准的评估管线：自动化裁判必须对照社区判断进行验证，以确定哪些场景可信任自动评估、哪些场景仍需人工审查；这为多模态生成内容的跨文化评估提供更负责任的实践路径。

Abstract: In this paper, we examine how well AI-generated multimodal stories align with the lived practices, relationships, language, values, and visual expectations of the communities they represent. We conduct a community-grounded mixed-methods evaluation with 19 culture representatives across five African communities, combining quantitative annotations with qualitative focus group discussions. We find that cultural alignment depends not simply on recognizable cultural markers, but on how those markers fit social, linguistic, procedural, and visual context. From these evaluations, we develop a taxonomy of cultural alignment comprising five broader cultural marker categories and eight recurring mechanisms of misalignment. We additionally evaluate five multimodal LLM judges to examine whether automated evaluation can approximate community-grounded judgments at scale. Judge reliability and score calibration vary substantially across communities, with no single judge performing consistently across all five settings. These findings motivate community-calibrated evaluation pipelines in which automated judges are validated against community judgments to determine where they can be trusted and where human review remains necessary.

</details>


### [305] [Attribute-Based Activation Steering of LLMs for Group-Specific Explanation Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29215)
*Leandra Fichtel,Janek Prange,Henning Wachsmuth*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于激活工程（activation engineering）的方法，通过计算目标群体特定的属性引导向量并将其添加到LLM内部激活中，实现对解释内容的细粒度操控，使其更贴合特定人群的背景和知识水平。实验表明，该方法在解释的针对性和事实性方面显著优于提示词工程和现有引导基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了让人们有效理解新主题，解释需要根据受众的背景和能力进行定制。然而，仅靠提示词（prompting）已被证明不足以生成此类解释，且缺乏其他计算方法，因此需要探索如何引导LLM为特定群体生成量身定制的解释。

Method: 该方法分两步：首先识别目标群体在解释风格和知识方面的群体特定属性；然后基于激活工程（activation engineering）计算基于属性的引导向量（steering vectors），在推理过程中将这些向量添加到LLM的内部激活中，实现细粒度的引导控制。

Result: 实验从解释的针对性和事实性两方面评估了引导效果，并通过不同目标群体的人类专家研究进行评估。与提示词工程和最新的引导基线方法相比，该方法能显著更好地将解释定制到目标群体，同时在很大程度上保持事实性。

Conclusion: 基于激活工程的引导方法是一种比提示词更有效的控制手段，能够在保持事实性的前提下，让LLM为特定目标群体生成更具针对性的解释，为个性化解释生成提供了新的技术路径。

Abstract: To effectively enable people to understand new topics, explanations should be tailored to their backgrounds and abilities. So far, prompting alone has been shown to be insufficient for creating such explanations and other computational methods are missing. Therefore, this paper investigates whether LLMs can be steered to generate explanations that are tailored to a specific group of people. To this end, we propose an approach that first identifies group-specific attributes in terms of explanatory style and knowledge of a specific target group. Building on activation engineering, it then computes attribute-based steering vectors and adds them to the internal activations of an LLM during inference to enable a fine-grained steering. In our experiments, we assess the steering effectiveness of our approach in terms of specificity and factuality of the generated explanations. Additionally, we evaluate the explanations in a study with human experts from different target groups. Compared to prompting and state-of-the-art steering baselines, our approach tailors the explanations significantly better to the target group while largely maintaining factuality.

</details>


### [306] [Anchoring Speech with Semantics: A Multimodal Adapter Mechanism for Automatic Speech Recognition in Low-Resource Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29239)
*Kuan-Tang Huang,Cheng-Yeh Yang,Chien-Chun Wang,Hung-Shin Lee,Hsin-Min Wang,Berlin Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SAMA-ASR，一种轻量级适配器机制，通过从辅助翻译中提取语义锚点并结合语音锚点来增强解码器，从而改善低资源语音识别。该方法在30小时语料（台湾闽南语、客家话）上优于声学基线、提示基线和纯语义翻译引导基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低资源ASR面临稀缺转录本导致的监督信号不足问题，目标侧生成的监督证据非常有限，现有方法难以充分利用辅助信息来改善识别性能。

Method: SAMA-ASR采用轻量级适配器机制，通过跨模态适配将解码器状态条件化于两类锚点：(1) 由辅助翻译导出的语义嵌入（语义锚点），(2) 语音嵌入（声学锚点）。该方法在token预测前结合话语级语义与语音证据。在评估时，语义锚点可由上游语音到文本翻译器自动生成，而非依赖oracle翻译。

Result: 在台湾闽南语和客家话两个30小时低资源数据集上的实验表明，SAMA-ASR优于声学基线、先验提示基线和纯语义翻译引导基线。在实际自动语义锚点设置下仍保持有效性；通过翻译器容量分析表明，紧凑型ST模型也能产出有用的语义锚点。

Conclusion: SAMA-ASR通过语义锚点与声学锚点的跨模态适配，有效缓解了低资源ASR中监督信号不足的问题，且可推广至类似的编码器-解码器多任务语音模型。

Abstract: Low-resource ASR remains difficult because scarce transcripts provide limited supervised evidence for target-side generation. To address this gap, we propose SAMA-ASR, a lightweight adapter mechanism that augments the decoder with semantic anchors from auxiliary translations and an acoustic anchor from speech; in principle, the mechanism can be applied to similar encoder--decoder multitask speech models. Through cross-modal adaptation, SAMA-ASR conditions decoder states on translation-derived semantic embeddings and a speech embedding, combining utterance-level meaning with speech-grounded evidence before token prediction. At evaluation time, these semantic anchors can be generated automatically by an upstream speech-to-text translator rather than supplied as oracle translations. Experiments on two 30-hour datasets covering the low-resource Sinitic varieties Taiwanese Hokkien and Hakka show that SAMA-ASR improves over acoustic, prior prompt-based, and semantic-only translation-guided baselines and remains effective in practical automatic semantic-anchor settings; translator-capacity analyses show that useful semantic anchors can be produced by a compact ST model.

</details>


### [307] [When Patients Cut In: Extending Clinical Conversational AI Safety to Interruptions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29241)
*Zachary Ellis,Spencer Hazel,Adam Brandt,Yajie Vera He,Ernest Lim,Jared Joselowitz*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文指出现实临床环境中患者会打断语音助手说话，导致级联架构（语音转文本→LLM→文本转语音）丢失临床必需内容，而现有基准几乎都假设患者耐心等待。作者提出基于转录本的打断恢复评估框架，将对话分析中的重叠类别转为三种操作化类型，并测试四种部署导向的非推理LLM配置，覆盖信息收集（病史采集）与信息提供（FAQ）两类场景。结果显示：信息提供场景中所有模型失败率上升；竞争性打断在FAQ场景下四个模型均产生30/30覆盖率失败；道歉标记对恢复效果影响不一致，甚至对某模型有反效果。因此打断鲁棒性不能用一个单一分数衡量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床语音助手已实际部署，真实患者会中途打断，导致级联架构中必要的临床内容在语音转文本环节丢失。然而现有临床对话式AI基准几乎都假定患者等待助手说完，忽视了打断导致的内容丢失问题，缺乏对这一实际部署风险的评估。

Method: 提出基于转录本（transcript-based）的打断恢复评估方法：将对话分析中的重叠类别操作化为三种类型（识别性、竞争性、过渡性子单元），在四个单元（信息收集与信息提供两个场景维度）中测试四种面向部署的非推理LLM配置，评分标准为助手是否保留临床必需内容，并引入道歉标记测试其影响。

Result: 信息收集单元中目标问题失败率因模型而异；信息提供单元中所有模型失败率均上升；竞争性FAQ打断导致四个模型全部产生30/30信息提供覆盖率失败（Wilson 95% CI: 88.6-100.0%），而基线仅0/30或4/30。道歉标记可改变数十个百分点的恢复率，但对不同模型影响不一致，甚至对某个模型反而降低恢复率。模型排名在不同单元间不一致。

Conclusion: 打断鲁棒性不能用单一分数衡量，评估必须基于内容、按单元分别报告，并与部署场景的实际打断画像相匹配。这为临床语音AI的评估和实践部署提供了重要指导。

Abstract: Clinical voice agents are now deployed in routine care, where real patients do not wait their turn: they interrupt. These systems typically use a cascaded architecture (speech-to-text -> LLM -> text-to-speech), so when a patient cuts the agent off mid-utterance, clinically required content can be lost even when the model handles cooperative transcripts well. Yet clinical conversational-AI benchmarks almost universally assume patients wait for the agent to finish, missing interruption-induced loss of required content. We present a transcript-based evaluation of interruption recovery, adapting conversation-analytic overlap categories into three operational types (recognitional, competitive, transitional sub-unit) and testing four deployment-oriented, non-reasoning LLM configurations across four cells spanning history-taking (information gathering) and FAQ (information provision), scored on whether the agent preserves the clinically required content. In the gathering cells, target-question failure varied across models; in the provision cells, where arms are directly comparable, failure rose for every model. Rankings differ across cells, and competitive FAQ interruption produced 30/30 provision-coverage failures for all four models (Wilson 95% CI: 88.6-100.0%; baseline 0/30 for three, 4/30 for Llama). A brief apology marker ("sorry to interrupt") shifts recovery by tens of percentage points, inconsistently across models, and for one it reduces recovery. Interruption robustness therefore cannot be a single score: evaluation must be content-grounded, reported per cell, and matched to the deployment's interruption profile.

</details>


### [308] [Large Language Models Systematically Favor Popular Options: Evidence and Mitigation Across MCQs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29257)
*Abdelrahman Abdallah,Mohammed Ali,Bhawna Piryani,Mahmoud Abdalla,Adam Jatowt*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出多选题中"流行度偏差"问题，通过PopMCQ基准控制选项流行度系统研究该现象，并提出PopDebias轻量级推理时校正方法，无需微调即可消除流行度先验，在22个开源LLM上取得最高54.1个百分点的准确率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多选题是评估LLM的标准格式，但选项的流行度会混淆评估结果——现代LLM系统性偏向流行但不正确的选项，且模型置信度保持很高，说明准确率崩溃时存在置信度校准错误，这一缺陷尚未被系统研究。

Method: 1) 构建PopMCQ基准，包含六种受控策略，在保持正确答案不变的情况下变化选项流行度；2) 提出PopDebias推理时校正方法，通过估计并从模型预测中去除流行度先验，仅需少量校准集拟合参数，无需微调，测试时无标签，计算开销可忽略。

Result: 在最对抗性设置下（所有干扰项比正确答案更流行），模型66%的时间选择流行但错误的答案。在22个开源LLM（0.5B至32B参数）上PopDebias表现出一致改进，在强流行度压力下准确率最高提升54.1个百分点。

Conclusion: 流行度偏差严重影响LLM多选题评估的公平性，但可通过轻量推理时校正有效缓解，为更可靠的多选评估和偏差消除提供了新工具。

Abstract: Multiple-choice questions (MCQs) are a standard format for evaluating large language models (LLMs), yet the popularity of answer options can confound evaluation. Modern LLMs systematically prefer popular but incorrect options over less popular correct ones, a vulnerability we call \textbf{popularity bias}. This pattern aligns with confidence miscalibration: model confidence remains high even as accuracy collapses for popular options. To systematically isolate this phenomenon, we introduce \textbf{PopMCQ}, a benchmark with six controlled strategies that vary option popularity while keeping the correct answer fixed. In our most adversarial setting, where all distractors are more popular than the correct option, models choose popular but wrong answers 66\% of the time. To mitigate this bias, we propose \textbf{PopDebias}, a lightweight inference-time correction that estimates and removes a popularity prior from model predictions. It requires no fine-tuning, is label-free at test time (using only a small calibration split for parameter fitting), and adds negligible computational cost. Experiments on 22 open-source LLMs (0.5B to 32B parameters) show consistent improvements, with accuracy gains up to 54.1 percentage points under strong popularity pressure. The code and data are available https://github.com/DataScienceUIBK/PopMCQ

</details>


### [309] [SHADOWBENCH: Toward Reliable Automatic Evaluation of Semantic Alignment in Autoformalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29270)
*Hojae Han,Jongyoon Kim,Sanghyuk Park,Dongwook Cheon,Myungjae Jeon,Sunjong Choi,Soonho Kong,Wonseok Heo,Seung-won Hwang,Donghoon Hyeon*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的自动形式化评估方法 SA-Pass（语义对齐通过），通过引入"影子"辅助命题来同时检验形式化语句的编译正确性和语义对齐性，并基于此构建了 Lean 4 全自动形式化基准 ShadowBench（178 道研究生至研究级数学问题）。实验表明该方法与专家判断达到 98.8% 的二元一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动形式化评估指标存在核心缺陷：类型正确但语义不对齐的语句可能被误接受，而表述不同的正确语句可能被误拒绝。传统编译率无法捕获语句与原始定理的语义匹配度，需要一种能同时验证语句正确性和语义对齐性的评估方法。

Method: 受 Pass@k 启发提出 SA-Pass 指标：利用一组称为"影子"的辅助命题刻画目标语句的预期语义。评分规则为：生成语句需同时满足（1）编译通过；（2）正向检查——能够推导出每个影子命题；（3）反向检查——所有影子命题的合取能够推导出该生成语句。基于此构建 ShadowBench 基准，包含 178 道 Lean 4 形式化问题，覆盖八个数学领域。

Result: Claude Code (Opus 4.8) 配合 Numina-Lean-Agent 在 ShadowBench 上达到 61.8% 编译率和 11.2% SA-Pass。在六种智能体配置生成的输出上，SA-Pass 与专家判断达到 98.8% 的二元一致性。

Conclusion: SA-Pass 提供了一种比单纯编译率更可靠的自动形式化评估范式，通过双向影子检查机制有效区分语义对齐与不对齐的形式化结果。ShadowBench 作为该方法的实例化基准，已被采用为 ICML 2026 AI4Math Challenge Track 4 的官方基准，验证了其在社区中的实用价值。

Abstract: Autoformalization translates informal mathematical theorems into code for proof assistants such as Lean. A central challenge is that current evaluation metrics can accept type-correct but misaligned statements or reject correct statements written in a different formulation. Inspired by Pass@$k$, we propose SA-Pass (*Semantic Alignment Pass*), which tests formal statements using auxiliary statements called *shadows* that characterize the intended statement. A generated statement receives full credit only when it compiles, implies each shadow (forward check), and is implied by their conjunction (backward check). We instantiate SA-Pass in ShadowBench, a Lean 4 full autoformalization benchmark of 178 postgraduate- to research-level problems spanning eight mathematical areas. Claude Code (Opus 4.8) with Numina-Lean-Agent reaches $61.8\%$ compile rate and $11.2\%$ SA-Pass. Across outputs generated by six agentic configurations, SA-Pass achieves $98.8\%$ binary agreement with expert judgments. An early version of ShadowBench served as the benchmark for Track 4 of the ICML 2026 AI4Math Challenge.

</details>


### [310] [Modality Fault Lines: Structural Corruptions Reveal Fragile Omni-Modal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29278)
*Zhaolu Kang,Meixin Wu,Yu Xue,Yingjie He,Qiming Shi,Lei Wei,Yidi Wang,Richeng Xuan,Zhichao Hu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SCEval（结构破坏评估）协议，通过在保持问题、答案空间和模态通道不变的前提下，对文本、视觉和音频模态施加受控结构破坏，揭示全模态大语言模型在跨模态证据结构不稳定时的行为脆弱性。实验表明，干净准确率不能保证模型在结构性不可靠的跨模态证据下依然可靠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全模态大语言模型评估仅在干净的文本-视觉-音频输入上进行，无法判断模型成功是依赖稳定的跨模态结构，还是仅依赖完整输入中的浅层线索。需要一种诊断方法来识别模态故障线，即模型在模态仍存在且可解释但其内部证据结构被扰动时行为不稳定的边界。

Method: 提出SCEval诊断评估协议，固定问题、答案空间和模态通道，对文本、视觉和音频单独及联合施加受控结构破坏。使用来自Social-IQ、OmniBench和VALOR的273个人工验证的三模态示例，评估15个专有和开源全模态系统。

Result: 结构破坏会降低干净准确率；文本-视觉损伤构成最稳定的共享故障线；多模态退化是非加性的，而非损坏模态数量的简单函数。干净全模态准确率不能证明模型在跨模态证据结构不可靠时仍能保持可靠性。

Conclusion: 干净的全模态准确率并不能确立模型在跨模态证据变得结构不可靠时仍能保持可靠，因此需要将结构鲁棒性纳入全模态系统的评估标准。

Abstract: Omni-modal large language models are increasingly evaluated on clean text--vision--audio inputs, where every channel is present, synchronized, and readily interpretable. Such scores are often taken as evidence of robust cross-modal fusion, but clean evaluation cannot tell whether success depends on stable cross-modal structure or on cues sufficient only in intact inputs. To address this gap, we define a modality fault line: a boundary at which model behavior becomes unstable when a modality remains present and human-interpretable, but its internal evidence structure is perturbed. We introduce SCEval (Structure-Corruption Evaluation) a diagnostic evaluation protocol that keeps the question, answer space, and modality channels fixed while applying controlled structural corruptions to text, vision, and audio individually and jointly. Built from $273$ human-verified tri-modal examples from Social-IQ, OmniBench, and VALOR, SCEval evaluates $15$ proprietary and open-source omni-modal systems. The results show that structural corruption lowers clean accuracy, text--vision damage forms the most stable shared fault line, and multi-modal degradation is non-additive rather than a simple function of the number of corrupted modalities. Clean omni-modal accuracy therefore does not establish that a model will remain reliable when cross-modal evidence becomes structurally unreliable.

</details>


### [311] [Cloud and On-Premises Deployment of Uzbek Legal RAG via Targeted Retriever Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29284)
*Tatul Danielyan,Mariam Avetisyan,Hrant Davtyan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文报告了为乌兹别克语构建和运营检索增强（RAG）法律助手的实践，该系统需在两种部署模式下运行：受每token成本上限约束的云端服务和受本地硬件与延迟限制的本地私有化部署。作者构建了检索和端到端两套领域基准，发现开源与专有模型差距很小且可通过微调低成本弥合，因此训练了UTE-1——乌兹别克语开源模型中SOTA的文本嵌入器，同时通过QLoRA负结果实验证明微调在长上下文法律问答场景中既不现实也非必要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用大模型排行榜无法反映法律问答在低资源语言和硬性运维约束下的真实挑战，且该领域此前缺乏针对乌兹别克语法律RAG系统的评估基准，导致部署决策缺乏依据。

Method: 构建两个领域基准：包含178条专家标注法律查询的检索基准，以及由504对专家整理的问答对、采用经人工评判和独立家族评判验证的LLM法官评分的端到端基准；在两个部署场景下进行系统评测，并结合QLoRA微调实验验证结论。

Result: 开源与专有模型在该任务上的性能差距很小且可通过微调廉价弥合；训练出UTE-1，成为乌兹别克语开源文本嵌入器的SOTA；QLoRA微调实验为负结果，证明长上下文法律问答的微调在硬件上不切实际且因法律频繁变更而不必要。

Conclusion: 为类似低资源语言的合规RAG部署提供了实用指导，并开源基准、评估代码和UTE-1嵌入器，以支持低资源法律NLP的后续研究。

Abstract: Deploying large language models for legal question answering raises challenges that general-purpose leaderboards do not capture, particularly for low-resource languages and under hard operational constraints. We report on building and operating a retrieval-augmented (RAG) legal assistant for Uzbek that must run in two regimes: a managed cloud service that maximizes answer quality within a per-token cost ceiling, and an on-premises deployment for clients whose legal data may not leave their infrastructure, restricting us to open-weight models on limited local hardware under latency constraints. Because no evaluation existed for this setting, we build two domain benchmarks: a retrieval benchmark of 178 expert-annotated legal queries with gold provision spans, and an end-to-end benchmark of 504 expert-curated question--answer pairs scored by an LLM judge whose ratings we validate against human judgments and against an independent-family judge. Applying these benchmarks under each regime, we find the open-versus-proprietary gap is small and cheaply closed by fine-tuning. Therefore, we train UTE-1, which is a state-of-the-art text embedder among open models for Uzbek. We also demonstrate that closing the performance gap via fine-tuning is both impractical due to the intensive hardware demands of long-context legal Q\&A and unnecessary, given that legal acts change frequently. We support this by reporting a negative result from a QLoRA experiment. We distill practical guidance for similar deployments, drawn from a system serving real users in production. We release our benchmarks, evaluation code and the fine-tuned embedder (UTE-1) \href{https://metric-ai-lab.github.io/Uzbek-Legal-RAG/}{at this https URL} to support future work on low-resource legal NLP.

</details>


### [312] [Learning Simple Test-Time Environments for LLM Web Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29305)
*Junxuan Li,Zijun Liu,Ziyi Huang,Peng Li,Yuzhou Liu,Ming Yan,Yang Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种测试时环境分解（TTED）方法，让LLM智能体在推理阶段通过试验步骤将复杂环境观测分解为子模块，并使用无标签学习方法从子环境中获取经验，从而提升其在真实复杂环境中的组合泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在人为构造的环境中表现优异，但在复杂真实场景中性能会显著下降。现有研究认为这是LLM在多个简单且结构化环境组合时的组合泛化差距所致，作者提出LLM智能体可以在测试时学习简单环境的观测来应对这一挑战。

Method: 引入试验步骤（trial steps）让智能体将复杂环境观测分解为子模块，并实现了一种无标签学习方法TTED（Test-Time Environment Decomposition），在推理过程中通过经验自适应地调整智能体行为。

Result: 在合成和真实基准上的实验表明：(1) 在较简单的子环境中获得的经验可以有效组合以提升整体环境的表现；(2) 子环境上的测试时训练能显著增强智能体在真实网络自动化任务中的组合泛化能力。

Conclusion: 随着LLM智能体面对越来越复杂的环境，在测试时学习环境分解技能对于真实世界中的稳健部署至关重要。论文还提供了无标签学习算法设计的关键见解。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in manually constructed environments, yet their performance frequently collapses when transitioned to complex real-world settings. Existing research largely attribute this degradation to the compositional generalization gaps in LLMs on combinations of multiple simple, well-structured environments. In this work, we propose that LLM web agents can learn simple environment observations at test time. Specifically, we introduce trial steps for agents to decompose a complex environment observation into sub-modules, and implement a label-free learning method, Test-Time Environment Decomposition (TTED), to adapt agent behaviors with experience during inference. Our empirical evaluations demonstrate the framework's efficacy across both synthetic and realistic benchmarks, showing (1) experience gains acquired within simpler sub-environments can be effectively composed to improve performance in the full one, and (2) test-time training on sub-environments can significantly enhance the compositional generalization of agents in real-world web automation tasks. We also provide key insights in the design of the label-free learning algorithm. As more complex environments are accessed by LLM agents, we believe learning environment decomposition skills at test time will be critical for robust real-world deployment.

</details>


### [313] [Detecting and Repairing Hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29307)
*Sai Krishna Reddy Mulakkayala,Niki van Stein,Aske Plaat*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究RAG系统中生成答案的事实修复策略。基于RAGTruth基准，将标记为不支持的答案拆分为事实性声明，并与三种修复策略（删除、替换、重写）进行比较。三种语言模型评估916个修复后的答案，发现所有策略都减少了无支持内容，其中删除策略效果最大（保留64.3%原文），重写保留最多文本（80.1%）但减少效果最弱。存在接地性保持的权衡而非质量排序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RAG系统即使检索文档仍会产生无支持的陈述，且读者无法区分接地与编造的内容。现有研究止步于检测，但标记错误答案对读者毫无帮助，需要明确检测后应采取何种修复行动。

Method: 使用手工标注不支持段落（无支持内容）的RAGTruth基准，将每个标记答案拆分为独立事实性声明，对照检索源逐条检查。比较不干预与三种修复策略：删除无支持声明、用源文替换、重写。使用三个不同家族的LM对916个修复后答案进行评判。

Result: 所有三种策略均降低了被判定含无支持内容的答案比例，三个评判模型排序一致。删除策略减少最多但保留原文最少（64.3%），重写保留最多（80.1%）但减少最少。83.5%的干净答案也被编辑，修复不限于有缺陷答案。

Conclusion: 不同修复策略占据接地性保持权衡曲线上的不同点，而非形成质量高下排序。选择何种策略需要关于答案有用性的证据，而这超出自动指标的能力范围。

Abstract: Language models increasingly answer questions by consulting retrieved documents rather than memory alone, a design now common in search assistants and enterprise knowledge tools. Grounding a model in retrieved text reduces unsupported statements but does not eliminate them, and a reader cannot tell a grounded sentence from an invented one. Most research on this problem stops at detection, yet flagging a faulty answer changes nothing for the person reading it, and little is known about which action should follow. Using RAGTruth, a benchmark whose unsupported passages are annotated by hand, we split each flagged answer into individual factual claims, check each against the retrieved source, and compare leaving the answer untouched with three repair strategies of increasing richness: deleting an unsupported claim, replacing it with source text, and rewriting it. Three language models from different families judge the 916 repaired answers. Every strategy reduces the proportion of answers judged to contain unsupported content, and all three judges agree on the ordering. Deletion achieves the largest reduction while retaining least of the original answer, at 64.3% of the text, whereas rewriting retains 80.1% and reduces least. Repair is not confined to faulty answers: 83.5% of answers annotated clean are edited too. The strategies occupy different points on a grounding preservation trade-off rather than forming a quality ranking, and choosing between them needs evidence about answer usefulness that automatic metrics cannot supply.

</details>


### [314] [All You Need Is Non-Commutative Words](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29314)
*Carla M. Quispe Flores,Stanley Salvatierra,Renan Cabrera*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出用酉矩阵表示词汇token，并将句子编码为这些矩阵的有序乘积。矩阵乘法的非交换性天然捕捉了词序信息，无需位置编码。该代数框架同时支持无查询/键/值投影的反对称自注意力、变长文本块的并行组合（降低注意力成本）、以及通过典型陪集读出层紧凑编码全部酉自由度。该方法还通过嵌套群扩展支持持续学习，每个新任务扩展算子空间且完全保留先前表示。在标准文本分类基准上，该方法匹配或超越词袋基线，在IMDB上取得更高精度，在AG News上表现相当，且仅用64参数实数编码取代约30000维词表空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统词嵌入方法（如词袋模型）忽略了词序信息，而基于位置编码的序列模型需要大量参数和高计算成本。作者希望找到一种既能天然捕捉词序、又具有参数效率的文本表示方法，同时支持持续学习和高效并行计算。

Method: 将每个词汇token表示为酉矩阵，句子编码为矩阵的有序乘积。利用矩阵乘法的非交换性替代位置编码捕捉词序；构建反对称自注意力机制（无需Q/K/V投影）；支持变长文本块并行组合；使用典型陪集读出层编码全部真实酉自由度；通过嵌套群扩展实现持续学习。

Result: 在标准文本分类基准上匹配或超越词袋基线，在IMDB上取得更高精度，在AG News上表现相当。关键亮点是仅用64参数实数编码取代约30000维词表空间，展示了参数化表达的效率。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，用低维酉矩阵代数表示文本在表达效率和词序捕捉上具有显著优势，为文本表示学习提供了新的数学框架，同时在持续学习方面展现出潜力。

Abstract: We represent lexical tokens as unitary matrices and encode each sentence as their ordered product. The noncommutativity of matrix product captures word order without positional encodings (PEs). The same algebra yields several capabilities, including antisymmetric self-attention with no query, key, or value projections, and parallel composition of variable-length text chunks at a reduced attention cost. Furthermore, it provides a canonical-coset readout layer that encodes all true unitary degrees of freedom compactly, while supporting continual learning through nested group extensions that enlarge the operator space with each new task preserving prior representations exactly. Across standard text-classification benchmarks, the method matches or exceeds bag-of-words baselines. Achieving higher accuracy on IMDB and comparable performance on AG News. Notably, this is accomplished by replacing the conventional $\sim$30,000-dimensional vocabulary space with a dense, 64-parameter real-valued encoding, highlighting the expressive efficiency of our parameterization.

</details>


### [315] [Padārtha: Ontology-Grounded Fine-Grained NER Benchmark for Classical Sanskrit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29324)
*Sujoy Sarkar,Pretam Ray,Paramhans Shah,Manoj Balaji Jagadeeshan,Akash Gairola,Arjuna S R,Pawan Goyal*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了Padārtha，第一个基于本体论的细粒度梵语命名实体识别（NER）基准数据集，构建于《摩诃婆罗多》史诗之上。该基准的标签集源自印度古典本体论系统Nyāya-Vaiśesika，包含18个细粒度类别、10个本体节点，并映射到5个标准粗粒度标签以保持互操作性。数据集包含108,335个实体提及（73,632诗句），以及5,000诗句的专家验证测试集。论文首次系统比较了生成式NER与传统架构在梵语上的表现，发现微调的生成模型与传统系统性能相当，但所有系统从粗粒度到细粒度都表现显著下降，且对训练中未见过的实体泛化能力差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有NER标注模式并非中立：为现代新闻文本设计的标签集应用于古典文学时，会强加源文化定义。作者主张应将模式植根于文本自身的传统之中，因此引入基于印度古典本体论系统的标注方案来适配梵语史诗文本。

Method: 1) 从Nyāya-Vaiśesika古典印度本体论系统推导出18个细粒度类别，组织在10个本体节点下，并映射到5个标准粗粒度标签；2) 专家标注者从学术索引中标注12.6K+命名实体条目，链接到Mahānāma语料库中的提及，生成73,632诗句中的108,335个命名实体提及的细粒度标注；3) 构建5,000诗句的专家验证测试集，专门采样以强调稀有提及；4) 对生成式NER与传统架构进行首次系统性基准测试比较。

Result: 微调的生成式模型与传统任务特定系统表现相当。但所有系统在从粗粒度到细粒度转换时性能显著下降，并且难以处理训练中未见的实体提及。研究发现这一局限性不仅仅源于数据稀缺：微调模型对未见实体的召回率远低于已见实体，并且在词汇歧义下倾向于默认为主要义项。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，基于文本自身传统构建本体论标注模式是可行的，但当前所有NER系统在处理梵语古典文本的细粒度识别和未知实体泛化方面仍存在重大挑战，需要进一步改进。

Abstract: Annotation schemas are not neutral. When applied to classical literature, tag sets developed for modern journalistic texts impose source-culture definitions on texts they were never designed to describe. We instead ground a schema in the tradition of the text itself introducing \textit{Padārtha}, the first ontology-grounded fine-grained Named Entity Recognition (NER) benchmark for Sanskrit, built on the \textit{Mahābhārata} epic. Our tag set derives from \textit{Nyāya-Vaiśesika}, a classical Indian ontological system, yielding 18 fine-grained categories organized under 10 ontological nodes and mapped onto five standard coarse tags, ensuring interoperability with existing benchmarks. Expert annotators label over 12.6K entries from a scholarly index of named entities, linked to corresponding mentions in the \textit{Mahānāma} corpus, producing fine-grained annotations for 108,335 entity mentions across 73,632 verses, along with a 5,000-verse expert-verified test set sampled to stress rare mentions. We present the first systematic benchmarking of generative NER against traditional architectures for Sanskrit, finding that fine-tuned generative models perform comparably to task-specific systems. However, all systems show a sharp decline from coarse to fine granularity and struggle with out-of-entity mentions unseen during training. The limitation is not due to data scarcity alone, as fine-tuned models recall unseen entities far worse than seen ones and tend to default to the majority sense under lexical ambiguity.

</details>


### [316] [StageWell: A Process-Aligned Chinese Corpus for Positive-Psychology Support Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29326)
*Yuxiong Wang,Ziwei Lin,Bo Wang,Yu Zhang,Shiguang Ni*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出StageWell，一个面向积极心理学对话的过程对齐中文语料库，以及HQS结构化数据构建与评估协议。StageWell将支持过程组织为六个阶段，采用多智能体整轮对话重写流程构建了12,445条SFT实例、1,849个DPO偏好对及120条专家修订对话。在四个9B-14B开源LLM上验证，该方法在过程控制、响应质量和安全性上均取得稳健提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有积极心理学对话资源将监督简化为单轮策略标签或整体偏好标签，隐含了过程位置、支持功能和局部修复目标，缺乏对多轮支持过程的结构化建模，导致模型难以产生连贯的阶段性支持。

Method: 提出StageWell语料库和HQS协议：将支持过程组织为六阶段结构；采用多智能体整轮对话重写工作流构建SFT实例和DPO偏好对；DPO对以过程局部修复方式构建——将有缺陷的模型输出作为拒绝响应，在同一上下文和阶段约束下定向重写为选择响应。

Result: 在四个9B-14B开源LLM上，平均BERTScore提升0.037，Q-Overall提升1.32分，S-exact提升0.236，H-critical率降低0.167，在过程控制、响应质量和安全性方面均取得稳健增益。

Conclusion: 将支持性对话建模为结构化的多轮支持过程而非单轮响应生成，能够显著提升模型在积极心理学对话中的表现，验证了过程对齐监督的价值。

Abstract: Positive psychology dialogue aims to support emotional distress and positive resource building, requiring models to produce not only empathetic replies but also coherent progression through a multi-turn support process.
