Existing resources often reduce supervision to turn-level strategies or holistic preference labels, leaving process position, support function, and local repair targets implicit. We introduce StageWell, a process-aligned Chinese corpus for positive psychology dialogue, together with HQS, a structured protocol for data construction and evaluation. StageWell organizes support into a six-stage support process and uses a multi-agent whole-dialogue rewriting workflow to construct 12,445 SFT instances, 1,849 DPO preference pairs, and a GroundTruth subset of 120 expert-revised dialogues and 977 QA pairs. Guided by HQS, DPO pairs are built as process-localized repairs: flawed model outputs are used as rejected responses, and targeted rewrites under the same context and stage constraint are used as chosen responses. Across four 9B-14B open-source LLMs, this supervision yields robust gains in process control, response quality, and safety. Averaged across models, BERTScore improves by 0.037, Q-Overall increases by 1.32 points, S-exact increases by 0.236, and the H-critical rate decreases by 0.167. These results highlight the value of modeling supportive dialogue as a structured multi-turn support process rather than as single-turn response generation.

</details>


### [317] [When to Adapt: Conditional Memory Adapters for Retention-Preserving Domain Specialization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29327)
*Jiayu Hou,Lei Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Engram Adapter框架，将预训练时的条件记忆重新用作冻结大语言模型的事后适配器。通过多通道n-gram模式匹配和占用追踪作为选择性先验，加上可学习的标量门控抑制不连贯的OOD检索，在提升域内性能的同时保留99.4%-100.1%的OOD性能，实现了保留记忆的模块化领域特化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有参数高效微调方法通常是"始终开启"的，其学习到的扰动会应用到每个输入上，导致域外(OOD)性能下降。需要一种能在提升领域内性能的同时不牺牲通用能力的适配方法。

Method: Engram Adapter框架：1) 将预训练时的条件记忆重新用作冻结LLM的事后适配器；2) 使用多通道匹配本地n-gram模式并显式追踪占用率作为轻量级选择性先验；3) 对域内输入增加残差注入的可能性，同时用可学习的标量门控抑制不连贯的OOD检索。

Result: 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B上评估，使用AG-News和MedMCQA作为适配任务。Engram Adapter提升了域内准确率，同时保留了99.4%-100.1%的平均OOD性能；在LegalBench上平均略微超过冻结基座模型，而可比的始终开启基线性能急剧下降。机理分析显示OOD残差被衰减到隐状态范数的约0.08%，产生很小的KL漂移和可忽略的准确率变化。

Conclusion: 条件激活是朝向模块化、保留记忆的领域特化冻结主干模型的有前景路线，既能提升域内性能又不牺牲通用能力。

Abstract: Large language models deployed in specialized domains must improve in-domain performance without sacrificing general capabilities. Existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods are typically always on: their learned perturbations are applied to every input, which can degrade out-of-domain (OOD) performance. We propose Engram Adapter, a framework that repurposes pretraining-time conditional memory as a post-hoc adapter for frozen LLMs. It uses multi-channel matching over local n-gram patterns with explicit occupancy tracking as a lightweight selectivity prior, making residual injection more likely on in-domain inputs while a learned scalar gate suppresses incoherent OOD retrievals. We evaluate on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B with AG-News and MedMCQA as adaptation tasks and OOD benchmarks spanning reasoning, translation, code generation, and legal reasoning. Engram Adapter improves in-domain accuracy while preserving 99.4%--100.1% of average OOD performance; on LegalBench it slightly exceeds the frozen base model on average, whereas comparable always-on baselines degrade sharply. Mechanistic analyses show that although OOD activations are non-zero, gate and projection attenuation reduce residuals to approximately 0.08% of hidden-state norm, yielding small KL drift and negligible accuracy change. These results suggest conditional activation is a promising route toward modular, retention-preserving domain specialization over frozen backbones.

</details>


### [318] [Arabic Safety Alignment as Selective Refusal: An Empirical Study of SFT, DPO, and Guard Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29378)
*Mohamad Zbib,Ammar Mohanna*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对阿拉伯语大语言模型的安全拒绝（refusal）行为提出双维度评估框架——良性拒绝率B与有害提示拒绝率H，强调单一拒绝率指标会掩盖两者间的权衡。作者在五个阿拉伯语模型、130次运行、完整人工编写的AraSafe数据集上系统比较了仅拒绝监督微调（SFT）、混合SFT、DPO及推理护栏等干预手段，发现仅拒绝SFT会导致全盘拒绝的坍塌，而精心选择的混合SFT配置可在B=14%-23%时达到H=90%-93%。同时通过300条响应盲审验证注解一致性，并发现从现代标准阿拉伯语到阿拉伯方言（Arabizi）只有部分迁移效果。研究最终主张采取模型特定的工作点选择策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全评估普遍使用单一拒绝率衡量模型安全行为，但这无法区分模型是合理拒绝有害提示，还是过度拒绝无害或敏感提示。对阿拉伯语这种低资源语言而言，尤其缺乏对"拒绝不充分与拒绝过度"之间权衡的系统量化研究，导致了安全性与可用性之间无法精确管控。

Method: 采用双指标框架：良性拒绝率B（衡量对无害提示的过度拒绝）与有害提示拒绝率H（衡量对有害提示的拒绝而非有害顺从）。在五个阿拉伯语能力模型上对完整人工编写的AraSafe集进行130次运行，比较仅拒绝SFT、混合SFT、DPO和推理护栏等多种干预策略，并通过300条响应的盲审、双变量可靠性指标kappa以及两模型（Qwen3Guard与Aya Expanse 32B）的准确率比较进行验证。

Result: 仅拒绝SFT会导致全盘拒绝坍塌；四种精选混合SFT配置在所有三次运行中均达到H=90%目标（B=14%-23%），Fanar模型在三次运行中两次达标。DPO与推理护栏并非统一升级，对不同模型改变B和H的方式各异。盲审中二值拒绝一致率89.0%（kappa=0.78），Qwen3Guard与Aya Expanse 32B准确率分别为88.7%和91.0%，无显著配对差异。所选SFT虽在所有五个模型上提升Arabizi的H值，但无一达到90%，说明从现代标准阿拉伯语的迁移不完整。

Conclusion: 建议采用模型特定的工作点选择策略：设定部署目标（目标H与可接受B），仅保留能同时改善该目标的干预措施，而非追求通用性的安全升级方案。研究同时揭示了单指标评估的局限，以及跨方言（MSA到Arabizi）安全拒绝迁移的不足。

Abstract: Arabic large language models must refuse harmful prompts without over-refusing benign or sensitive prompts, yet a single refusal rate hides this trade-off. We evaluate it using benign refusal B and harmful-prompt refusal H, where H measures refusal rather than harmful compliance. Across five Arabic-capable models and 130 runs on the full human-written AraSafe set, refusal-only supervised fine-tuning (SFT) collapses toward blanket refusal, whereas selected mixed-SFT configurations reach H = 90% to 93% at B = 14% to 23%; four selected configurations exceed the H = 90% target in all three runs, while Fanar does so in two of three. Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and inference guards change B and H differently across models rather than acting as uniform upgrades. In a blinded 300-response audit, annotator binary-refusal agreement is 89.0% (kappa = 0.78); Qwen3Guard and Aya Expanse 32B reach 88.7% and 91.0% accuracy, respectively, with no conclusive paired difference. Selected SFT raises H on Arabizi for all five models, but none reaches 90%, showing only partial transfer from Modern Standard Arabic. Overall, the results support model-specific operating-point selection: set a deployment target and retain only interventions that improve it.

</details>


### [319] [AlgoWorlds: Benchmarking Tool Use for Global Optimization in Algorithmic Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29397)
*Zixiang Xu,Jiaan Wang,Fandong Meng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 作者提出AlgoWorlds基准，将形式化的组合优化问题转化为部分可观测的决策环境，测试LLM代理能否通过工具收集信息后做出全局最优决策。240个环境覆盖10类组合优化问题，评估7个领先LLM，结果最优模型仅38.61%达到精确最优，多数失败为可行但次优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工具使用基准只评估代理能否用合适工具和有效参数完成工作流（可行性），但在路线规划、车队调度等真实决策场景中，个体选择通过共享约束和成本相互影响，可行解可能仍远非最优。因此需要回答更难的问题：代理能否将通过工具收集的信息转化为全局最优决策。

Method: 构建AlgoWorlds基准：将组合优化问题转化为部分可观测决策环境，每个环境含隐藏实例，仅能通过任务特定信息工具观测，代理最终提交一个结构化决策，同时评估可行性与最优性。共240个环境，覆盖10个组合优化族和4个工作负载级别。由确定性程序生成实例，精确算法验证最优值并确定工作负载级别，提供两种结构不同的工具界面。评估7个领先LLM（含Claude Opus 4.8和GPT-5.6 Sol）。

Result: 最优模型仅在38.61%的案例中达到精确最优；虽然大多数情况下模型能产出可行决策，但即使在代理收集到足够信息重建隐藏实例时，大多数失败仍是可行但次优的决策。

Conclusion: 全局最优决策对现有LLM仍极具挑战性，挑战不仅在于信息获取，更在于信息整合、全局约束推理和决策验证。

Abstract: Tool-use benchmarks generally evaluate whether an agent completes a workflow using appropriate tools and valid arguments. However, feasibility alone is insufficient in real-world decision settings such as route planning and fleet dispatch. Individual choices interact through shared constraints and costs, so a feasible solution may still be substantially suboptimal. This raises a harder question: can an agent turn information gathered through tools into a globally optimal decision? We introduce AlgoWorlds, a benchmark that transforms formally specified combinatorial optimization problems into partially observed decision environments with verifiable global optima. Each environment contains a hidden instance observed only through task-specific information tools, after which the agent commits to one structured decision evaluated for feasibility and optimality. AlgoWorlds contains 240 environments covering ten combinatorial optimization families and four workload levels. Family-specific deterministic programs generate the instances, exact algorithms certify their optima and determine workload levels, and two structurally different tool interfaces present each underlying instance. We evaluate seven leading LLMs, including Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.6 Sol. Achieving global optimality remains highly challenging: although leading models produce feasible decisions in most cases, the best-performing model reaches exact optimality in only 38.61% of cases. Even when agents collect sufficient information to reconstruct the hidden instance, most failures end in feasible but suboptimal decisions. The challenge therefore extends beyond information acquisition to information integration, global constraint reasoning, and decision verification. The project homepage is available at https://xzx34.github.io/AlgoWorlds/, and the code is available at https://github.com/xzx34/AlgoWorlds.

</details>


### [320] [Evaluating the Semantic Specificity of Representation Steering in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29431)
*Zhangdie Yuan,Andreas Vlachos*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Cross-Rule Transfer (CRT)诊断框架，用于审计大语言模型中局部表征引导（LRS）干预是否真正修复了推理电路。研究发现，针对矛盾盲视这一逻辑故障的late-layer LRS干预实际上只是注入了全局标签偏置，在模型本已正确的规则上（99.6%基线）施加干预后性能骤降至40.4%。作者通过四种互补对照实验验证了这一诊断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准的基准测试评估很容易被表面上的标签覆盖所欺骗，造成推理电路已被修复的虚假印象。需要一种更严格的诊断方法来区分真正的推理修复与表面的标签偏置。

Method: 提出Cross-Rule Transfer (CRT)诊断框架：在被干预模型原本就胜任的规则族上评估干预效果。并辅以四种对照实验：直接logit偏置等价性、控制向量标签翻转、跨模型嫁接、早期层引导检查。

Result: 针对矛盾盲视的late-layer LRS干预仅注入了全局标签偏置：在模型已能正确处理99.6%的规则上施加干预后，性能急剧下降到40.4%，说明干预迫使模型产生错误的矛盾预测，而非修复推理电路。

Conclusion: 提出了严格的诊断方法论，用于区分真正的推理电路修复与表面的标签覆盖，揭示了一类广泛使用的干预方法可能存在的根本性缺陷。

Abstract: Localized Representation Steering (LRS) is widely used to correct reasoning pathologies in large language models. However, standard benchmark evaluations can easily be fooled by superficial label overrides, creating a false impression of reasoning circuit repairs. In this work, we propose Cross-Rule Transfer (CRT), a diagnostic framework that audits representational interventions by evaluating them on rule families where the model is natively competent. Evaluating late-layer LRS for a widespread logical failure, contradiction blindness, reveals that the intervention merely injects a global label bias: applying the steering vector to rules the model already handles correctly (99.6% baseline) degrades performance to 40.4% by forcing false contradiction predictions. We support this diagnosis with four complementary controls (direct logit bias equivalence, control vector label-flipping, cross-model grafting, and early-layer steering checks), providing a rigorous methodology to distinguish genuine reasoning repairs from superficial label overrides.

</details>


### [321] [Whose Assessment of Distress? Community Perspectives and LLM Alignment on Well-Being Posts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29446)
*Andrew Aquilina,Xiang Lorraine Li,Yu-Ru Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究通过321名参与者对1198条Reddit帖子进行的视角主义标注研究，发现大语言模型（LLM）在心理困扰检测中对社区规范和视角的捕捉能力不足。开放权重模型系统性高估困扰程度（无至轻度困扰场景下准确率仅31-44%），且这种偏差源于模型本身过高的"困扰先验"，而非简单地反映局外人的阅读立场。GPT-5和Gemini 2.5 Pro也存在类似的高估问题，而Claude Opus 4则更为保守。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 心理困扰的判断本质上是社会情境化的——什么样的表现值得关注取决于社区对情绪表达、脆弱性和求助行为的规范。然而，用于困扰检测的大语言模型通常被对齐到一个单一的、无差异的标准上，可能无法捕捉被评估社区的真实视角。这一差距可能导致心理健康场景中AI部署的不公平。

Method: 采用视角主义（perspectivist）标注研究方法：招募321名参与者对1198条Reddit帖子（覆盖六个身份社区）提供9587条判断，生成社区特定标签。比较情境化的内群体标注者与未情境化的外群体标注者的一致性，随后评估九种开放权重LLM配置和四种前沿配置（GPT-5、Gemini 2.5 Pro、Claude Opus 4等）的表现。

Result: 情境化的内群体标注者比未情境化的外群体标注者更倾向于同意其社区判断（OR=1.18），但该效应在各社区间差异显著。开放权重LLM系统性高估困扰：在社区认为无至轻度困扰的情况下，准确率仅31-44%，以假阳性为主。GPT-5和Gemini 2.5 Pro同样存在此问题，Claude Opus 4更保守。未情境化的人类外群体聚合几乎对称（18%高估vs 19%低估），而高估困扰的模型展现出超过人类群体的困扰先验。

Conclusion: 当前LLM在心理困扰检测中系统性高估困扰程度，且该偏差并非简单地等同于人类局外人的视角，而是模型自身过高的困扰先验所致。这对心理健康领域AI的公平部署有重要影响——校准不良的困扰检测可能对不同社区产生不均等的负面影响。

Abstract: Judgments about psychological distress are socially situated: what counts as concerning hinges on community norms around emotional expression, vulnerability, and help-seeking. Yet large language models (LLMs) used for distress detection are typically aligned to a single, undifferentiated standard. How well do these models capture the perspectives of the communities whose language they assess? We address this question through a perspectivist annotation study in which 321 participants provided 9,587 judgments on 1,198 Reddit posts spanning six identity-based communities, yielding community-specific labels. Raters in the contextualized in-group condition show a modest tendency to agree more with their community than uncontextualized out-group raters (OR = 1.18), an effect varying significantly across communities. We then evaluate nine open-weight LLM configurations and four frontier configurations against these labels. Open-weight LLMs systematically over-estimate distress: when communities perceive none-to-mild distress, these models achieve only 31-44% accuracy, predominantly producing false positives. GPT-5 and Gemini 2.5 Pro show the same none-to-mild inflation even when their full-sample over/under rates are mixed, while Claude Opus 4 is more conservative. This pattern does not simply mirror an outsider reading position: uncontextualized out-group human aggregates were nearly symmetric, with 18% over-estimation versus 19% under-estimation. Instead, the models that inflate none-to-mild cases exhibit a distress prior that exceeds both contextualized in-group and uncontextualized out-group human judgments. These findings have implications for equitable AI deployment in mental health contexts, where miscalibrated distress detection may unevenly affect the communities being assessed.

</details>


### [322] [AI Can Be Easily Persuaded in Clinical Decision Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29453)
*Jiayuan Zhu,Jiazhen Pan,Fenglin Liu,Minhao Hu,Junde Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过受控实验研究AI在临床决策中是否容易被说服，发现专业权威、国籍背景、机构隶属、声称的过往表现、多位医生、支持的临床观点及重复施压都会影响AI决策，表明AI容易被言语内容、说话者身份及观点呈现方式所左右。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI在临床实践中日益普及并参与医疗决策，而医疗是高风险、循证领域，决策直接影响患者生命，因此理解AI是否能在他人的说服下保持客观判断至关重要。

Method: 通过受控实验系统性地研究AI被说服的难易程度，操纵多种说服变量（专业权威、国籍背景、机构隶属、声称的过往表现、多位医生、支持的临床观点、重复压力）来测量其对AI决策的影响。

Result: 同一说服输入来自资深临床医生比来自医学生时多改变约10%的决策案例；仅声称更好的表现历史就能持续提升说服力；更惊人的是，即使捏造支持错误答案的临床观点，也可能说服AI偏离正确决策。

Conclusion: AI容易被说服，且无法可靠地区分临床观点是否正确，因此必须确保AI在说服下保持稳健判断，以实现高风险医疗决策中的安全可靠使用。

Abstract: As AI becomes increasingly integrated into clinical practice, it is playing a growing role in medical decision making. Medicine, however, is a high stakes and evidence based field, where decisions can directly affect patients' lives. It is therefore important to understand whether AI can maintain objective judgment when others try to persuade it. In this paper, we study how easily AI can be persuaded through controlled experiments. We find that professional authority, national background, institutional affiliation, claimed past performance, multiple physicians, supported clinician views, and repeated pressure can all affect AI decisions. Surprisingly, the same persuasive input changes about 10% more cases when it comes from a senior clinician than from a medical student. Simply claiming a better performance history consistently makes the physician more persuasive. More strikingly, a plausible clinician view can persuade AI away from a correct decision even when it is fabricated to support an incorrect answer. This indicates that AI can be strongly influenced by convincing support without reliably determining whether this view from the clinician is correct. Together, these findings suggest that AI can be easily persuaded by what people say, who says it, and how the opinion is presented. Therefore, it is essential for AI to maintain sound judgment under persuasion, enabling its safe and reliable use in high stakes medical decision making.

</details>


### [323] [Item-Mean Surrogates: Why Richer Persona Data Fail to Improve LLMs as Human Surrogates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29455)
*Daehwan Ahn,Chengfeng Mao,Dokyun Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过涵盖40多万参与者、6000多个调查题项的四组数据集，系统检验了LLM作为人类替代品的可行性。研究发现LLM在聚合层面表现良好，能准确预测每个题项的平均人类反应，但仅能解释3.05%的个体差异变异（远低于人类53.6%的重测基准）。丰富的人物角色数据、模型变体和微调均无法缩小这一差距。LLM回应还会压缩人类反应分布，作者将此现象称为"题项均值替代"（item-mean surrogacy），并提出四项实证检验标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM越来越多地被用作人类替代品或探索工具，前提是更丰富的人物角色数据能使它们成为特定个体的替代品。作者希望实证检验这一前提是否成立，质疑LLM是否真能替代具体个体而非仅能预测群体平均水平。

Method: 使用四组数据集（超过400,000名参与者、6,000多个调查题项和实验结果），通过去除题项均值后的残差分析来衡量LLM预测个体特异性变异的能力，并与人类测试-重测基准（53.6%）进行比较。同时进行方差分析和分布形状比较，并测试丰富人物角色、模型变体和微调是否能缩小差距。

Result: LLM在聚合层面与人类平均反应高度一致，但去除题项均值后仅能解释3.05%的个体剩余变异，远低于53.6%的人类基准。方差分析显示，去除题项均值后最主要的可靠信号是"人×题项"交互效应（约为稳定个体效应的8.9倍），而人物角色数据虽编码了受访者信息，却无法捕获这种题项特异性的个体偏差。LLM回应还表现出更少的分布展布、更少的回应类别和扭曲的分布形态。

Conclusion: 当前LLM替代品只能近似题项平均值，无法替代个体人类所需的分布或受访者特异性偏差。作者提出"题项均值替代"概念，并给出四项实证测试以检验LLM作为人类替代品的主张。

Abstract: LLMs are increasingly used as human surrogates, often on the premise that richer persona data could make them substitutes or exploratory tools for specific individuals. We test this premise across four datasets covering more than 400,000 participants and more than 6,000 survey items and experimental outcomes. LLMs perform well at the aggregate level: their average responses closely align with average human responses to the same items. But this success largely reflects predicting each item's average human response. Once each item's human mean is removed, LLM predictions explain only 3.05% of the remaining respondent-specific variation, far below the 53.6% human test-retest benchmark. Richer personas, model variants, and fine-tuning do not close this gap. In variance analyses, once item means are removed, the reliable remaining signal is person-by-item. It captures how a respondent departs from the mean on a particular item and is about 8.9x larger than the stable person effect. Persona data encode the respondent, but not this item-specific deviation. LLM responses also compress human response distributions, using less spread, fewer response categories, and distorted distributional shapes. We call this pattern item-mean surrogacy. Current LLM surrogates can approximate item averages, but not the distributions or respondent-specific deviations needed to replace individual humans. We propose four empirical tests for LLM-based human-surrogate claims.

</details>


### [324] [Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness of Reasoning Models Varies with Where and How Preference Cues Are Delivered](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29464)
*Aryo Pradipta Gema,Neel Rajani,Rohit Saxena,Wai-Chung Kwan,Pasquale Minervini*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: FACE-Eval是一个包含5,100个样本的评估框架，用于测试模型思维链（CoT）监控的可靠性，特别是在偏好信息通过工具返回或原始工件传入而非用户消息时。研究测试了15个开源模型，发现所有模型对工具返回和隐式线索的语言承诺更低，而隐性采纳更高，且监控检测能力与隐性采纳呈负相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的CoT忠诚信度测试通常将明确的偏见线索放在用户消息中，但现实场景中智能体可能通过工具返回或原始工件获得偏好信息。作者旨在填补这一空白，系统评估当偏好信息以不同位置和显式程度到达时，CoT监控的可靠性是否会下降。

Method: 构建FACE-Eval数据集（5,100个样本），变化线索位置（用户消息或工具返回）和显式性（直接摘要或原始工件）。对15个开源模型（参数范围4B-1.60T）测量语言承诺和隐性采纳，并使用两个转录监控器检测偏好采纳情况。

Result: 所有模型对工具返回线索的语言承诺低于用户消息线索，对隐式线索低于显式线索。隐性采纳在15个模型中全部对工具返回更高，28/30模型-通道比较中对隐式线索更高。源归因提示在7个模型上缩小通道差距。两个监控器的检测能力与隐性采纳呈显著负相关（r=-0.54和r=-0.78）。

Conclusion: CoT监控在偏好信息通过工具返回或需从原始工件推断时可靠性较低。这提示现有的CoT监控方法在更贴近真实智能体应用场景中可能存在局限性，需要开发更鲁棒的监控策略。

Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring assumes that reasoning traces faithfully record the information that shapes a model's answer. Existing faithfulness tests often place explicit bias cues in the user message, while agents may encounter preferences through tool returns or raw artifacts. We introduce FACE-Eval (Faithful Attribution of Cue Effects Evaluation), a 5,100-sample evaluation that varies cue location (user message or tool return) and explicitness (direct summary or raw artifact). We measure verbalized commitment among cue-following answers and unverbalized adoption among all cued samples. We evaluate 15 open-weight models from eight families, with total parameters ranging from 4B to 1.60T. Every model has lower verbalized commitment for tool-return than user-message cues and for implicit than explicit cues. Unverbalized adoption is higher for tool-return cues on all 15 models and for implicit cues in 28 of 30 model-channel comparisons. A source-attribution prompt narrows the channel gap on seven models, sometimes by increasing user-channel unverbalized adoption, while telling models that their reasoning will be monitored does not reliably close the gap. We also use two transcript monitors (GPT-5.6-Luna and GPT-4o-mini) to detect preference adoption in the largest model of each family. Across 32 model-channel-explicitness cells, higher unverbalized adoption is associated with lower detection ability for both monitors (Pearson r=-0.54 and r=-0.78, respectively). These results suggest that CoT monitoring may be less reliable when preference information arrives through tools or must be inferred from raw artifacts, within the single-call, prefilled-tool setting tested here.

</details>


### [325] [MUDDLE: Measuring Understanding of Documents under Distractor and Length Effects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29477)
*Jason Luo,Saibilila Abudukelimu,Judy Song,Andrew Feng,Shivank Garg,Vasu Sharma,Kevin Zhu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出MUDDLE，一个受控基准测试，用于分离文档问答系统中两个常被混淆的失败因素：上下文长度与干扰文档的主题相似性。通过270个人工标注问题，每种问题在五种条件下实例化（仅源文档、源文档+2/4个主题相似硬负样本、源文档+2/4个长度匹配的随机干扰文档），发现硬负样本比长度匹配的随机文档更能降低gpt-5-mini的准确率，但效应较小且方向一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文档问答系统常因检索到多篇相关文档而失败，但先前工作混淆了"上下文过长"和"干扰文档过于接近主题"两种效应，难以诊断系统失败的根本原因。

Method: 构建MUDDLE基准：(1) 270个人工标注问题，每个问题绑定单一源文档；(2) 每种问题实例化为五种条件（源文档、源+2/4个硬负样本、源+2/4个随机干扰文档）；(3) 随机干扰文档与硬负样本在长度和来源上匹配；(4) 以markdown格式运行完整的干扰项扫描实验；(5) 使用LLM评判器在三个模型家族上评分。

Result: 在markdown完整干扰项扫描中，硬负样本在两种上下文大小下都比长度匹配的随机文档更降低准确率（以gpt-5-mini为例）；随机文档几乎保持无干扰基线水平。效应虽小但方向一致，且gpt-5-mini上硬负样本跨上下文大小合并时显著低于长度匹配的随机干扰项。

Conclusion: MUDDLE成功分离了上下文长度和主题相似性两种干扰效应，证明主题相似的硬负样本对问答性能的影响大于长度本身；并公开数据和代码以支持可复现的上下文退化研究。

Abstract: Document question-answering systems increasingly answer questions over collections of retrieved documents rather than one clean source, so robustness to distracting context matters as much as reading ability. When such systems fail, it is often unclear whether the context was too long or the distractors were too close to the topic, because prior work tends to conflate these two effects. We present MUDDLE, a controlled benchmark that separates them. MUDDLE uses 270 human-annotated questions, each tied to a single source document, and instantiates every question in five conditions: the source alone, the source with two or four topically similar hard negatives, and the source with two or four random distractors. The random distractors are matched to the hard negatives in length and provenance, so an accuracy gap between the two arms reflects topical similarity rather than length. All five conditions are rendered in markdown, page images, and raw PDF, but the distractor sweep reported here is run in markdown, since a source plus its distractors exceeds current image and PDF input limits. We score answers with an LLM judge across three model families. In the complete markdown sweep, hard negatives lower accuracy more than length-matched random documents at both context sizes for gpt-5-mini, while random documents stay near the no-distractor baseline. The effect is small but directionally consistent, and for gpt-5-mini hard negatives significantly underperform length-matched random distractors when pooled across context sizes. We release the data and evaluation code for a reproducible study of context degradation.

</details>


### [326] [SIC-Agents: Benchmarking and Building an Adaptive Simulator for Pediatric Serious Illness Communication Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29481)
*Zihan Wang,Anita Marie Slominska,Rennie Bimman,Elizabeth Di Flumeri,Amanda Mayappo-Neeposh,Conall Francoeur,Tamara Ellen Carver,Xiao-Wen Chang,Doina Precup,Esin Darici Haritaoglu,Ismail Haritaoglu,Akshatha Arodi,Naomi Goloff*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出首个专门针对儿科重症疾病沟通（SIC）训练的大语言模型模拟器基准套件与仿真框架。作者与教育工作者和儿科临床医生合作，构建了PitfallBench和DialogueBench两个基准，分别从回合级和完整对话层面评估模拟器，并提出了SIC-Agents自改进框架通过生成临床医生可编辑的技能文档来引导模拟器行为，实验表明其优于静态专家提示方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 儿科重症疾病沟通训练至关重要，但现有可扩展的沟通训练有限。相比其他对话模拟场景，儿科SIC面临多方交互、回应家长情绪困扰和依赖反馈动力学的额外挑战。现有LLM模拟器优化通用对话质量而非课程相关的行为，无法满足有效SIC训练需求。

Method: 与教育工作者和儿科临床医生合作，构建了PitfallBench和DialogueBench两个基准（分别评估回合级和完整对话层面），并提出SIC-Agents自改进框架，通过生成临床医生可编辑的技能文档来指导和引导模拟器行为。

Result: 实验表明SIC-Agents框架在模拟效果上优于静态专家提示方法，并已开源基准以便后续研究。

Conclusion: 作者为儿科SIC模拟器评估提供了首个专门基准，并提出能超越静态提示的自改进模拟框架，为儿科重症沟通训练的可扩展发展奠定了基础。

Abstract: Pediatric serious illness communication (SIC) is critically important, yet scalable communication training for clinicians remains limited. Compared with other dialogue simulation settings, pediatric SIC poses additional challenges, including multi-party interactions, response to parental distress and strong dependence on feedback dynamics. Existing LLM-based simulators optimize generic dialogue quality rather than curriculum-contingent behavior required for effective SIC training. In collaboration with educators and pediatric clinicians, we introduce the first benchmark suite and simulation framework tailored to pediatric SIC training. Our benchmarks, PitfallBench and DialogueBench, evaluate simulators both at the turn-level and across full dialogues. We further propose SIC-Agents, a self-improving framework that generates a clinician-editable skill document to guide simulator behavior. Our experiments show that SIC-Agents outperforms static expert prompting. To support future research, we release our benchmarks for parent simulation in pediatric SIC at https://github.com/Beikewzh/sic-benchmarks

</details>


### [327] [CoCoA: Context-Conditional Cultural Alignment for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29492)
*Kyungdon Lee,Wei Xu,Alan Ritter,Dong-Ho Lee,JinYeong Bak*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出CoCoA（上下文条件文化对齐）框架，通过双上下文训练让大语言模型在有文化线索时偏好文化适当实体，无文化线索时保持中性，在CAMeL和Camellia基准上将文化偏差分数从43降至24，同时保持接近中性的偏好水平（50.2）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统去偏方法追求统一中性，但文化偏差缓解需要上下文条件行为——有文化线索时偏好适当实体，无线索时保持中性。现有方法无法满足这一需求。

Method: CoCoA框架：1）在有无文化线索的上下文中对同一实体对进行双上下文训练；2）结合对比对齐目标、校准和漂移正则化；3）通过目标感知梯度调和优化。

Result: 在CAMeL和Camellia基准、十种语言设置和四个LLM上，CoCoA将文化偏差分数从43降至24（平均），保持接近中性的50.2偏好，同时对五个标准基准的通用性能影响最小。

Conclusion: 有效文化对齐需要上下文条件建模而非统一去偏，为缓解LLM中实体中心文化偏差确立了新方向。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often favor Western-associated entities across cultural contexts. Conventional debiasing methods aim for uniform neutrality, but cultural bias mitigation demands context-conditional behavior, preferring culturally appropriate entities when cultural cues are present and remaining neutral when they are absent. We propose CoCoA (Context-Conditional Cultural Alignment), a framework that learns this behavior through dual-context training on the same entity pairs under contexts with and without cultural cues. CoCoA combines a contrastive alignment objective with calibration and drift regularization, optimized through goal-aware gradient reconciliation. We evaluate CoCoA on CAMeL and Camellia, two entity-centric cultural bias benchmarks, across ten language settings and four LLMs. CoCoA reduces the Cultural Bias Score from 43 to 24 on average while maintaining near-neutral preferences at 50.2, with minimal impact on general performance across five standard benchmarks. These findings highlight that effective cultural alignment requires context-conditional modeling rather than uniform debiasing, and establish a new direction for mitigating entity-centric cultural bias in LLMs.

</details>


### [328] [LLM Judges as Raters: A Pre-Registered Audit of Severity, Halo, Reliability, and Version Instability in LLM Essay Scoring on Public Corpora](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29517)
*Veerendra Kumar Sunkavalli*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文对LLM作为作文评分员进行了系统性的"评分员效应"测试（类似心理测量学中对人类评分员的检验），在两种语言的公共语料（ENEM/Essay-BR与ASAP）上，使用12个评审、4个提供商、5个版本对比，发现LLM评分员存在严重的严重性偏差（高达219分）、与人类相关性低（.47-.56）、版本更新会导致严重性大幅漂移（最高133分），但预注册的两项假设检验（排行榜反转和静默漂移）均未通过置换零假设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文献几乎只用一致性统计量评估LLM作为作文评分器的表现，但教育测量学提醒我们，评分员还会在严重性（severity）、光环效应（halo）和漂移（drift）上存在差异。本研究希望将LLM视为评分员，用标准评分员效应测试来系统检验其可靠性。

Method: 采用预注册的评分员效应测试套件，包括：多面Rasch严重性分析、残差光环检验、概化理论/决策研究、跨版本漂移检验、差异功能分析。在两个公共语料库上运行，共2,377篇作文，12个LLM评审，4个提供商，5个版本对比，并释放为评分张量数据集。数据中嵌入身份金丝雀（identity canaries）以检测评审污染。

Result: LLM评审严重性跨度在ENEM 0-1000分制上达219分；ASAP上评审间分布占分数范围的15-33%，而训练过的人类评分员差距仅约1%。评审与人类相关性在低区分度的.47-.56区间。全部5个版本对比的严重性漂移超过族系置换零假设（最高133分），且一名评审在研究期间被淘汰。两个预注册测试返回诚实的零结果：基于严重性调整的排行榜反转未通过置换检验，"静默漂移"假设被驳斥（4/5的对比中一致性与严重性同步变化）。重复实验显示自一致性良好（phi>=.80，k<=2）但不达人类水平准确度。在控制仪器和校准后，没有可信证据表明LLM评审的光环效应超过训练过的人类评分员范围。

Conclusion: LLM评分员在一致性统计上看似可靠，但在评分员效应视角下存在严重不足：严重性偏差大、与人类弱相关、版本更新引发显著漂移。然而，严格检验也驳斥了一些悲观假设（无额外光环效应、无静默漂移），说明需以更严谨的心理测量学框架评估和规范LLM评分器。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as essay graders in learning analytics, evaluated almost exclusively with agreement statistics. Educational measurement warns that raters also differ in severity, show halo, and drift as instruments. We treat LLM judges as raters and run a pre-registered rater-effects battery (many-facet Rasch severity, residual halo, generalizability/decision studies, cross-version shifts, differential functioning) on public corpora in two languages (ENEM/Essay-BR; ASAP): 2,377 essays, 12 judges, 4 providers, 5 version contrasts, replicated cells, released as a score tensor. Judge severity spans 219 points on ENEM's 0-1000 scale; on ASAP the panel spread is 15-33% of the score range against a between-trained-human gap near 1%. Judge-human correlations sit in an undiscriminating .47-.56 band. All five version contrasts shift severity beyond a family-wise permutation null (up to 133 points), and one judge was deprecated mid-study, caught by identity canaries. Two pre-registered tests returned honest nulls: severity-adjusted leaderboard reversals did not survive a permutation null, and "silent drift" was refuted: agreement moved with severity in four of five contrasts. Replication yields self-consistency (phi>=.80 at k<=2) but not human-level accuracy, and a same-instrument check overturned our own halo comparison: matched on instrument and calibration, we find no credible evidence that judge halo exceeds the trained-human range.

</details>


### [329] [Ontology-Guided Multi-Agent Extraction of Evaluation Objects from Academic Review Texts: Evidence from Chinese Library and Information Science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29526)
*Haolin Chen,Hongyi Dong,Yu Zhu,Yijia Hong,Leiqing Niu,Jiyuan Ye*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种本体引导的多智能体框架，用于从学术评论、书评等评价性学术文本中提取评价对象实体。该框架结合候选发现、本体约束分类和领域审查三个模块，在实验中取得了90.33%的精确率、84.55%的召回率和87.34%的实体级F1值，显著优于基于规则和零样本的基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的科学实体提取方法主要针对研究论文，而对评价性文本中的评价对象（如理论、方法、文献、制度、政策等）提取效果不佳。这些评价对象往往抽象、依赖上下文、类型边界模糊，需要专门的提取框架。本研究的动机是为学术评价和科研评价提供结构化的证据支持，弥补现有方法在评价对象提取上的不足。

Method: 提出一个本体引导的多智能体框架（ontology-guided multi-agent framework），具体包含三个核心组件：(1) 候选发现模块，用于初步识别潜在的评价对象；(2) 本体约束分类模块，利用本体定义的类型边界对候选实体进行细粒度分类，减少类别混淆；(3) 领域审查模块，通过多智能体工作流对提取结果进行验证和修正，提升召回率和稳定性。

Result: 实验结果显示：Precision达90.33%，Recall达84.55%，实体级F1为87.34%，严格类型F1为79.78%，类型准确率为91.35%，显著优于基于规则和零样本的基线方法。消融实验表明，多智能体工作流提升了召回率和稳定性，而本体边界约束增强了细粒度分类效果并减少了类别混淆。

Conclusion: 该框架有效支持了评价性学术文本的结构化利用，为基于证据的研究评价和科技情报挖掘提供了方法论支持，填补了现有实体提取方法在评价对象识别方面的空白。

Abstract: Academic reviews, scholarly commentaries, and book reviews serve as sources of evaluative statements about theories, methods, literature, institutions, and policies, providing valuable evidence for scholarly evaluation. Existing scientific entity extraction methods mainly target research articles and are less effective for evaluation objects, which are often abstract, context-dependent, and characterized by ambiguous type boundaries. This study proposes an ontology-guided multi-agent framework for evaluation object extraction. The framework combines candidate discovery, ontology-constrained classification, and domain review. Experimental results show that it achieves a Precision of 90.33%, Recall of 84.55%, Entity-level F1 of 87.34%, Strict Typed F1 of 79.78%, and Type Accuracy of 91.35%, substantially outperforming rule-based and zero-shot baselines. Ablation results indicate that the multi-agent workflow improves recall and stability, while ontology-based boundary constraints enhance fine-grained classification and reduce category confusion. The framework supports the structured utilization of evaluative scholarly texts and provides methodological support for evidence-based research evaluation and STI mining.

</details>


### [330] [Argument-Aware Semantic Alignment of Normative Texts: A Toulmin-Based Neuro-Symbolic Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29529)
*William Schroeder*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种神经符号管道，将LLM提取的Toulmin论证结构与神经文本表示结合，用于跨标准规范文本的语义对齐。在NERC-CIP到NIST-CSF映射基准上，论证特征（尤其是warrant相关特征）显著提升了对齐性能，且精简的claim-grounds-warrant子集即可保持竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专业规范文本的语义对齐具有挑战性：等价需求可能使用不同术语、句法和抽象层级。现有的词汇重叠、分布嵌入和语义相似度方法虽能捕捉主题相关性，但往往忽略规范主张被支持、限定和论证的论证结构，导致对齐不准确。

Method: 构建神经符号管道：(1) 使用LLM显式化步骤识别Toulmin论证要素（claim、grounds、warrant、qualifiers、backing）并重建省略三段论；(2) 通过论证感知相似度和结构特征将这些要素输入对齐模型；(3) 结合神经文本表示进行跨标准控制映射。

Result: 在NERC-CIP到NIST-CSF映射基准上，论证特征优于神经符号语义基线；特征选择显示warrant相关特征信号最强，表明claim与其支撑推理之间的连接未被传统相似度捕捉；精简的claim-grounds-warrant子集与完整Toulmin特征集竞争力相当。

Conclusion: 论证结构作为规范文本对齐的中间表示具有实用价值。LLM显式化生成的论证图还可支持后续的检索、推理和规范文本解释工作。但结果仅提供初步证据，网络安全标准作为受控测试平台，不代表领域无关的泛化证明。

Abstract: Semantic alignment between specialized normative texts is challenging when equivalent requirements use different terms, syntax, and levels of abstraction. Lexical overlap, distributional embeddings, and semantic similarity capture topical relatedness but often miss the argumentative structure by which normative claims are supported, qualified, and justified. This paper asks whether explicit argument structure adds information complementary to neural semantics for aligning requirements. We treat cross-standard control mapping as argument-aware semantic alignment and build a neuro-symbolic pipeline that combines neural text representations with Toulmin features. An LLM explicitation step identifies claims, grounds, warrants, qualifiers, and backing and reconstructs enthymemes. These feed an alignment model via argument-aware similarity and structural features. On a NERC-CIP to NIST-CSF mapping benchmark, argument-derived features improve alignment over a neuro-symbolic semantic baseline. Feature selection shows especially strong signal from warrant-related features, indicating that the link between a claim and its supporting reasoning is not captured by conventional similarity alone. A compact claim--grounds--warrant subset remains competitive with the full Toulmin feature set. The results give preliminary evidence that argument structure is a useful intermediate representation for aligning specialized normative texts. Cybersecurity standards are used as a controlled testbed, not as proof of domain-independent generalization. The argument graphs produced by LLM explicitation may also support later work on retrieval, reasoning, and explanation over normative text.

</details>


### [331] [The Emergent Symbolic Structure of Artificial Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29530)
*R. Thomas McCoy,Paul Soulos,Tal Linzen,Paul Smolensky*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种调和符号主义与连接主义AI的观点：尽管神经网络基于连续向量表示，但其内部表征实际上隐式地实现了符号结构。作者通过闭式方程逼近神经网络的表征生成过程，证明其行为几乎不变，且支持对LLM内部表征进行精确干预以改变行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统上智能被建模为基于符号组合（如逻辑公式）的操作，但现代最强AI系统基于神经网络的连续向量表示。向量看似无法捕捉语言、逻辑等认知领域的结构，然而神经网络在这些领域表现卓越，这构成了一个悖论，亟需解释。

Method: 作者提出假设：神经网络的内部表征隐式实现了符号结构。方法是通过闭式方程实例化符号结构来逼近网络的向量表征生成过程，并用该符号近似替代网络的整个表征生成流程，观察行为是否保持不变。实验覆盖小规模列表操作网络及四个领域的LLM（算术、逻辑、代码、语言），并通过符号近似对LLM内部表征进行精确干预。

Result: 符号结构近似可以替换网络表征生成过程而行为基本不变，该发现在小规模网络和LLM的四个符号传统领域中均成立。进一步地，通过基于符号近似的精确干预可以定向修改LLM行为，证明其行为确实依赖于已识别的符号结构。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了调和传统符号主义智能观与现代基于向量的AI本质的潜在途径，表明神经网络的连续表征中可能隐含着符号结构，从而弥合两种范式之间的鸿沟。

Abstract: Modern systems in artificial intelligence (AI) somehow excel in domains for which they seem poorly suited. Intelligence has traditionally been modeled as operating over structured combinations of symbols, such as logical formulas. However, the strongest modern AI systems are based on neural networks, which instead represent information in continuous vectors. Vectors seem inadequate for capturing the structure of language, logic, and other cognitive domains, yet neural networks achieve impressive performance in these areas. How do they do it? In this work, we propose a potential answer: Despite appearances, perhaps the internal representations of neural networks implicitly realize symbolic structure. In support of this hypothesis, we show that the vector representations of a variety of neural networks can be closely approximated with symbolic structures: we can replace the network's entire representation-generating process with a closed-form equation instantiating a symbolic structure, and the network's behavior remains largely unchanged. This finding holds for both small-scale neural networks trained to manipulate lists as well as large language models (LLMs) operating in four domains that are central in symbolic traditions: arithmetic, logic, computer code, and language. Further, our symbolic approximation allows us to modify an LLM's behavior in targeted ways via precise interventions on its internal representations, showing that the LLM's behavior is reliant on the symbolic structures we have identified. This work provides a potential way to reconcile longstanding symbolic conceptions of intelligence with the vector-based nature of modern AI.

</details>


### [332] [LoGo: Token-Level Dynamic Local-Global Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29539)
*Yuqi Pan,Zheng Li,Bohao Tang,Zhen Qin,Guoqi Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: LoGo提出了一种token级别的动态局部-全局注意力机制，通过可学习的门控来决定哪些token需要全局注意力，其余token仅使用高效的局部注意力，并配合阈值预算控制器和渐进掩码调度来维持目标全局比例，从而在保持全注意力Transformer扩展行为的同时显著提升长上下文场景的计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着上下文长度增长，注意力计算成为大语言模型的主要瓶颈。标准Transformer对所有token分配相同的注意力预算，效率低下；现有的局部-全局混合方法虽然更高效，但注意力跨度是静态分配（固定层或固定头），无法根据每个token的实际上下文需求动态调整。

Method: LoGo包含耦合的局部和全局分支：所有token先在受限上下文窗口内获得高效的局部注意力；同时一个可学习的门控机制只对需要长距离信息的token激活全局注意力（全上下文访问）。阈值预算控制器维持目标全局比例且无需辅助损失，渐进掩码调度稳定了稀疏路由生效前的训练过程。此外实现了查询稀疏的Triton核，将减少的全局注意力计算转化为实际加速。

Result: 大量实验表明LoGo在多种模型规模下保持了全注意力Transformer的扩展行为；在受控对比中，LoGo优于全注意力Transformer和同预算的静态局部-全局混合模型，在长距离检索任务上增益明显。分析还显示LoGo学习了可解释的跨度分配模式。

Conclusion: 所提出的token级别动态跨度分配是一种有效且可扩展的方法，能够改善长上下文场景下的性能-计算权衡。

Abstract: As context lengths scale, attention increasingly becomes a primary computational bottleneck in large language models. Standard Transformers remain powerful but computationally inefficient, as they allocate the same attention budget to every token regardless of its contextual demand. Existing local-global hybrids provide a more efficient alternative by mixing restricted- and full-context attention, but they typically allocate span statically across layers or heads. To address these limitations, we propose LoGo, a token-level dynamic local-global attention mechanism that uses attention span as a direct proxy for attention budget allocation. Each LoGo layer contains coupled local and global branches: all tokens receive efficient local attention over a restricted context window, while a learned gate activates global attention with full-context access only for tokens requiring long-range information. A threshold-based budget controller maintains a target global ratio without auxiliary losses, and a progressive masking schedule stabilizes training before sparse routing takes effect. We further implement query-sparse Triton kernels that convert reduced global-attention computation into practical speedups. Extensive experiments validate LoGo's effectiveness, showing that it preserves the scaling behavior of full-attention Transformers across model sizes. In controlled comparisons, LoGo improves over the full-attention Transformer and matched-budget static local-global hybrids, with clear gains on long-range retrieval. Analysis further shows that LoGo learns interpretable span allocation patterns. These results suggest that learned token-level span allocation is an effective and scalable way to improve the long-context performance-compute trade-off.

</details>


### [333] [Evaluating LLMs on Conversational Text-to-SQL under Chain Ambiguity and Intent Drift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29543)
*Yujia Liu,Jiayan Lin,Zijin Hong,Zheng Yuan,Shengyuan Chen,Hao Chen,Qinggang Zhang,Xiao Huang,Feiran Huang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出TIDE-Bench基准，专门评估对话式文本到SQL任务中的链式歧义和意图漂移两种模式，包含1,542个样本和专用评估指标，并通过12个LLM的实验揭示了现有模型在链识别和漂移识别-解决方面的瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对话式文本到SQL基准主要评估执行准确性，未能覆盖多轮对话中用户意图的展开和转移。作者旨在填补这一空白，针对链式歧义（分层澄清条件依赖）和意图漂移（用户撤回并替换已提交请求元素）这两种常见但未被充分研究的模式进行系统评估。

Method: 基于BIRD的514个anchor SQL构建了1,542个TIDE-Bench样本，覆盖链式歧义和意图漂移两种模式。设计了超越执行准确率的专用指标，包括链识别指标和漂移识别-解决指标，并评估了12个先进LLM。

Result: 实验发现：(1)链识别存在持续性瓶颈，且不受澄清频率影响；(2)漂移识别-解决之间存在明显差距；(3)当两种模式联合激活时，失败模式存在重叠。

Conclusion: TIDE-Bench揭示了现有LLM在对话式文本到SQL中处理意图动态变化的深层缺陷，为后续研究提供了公开可用的基准和代码，推动该方向的发展。

Abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have established conversational text-to-SQL as a practical interface between users and databases, often involving multiple turns of clarification and revision. However, existing benchmarks primarily evaluate execution accuracy, leaving the unfolding and shifting of user intent across turns largely uncovered. To address this, we introduce TIDE-Bench, a benchmark for conversational text-to-SQL under chain ambiguity and intent drift evaluation, targeting two recurring patterns: chain ambiguity, where an underspecified question triggers layered clarification with conditional dependencies, and intent drift, where the user retracts and replaces a previously committed request element. Built on 514 anchor SQLs from BIRD, TIDE-Bench comprises 1,542 samples and introduces dedicated metrics for chain identification and drift recognition-resolution beyond execution accuracy. Evaluating 12 advanced LLMs reveals a persistent chain identification bottleneck unaffected by clarification frequency, a wide drift recognition-resolution gap, and overlap between failure modes when jointly activated. The corresponding code of TIDE-Bench is released for further research.

</details>


### [334] [TACS: Trajectory-Aware Candidate Selection for LLM Jailbreak Suffix Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29564)
*Shiliang Xiao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文发现基于梯度的越狱后缀优化方法在每一步仅选择当前损失最低的候选者是一种"短视"设计，会导致选择阶段的奖励作弊（reward hacking）。作者提出OURS框架，通过轨迹感知的候选选择、参考策略正则化和判别器估计的卡方修正来缓解这一问题，在HarmBench上显著提升了攻击成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有梯度式越狱后缀优化方法在每一步只根据当前损失挑选最优候选者，但作者发现这种看似自然的设计实际上是短视的——当前步骤表现好的候选者在后续搜索中往往不会产生更好的越狱结果。这意味着候选选择（而非候选生成）才是后缀优化的隐藏瓶颈，存在选择阶段的奖励作弊问题。

Method: 提出OURS框架：(1) 在每步评估中引入轨迹感知的代理指标来替代仅基于即时损失的候选选择；(2) 使用参考策略正则化稳定选择过程；(3) 通过判别器估计的卡方修正进一步校正选择偏差，鼓励候选者在当前步之外仍然保持有效性。

Result: 在HarmBench基准上的实验表明，在相同的搜索预算下，OURS一致性地优于强基线方法，显著提高了攻击成功率，并在整个搜索过程中展现出更稳定的优化行为。

Conclusion: 研究表明，缓解由短视候选选择导致的选择阶段奖励作弊，对于改进越狱后缀优化至关重要。候选选择应被视作与候选生成同等重要的优化环节。

Abstract: Gradient-based jailbreak suffix optimization methods typically update the suffix by retaining the candidate with the lowest current loss. We show that this seemingly natural design is fundamentally myopic: candidates that look better under the current-step proxy often fail to produce better jailbreak outcomes later in the search, revealing a form of selection-stage reward hacking. This suggests that candidate selection, rather than candidate generation alone, is a hidden bottleneck in suffix optimization. To address this issue, we propose \OURS{}, a trajectory-aware candidate selection framework for jailbreak suffix optimization. Instead of selecting candidates solely by their immediate loss, \OURS{} augments per-step evaluation with a trajectory-aware proxy and stabilizes selection with reference-policy regularization and a discriminator-estimated chi-squared correction, encouraging choices that remain effective beyond the current step. Experiments on HarmBench show that \OURS{} consistently outperforms strong baselines under the same search budget, substantially improving attack success rates while exhibiting more stable optimization behavior throughout the search. Our findings highlight that mitigating selection-stage reward hacking caused by myopic candidate selection is critical for improving jailbreak suffix optimization.

</details>


### [335] [Which one is banana man? Evaluating vision-language models in multi-turn pragmatic interpretation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29571)
*Alvin Wei Ming Tan,Ben Prystawski,Veronica Boyce*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文测试了人类和视觉-语言模型在迭代指称游戏中的上下文敏感语用推理能力。人类表现始终良好，而模型虽能利用先前上下文理解人类的指称表达，但难以有效构建相关上下文来解读这些表达，缺乏高效语言协作的核心技能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类对话依赖于灵活的上下文适应和共享语用直觉，而迭代指称游戏是测试智能体在多轮语言环境中进行上下文敏感语用推理能力的理想场景。作者希望评估当前视觉-语言模型是否具备这种能力。

Method: 通过迭代指称游戏实验，变换上下文的数量、顺序和相关性三个维度，比较人类和视觉-语言模型在识别人类产生的指称表达意图方面的表现。

Result: 人类在所有条件下均表现良好；视觉-语言模型能够利用先前上下文来解读人类指称表达，但在构建有效理解所需的上下文方面存在困难。

Conclusion: 当前视觉-语言模型缺乏高效语言协作所需的核心能力，即在多轮交互中主动构建和利用相关上下文进行语用推理的能力，这与人类存在显著差距。

Abstract: Flexible adaptation to context and shared pragmatic intuitions contribute to smooth human conversation. Iterated reference games---in which players repeatedly pick out novel referents using language---present a test case for agents' ability to perform context-sensitive pragmatic reasoning in multi-turn linguistic environments. We tested humans and vision--language models on their ability to identify the intended meaning of descriptions produced in iterated reference games, varying the provided context in terms of amount, order, and relevance. While humans performed well consistently, the models we evaluated could make use of prior context to interpret humans' referring expressions, but they struggled to build up the relevant context to interpret those expressions effectively. Our results suggest that the models we evaluated lack core skills needed for efficient linguistic collaboration.

</details>


### [336] [SemTrace: Source-Grounded Semantic Signatures for Tracing LLM Exposure to Protected Documents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29575)
*Junyan Zhang,Yudong Zeng,Yongwei Huang,Zuhao Ouyang,Hong Chen,Xuming Hu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SemTrace是一种基于源文档语义的水印方法，通过在受保护的PDF中嵌入内容契约，引导生成式审稿模型在固定槽位中表达源文档支持的事实命题，再用冻结的NLI模型解码语义证据以检测生成内容是否受到特定手稿副本的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型被广泛用于阅读文档并生成下游文本，但当文档所有者无法控制或检查执行生成的模型时，就产生了溯源问题。现有水印方法多通过偏置token概率或施加表面形式模式，缺乏与源文档的语义关联。

Method: SemTrace从受保护手稿中构建文档特有的二元签名（从事实命题的二元对中各选一个），将内容契约嵌入PDF中，引导遵循指令的审稿模型在固定审稿槽位中表达这些事实而不改变其独立评估；随后使用冻结的自然语言推理模型解码语义证据（含显式擦除），将恢复的比特与分配给该副本的码字进行比对评分。

Result: 该设计实现了模型无关的、指定副本暴露检测，同时保持水印在语义上与源文档紧密关联。

Conclusion: SemTrace通过语义层面的源文件基础水印方案，解决了大模型生成内容的溯源问题，为文档所有者提供了一种在不控制生成模型的情况下检测内容是否受保护文档影响的机制。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to read documents and produce downstream text, creating a provenance problem when the document owner cannot control or inspect the model that performs the generation. We introduce SemTrace, a source-grounded semantic watermark for detecting whether a generated review was influenced by a known protected manuscript copy. Rather than biasing token probabilities or imposing surface-form patterns, SemTrace constructs a document-specific binary signature from factual propositions that are directly supported by the manuscript itself. A protected PDF invisibly carries a content contract that selects one fact from each binary pair and asks an instruction-following reviewer to express those facts in fixed review slots without changing its independent evaluation. A frozen natural language inference model then decodes the resulting semantic evidence with explicit erasures and scores the recovered bits against the codeword assigned to that copy. This design targets model-agnostic, assigned-copy exposure detection while keeping the watermark semantically tied to the source document.

</details>


### [337] [SUP-MIMIC: A Multi-Task Clinical Diagnosis Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs' Robustness to Contradictory Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29582)
*Yi Yu,Bo Wang,Chong Feng,Ge Shi,Xia Liu,Ziyi Yang,Xuewen Shi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SUP-MIMIC框架，基于MIMIC-IV-v3.1构建三类任务（基础评估BA、诊断发散任务DDT、诊断收敛任务DCT），评估LLM在临床诊断模糊场景下的推理能力，发现现有模型在非一一映射的诊断任务中表现显著下降，存在统计捷径依赖和"健康"预测的保守偏见。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM评估过度聚焦于事实性知识检索，忽略了临床诊断中关键的推理挑战——相同临床表现对应不同病因（一对多）以及异质症状指向同一疾病（多对一）的复杂映射关系，缺乏针对诊断歧义场景的基准测试。

Method: 提出SUP-MIMIC多任务框架，包含：BA（基础评估）、DDT（诊断发散任务，评估一对多的去歧义能力）、DCT（诊断收敛任务，评估多对一的诊断模式识别能力），在MIMIC-IV-v3.1数据集上对SOTA LLM进行全面评估。

Result: SOTA LLM在DDT和DCT上的性能相比基线任务显著下降，暴露出对统计捷径的系统性依赖而非真正的因果推理；同时发现模型存在保守偏见，倾向于预测"健康"，在真实医疗场景中可能导致漏诊风险。

Conclusion: 本文建立了量化临床推理鲁棒性的严谨方法论，为提升语言模型在临床医学中的安全性提供了路线图。

Abstract: Current evaluations of large language models (LLMs) primarily focus on factual knowledge retrieval, overlooking the fundamental challenge of navigating the complex, non-bijective mappings between clinical indicators and diagnoses. Existing benchmarks fail to assess whether large language models truly possess the reasoning capability required for diagnostic ambiguity scenarios, where identical clinical presentations may correspond to different etiologies, and diagnostic convergence scenarios, where heterogeneous symptoms ultimately indicate the same disease. To address this issue, we propose SUP-MIMIC, a multi-task framework utilizing MIMIC-IV-v3.1 that comprises Basic Assessment (BA), Diagnostic Divergence Task (DDT), and Diagnostic Convergence Task (DCT). Specifically, DDT is designed to evaluate the model's "one-to-many" disambiguation capability among phenotypically similar cases, while DCT assesses the model's ability to identify "many-to-one" diagnostic patterns across different pathophysiological pathways. Comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art LLMs reveals substantial performance degradation on DDT and DCT compared to baseline tasks, exposing a systemic reliance on statistical shortcuts over genuine causal reasoning. Our findings further highlight a conservative bias toward "healthy" predictions, implying non-trivial risks for missed diagnoses in realistic medical settings. This work establishes a rigorous methodology for quantifying clinical reasoning robustness and provides a roadmap for enhancing the safety of language models in clinical medicine.

</details>


### [338] [How You Ask Shapes What You Get: A Theory-Seeded Measurement of Articulation in Advice-Seeking LLM Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29591)
*Juneha Baek,Suhyeon Lee,Donghyuk Shin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文从16,447条建议寻求提示中提取可解释的潜在表达维度，发现表达方式（如何提问）与话题（问什么）在很大程度上可分离，并识别出一种"信息贫乏的长式表达"风格（约占六分之一），该风格下模型回复更短、更模糊且不主动追问澄清，即使这种情况最需要澄清。作者主张基准测试应按表达方式分层，并提供提取出的结构作为测量工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往研究将用户表达方式的差异视为需要平均化的噪声，本文则认为这种差异是输入分布中稳定、可测量的结构。作者想探究表达（如何提问）是否构成与话题（问什么）可分离的潜在维度，以及它是否影响语言模型的响应方式，从而揭示被话题或任务导向评估所忽视的盲区。

Method: 从WildChat、LMSYS和ShareChat三个公开聊天语料库中汇集16,447条建议寻求提示，提取可解释的特征，恢复少量潜在表达因子。通过训练/测试分割和跨语料库验证因子的可复制性，并使用人工标注员独立验证发现的对比效应。

Result: 恢复的潜在表达因子在训练/测试分割和跨语料库中可复制，且与话题在很大程度上可分离。发现一种突出的表达风格：长式但信息贫乏，约占最大语料库中六分之一的提示。在这种风格下，模型返回更短、更模糊的回答且不询问澄清，而这种欠规格恰恰是需要澄清的条件。该对比在每个话题组和长度五分位数内均成立，且不仅是欠规格本身造成的——另一种同样欠规格的风格确实会引发澄清问题。两名独立人类标注员复现了该对比。

Conclusion: 表达方式是可测量且稳定的结构，独立于话题，并与模型响应行为相关联。现有的话题或任务导向评估会忽略由表达方式界定的群体。作者主张基准测试应计入表达方式的分层，并提供了提取出的结构作为实现这一目标的测量工具。

Abstract: Users articulate the same advice-seeking request in different ways: some specify detailed constraints, others gesture at a vague need. Prior work treats this variation as noise to be averaged away; we instead treat it as a stable, measurable structure in the input distribution. We ask whether articulation (how people ask) forms latent dimensions separable from topic (what they ask about), and whether it is associated with how language models respond. We extract interpretable features from 16,447 advice-seeking prompts pooled from public chat corpora (WildChat, LMSYS, and ShareChat) and recover a small set of latent articulation factors that replicate across train/test splits and across corpora. Because this structure is largely separable from topic, the populations it defines cut across topics and stay invisible to topic- or task-based evaluation. The factors define a handful of recurring articulation styles, one of which stands out: a long-form but information-poor style, roughly one in six prompts in the largest corpus, where models return shorter, vaguer answers and do not ask for clarification even though under-specification is exactly the condition that warrants it. The contrast holds within every topic group and length quintile, and is not under-specification alone -- a second, equally under-specified style does draw clarifying questions. Two independent human annotators reproduce this contrast. We argue that benchmarks should stratify on articulation, and we offer the extracted structure as a measurement instrument for doing so.

</details>


### [339] [Hindsight Memory-PRM: Supervising Memory Management with Auditable Hindsight Credit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29605)
*Haoxuan Jia,Yang Liu,Yingguang Yang,Yancheng Chen,Chongyang Zhang,Hao Zheng,Qian Li,Yulin Huang,Jianshen Zhang,Yongzhi Qi,Shang Luo,Kefu Xu,Hao Peng,Junyu Lu,Du Cheng,Philip S. Yu,Bin Chong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Hindsight Memory-PRM方法，利用检索命中和引用等机器可读证据作为"审计轨迹"，离线训练内存效用评论器，在线通过受控删除-重答实验评估干预校准的条目前置信用，无需人工标注或蒙特卡洛重放，实现长时程LLM智能体内存操作的监督。在LoCoMo上8B模型达到77.5%，超越API教师(65.1%)及所有外部系统，在LongMemEval上达79.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程LLM智能体的内存操作难以监督，因为操作的价值在操作发生时不可观测，且按步标注内存操作需要大量人力资源，现有方法无法有效评估内存条目的因果关系。

Method: 利用内存操作的审计轨迹（检索命中率和答案时引用），离线训练操作条件化的内存效用评论器；在线通过检索、引用和每次探针的受控"删除-重答"实验，建立干预校准的条目前置信用，并沿版本链传播作为动作级代理奖励。无需逐操作人工标注和蒙特卡洛续写重放。

Result: 在LoCoMo上，本地8B策略达到77.5%准确率（固定共享阅读器），超越API教师(65.1%)和所有复现的外部系统，且仅用Mem0官方操作点1/8的上下文；在LongMemEval上达79.0%。消融实验表明收益来自因果校准而非信号密度，策略收敛到多版本内存组织，无测试的开环基线能复现其增益。

Conclusion: 内存操作的机器可读证据（审计轨迹）可作为有效的监督信号，结合干预校准的因果信用分配，可在无需人工标注的情况下显著提升长时程LLM智能体的内存管理与任务性能。

Abstract: Memory operations of long-horizon LLM agents are hard to supervise: an operation's value is unobservable when it is taken. But they are special -- they leave machine-readable evidence in the trajectory: retrieval hits and answer-time citations. Hindsight Memory-PRM exploits this audit trail twice: offline to train an operation-conditioned memory-utility critic, and online, where retrievals, citations, and one controlled deletion-and-reanswer per probe settle an intervention-calibrated entry-level presence credit, propagated along version chains as an action-level proxy reward -- no per-operation human labels, no Monte-Carlo replay of continuations. On held-out LoCoMo a local 8B policy reaches 77.5% under a fixed shared reader, surpassing its API teacher (65.1%) and all reproduced external systems, at one eighth the context of Mem0's official operating point; on LongMemEval, 79.0%. Ablations attribute the gain to causal calibration rather than signal density, and the policy converges to a multi-version memory organization whose gains no tested open-loop baseline reproduces.

</details>


### [340] [Agent Zero Memory: Provenance-Aware Long-Term Memory for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29606)
*Ming Wu,Pengyuan Zhu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Agent Zero Memory，一个具有来源感知的长期记忆系统，将用户对话、文件和连接来源蒸馏为三种并行记忆系统（情节式记忆事件时间线、关联实体-事件知识图谱、语义策展且引用锁定的分层纪实记忆HDM）。检索时通过意图门控、来源路由和三种并发智能体搜索整合答案，并采用严格的阅读纪律确保每个答案只能引用实际阅读过的证据，从结构上排除捏造。在LongMemEval和LoCoMo上分别达到95.60%和93.60%的SOTA性能，并通过八种骨干LLM的控制实验验证了记忆驱动而非模型驱动的质量特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体记忆系统大多采用单一组织结构（事实存储、向量索引或知识图谱），每种结构都有其盲点，无法全面捕捉用户历史信息的不同侧面。同时，大多数记忆系统缺乏可靠的来源追溯和引用验证机制，可能产生捏造内容。

Method: 1) 构建三种并行记忆系统：情节式记忆事件时间线（记录何时和什么发生了变化）、关联实体-事件知识图谱（跨会话链接人物和项目）、语义策展且引用锁定的HDM（持久事实）。2) 检索过程包括意图门控（自包含查询零延迟）、来源路由和三种并发智能体搜索，每种搜索都是混合（嵌入+词汇）检索的工具循环。3) 实施阅读纪律：每个学习项携带来源、时间戳和证据指针，每个答案在引用锁定下生成，只能引用读者实际打开的证据，无法引用则拒答。

Result: 在LongMemEval上达到95.60%（提升+0.73），在LoCoMo上达到93.60%（提升+1.10），均创下新SOTA。八种骨干LLM的控制研究显示：准确率仅波动3.4个点，而单查询成本波动约30倍，以低至20倍的成本实现接近SOTA的质量，证明质量由记忆系统驱动而非模型驱动。

Conclusion: Agent Zero Memory通过多面记忆架构和严格的来源追溯/引用锁定机制，实现了更全面、可信且成本高效的长期记忆管理。该系统在性能上超越现有SOTA，且其质量主要由记忆设计驱动而非底层模型能力决定，为LLM智能体的持久记忆系统提供了新范式。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents need durable, faithful memory of everything a user or organization has said and stored, yet most memory systems commit to a single organizing structure (a fact store, a vector index, or a knowledge graph) and inherit its blind spots. We present Agent Zero Memory, a provenance-aware long-term memory system that distils a user's conversations, files, and connected sources into three parallel memory systems, each capturing a different facet of the same history: an episodic Memory Events timeline that makes when and what changed first-class, an associative entity-event knowledge graph that links people and projects across sessions, and a semantic, curated, citation-locked Hierarchical Documentary Memory (HDM) of durable facts. A retrieval turn runs an intent gate (so self-contained turns add no latency), a source router, and three concurrent agentic searches, one per system, each a tool-using loop over hybrid (embedding + lexical) search under agent-controlled filters; their grounded, cited answers are integrated into one answer with a single confidence. We formalize the reading discipline: every learned item is a provenanced item carrying its origin, timestamp, and evidence pointer, and every answer is read under a citation lock, so it may cite only evidence its reader actually opened; fabrication is structurally excluded and the system abstains rather than guesses. On two public benchmarks the system sets a new state of the art: 95.60% on LongMemEval and 93.60% on LoCoMo, improving over the strongest prior systems by +0.73 and +1.10 points. A controlled study across eight backbone LLMs characterizes the accuracy-cost-latency frontier: accuracy varies by only 3.4 points while per-query cost varies by ~30x, with near-state-of-the-art quality at up to 20x lower cost per query, the signature of memory-driven, rather than model-driven, quality.

</details>


### [341] [Beyond Surface Alignment: Grounding the Dynamics of Situational Understanding and Generative Control in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29610)
*Chenghao Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"接地对齐"(Grounded Alignment)框架,批判当前LLM对齐范式的表面化问题,通过情境接地和生成接地两个维度的评估与改进,使模型不仅风格自信而且情境稳健。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的LLM对齐调优侧重表面行为(流畅性、安全性、语气一致性),在闲聊中有效,但掩盖了模型缺乏真实情境理解的问题——模型风格上自信但情境上脆弱。

Method: 1) 提出SitTest和ReCode评估情境接地失败;2) 引入Branching Factor (BF)映射生成空间,并用Hindsight评估模型自我理解;3) 提出动态控制方案:AI Realtor、Base-Aligned Model Collaboration、Annealed Sampling,并应用于成瘾支持领域。

Result: SitTest展示模型难以维持对变化环境的"心理模型";ReCode揭示模型依赖表面启发式而非深层句法依赖;标准对齐调优导致生成空间过早风格坍缩;模型常无法理解自身生成内容。

Conclusion: 对齐应超越表面调优,朝同时锚定于情境(输入)与生成(输出)的智能体方向发展,通过接地对齐框架实现更稳健的模型行为。

Abstract: The current alignment tuning paradigm for Large Language Models (LLMs) prioritizes surface-level behaviors -- fluency, safety, and tonal consistency. While effective for casual chat, this thesis argues that such surface alignment masks a lack of grounding, creating models that are stylistically confident but situationally brittle. We propose a framework of Grounded Alignment, analyzing how models process context (Input) and structure generation (Output), then aligning these grounded behaviors to human needs.
  First, we evaluate failures in Situational Grounding. SitTest shows that despite large context windows, state-of-the-art models struggle to maintain a consistent "mental model" of a changing environment. ReCode further shows that models rely on surface heuristics rather than deep syntactic dependencies: they "read" extensive histories without truly "understanding" the evolving situation.
  Second, we evaluate Generative Grounding. We introduce the Branching Factor (BF) to map LLM generation, finding that standard alignment tuning constricts this landscape into premature stylistic collapse. Hindsight further shows that models often fail to understand their own generations.
  Finally, we propose Dynamic Control for grounded interaction. AI Realtor demonstrates context engineering to compensate for poor situational grounding. Base-Aligned Model Collaboration decouples exploration from stylistic constraints. We also present Annealed Sampling for verifiable reinforcement learning and apply these ideas to Addiction Support, where model-generated rationalization offers a communication interface for high-stakes domains. Collectively, this work moves beyond surface alignment toward agents anchored in both context and generation.

</details>


### [342] [Cross-lingual Functional Vectors for Emotion Detection in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29613)
*Jieying Xue,Phuong Minh Nguyen,Minh Le Nguyen,Shogo Okada*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了函数向量（Function Vectors, FVs）在多语言多标签情感识别任务中的跨语言可迁移性，发现FVs能够捕获与语言无关的任务相关信号，在不同语言的零样本设置下有效引导模型行为，且各LLM存在相对稳定的最优注意力头范围用于构建有效FVs。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前研究主要验证了FVs在结构化上下文学习场景中能够恢复任务行为，但其在语义复杂任务上的有效性以及跨语言泛化能力尚未得到充分探索。作者希望填补这一空白，探究FVs是否能够作为轻量级、可迁移的多语言任务适应机制。

Method: 采用多语言多标签情感识别作为具有挑战性的语义分类基准，从源语言中提取FVs，在无推理演示的标准干净和扰动零样本设置下，测试其引导另一语言任务行为的能力，并分析不同LLM的最优注意力头范围。

Result: 跨多种跨语言设置下，应用FVs显著提升了性能，表明FVs捕获的是语言无关的任务相关信号而非纯语言特定的词汇模式；每个LLM展示了相对稳定的最优注意力头范围，且该模式在不同语言间保持一致；FVs能部分复现标准少样本上下文学习的任务引导效果，同时避免了处理多个演示的计算开销。

Conclusion: FVs是一种轻量且可迁移的多语言任务适应机制，能够在无演示的情况下实现跨语言任务引导，适合大规模实际应用场景。

Abstract: Function vectors (FVs) have recently emerged as a promising mechanism for steering the behavior of large language models (LLMs) by injecting task-specific latent direction representations derived from in-context demonstrations. While prior studies have shown that FVs can recover task behavior in structured in-context learning settings, their effectiveness on semantically complex tasks and their ability to generalize across languages remain underexplored. We investigate the cross-lingual transferability of FVs using multilingual multi-label emotion recognition as a challenging semantic classification benchmark. Specifically, we examine whether FVs extracted from a source language can steer task behavior in another language under both standard clean and perturbed zero-shot settings without providing demonstrations during inference. Across diverse cross-lingual settings, applying FVs substantially improves performance, suggesting that FVs capture language-agnostic, task-relevant signals rather than purely language-specific lexical patterns, and highlighting their potential as a lightweight and transferable mechanism for multilingual task adaptation. We observe that each LLM exhibits a relatively stable optimal range of attention heads for constructing effective FVs, and the pattern remains consistent across languages. In addition, FVs can partially replicate the task-steering effects of standard few-shot in-context learning while avoiding the computational overhead of processing multiple demonstrations, making them effective for large-scale practical applications. Our code is available at https://github.com/yingjie7/cross_lingual_fvs.

</details>


### [343] [JPO: Juris Policy Optimization for Structured Legal Reasoning in Criminal Judgment Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29616)
*Zhaolu Kang,Yantao Liu,Tailong Luo,Leqi Zheng,Lei Wei,Chenghua Zhu,Junhao Gong,Jiachen Qian,Eric Hanchen Jiang,Jiaxin Liu,Yuan Wang,Hao Zhang,Zixia Wang,Rong Fu,Zheng Lin,Richeng Xuan,Zhichao Hu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了Juris Policy Optimization (JPO)，一种面向中文刑事判决预测的结构化法律推理后训练框架。JPO通过教师生成的推理路径监督标准化的四步推理过程，并利用复合奖励（法律预测质量、推理结构完整性、跨步一致性）进行强化学习，引入token级优势重加权和自适应裁剪。在多个开源语言模型和三个中文法律基准上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有刑事判决预测方法仅优化最终标签，即便有方法尝试评估推理质量，其评估也往往是间接的，依赖LLM生成的评判标准，反映的是模型内部偏好而非法律裁判固有的逻辑结构。因此需要一个能显式建模并优化结构化解题推理过程的框架。

Method: 1) 使用教师模型生成推理路径，监督标准化的四步推理过程（法条匹配→罪名认定→量刑推理等）；2) 采用强化学习，设计复合奖励函数，兼顾法律预测质量、推理结构完整性和跨步骤一致性；3) 引入token级优势重加权和自适应裁剪，聚焦法律上关键推理段落。

Result: 在多个开源语言模型和三个中文法律基准（CJPE等）上，JPO相比监督微调和强化学习基线，在判决预测准确性和推理质量两方面均取得一致的显著提升。

Conclusion: JPO证明了将法律裁判的内在逻辑结构（法条-罪名-量刑的递进关系）显式编码为推理过程和奖励信号，可以同时改善预测性能与推理可解释性，优于传统仅优化最终标签的方法。

Abstract: Criminal judgment prediction requires models to infer statutory articles, charges, and sentencing outcomes from case facts. Unlike standard classification tasks, it involves a structured reasoning process in which statutes should be matched with facts, charges should be justified by statutes, and sentencing outcomes should remain consistent with charges. Existing approaches optimize final labels, and while some have attempted to evaluate reasoning quality, their evaluations are indirect, often relying on LLM-generated rubrics that reflect model-internal preferences rather than the inherent logical structure of legal adjudication. We propose Juris Policy Optimization (JPO), a post-training framework for structured legal reasoning in Chinese criminal judgment prediction. JPO first uses teacher-generated rationales to supervise a standardized four-step reasoning process, and then applies reinforcement learning with a composite reward over legal prediction quality, reasoning structure completeness, and cross-step consistency. JPO further introduces token-level advantage reweighting and adaptive clipping for legally salient reasoning segments. Experiments on multiple open-source language models and three Chinese legal benchmarks show that JPO consistently improves both judgment prediction and reasoning quality over supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning baselines.

</details>


### [344] [Memory-First Fact-Checking: A Knowledge-Graph-Grounded Multi-Agent System for Misinformation Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29617)
*Amelia Petrenciuc,Alexandru Lecu,Adrian Groza*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合式事实核查框架，将基于知识图谱的语义记忆与对抗性多智能体推理相结合，用于可解释的虚假信息检测。系统采用"记忆优先、网络回退"的架构，先用Sentence-BERT语义检索和自然语言推理在双索引知识图谱中评估声明，证据不足时再从可信网络来源收集信息，并通过支持、反驳和裁决三个对抗性智能体进行评估。实验在COVID-19虚假信息基准上达到97.4%的准确率和92.6%的宏平均F1分数，显著优于Llama 3.3 70B基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有虚假信息检测方法缺乏可解释性，且单一模型或单一知识来源在复杂场景下准确性有限。作者希望结合知识图谱的结构化记忆优势与多智能体对抗推理的灵活性，构建一个既能提供可解释证据、又能动态扩展知识储备的混合检测框架。

Method: 框架采用"记忆优先、网络回退"架构：(1) 输入声明先通过Sentence-BERT语义检索与NLI在双索引知识图谱中评估；(2) 当图谱证据不足时，从可信网络来源收集信息；(3) 对抗性法庭由支持、反驳、裁决三个智能体协同评估；(4) 图感知置信机制融合语义相似度、NLI置信度与图结构证据判断内部知识是否充分；(5) 验证后的信息转成结构化三元组回写知识图谱，实现语义记忆的增量扩展。

Result: 在COVID-19虚假信息基准上，框架对已解决声明达到97.4%准确率和92.6%宏平均F1分数，远超Llama 3.3 70B基线的87.7%准确率和86.3%宏平均F1分数。

Conclusion: 知识图谱语义记忆与对抗性多智能体推理的混合架构能有效提升虚假信息检测的准确性和可解释性，同时通过增量知识回写机制实现系统的持续学习与知识扩展。

Abstract: This paper introduces a hybrid fact-checking framework that integrates Knowledge Graph-based semantic memory with adversarial multi-agent reasoning for explainable misinformation detection. The proposed system follows a memory-first, web-fallback architecture, in which input claims are initially evaluated against a dual-index Knowledge Graph through Sentence-BERT-based semantic retrieval and Natural Language Inference. When the evidence retrieved from the graph is insufficient to support a reliable decision, the framework collects information from trusted web sources and assesses it using an adversarial tribunal composed of support, contradiction, and judging agents. A graph-aware confidence mechanism combines semantic similarity, NLI confidence, and structural graph evidence to determine whether internal knowledge is sufficient, thereby reducing unnecessary web retrieval. Following verification, validated information is transformed into structured triples and incorporated into the Knowledge Graph, supporting the incremental expansion of the system's semantic memory. Experimental evaluation on a curated COVID-19 misinformation benchmark demonstrates that the proposed framework achieves an accuracy of 97.4\% and a macro-averaged F1-score of 92.6% on resolved claims, outperforming a Llama~3.3~70B baseline, which obtains an accuracy of 87.7% and a macro-averaged F1-score of 86.3%.

</details>


### [345] [MI-Distillation: Selecting from Model-Interpolated Instruct-Reasoning Data Spectrum for Chain-of-Thought Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29623)
*Yangsong Lan,Renkai Hu,HongKai Zheng,Bo Zhang,Renzhi Wang,Hongliang Dai,Piji Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出MI-Distillation框架，通过模型插值构建推理数据谱系，并利用SeqLSS分数选择既具信息量又适合学生模型学习的推理轨迹，解决了长链思维(Long CoT)蒸馏到小模型时效果不佳的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型推理模型(Long CoT)在复杂问题上表现出色，但将长链思维轨迹蒸馏到小模型时效果有限，甚至不如短链(Short CoT)推理。作者从梯度视角分析发现，Long CoT会带来更大的梯度幅值和更集中的更新方向，且随学生模型容量增大而加剧，因此需要平衡推理轨迹的信息密度与学生模型的分布对齐程度。

Method: 提出MI-Distillation框架：(1)通过模型插值构建连续的Instruct-Reasoning数据谱系；(2)引入SeqLSS(序列可学习惊讶分数)用于从该谱系中选择既具信息量又适合学生模型学习的推理轨迹。

Result: 在多个推理基准上的大量实验表明，MI-Distillation在强Long CoT基线上持续提升了小模型的CoT蒸馏效果。

Conclusion: 有效的长链思维蒸馏需要平衡推理轨迹的信息密度与学生模型的能力对齐，MI-Distillation通过数据谱系构建与智能轨迹选择实现了这一目标。

Abstract: Recent advances in large reasoning models (LRMs) have shown strong performance on complex problems through long chain-of-thought (Long CoT) reasoning. However, distilling such trajectories into smaller student models remains challenging: direct Long CoT supervision often provides limited gains and can be less effective than concise Short CoT rationales. In this work, we investigate this phenomenon from a gradient-centric perspective. Our analysis shows that Long CoT induces larger gradient magnitudes and more concentrated update directions than Short CoT, with this effect becoming more pronounced as student model capacity increases. These findings suggest that effective Long CoT distillation requires balancing the reasoning information density of reasoning trajectories with their distributional alignment to the student model. Motivated by this insight, we propose \textbf{M}odel \textbf{I}nterporlation \textbf{Distillation} (\textbf{MI-Distillation}), a framework that constructs a continuous Instruct-Reasoning data spectrum through model interpolation. To select suitable trajectories from this spectrum, we further introduce \textbf{Seq}uential \textbf{L}earnable \textbf{S}urprisal \textbf{S}core (\textbf{SeqLSS}), which favors reasoning paths that are both informative and learnable for the student. Extensive experiments on reasoning benchmarks show that MI-Distillation consistently improves small model CoT distillation over strong Long CoT baselines.

</details>


### [346] [PrivBench: A Holistic and Modular Benchmarking Platform for Evaluating Text-to-Text Privatization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29624)
*Stephen Meisenbacher,Andreea-Elena Bodea,Ahmet Bilal Akın,Alexandra Klymenko,Jana Diesner,Florian Matthes*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 PrivBench，一个全面的模块化文本到文本私有化评估基准平台，通过一系列定义的期望标准（desiderata）对文本私有化方法进行统一评估，支持实时评估和公开排行榜。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言处理在隐私领域（尤其是文本到文本私有化）取得了进展，但文本私有化方法的评估缺乏统一标准，现有文献使用了各种不同的技术和指标，难以比较不同方法的隐私保护能力。

Method: PrivBench 是一个整体且模块化的基准测试平台，将评估标准组织为多个模块（desiderata），支持扩展和未来更新，并提供实时评估和公开排行榜以促进竞争。

Result: PrivBench 提供免费开放的平台，网址为 https://privbench.com/，涵盖文本私有化的多维评估，支持研究人员和实践者使用。

Conclusion: PrivBench 通过统一的评估框架解决了文本私有化评估碎片化的问题，以用户为中心，旨在推动该领域的研究进展和标准化。

Abstract: Natural Language Processing methods have enabled novel solutions and advances in the field of privacy, particularly in the sub-domain of text-to-text privatization, where the goal is to transform a sensitive input text into a privatized output by ideally masking (in)directly identifiable or otherwise private information. The evaluation of text-to-text privatization, however, is not straightforward, and the extant literature has utilized a myriad of techniques and metrics to quantify the privacy-preserving capabilities of privatization methods. Seeking to unify the evaluation of text-to-text privatization, we introduce PrivBench, a holistic and modular benchmarking platform for researchers and practitioners working on text privatization. PrivBench is holistic in that it evaluates privatization on a series of defined desiderata, which are structured into modules. PrivBench is not only modular but also extensible, allowing for future updates and benchmark versions. PrivBench is user-centered and promotes competition via real-time evaluation and a live public leaderboard. The platform is free to use and openly accessible at https://privbench.com/.

</details>


### [347] [ACTD: Anchor-Based Cross-Tokenizer Distillation with Residual Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29662)
*Huiyi Zhang,Zijian Li,Xiaocheng Feng,Weitao Ma,Xiaoliang Yang,Yichong Huang,Bing Qin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出ACTD框架，通过锚点损失和残差正则化解决跨tokenizer知识蒸馏中的词汇和序列错位问题，并在多教师场景下扩展，在五个推理基准上取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨tokenizer蒸馏因词汇表和序列不对齐而困难，近似词汇对齐会引入额外噪声，影响大语言模型向轻量学生模型的知识迁移效果。

Method: ACTD通过词汇和序列对齐桥接结构异质性，并提出锚点损失（anchor loss）结合残差正则化（residual regularization）来缓解对齐噪声；进一步将该框架扩展到多教师蒸馏场景。

Result: 在五个推理基准上使用三个不同教师模型评估，ACTD达到SOTA性能；多教师扩展版本超越最强单教师和多教师基线，验证了方法的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: ACTD有效解决了跨tokenizer蒸馏的对齐噪声问题，且多教师扩展进一步提升了性能和鲁棒性，为异构模型家族间的知识迁移提供了可靠方案。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation effectively transfers reasoning capabilities from large language models to lightweight student models. To enable knowledge transfer across disparate model families, researchers increasingly explore cross-tokenizer distillation. However, cross-tokenizer distillation remains challenging due to vocabulary and sequence misalignment, while approximate vocabulary alignment can introduce additional noise into distillation. To address these challenges, we propose Anchor-Based Cross-Tokenizer Distillation with Residual Regularization (ACTD). ACTD bridges structural heterogeneity through vocabulary and sequence alignment, while mitigating alignment noise via a novel anchor loss with residual regularization. We further extend this framework to a multi-teacher setting. Evaluated across five reasoning benchmarks with three distinct teacher models, ACTD achieves state-of-the-art performance. Moreover, its multi-teacher extension outperforms the strongest single-teacher and multi-teacher baselines, further demonstrating the robustness of our method.

</details>


### [348] [A Hub of Short Rows Inflates Intrinsic Dimension Estimation of Token Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29702)
*Alexandre Quemy*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文发现token嵌入表原点附近存在一个高密度"枢纽"（hub）簇，它会严重偏置基于最近邻的内在维度（ID）估计结果。当移除该枢纽后，从GPT-2到GLM-4.7等11个模型的嵌入表内在维度从随参数量增长（27到122）collapse到一个狭窄范围（10到17）。该枢纽仅需几百行就足以完全扭曲估计结果，可通过归一化行向量而非删除来达到同样效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前研究报道Pythia等模型token嵌入表的内在维度随参数规模增长（从27到122），这一发现被用于理解模型容量与表示空间的关系。作者质疑该结果可能被嵌入表原点附近的密集簇（hub）所污染，因为测度集中效应使得每个token最近邻都指向该hub，从而扭曲了基于最近邻的ID估计（如TwoNN算法）。

Method: 作者系统分析了多个大语言模型（GPT-2、Pythia、K3、GLM-4.7等共11个模型）的token嵌入表。首先识别出原点附近的hub行集合，然后对比"包含hub"与"移除hub"两种情况下的TwoNN内在维度估计结果。同时检查了hub行与欠训练token检测器的关系、训练过程中的更新情况，并测试了归一化行向量作为替代方案的效果。

Result: 1) 嵌入表原点附近存在hub，其存在使ID估计值严重偏高（重尾分布）；2) 移除hub后，11个模型的ID读数collapse到10-17的窄范围，且不再随模型参数增长；3) hub仅需几百行即可完全inflate估计值，起开关作用；4) hub行被欠训练检测器标记，但在Pythia中是正常更新的，其特征是行长度而非更新缺失；5) 归一化行向量与删除hub得到同样的低ID读数。

Conclusion: 先前报道的"嵌入表内在维度随参数量增长"这一结论是伪影（artifact），由嵌入空间原点附近的测度集中效应导致。真实的内在维度在不同规模的模型中基本恒定。建议在估计token嵌入表ID时移除或归一化hub行，以避免偏置。

Abstract: A token-embedding table holds a hub of short rows near its origin, and we show that this cluster biases what nearest-neighbor intrinsic-dimension (ID) estimators report. Because of the concentration of measure, a token is closer to the central cluster than to any other token, so its first two neighbors are both hub rows at nearly the same distance. As a result, the ID estimators such as TwoNN return a dimension far above the real ID. Measured one token at a time, dimension is a heavy-tailed distribution. Measured on the full vocabulary, it grows with the model's parameter count. However, when we remove the hub, the heavy tail disappears and the measured dimension collapses to a narrow range for eleven models, from GPT-2 to models such as K3 and GLM-4.7. The hub acts as a switch: a few hundred rows are enough to fully inflate the estimate. We reproduced an experiment stating that the intrinsic dimension (ID) of Pythia's token-embedding table grows with the parameter count, from $27$ to $122$ between 160M and 12B parameters. We show that this result disappears when the hub is removed: the table then reads $10$ to $17$ at every size. The hub contains a subset of the population that under-trained-token detectors flag, but on Pythia the hub that we detected and removed as a whole was updated during training: what seem to characterize these rows is simply their length, not an absence of updates. Finally, we show that normalizing the rows instead of removing them gives the same lower reading.

</details>


### [349] [The Depth Flow of Token Representations Is Nonlinear and Does Not Descend Its Own Density](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29706)
*Alexandre Quemy*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过离散Langevin模型拟合Pythia-160M和410M模型中词元表征在层间的流动轨迹，发现该流动是非线性的（二次漂移优于线性映射），不沿自身对数密度下降，且旋转分量显著（占可解释漂移的4-45%），揭示了词元在层间保持角向排序而径向和浓度排序被重排的现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解语言模型中词元表征如何逐层演化的动态过程，超越简单的线性映射近似，从物理学的视角刻画表征流动的"运动方程"。

Method: 将整个词汇表在层间的表征流动建模为离散Langevin方程，在语料均值轨迹上拟合漂移项（线性vs二次），使用Kramers-Moyal估计器验证，并分析漂移的势能函数与旋转/径向分量。

Result: 二次漂移在每一层转换中都优于线性映射；流动不沿自身对数密度下降，而是沿另一个势能函数下降；旋转分量占总漂移的4-45%；词元的角向排名在13层中保持稳定，而范数排名被重排、浓度排名在最后块被反转。

Conclusion: 词元表征在层间的流动具有丰富的非线性结构，包含显著的旋转动力学，这些动力学性质揭示了模型内部表征组织的深层规律，线性映射作为层替代品存在系统性偏差。

Abstract: A token's representation is carried through the network layer by layer. The whole vocabulary carried together forms a flow. We fit this flow's equation of motion as a discrete Langevin model over corpus-mean trajectories of Pythia-160M and Pythia-410M, and score the predicted steps on held-out tokens. Linear maps are often used as cheap surrogates for a layer. The flow they summarize is not linear: a quadratic drift beats the linear linear map at every transition of both models, and the Kramers--Moyal estimator agrees wherever its neighborhoods stay local.
  We then characterize the flow further. First, we show that it does not descend its own log-density. The drift instead descends a potential that is not the density. Second, the rotational component is not negligible, $4$ to $45\%$ of the explainable drift, and the circulation shows in what the flow preserves: a token keeps its angular rank across all thirteen layers while its norm rank is shuffled and its concentration rank is reversed by the last block.

</details>


### [350] [DVBench: Benchmarking MLLMs for Understanding Dynamic Charts and Narratives in Data Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29711)
*Bomiao Wang,Zekai Shao,Jiexiang Lan,Xiaoliang Fu,Xingchen Zeng,Siming Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了DVBench基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在数据视频理解上的能力。包含300个真实数据视频和1000个QA对，分解为五个维度，并对九个MLLM进行了广泛评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLM评估将图表理解和视频理解割裂开，缺乏对"随时间演化的结构化视觉信息"（即数据视频）的综合评估，这是一个关键的研究空白。

Method: 构建DVBench基准：包含300个真实数据视频和1000个人工验证QA对，通过严格的半自动流水线策展；将数据视频理解分解为五个维度进行全面评估；对九个MLLM进行基准测试，并进行细粒度分析和消融研究。

Result: Gemini-3.1-Pro取得最佳综合性能，Kimi-k2.5是最强开源模型。发现两个现象：开源模型性能不与参数规模严格成正比；叙述能力不能保证视觉能力。消融研究揭示了维度特定弱点及帧配置和字幕输入的影响。

Conclusion: DVBench填补了数据视频理解评估的空白，揭示的发现为未来MLLM开发提供了指导方向，基准已公开供社区使用。

Abstract: While MLLMs have made significant strides in chart comprehension and video understanding, current evaluations largely isolate these capabilities, leaving a critical gap in understanding temporally evolving structured visual information.
