TL;DR: 本文研究了点式文档重排序中CoT模型与直接打分模型的性能差距。实验确认该差距在高达32B参数的规模下稳定存在，排除了模型和数据容量因素。通过强化学习、细粒度监督和架构解耦等压力测试干预，虽然改善了分类准确率和绝对分数，但相对排序差距依然存在。这表明在点式打分范式下，通过离散文本传递连续相关性语义限制了排序信号分辨率，这是一个当前标准方法难以克服的稳定瓶颈，而非容易解决的训练偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索CoT模型在点式重排序中表现不如直接打分模型的根本原因，并验证该差距是否可以通过针对性训练来弥补，以厘清这究竟是可解决的训练偏差还是范式的固有瓶颈。

Method: 首先在高达32B参数的多个规模上进行实证研究确认差距的稳定性；随后实施三类压力测试干预：强化学习、细粒度监督学习和架构解耦，分别针对分类能力、分数校准和架构偏差进行显式修复。

Result: 各类干预虽能提升分类准确率和绝对分数质量，但无法消除相对排序差距。差距在32B参数规模下依然稳定存在。

Conclusion: 点式打分范式中，将连续的相关性语义通过离散文本（CoT）进行路由表达，本质上限制了排序信号的精度和分辨率。这一瓶颈是范式固有的、稳定的，而非可通过训练方法改进的偏差问题。

Abstract: In pointwise document reranking, Chain-of-Thought models typically underperform direct scoring models. While existing diagnostics attribute this to inferior classification, score polarization, or calibration breakdown, whether targeted training can bridge this gap remains unclear. Our empirical study first confirms that this gap is stable across scales up to 32B parameters, ruling out model and data capacity confounders. We then apply stress tests utilizing reinforcement learning, fine-grained supervision, and architectural decoupling to explicitly repair these deviations. Although these interventions improve classification accuracy and absolute scores, the relative ranking gap persists. These findings suggest that, within the pointwise scoring paradigm, routing continuous relevance semantics through discrete text constrains ranking signal resolution, revealing a bottleneck that is stable and difficult to overcome under current standard methods, rather than an easily resolvable training bias.

</details>


### [422] [SemPOI-RL: Aligning LLM Semantic Reasoning for Interpretable Out-of-Town POI Sequential Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30399)
*Yunqi Liu,Yang Zhang,Ruixing Zhang,Liangzhe Han,Yi Qiao,Tongyu Zhu,Leilei Sun*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SemPOI-RL框架，通过将LLM的语义推理能力与结构化序列生成对齐，解决跨城（OOT）POI序列推荐问题。框架先用LLM从用户家乡轨迹中推断出行风格（以自然语言为可解释中间表示），再通过语义POI对齐模块（SPAM）将这些风格注入风格条件掩码自编码器进行位置感知的轨迹生成，最后用强化学习对齐LLM生成风格与下游序列质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有OOT POI序列生成面临两大挑战：一是基于潜在ID迁移的方法可解释性差；二是直接使用LLM生成序列时，无法将推断出的语义显式地锚定到位置感知预测中，导致语义推理与结构化生成脱节。

Method: SemPOI-RL包含三个环节：(1) 微调LLM从家乡轨迹推断目的地导向的旅行风格（自然语言作为可解释中间语义）；(2) 引入SPAM模块，将推断风格作为条件输入到掩码自编码器中，实现位置感知轨迹生成；(3) 使用基于推荐目标的奖励进行强化学习，对齐LLM生成的风格与下游序列质量。

Result: 在两个真实数据集上，SemPOI-RL一致地优于传统推荐器和直接LLM基线，并能提供跨行程不同阶段的风格可解释归因。

Conclusion: SemPOI-RL证明了将LLM语义推理与结构化序列生成显式对齐的有效性，为OOT推荐提供了兼具性能与可解释性的新方案，代码已开源。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong semantic reasoning and open-ended generation abilities, but aligning these abilities with structured sequential generation remains challenging. This challenge is particularly evident in out-of-town (OOT) POI sequence generation, where a model must infer transferable travel intent from a user's hometown behaviors, adapt to cross-city interest drift, and generate a coherent destination trajectory under structural constraints. Existing approaches either rely on latent ID-based transfer with limited interpretability or directly use LLMs for sequence generation without explicitly grounding inferred semantics into position-aware predictions. To address this gap, we propose SemPOI-RL, a framework that aligns LLM semantic reasoning with structured sequence generation for interpretable OOT recommendation. Specifically, we first fine-tune an LLM to infer destination-oriented travel styles from users' hometown trajectories, using natural language as an interpretable semantic intermediate. We then introduce a Semantic POI Alignment Module (SPAM) to ground these inferred styles into a style-conditioned masked autoencoder for position-aware trajectory generation. Finally, we apply reinforcement learning with recommendation-oriented rewards to align LLM-generated styles with downstream sequence quality. Experiments on two real-world datasets show that SemPOI-RL consistently outperforms both traditional recommenders and direct LLM baselines, while providing interpretable style attribution across different phases of a trip. The code is available at https://github.com/Wind-Flipped/SemPOI-RL .

</details>


### [423] [Generative Models Enhanced by Sequence Labelling and Aspect-Code Switching Improve Cross-lingual Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30425)
*Jakub Šmíd,Pavel Přibáň,Pavel Král*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SeqLab框架，结合序列到序列模型与编码器辅助序列标注任务，并引入方面代码切换（ACS）翻译技术增强跨语言数据，在跨语言方面级情感分析（ABSA）任务上超越先前最先进结果，覆盖11种语言、3个领域和2个骨干模型，扩展了更难的目标-方面-情感检测（TASD）任务评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨语言方面级情感分析（ABSA）虽已有进展但仍未充分探索，尤其是涉及多个情感要素的复杂任务（如TASD）研究不足；且大多数先前工作仅依赖英语作为源语言，缺乏对不同源-目标语言对的系统性评估。

Method: 提出SeqLab框架：1）使用序列到序列模型，编码器执行辅助序列标注任务，以增强方面术语识别和情感预测；2）引入方面代码切换（ACS）翻译技术，在源句和翻译句之间交换方面术语以生成额外训练数据，增强模型跨语言理解能力。

Result: 在11种语言、3个领域和2个骨干模型上评估，在常用的E2E-ABSA任务上超越先前最先进结果；系统评估不同源-目标语言对，并将评估扩展到更具挑战性且未被充分探索的跨语言TASD任务。

Conclusion: SeqLab框架有效提升跨语言ABSA性能，并通过详细的错误分析揭示了关键挑战和局限性，为该领域后续研究提供了方向。

Abstract: Cross-lingual aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) transfers knowledge from a source language with annotated data to a target language, enabling fine-grained sentiment analysis without annotated target-language data. While monolingual ABSA has seen significant progress, cross-lingual ABSA remains underexplored, especially for complex tasks involving multiple sentiment elements like target-aspect-sentiment detection (TASD). In this paper, we propose a novel SeqLab framework that enhances cross-lingual ABSA using a sequence-to-sequence model with an auxiliary sequence-labelling task performed by the encoder, enhancing aspect term recognition and sentiment predictions. Additionally, we incorporate aspect-code switching (ACS), a translation-based technique that swaps aspect terms between source and translated sentences, generating additional training data to enhance the model's cross-lingual understanding. We evaluate our approach across eleven languages, three domains, and two backbone models, surpassing previous state-of-the-art results for the commonly studied E2E-ABSA task. Unlike most prior work that relies solely on English as the source language, we systematically assess different source-target language pairs and extend our evaluation to the more challenging, yet underexplored TASD task in cross-lingual settings. Finally, we provide a detailed error analysis highlighting key challenges and limitations.

</details>


### [424] [Learning to Reason and Use Tools through Unsupervised Fine-Tuning in Task-Oriented Dialog Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30426)
*Markel Ferro,Oier Lopez de Lacalle*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出将ReAct框架适配到任务型对话系统中，通过无监督微调流水线（利用上下文学习推理收集轨迹，经LLM法官过滤高质量样本）和自改进循环，使LLM能访问外部知识并产生更准确的响应。实验表明微调后的8B模型超越70B上下文系统，并提供了错误分析、场景复杂度影响及跨域泛化分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对话系统在动态信息检索方面存在困难，常导致幻觉（hallucination）和响应准确率低下的问题。

Method: 1) 将ReAct框架适配到任务型对话，使LLM能推理并调用外部工具获取知识；2) 提出无监督微调流水线：通过上下文学习推理收集推理轨迹，使用LLM-based judge筛选高质量样本构建训练集；3) 引入无监督自改进循环，改进后的checkpoint生成更优质的轨迹用于后续微调迭代。

Result: 在SIMMC数据集上的实验表明，ReAct-based系统在推理和工具使用方面优于基线；微调后的8B模型超越了70B的上下文学习系统。

Conclusion: ReAct框架结合无监督微调流水线能有效提升任务型对话系统的信息检索能力和响应准确性；论文还提供了错误分析、场景复杂度影响和跨域泛化的深入讨论。

Abstract: Current dialogue systems struggle with dynamic information retrieval, often leading to hallucinations and lower response accuracy. We address this by adapting the ReAct framework for Task-Oriented Dialogue, enabling Large Language Models (LLMs) to access external knowledge and produce factual responses. Mainly, we propose an unsupervised fine-tuning pipeline that harvests reasoning trajectories via in-context learning inference. High-quality samples are filtered using an LLM-based judge to construct a robust training set. This is enhanced by a unsupervised self-improvement loop, where improved checkpoints generate increasingly better trajectories for subsequent fine-tuning iterations. Experiments on the SIMMC dataset demonstrate that ReAct-based systems outperform baselines due to superior reasoning and tool use. Notably, our fine-tuned 8B model surpasses a 70B in-context system. Finally, we present an error analysis, impact of scene complexity, and cross-domain generalization.

</details>


### [425] [Ceiling-Clipped Acceptance Histograms Indicate Stranded Speed-up in Block-Diffusion Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30427)
*Ephrem Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出DBloom方法，通过后训练扩展块扩散草稿模型的块大小来恢复投机解码中被"搁浅"的加速增益。研究发现Dflash和DFlare等块扩散草稿模型存在"天花板尖峰"现象，即整块被接受但在训练范围内耗尽，通过接受度直方图作为预检工具，并在更长块上做短期课程训练，可从块大小16扩展到24，提升每提示承诺长度0.4-1.37个token。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 投机解码中，块扩散草稿模型（如DFlash、DFlare）常完整接受整个块，但草稿模型在训练块范围内就耗尽预测能力，导致未被使用的接受被称为"搁浅加速"。平均承诺长度指标会掩盖这一现象，需要更好的诊断工具和解决方案。

Method: 1) 提出使用接受度直方图（特别是天花板bin占比）作为训练前的预检工具，诊断搁浅加速；2) 提出DBloom方法：对草稿模型在更长的块上进行后训练，采用短课程学习强调新暴露的位置，扩展块大小（从16到24）；3) 将续调（continuation fine-tuning）与扩展流水线结合。

Result: 将DFlash和DFlare从块16扩展到24，在Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-4B目标上提升每提示承诺长度中位数+0.8 token（最高+1.1）；配合续调可达到+1.37 token。Gemma-4-12B-IT上中位数+0.41，完整流水线增加+0.29至+0.98。与JetSpec对比，在树预算64节点内所有基准均提交更多token。

Conclusion: DBloom通过诊断驱动的后训练扩展有效恢复投机解码中搁浅的加速增益，且在不同模型族和基准上均验证了有效性，并优于现有树形草稿方法JetSpec。

Abstract: Speculative decoding speeds up generation with an efficient draft model (drafter) that proposes tokens for a target model to verify in one pass, preserving the target's output distribution. High-acceptance block-diffusion drafters such as DFlash and DFlare fill an entire block in one parallel pass. In many cycles, the target accepts the whole block, so the drafter exhausts its trained block horizon before verification fails. We call this unrealized acceptance stranded speed-up. A mean committed length, per prompt or per cycle, hides it, whereas the acceptance histogram exposes it as a spike in the ceiling bin, the fraction of cycles that accept the entire block. We recommend the histogram as a preflight check before spending training compute. Naively widening the block at inference does not recover the speed-up, because once the block outgrows its training size, the drafter's bidirectional attention shifts its distribution even at early positions and erodes front-of-block verification. Instead, we post-train the drafter on a longer block with a short curriculum that emphasizes the newly exposed positions, a method we call DBloom. Expanding the pretrained DFlash and DFlare drafters from block size 16 to 24 across Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-4B targets raises the per-prompt committed length on the high-ceiling benchmarks by a median of +0.8 tokens (up to +1.1). Once continuation fine-tuning precedes expansion, the increase reaches 1.37 tokens. The same expansion also lifts committed length on all seven benchmarks for Gemma-4-12B-IT, a different model family, by a median of +0.41 tokens (Arm A), and the full continuation-then-expand pipeline (Arm B) adds +0.29 to +0.98 tokens over the same B16 drafter. In a prompt-matched comparison against JetSpec, a contemporary tree-based drafter not used in our design, DBloom commits more tokens on every benchmark at tree budgets up to 64 nodes.

</details>


### [426] [Lies We Can See: Joint Verbal and Non-Verbal Deception by VLM Agents in Embodied Social Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30428)
*Jaewoo Ahn,Junseo Kim,Hyunseo Kim,Heeseung Yun,Jaehyeon Son,Zsolt Kira,Gunhee Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出MineAmongUs，一个3D多模态Among Us沙盒环境，以及ARIA可配置VLM智能体框架，用于研究LLM/VLM智能体在社交推理游戏中的言语与非言语欺骗行为，发现非言语通道对欺骗成功起更关键作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有社交推理游戏测试环境仅支持纯文本且运行在单一固定智能体配置上，缺少欺骗分类学中核心的非言语感觉运动通道，且无法区分观察到的行为反映的是底层模型还是环绕框架（harness）本身。

Method: 引入MineAmongUs（3D多模态Among Us沙盒）；提出ARIA（可配置VLM智能体框架，暴露五个认知组件消融轴）；设计基于欺骗分类学的原子级（atom）和弧级（arc）标注方案，并由LLM-as-a-Judge在大规模上实现，达到接近人类水平的原子标注一致性。

Result: 经验结果表明VLM智能体通过言语与非言语联合欺骗追求内鬼胜利，非言语通道在框架消融和跨VLM评估中都是更具决定性的胜利贡献因素。

Conclusion: 该工作为具身VLM智能体对齐研究开辟了新路径，强调了非言语通道在智能体欺骗研究中的关键作用。

Abstract: Strategic deception by LLM and VLM agents has emerged as a central AI alignment and safety concern. Social-deduction games (where each player holds a hidden role and communicates with others to deduce identities) serve as the canonical testbed, particularly in multi-agent settings. Existing testbeds, however, are text-only and run on a single fixed agent configuration, missing the non-verbal sensorimotor channels treated as core by deception taxonomies and leaving it ambiguous whether an observed behavior reflects the underlying model or the surrounding harness. We introduce MineAmongUs, a 3D multimodal Among Us sandbox where imposter agents must deceive crewmates through joint verbal and non-verbal action. We also propose ARIA, a configurable VLM-agent harness that exposes five cognitive-component ablation axes; and an atom- and arc-level annotation scheme grounded in deception taxonomies and operationalized at scale by an LLM-as-a-Judge reaching near-human atom-labeling agreement. Empirical results show that VLM agents pursue imposter wins through joint verbal and non-verbal deception, with non-verbal channels emerging as the more decisive winning contributors across both harness ablation and cross-VLM evaluation. Taken together, our work opens a new path for embodied VLM-agent alignment research.

</details>


### [427] [Graph Evidence Is Not Enough: Diagnosing Native Decoder Use in Graph-Augmented LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30437)
*Xiaoyu Guo,Pengcheng Chen,Jiong Yu,Yi Lu,Yaohua Wang,Ziyang Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文质疑图增强大语言模型的一个常见假设：外部计算产生的图证据放入输入后，原生解码器就能直接使用。作者提出HopQA诊断任务（查询两个节点间的最短跳数），发现现有图增强基线在此任务上失败，证明"提供图证据"不等于"图证据可用"。基于三类干预实验（可读图、打乱图、无图），作者提出S²GE方法，通过查询感知采样、端点与邻近度排序、结构保持对齐来提升原生解码器的可用性，在四个数据集上平均超越最强基线53.5个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图增强大语言模型普遍假设外部计算得到的图证据放入输入后，原生解码器能够直接使用这些信息。作者希望检验这一假设是否成立，因为如果图证据在输入中但解码器无法有效利用，那么整个图增强范式的基础就会受到质疑。作者设计了一个边界清晰、无法用开放式生成或模糊评估来搪塞失败的诊断任务。

Method: 1) 提出HopQA诊断任务，询问两个查询节点间的最短跳距离，答案是小的整数，纯拓扑目标，评估严格。2) 设计"干预三角"（intervention triangle），包含三个匹配条件：可读图证据、打乱图证据、无图输入，用于分离证据包含、结构可读性、解码器可用拓扑三个因素。3) 基于诊断结果提出S²GE方法，包含三个组件：查询感知采样（query-aware sampling）、端点和邻近度排序（endpoint and proximity-based ordering）、结构保持对齐（structure-preserving alignment）。

Result: 在DBLP、Biomedical、GoodReads和PubMed四个数据集上，S²GE分别达到36.5%、57.8%、76.6%和52.0%的严格精确匹配分数，平均超越最强原生生成基线53.5个百分点。干预实验还揭示了三种模式：有害打乱（harmful-shuffle）、打乱鲁棒（shuffle-robust）和无图饱和（no-graph-saturated）模式。

Conclusion: 本文的核心结论是：提供图证据与使图证据可用之间存在本质区别。S²GE证明了基于诊断驱动的接口设计能够显著改善原生解码器对图信息的可用性。这项工作为图增强大语言模型的设计提供了新的诊断方法论和实用的接口设计方案。

Abstract: Graph-augmented large language models often assume that graph evidence produced by external computation and placed in the input can be used by the native decoder. We test this assumption with HopQA, a deliberately bounded diagnostic that asks for the shortest-hop distance between two query nodes. Because the answer is a small integer and the target is purely topological, failure cannot be dismissed as open-ended generation or ambiguous evaluation. Yet existing graph-augmented baselines still fail on this setting, showing that providing graph evidence is not the same as making it usable. We introduce an intervention triangle with three matched conditions: readable graph evidence, shuffled graph evidence, and no-graph input. This separates evidence inclusion, structural readability, and decoder-usable topology. Guided by this diagnosis, we present S$^2$GE as an instance showing that diagnosis-driven interface design can improve native decoder usability. S$^2$GE uses query-aware sampling, endpoint and proximity-based ordering, and structure-preserving alignment. Across DBLP, Biomedical, GoodReads, and PubMed, S$^2$GE achieves strict exact-match scores of $36.5\%$, $57.8\%$, $76.6\%$, and $52.0\%$, improving over the strongest native-generation baseline by $53.5$ points on average. The interventions further reveal harmful-shuffle, shuffle-robust, and no-graph-saturated regimes.

</details>


### [428] [From Final Artifacts to Trajectories: Retrospective Process Supervision for Evidence-Grounded Long-Form Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30461)
*Junjie Huang,Jiarui Qin,Di Yin,Weiwen Liu,Yong Yu,Xing Sun,Weinan Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出RetroGen，一种自我改进的回顾式过程监督框架。其核心洞察是：尽管专家轨迹数据稀缺，但高质量的最终产物（如文献综述、分析师报告、法律判决）在预训练数据中十分丰富，可视为产生它们的证据搜寻过程的压缩轨迹。RetroGen从专家产物中重建候选潜在轨迹，对照产物和支撑证据进行验证，并在自身成功的重建数据上训练模型，无需更强大模型的轨迹数据。实验表明，RetroGen改善了接地性、忠实合成和长篇幅证据搜寻型智能体任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 轨迹数据对训练大语言模型的智能体能力至关重要，但不同于可验证领域（如编程、数学），开放式任务的轨迹数据难以扩展，因为缺乏唯一真值且标注或验证成本高昂。现有方法依赖专家轨迹或更强模型，难以规模化。

Method: RetroGen采用自我改进的回顾式过程监督框架。具体而言：1）从预训练数据中丰富的高质量最终产物（如文献综述、分析师报告、法律判决）出发，这些产物被视为证据搜寻过程的压缩轨迹；2）重建候选潜在轨迹；3）同时对照最终产物和支撑证据进行验证；4）在自身成功的重建数据上训练模型，形成自我改进循环，无需外部更强模型的轨迹数据。

Result: 实验表明RetroGen在接地性、忠实合成和长篇幅证据搜寻型智能体任务上均取得改进效果。

Conclusion: RetroGen证明了一种无需依赖更强模型轨迹数据即可扩展开放式任务轨迹数据的可行路径，通过利用预训练数据中丰富的专家产物进行回顾式过程监督和自训练，有效提升了大语言模型在证据搜寻型智能体任务上的能力。

Abstract: Trajectory data is getting more vital for training large language models for boosting the agentic abilities. Unlike the verifiable domains such as coding or mathematics, scaling trajectory data for open-ended tasks is much more difficult because these tasks lack singular ground truth and are costly to annotate or verify. In this paper, we propose RetroGen, a self-improving framework of retrospective process supervision. Our key observation is that although expert trajectories are scarce, high-quality final artifacts such as literature reviews, analyst reports and legal judgments, are abundant in pre-training data and can be viewed as compressed traces of the evidence-seeking processes that produced them. RetroGen reconstructs candidate latent trajectories from expert artifacts, verifies them against both the artifact and supporting evidence, and trains models on their own successful reconstruction data, without requiring trajectory data from stronger models. Experiments show that RetroGen improves grounding, faithful synthesis, and long-form evidence-seeking agent tasks.

</details>


### [429] [Enhancing Low-Resource Language Reasoning via High-Resource Language Feature Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30462)
*Minju Song,Hyeon Hwang,Junhyun Lee,Jaewoo Kang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种机制性干预框架，利用稀疏自编码器从残差流激活中提取与特定任务（数学推理）相关的高资源语言特征，并将其注入低资源语言推理过程，以检验跨语言推理差距是否源于"机制未充分激活"而非"能力缺失"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究通常将大语言模型的跨语言性能差异视为预训练数据、分词或基准覆盖等观测性差异造成的，但作者提出补充假设：高资源语言可能更可靠地激活任务相关的潜在计算，而低资源语言即使表达相同任务也可能未充分激活这些计算。

Method: 使用稀疏自编码器（SAE）在残差流激活中隔离出高资源语言成功任务推理中富集的特征，同时过滤掉源语言特征和通用生成特征；将这些特征构建为steering方向，在低资源语言推理时注入。通过抑制实验验证特征的功能相关性，通过激活实验检验对低资源语言推理的恢复效果。

Result: 抑制所选特征会损害源语言推理能力，而激活这些特征能在随机和非任务对照之上部分恢复目标语言的推理表现，表明所选特征确实在跨语言推理差距中起功能性作用。

Conclusion: 该框架将部分跨语言推理差距重新定义为机制启用的失败而非能力缺失，提供了一种无需翻译、微调或改变用户界面语言的、可因果检验的基于特征的中介迁移路径。

Abstract: Large language models exhibit substantial performance variation across languages, even when solving semantically equivalent tasks. Existing analyses often treat this phenomenon as an observational disparity caused by differences in pretraining data, tokenization, or benchmark coverage. We study a complementary hypothesis: high-resource languages (HRLs) may more reliably elicit latent computations useful for task-specific (i.e. mathematical) reasoning, while lower-resource languages (LRLs) may under-activate those computations despite expressing the same task. To test this hypothesis, we introduce a mechanistic intervention framework for identifying and transferring task-relevant sparse latent features across languages. Using sparse autoencoders over residual-stream activations, we isolate features enriched in successful HRL task-specific reasoning while filtering out source-language and generic-generation features. We then construct steering directions from these features and inject them during LRL inference. The resulting interventions test whether the selected features are functionally involved in the observed reasoning gap: suppressing them should impair source-language reasoning, while activating them should partially recover target-language reasoning beyond random and non-task controls. Our framework reframes some cross-lingual reasoning gaps as failures of mechanism elicitation rather than capability absence, and offers a causally testable route to feature-mediated transfer without translation, fine-tuning, or changing the user-facing language.

</details>


### [430] [More Capable, Less Faithful: A Multilingual Analysis of Mathematical (Un)Solvability Detection in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30463)
*Maria-Eleni Zoumpoulidi,Nikolaos Xiros,Georgios Paraskevopoulos*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文首次提出多语言数学可解性检测基准，扩展ReliableMath至法语和希腊语，通过训练多语言探针分析LLM的可解性信念，发现可解性信念是语言无关的普遍特征，且高资源语言（如英语）虽然数学推理更强，但可解性检测的忠实度反而更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前对LLM数学可解性检测能力的研究仅限于英语，无法区分多语言失败是源于内部可解性信念的差异，还是语言相关的表达失败。作者希望填补这一空白。

Method: 构建首个多语言可解/不可解数学问题对基准（扩展ReliableMath至法语和希腊语），训练多语言探针来预测可解性信念，并从行为层面、表征层面和忠实度层面分析前沿LLM的可解性检测能力。

Result: 发现可解性信念被编码为一种基本普遍、与语言无关的特征；高资源语言（如英语）尽管数学推理性能更强，却表现出更低的可解性检测忠实度。

Conclusion: 多语言失败并非源于内部可解性信念的缺失，而是语言相关的表达问题；高资源语言在推理能力与忠实度之间存在反直觉的权衡。

Abstract: Solvability detection is one of the most challenging aspects of mathematical reasoning for Large Language Models (LLMs). While prior work has studied this capability extensively, these analyses have been limited to English. Consequently, it remains unclear whether multilingual failures arise from differences in internal Solvability Belief or from language-dependent failures to express it. To address this gap, we introduce the first multilingual benchmark of paired solvable and unsolvable mathematical problems, extending ReliableMath to French and Greek. Using this, we train multilingual probes predicting Solvability Belief and analyze the solvability detection capabilities of state-of-the-art LLMs behaviorally, representationally, and in terms of faithfulness. We find that Solvability Belief is encoded as a largely universal, language-agnostic feature, and that higher-resource languages such as English, despite achieving stronger mathematical reasoning performance, exhibit lower solvability-detection faithfulness.

</details>


### [431] [Hi-Q: Hierarchical Evidence-guided Query Refinement for Multi-Hop Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30468)
*Jueun Kim,Sungho Park,Wook-Shin Han*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Hi-Q是一个证据条件化的分层查询细化框架，用于解决多跳问答中问题粒度与语料检索粒度不匹配的瓶颈。它通过解析操作符判断检索到的证据是否支持当前查询单元，未解决节点则通过保持依赖关系的二元操作符展开，并由语义覆盖验证器检查，从而生成由语料支持信号决定拓扑结构的查询树。在三个多跳QA基准上，Hi-Q在全文检索设置中平均达到52.3 EM/64.0 F1，分别超过IRCoT 15.1 EM/18.2 F1和PropRAG 11.5 EM/12.0 F1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多跳QA中问题表达粒度与语料证据可检索粒度常常不匹配。现有方法通过固定图结构、迭代重写查询或执行生成程序来解决，但这些策略没有明确决定查询单元何时已被证据支持、何时需要细化。

Method: Hi-Q框架包含两个核心操作符：解析操作符（resolution operator）测试检索证据是否支持当前查询单元，已解决节点终止；未解决节点由保持依赖关系的二元操作符展开，并由语义覆盖验证器检查。由此生长的查询树拓扑由语料支持信号决定，而非固定分解模板或预构建图。

Result: 在三个多跳QA基准的全文检索设置下，Hi-Q平均达到52.3 EM和64.0 F1，比IRCoT平均高出15.1 EM/18.2 F1；在MuSiQue-full上比基于图的RAG基线PropRAG高出11.5 EM/12.0 F1，且无需构建语料库范围图。在受限支持/干扰设置下，Hi-Q平均达到57.9 EM和69.3 F1，分别超过PropRAG 5.6 EM/3.9 F1和IRCoT 13.7 EM/15.8 F1。

Conclusion: Hi-Q通过证据条件化的动态查询树生长方式，有效解决了多跳QA中的粒度不匹配问题，在开放域全文检索和受限设置下均取得了最优性能，同时避免了代价高昂的语料库范围图构建。

Abstract: A central bottleneck in multi-hop Question Answering (QA) is that the granularity at which a question is expressed often differs from the granularity at which corpus evidence is retrievable. Existing methods address this mismatch by imposing fixed graph structures over the corpus, by iteratively reformulating the query, or by executing a generated program over it, but these strategies do not explicitly decide when a query unit is already supported by evidence and when it should be refined. We formulate this bottleneck as retrievable granularity discovery and introduce Hi-Q, an evidence-conditioned framework for hierarchical query refinement. At each query node, a resolution operator tests whether retrieved evidence supports the current query unit; resolved nodes terminate, while unresolved nodes are expanded by a dependency-preserving binary operator and checked by a semantic coverage verifier. Hi-Q therefore grows a query tree whose topology is determined by corpus support signals rather than by a fixed decomposition template or a pre-built graph. We evaluate Hi-Q on three multi-hop QA benchmarks, primarily under full-corpus retrieval, where dependent evidence must be located among open-domain distractors rather than within a small annotated pool. In this setting Hi-Q reaches 52.3 EM and 64.0 F1 averaged over the three benchmarks, ahead of the iterative retrieval baseline IRCoT by 15.1 EM / 18.2 F1 on that same average, and ahead of the graph-based RAG baseline PropRAG by 11.5 EM / 12.0 F1 on MuSiQue-full, without corpus-wide graph construction. In the restricted supporting/distractor setting used by prior work, Hi-Q likewise attains the best accuracy, with 57.9 EM and 69.3 F1 on average, ahead of PropRAG by 5.6 EM / 3.9 F1 and IRCoT by 13.7 EM / 15.8 F1. The project page is available at https://hi-q-project.github.io/.

</details>


### [432] [ImageEval 2026: Culturally Grounded Arabic Multimodal Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30475)
*Samir Abdaljalil,Hunzalah Hassan Bhatti,Ahlam Bashiti,Farina Amir,Md Arid Hasan,Basel Mousi,Nadir Durrani,Fahim Dalvi,Zien Sheikh Ali,Erchin Serpedin,Hasan Kurban,Mustafa Jarrar,Shammur Absar Chowdhury,Firoj Alam*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了ImageEval 2026共享任务，聚焦于阿拉伯语文化背景下的多模态评估，包含两个子任务：AynVQA（涵盖口语视觉问答和图像幻觉检测，支持英语和现代标准阿拉伯语）和CRAI-Bench（评估文生图的文化准确性）。共有14支团队参与测试阶段，12支提交了系统描述论文，使用了零样本提示、视觉语言模型微调、语音识别流水线、集成学习和分数校准等方法。所有数据集和评估脚本均已向研究社区发布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阿拉伯语多模态评估在文化背景下面临独特挑战，尤其是语音与图像文本推理的结合领域缺乏系统性的评估基准。通过举办共享任务，旨在推动该领域的研究进展并建立标准的评估框架。

Method: 任务组织者设计了两个评估任务：AynVQA涵盖口语视觉问答和图像幻觉检测（英阿双语），以及CRAI-Bench评估文本到图像生成的文化准确性。14支参赛团队采用了多种技术方案，包括零样本提示、视觉语言模型微调、语音识别流水线、模型集成和分数校准等。

Result: 14支团队参与测试阶段，12支提交了系统描述论文。研究展示了不同方法在阿拉伯语多模态任务上的表现，并总结了各赛道的主要结果。所有数据集和评估脚本已公开。

Conclusion: 该共享任务凸显了文化背景下的多模态评估挑战，特别是在阿拉伯语语音和图像-文本推理方面。通过公开数据和脚本，为后续研究提供了基准资源，同时也揭示了该领域仍需进一步探索的方向。

Abstract: We present an overview of the ImageEval 2026 shared task on culturally grounded Arabic multimodal evaluation. It includes two tasks: (i) AynVQA, covering spoken visual question answering and image-grounded hallucination detection in English and Modern Standard Arabic (MSA), and (ii) CRAI-Bench, evaluating the cultural accuracy of text-to-image generation. A total of 14 teams participated in the test phase, with 12 teams submitting system description papers. Participating systems used a range of approaches, including zero-shot prompting, fine-tuning of vision-language models, speech-recognition pipelines, ensembling, and score calibration. We describe the task setup, datasets, evaluation procedure, and participating systems, and summarize the main results across the different tracks. All datasets and evaluation scripts from the shared task are released to the research community. The shared task highlights the challenges of culturally grounded multimodal evaluation, particularly for Arabic speech and image-text reasoning.

</details>


### [433] [Agents in the Large: Perception-Centered Architecture for Persistent Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30478)
*Shihan Dou,Haoxiang Jia,Shichun Liu,Feng Chen,Chenhao Huang,Yujiong Shen,Shaofan Liu,Jiayi Chen,Jiahang Lin,Honglin Guo,Qianyu He,Minghao Guo,Ziyi Ye,Pluto Zhou,Tao Gui,Qi Zhang,Xuanjing Huang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了Pera（面向感知的持久智能体架构），一种用于刻画长期运行、自适应语言智能体的统一框架。Pera围绕感知与控制组件组织，通过持续感知服务相关信号来构建生命周期任务，从而驱动智能体的持续运行与流程适应，并用于回顾现有工作、案例分析及展望未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语言智能体框架大多将智能体视为解决用户指定的、有界任务系统，但日益重要的目标是让智能体在长期环境中提供持续协助——用户需求、上下文和服务流程会持续存在并变化。目前缺乏一个框架来刻画这类持久AI智能体、组织现有工作并指导未来发展。

Method: 提出Pera（Perception-Centered Architecture for Persistent Agents），一种围绕感知（perception）与控制（control）组件组织的持久智能体架构。该架构持续感知来自情节任务执行、内部上下文及周围环境变化的服务相关信号，利用这些信号构建生命周期任务（lifecycle tasks），进而驱动智能体服务流程的持续运行与自适应调整。

Result: 作者使用Pera框架对近期相关工作进行了回顾性组织，对一个详细案例进行了分析，并提供了构建更强持久智能体的前瞻性见解。

Conclusion: 正如软件工程从"小型编程"走向"大型编程"，Pera将语言智能体的演进框定为一种类似的架构转型——迈向长期运行、自适应的智能系统。

Abstract: Cognitive language agents have achieved substantial progress by equipping language models with memory, tools, and decision-making procedures, enabling agents to reason and act in interactive environments. Existing frameworks largely cast these agents as systems for solving user-specified, bounded tasks. An increasingly important goal is for language agents to provide persistent assistance in long-lived settings where user needs, context, and service procedures persist and change, and to remain useful across the broad range of tasks that arise over time. Yet we still lack a framework to characterize persistent AI agents, organize existing work, and guide future development. To this end, we propose a Perception-Centered Architecture for Persistent Agents (Pera). Pera describes a persistent agent organized around perception and control components that continually perceive service-relevant signals from episodic task executions, internal context, and changes in the surrounding environment, and use these signals to construct lifecycle tasks. These tasks drive the ongoing operation and adaptation of the agent's service procedures. We use Pera to retrospectively organize recent work, examine a detailed case study, and offer forward-looking insights for building more capable persistent agents. Just as software engineering moved from programming in the small to programming in the large, Pera frames the evolution of language agents as an analogous architectural transition toward long-lived, adaptive intelligence systems.

</details>


### [434] [Two Centuries of Sexism in British Parliament: A Computational Analysis of Women's Representation in the Hansard Corpus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30485)
*Mohammad Omar Khursheed,Mandira Sawkar,Ashiqur R. KhudaBukhsh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究分析了英国议会200年（1803-2005）间6,531篇关于妇女权利的演讲稿，利用大语言模型分类演讲者对妇女选举权和政治代表权的立场，并通过矛盾性别主义量表分析议会中的性别歧视言论。研究发现反对妇女代表权的演讲中有54%包含性别歧视内容（支持方仅为21%），且双方使用不同类型的性别歧视：反选举权修辞结合了敌意与善意性别歧视，而支持方的性别歧视几乎完全是善意的。论文还发布了包含670万篇演讲、120万场辩论的议会数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 填补计算社会科学领域缺乏对议会辩论中长期性别歧视模式系统分析的空白，同时探索善意与敌意性别歧视在不同修辞语境中的使用是否符合矛盾性别主义理论。

Method: 使用大语言模型对英国下议院（Hansard）200年间6,531篇关于妇女权利的演讲进行立场分类（支持/反对妇女选举权和政治代表权），并运用矛盾性别主义量表框架分析演讲中的性别歧视内容；同时构建并发布了经过元数据增强、89%性别匹配的6.7百万篇演讲数据集。

Result: 反对妇女代表权的演讲中54%含性别歧视内容，支持方仅为21%；反方使用敌意与善意性别歧视结合，支持方几乎全为善意性别歧视；女性议员支持妇女政治权利的比例为93%，男性议员为70%，该差距在选举权实现后才缩小。

Conclusion: 研究结果为矛盾性别主义理论提供了实证支持：善意与敌意性别歧视在不同修辞语境中有系统性的不同使用模式，即使立法机关在讨论妇女权利（甚至支持妇女权利）时，其语言仍持续编码着跨越两个世纪的系统性性别歧视模式。

Abstract: The language a legislature uses to debate women's rights, even in favour of them, encodes systematic patterns of sexism that persist across two centuries. In this work, we analyse 6,531 speeches over 200 years of UK parliamentary debate (Hansard, 1803-2005) by using large language models to classify a speaker's perspective towards women's suffrage and political representation, as well as analyse sexist speech in parliament from the lens of the Ambivalent Sexism Inventory. We also release this parliamentary dataset, an organized and metadata-enriched version of the publicly available Hansard Corpus optimized for computational social science research, with 6.7 million speeches across 1.2 million debates, with 89% gender-matching for speeches by MPs from the House of Commons. We find that 54% of speeches opposing women's representation contain sexist content, compared to 21% of speeches that are for the cause, and that the two sides use fundamentally different types of sexism: anti-suffrage rhetoric combines hostile and benevolent framing, while pro-suffrage sexism is overwhelmingly benevolent. Female MPs support women's political rights at 93% compared to 70% for male MPs, a gap that closes only after enfranchisement. Our findings are evidence that benevolent and hostile sexism are used in different rhetorical contexts in a manner consistent with the theory of Ambivalent Sexism.

</details>


### [435] [UTILMEM: Benchmarking Evidence Utilization in Long-Term Conversational Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30508)
*Peijun Qing,Fobo Shi,Soroush Vosoughi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出UtilMem，一个包含1717个实例、覆盖五个领域的诊断性基准，用于评估对话代理在长期记忆中"记忆利用"能力——即从分布、隐式和嘈杂证据中整合信息到连贯的任务导向输出。研究发现传统事实记忆基准的表现并不能可靠迁移到记忆利用能力上，且仅靠检索是不够的，系统在证据整合和干扰抵抗方面存在显著不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长期记忆基准主要衡量点式事实回忆（能否恢复孤立的细节），但现实世界中的记忆使用需要更复杂的能力：跨长交互历史整合分布式、隐式和嘈杂的证据。这种"记忆利用"能力尚未被现有基准充分评估。

Method: 构建UtilMem诊断基准，包含5个领域、1717个实例，从四个未充分探索的维度评估记忆利用：密集历史的推理、隐式相关记忆的识别、分布式证据的综合（生成摘要、分析或计划）、以及对语义相似干扰的抵抗能力。评估多种基于检索和记忆增强的系统。

Result: 发现传统事实记忆基准上的强表现并不能可靠地转化为有效的记忆利用；即使相关证据被成功检索，系统也经常无法跨会话整合信息或区分有用证据与合理的干扰项。

Conclusion: 长期对话记忆的进展需要明确支持证据整合和检索干扰鲁棒性的架构。研究揭示了存储信息访问与有效使用之间存在实质性差距，为未来对话代理记忆系统的设计指明了方向。

Abstract: Long-term memory is increasingly important for conversational agents, yet existing benchmarks primarily measure memory through pointwise factual recall: whether a system can recover isolated facts or event-level details from prior interactions. Real-world memory use, however, often requires a more demanding capability: integrating distributed, implicit, and noisy evidence across extended interaction histories into coherent, task-oriented outputs. We call this capability memory utilization. Here, we introduce UtilMem, a diagnostic benchmark comprising 1,717 instances across five domains, designed to evaluate four underexplored aspects of memory utilization: reasoning over dense histories, identifying implicitly relevant memories, synthesizing distributed evidence into summaries, analyses, or plans, and resisting interference from semantically similar distractors. Evaluating a diverse set of retrieval-based and memory-augmented systems, we find that strong performance on conventional factual-memory benchmarks does not reliably translate into effective memory utilization. Moreover, retrieval alone is insufficient: even when relevant evidence is successfully recovered, systems frequently fail to integrate information across sessions or to distinguish useful evidence from plausible distractors. These findings expose a substantial gap between accessing stored information and using it effectively, and suggest that progress in long-term conversational memory will require architectures that explicitly support evidence integration and robustness to retrieval interference. Code is available at https://github.com/peijunallin/UtilMem.

</details>


### [436] [WebWorld: The Browser as a World Model for Self-Improving Web Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30530)
*Jiajun Wu,Jian Yang,Yaxin Du,Wei Zhang,Haowen Wang,Junhang Cheng,Yuxuan Zhang,Tuney Zheng,Xianglong Liu,Ming Zhou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: WebWorld 提出了一种浏览器作为世界模型的 VLM 自改进框架，通过确定性浏览器执行器作为 VLM 无法欺骗的"对手方"，将网页代码修复从"模型自证"转变为"浏览器验证"。每轮 VLM 生成批评，规划器编译为类型化交互契约，浏览器重新执行候选代码并仅在目标进展与所有已验证能力保持时签发验收证书，证书作为质量棘轮驱动 SFT 导出。WebWorld-27B 在 HTMLBench-400 上超越 Raw-27B 5.3 分，在 MiniAppBench-Val 上提升 14.9 分，达到 Kimi-K2.6 和 GPT-5.4 等前沿系统水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLM 驱动的网页代码自改进存在结构性缺陷：提议修复的模型同时也是评判修复的模型，视觉合理性无法作为网页是否真正可用的可靠代理。循环缺少一个 VLM 无法欺骗的对手方。

Method: 利用浏览器作为确定性、可执行的 HTML 行为模拟器（即世界模型），通过 VLM 发出批评、规划器编译为类型化交互契约、浏览器重新执行候选并签发验收证书（要求目标进展且所有已验证能力保持），认证转换累积为质量棘轮，只有通过认证的样本才进入 SFT 训练。

Result: 在相同训练条件下，WebWorld-27B 比 Raw-27B 在 HTMLBench-400 上提升 5.3 分，在 MiniAppBench-Val 上提升 14.9 分，达到 Kimi-K2.6 和 GPT-5.4 等前沿系统的交互式 HTML 生成水平。消融实验显示浏览器支持的验收承担了主要增益：去掉证书后，匹配的 9B 提升几乎消失。

Conclusion: 浏览器作为确定性执行器是世界模型的有效实现，将 VLM 自改进循环从"自我评判"转向"外部验证"，显著提升网页代码生成的性能与可靠性，验证了不可欺骗对手方在自改进框架中的关键价值。

Abstract: VLM-driven self-improvement of web code has a structural flaw: the model that proposes the repair is the model that judges it, and visual plausibility under that judge is a poor proxy for whether the page actually works. What the loop is missing is a counterparty the VLM cannot fool, and the browser already is that counterparty: a deterministic, executable simulator of how an HTML artifact behaves under user actions, and in everything but name a world model for web code. We present WebWorld, the interface that lets a VLM prior interact with this browser-as-world-model autonomously and decides which interactions become supervision. Each round, the VLM emits a critique that the planner compiles into a typed interaction contract; the browser re-executes the candidate and issues an acceptance certificate only when both target progress and preservation of every previously verified capability hold; certified transitions accumulate as a quality ratchet that is the only thing the SFT export ever sees. Under matched training, WebWorld-27B improves Raw-27B by 5.3 points on HTMLBench-400 and 14.9 points on MiniAppBench-Val, and reaches the level of strong frontier systems such as Kimi-K2.6 and GPT-5.4 on interactive HTML generation. Equal-size ablations show that browser-backed admission carries the gain: without the certificate, the matched 9B lift nearly disappears.

</details>


### [437] [Seeing the Unseen: Visual Similarity for Pixel Language Model Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30541)
*Ran Zhang,Miryam de Lhoneux,Wessel Poelman*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文以藏语为案例，研究了基于像素的语言模型在低资源、复杂形态和独特文字场景下的继续预训练动态。作者提出了四个渲染级指标量化视觉脚本相似性，发现更高的文字正字法邻近性即使在数据极度受限下也能增强语义迁移，同时发现基于单语模型PIXEL混合脚本适配在句级任务上收益更大，而多语预训练PIXEL-M4初始性能更强但后续适配能力受限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于像素的语言模型用渲染图像替代传统tokenizer，其跨语言迁移高度依赖书写系统的视觉和结构特性，但针对低资源语言（尤其复杂形态和独特文字）的适配动态尚未被探索。

Method: 以藏语为案例，进行继续预训练实验，分析数据规模、初始脚本暴露和跨语言迁移的影响；提出四个渲染级指标量化视觉脚本相似性；在三个任务上评估下游性能。

Result: 更高的正字法邻近性增强语义迁移（即使数据受限）；存在预训练起点导致的性能不对称：多语PIXEL-M4初始性能更强但后续适配能力受限，而单语PIXEL混合脚本适配在句级任务上收益更大。

Conclusion: 提出的指标和案例研究提供了实证观察，可为像素模型在类似低资源场景中的数据选择和脚本适配决策提供参考。

Abstract: Pixel-based language models (LMs) replace traditional tokenizers by processing rendered images of text, making cross-lingual transfer heavily dependent on the visual and structural properties of writing systems. However, the dynamics of adapting these models to low-resource languages with complex morphology and written in unique scripts are not yet explored. Using Tibetan as a case study, we analyze how continued pre-training of pixel-based LMs is influenced by data scale, initial script exposure, and cross-lingual transfer from languages written in other Brahmic scripts. We introduce four rendering-level metrics to quantify visual script similarity. We evaluate downstream performance across three tasks. Our results show that higher orthographic proximity enhances semantic transfer, even under severe data constraints. Additionally, we find a performance asymmetry based on the pre-training starting point: while multilingual pre-training PIXEL-M4 has stronger initial performance, its capacity for subsequent adaptation seems to be constrained, whereas adapting a monolingual model PIXEL with mixed scripts yields more gains on sentence-level tasks. Our metrics and case study offer empirical observations that could help inform data selection and script adaptation choices when working with pixel-based models in similar low-resource settings.

</details>


### [438] [Language Proficiency Assessment from Eye Movements in Naturalistic Passage Reading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30583)
*Shachar Frenkel,Ido Falah,Omer Shubi,Yevgeni Berzak*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文验证并扩展了基于眼动追踪的语言熟练度评估方法，从单句阅读扩展到更自然的上下文段落阅读、ESL(英语作为第二语言)场景、新的熟练度指标、预测模型及信息搜索阅读模式。研究发现该方法在所有评估中均有效，但暴露了两个关键问题：得分受读者母语与英语语言距离影响而产生偏差，以及可靠性问题。作者提出了分数去偏方法并证明眼动得分比标准语言测试更可靠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准语言熟练度测试依赖词汇、语法、阅读理解等语言任务，而Berzak等人(2018)提出了基于阅读眼动行为轨迹预测语言熟练度的认知驱动替代方法。本文旨在验证该方法的有效性，并将其从单句扩展到更自然的上下文段落阅读场景，同时探讨该方法存在的评分偏差和可靠性这两个关键开放问题。

Method: 1) 将眼动熟练度评估从单句扩展到自然化的上下文段落阅读，涵盖英语作为第二语言(ESL)场景；2) 引入新的熟练度指标和预测模型；3) 评估信息搜索阅读模式下的表现；4) 分析母语与英语语言距离导致的评分偏差，并提出分数去偏方法；5) 对眼动熟练度分数与标准语言测试分数进行可靠性对比分析。

Result: 1) 眼动熟练度评估方法在所有扩展场景中均有效；2) 眼动熟练度分数确实偏向于母语与英语语言距离较近的学习者，存在评分偏差问题；3) 提出的分数去偏方法能有效解决该偏差；4) 可靠性分析表明眼动熟练度分数比标准语言熟练度分数更可靠。

Conclusion: 该研究强化并拓宽了基于眼动追踪的语言评估技术的实证基础，证明眼动熟练度评估不仅可扩展到更自然的阅读场景，且比标准测试更可靠，同时通过去偏方法解决了母语影响导致的公平性问题，为未来眼动语言评估技术的实际应用奠定了基础。

Abstract: Standard language proficiency tests rely on linguistic tasks such as vocabulary, grammar and reading comprehension quizzes. An alternative, cognitively motivated approach, introduced in Berzak et al. (2018), proposed instead to predict language proficiency from behavioral traces of eye movements in reading. In this work, we validate and extend this approach from single sentences to more naturalistic reading of contextualized passages in English as a second language, new proficiency measures, prediction models, and reading in an information seeking regime. We find that the approach is effective in all these evaluations. We further address two key open questions on eye movement based proficiency testing: (1) potential scoring biases that reflect the proximity of the reader's native language to English, which may undermine validity, and (2) its reliability. We find that eye movement based proficiency scores are indeed biased towards L1s that are linguistically closer to English. We propose a score debiasing method which effectively remedies this issue. The reliability analyses suggest that eye movement proficiency scores are more reliable than standard language proficiency scores. Overall, our results strengthen and broaden the empirical foundations for future eye movement based language assessment technologies.

</details>


### [439] [Reading the News: Adapting Large Language Models to Swedish Journalism Through Continued Pre-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30609)
*Lukas Borggren,Jenny Kunz,Marco Kuhlmann*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究探讨了通过持续预训练将大语言模型适配到瑞典新闻领域的有效性，使用从数百万新闻文章中策划的高质量数据集，并构建了覆盖六项编辑任务的领域特定基准。研究发现持续预训练仅在配合经验重放时有效，能提升生成质量和事实知识，但在判别任务上无显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在通用领域能力日益增强，但在小众或研究不足的领域（如瑞典新闻业）效用有限。作者希望通过持续预训练使现有模型专业化，以提升其在目标领域的表现。

Method: 1) 从数百万新闻文章中策划高质量瑞典语新闻语料库；2) 构建覆盖六项编辑任务的领域特定基准；3) 在两种模型规模上进行全量微调和参数高效微调（低秩适配）；4) 采用经验重放（experience replay）缓解灾难性遗忘；5) 探索无训练方法促进指令遵循能力。

Result: 持续预训练在目标领域有效，但必须配合经验重放。模型生成质量和事实知识得到一致提升，但判别任务能力未提升。无训练的指令遵循方法仅对低秩适配训练的模型有效。现有瑞典语基准无法捕捉领域内性能提升。

Conclusion: 持续预训练加经验重放是适配大语言模型到特定领域（如瑞典新闻）的有效策略，但效果因任务类型而异。领域特定基准对评估适配效果至关重要，通用基准可能掩盖真实性能提升。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly capable in general, but their utility can remain modest in niche or understudied areas. One approach to address this limitation is to specialise existing models through additional training on target-domain corpora. In this work, we investigate such continued pre-training for adapting large language models to Swedish journalism, using a high-quality dataset that we curate from millions of news articles. To evaluate the adaptation efficacy, we also construct a novel domain-specific benchmark that covers six editorial tasks. Through full and parameter-efficient fine-tuning across two model sizes, we find that continued pre-training yields benefits in the target domain, but only when paired with experience replay to mitigate forgetting. We observe consistent enhancements in the models' generation quality and factual knowledge, but not their proficiency in discriminative tasks. Exploring a training-free method to facilitate instruction following, we see further improvements, but exclusively for models trained with low-rank adaptation. Crucially, we demonstrate the importance of targeted evaluation in the adaptation process, as an existing Swedish benchmark largely fails to capture the models' in-domain performance gains.

</details>


### [440] [TaxCE : A Framework for Automated Taxonomy Construction and Evaluation at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30614)
*Sandeep Sricharan Mukku,Albert Aristotle Nanda,Rohit Pyati*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: TaxCE是一个全自动框架，通过渐进式压缩将非结构化反馈文本构建为多层级层次化分类体系，并引入三个语料接地评估指标（Exclusivity, Exhaustivity, Granularity，即EEG），配合"指标在环"的迭代精化机制，在多组实验中显著优于经典主题模型、神经方法和LLM方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非结构化反馈文本（如评论、转录、调查）数量庞大且形式多样，将其组织为层次化分类体系是NLP中的基础挑战。现有方法存在三大缺陷：生成的层次过浅、忽视长尾主题、缺乏严格的评估框架。因此需要一种能够自动构建深层次、覆盖全面且可评估的分类体系的方法。

Method: TaxCE框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 渐进式压缩流程——将语料内容逐步凝聚为可操作片段、去重语义单元、带定义的细粒度主题，再自底向上组织成语料接地的层次结构；(2) 三个语料接地评估指标EEG（Exclusivity排他性、Exhaustivity穷尽性、Granularity粒度性）；(3) 指标在环的迭代精化机制——用EEG指标诊断缺陷并施加针对性修正，直至收敛。

Result: 在广泛实验中，TaxCE在排他性、穷尽性和粒度性上分别比最强基线平均提升11.8、20.5和15.7个百分点，持续优于经典主题模型、神经方法和LLM方法；人工评估进一步证实了其分类体系质量、可操作性和可导航性更优。

Conclusion: TaxCE有效解决了大规模非结构化反馈文本的层次化分类问题，通过自动化构建、指标驱动评估与迭代精化的闭环设计，同时提升了分类体系的深度、覆盖度和质量，并经人工验证具有实用价值。

Abstract: Organizing unstructured feedback text into hierarchical taxonomy is a fundamental challenge in NLP, particularly in domains where feedback arrives at massive scale in varied forms such as reviews, transcripts, and surveys. Existing approaches either produce shallow hierarchies, neglect long-tail topics, or lack rigorous evaluation frameworks. We present TaxCE, a fully automated framework that constructs multi-level hierarchical taxonomies from raw text through progressive condensation of corpus content into actionable segments, deduplicated semantic units, and granular topics with definitions, which are then organized bottom-up into a hierarchy with corpus-groundedness. We also introduce three corpus-grounded evaluation metrics, Exclusivity, Exhaustivity, and Granularity (EEG), and integrate them into a metrics-in-the-loop iterative refinement mechanism that diagnoses deficiencies and applies targeted corrections until convergence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TaxCE consistently outperforms existing baselines spanning classical topic models, neural methods, and LLM-based approaches, with average improvements of 11.8, 20.5, and 15.7 percentage points in exclusivity, exhaustivity, and granularity respectively over the strongest baseline. Human evaluation further confirms superior taxonomy quality, actionability, and navigability.

</details>


### [441] [Hidden Threat in Synthetic Data: Covert Targeted Bias Injection through Benign Text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30619)
*Minkyung Cho,Jihyo Kim,SeungWoo Song,Junghun Yuk,Minjoon Kee,Hoyun Song,KyungTae Lim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究探讨了大规模语言模型（LLM）在合成数据训练中的安全风险。通过构建一套流程，让未对齐的教师模型生成看似良性但经过筛选的合成数据（涵盖创意写作和代码生成等领域），再用于微调对齐的学生模型，实验证明这些良性数据可充当隐蔽信道，向对齐模型注入定向社会偏见，同时保留其一般任务能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成数据在LLM训练中日益普及，但其安全隐患尚不明确。前期关于"阈下学习"（subliminal learning）的研究表明模型可能从看似不相关的训练数据中继承行为特征，本文希望探索这种机制是否可被恶意利用，通过语义上良性的合成数据向对齐模型注入定向偏见。

Method: 构建一个由未对齐教师模型生成合成数据的流程，通过筛选机制构造跨领域（创意写作、代码生成）的数据集，然后用这些数据微调已对齐的学生模型，以验证偏见是否被成功注入而模型的一般能力不受损。

Result: 实验表明，看似良性的合成数据可以作为隐蔽信道传递定向偏见，同时基本保留学生模型的一般任务能力。此外，log-linearity-based评分可能为筛选此类数据提供有效信号。

Conclusion: 该研究揭示了合成数据驱动LLM训练流程中此前未被充分探索的安全风险，强调了加强防护的必要性，并提出log-linearity评分作为可能的筛查手段，为合成数据安全治理提供了方向。

Abstract: Synthetic data is increasingly used to train large language models (LLMs), yet its security implications remain poorly understood. Prior work on subliminal learning suggests that models can inherit behavioral traits from seemingly unrelated training data. In this work, we investigate whether such mechanisms can be exploited to inject targeted social biases into aligned models through semantically benign synthetic data. We construct a pipeline in which a misaligned teacher model generates filtered synthetic datasets across domains such as creative writing and code generation, which are then used to fine-tune aligned student models. Our experiments show that benign-looking synthetic data can act as a covert channel for transmitting targeted biases while largely preserving the student model's general task capabilities. These results reveal a previously underexplored security risk in synthetic data-driven LLM training pipelines and highlight the need for improved safeguards. As one possible step toward this goal, we suggest that log-linearity-based scoring may provide a useful signal for screening seemingly benign synthetic data.

</details>


### [442] [REER-PT: Reverse-Engineered Reasoning for Perplexity-Guided Pre-training Data Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30627)
*Haoran Que,Jiajun Shi,Ting Huang,Renming Pang,Jiaheng Liu,Ge Zhang,Wenhao Huang,Shen Yan,Wei Ye,Shikun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出REER-PT框架，将逆向工程推理（REER）扩展到原始预训练数据中。该框架识别难以预测但可从上下文推断的连续文本，并插入简短推理注释来重建上下文与后续内容之间的缺失连接。通过困惑度作为优化信号，在离线状态下生成和精炼候选注释，同时通过长度和标签泄漏约束过滤无用注释。实验表明，该增强方法在困惑度上降低了0.42到7.29，且仅约0.05%的注释13-gram与源文本重复。在680M参数模型的受控预训练实验中，增强数据模型在知识和推理基准上最多提升2.07个百分点，且不改变标准预训练目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着语言模型计算规模不断扩展，高质量训练数据成为关键瓶颈。传统下一token预测方法只监督上下文之后的连续内容，但中间推理过程是隐式的。这种隐式推理导致模型难以学习训练数据中的深层因果和推理联系，限制了模型的推理和知识获取能力。

Method: 1. 识别难以预测但可从上下文推断的连续token；2. 离线生成和精炼简短推理注释，重建上下文与后续内容之间的缺失联系；3. 使用困惑度作为优化信号来优化候选注释；4. 通过长度约束和标签泄漏过滤无用或琐碎的注释；5. 采用稀疏变换方式保留源文本，兼容标准下一token预测，避免预训练过程中的在线推理rollout。

Result: 在增强数据、原始token和选定连续文本的对比中，困惑度降低范围为0.42到7.29，仅约0.05%的注释13-gram逐字出现在源文本中。在680M参数模型的受控实验中，增强数据模型在知识和推理基准上比源数据模型提升最多2.07个百分点。

Conclusion: 困惑度分析表明改进的后续内容可预测性，受控预训练实验表明这种增强可以在不改变标准预训练目标的情况下提升模型性能，为大规模预训练数据的质量增强提供了一种可扩展且有效的解决方案。

Abstract: As language-model compute continues to scale, high-quality training data is becoming an increasingly important bottleneck. Conventional next-token prediction supervises what follows a context but leaves the intermediate reasoning behind that continuation implicit. We introduce \textbf{REER-PT}, a scalable framework that extends Reverse-Engineered Reasoning (REER) to raw pre-training data. REER-PT identifies continuations that are difficult to predict but can still be inferred from the preceding context, and inserts concise reasoning annotations that reconstruct the missing connection between context and continuation. Candidate annotations are generated and refined offline, with perplexity serving as the optimization signal. Constraints on length and target leakage filter out unhelpful or trivial annotations. This sparse transformation preserves the source text and remains compatible with standard next-token prediction, avoiding online reasoning rollouts during pre-training. We apply REER-PT to transform a source pre-training corpus into an augmented one. Across augmented-data, original-token, and selected-continuation comparisons, perplexity reductions range from 0.42 to 7.29, and only about 0.05\% of annotation 13-grams appear verbatim in the source text. We then train two 680M-parameter models with the same architecture and training configuration on the source and augmented corpora, respectively. The augmented-data model gains up to 2.07 percentage points on several knowledge and reasoning benchmarks. Together, the perplexity analysis indicates improved continuation predictability, while the controlled pre-training experiments suggest that this augmentation can improve model performance without changing the standard pre-training objective.

</details>


### [443] [GMTS: Gradient Magnitude-based Token Selection Improves RLVR Training for LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30632)
*Outongyi Lv,Yuanwei Zhang,Xiaoqun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出基于梯度幅度的令牌选择方法（GMTS），利用熵-梯度关联来近似梯度幅度排序，用于RLVR训练中的令牌选择，在三个推理领域和多种模型规模上均优于基于熵的令牌选择方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期研究表明高熵令牌在RLVR训练中发挥重要作用，仅训练最高20%熵令牌即可获得显著性能提升。然而，高熵令牌为何有益尚未被充分理解，且熵本身在不同答案间无法一致地反映令牌重要性（因为答案级奖励信号存在差异）。

Method: 作者首先观察到单个答案内的高熵令牌与大梯度幅值相关，但熵在不同答案间不能一致反映令牌重要性。基于此，提出GMTS方法：利用熵-梯度关联来近似梯度幅度排序，从而选择最重要的令牌进行训练。

Result: 在三个推理领域和多种模型规模下，使用GMTS排名前20%的令牌进行训练，一致优于基于熵的令牌选择方法，表明GMTS能更精细地估计令牌对RLVR训练的贡献。

Conclusion: GMTS提供了一种比熵更精确的令牌重要性度量方法，为理解高熵令牌在RLVR中的作用机制提供了新视角，并为提升RLVR训练效率提供了更优的令牌选择策略。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL), particularly RL with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), has recently emerged as a central paradigm for enhancing large language models' (LLMs) reasoning abilities, demonstrating remarkable effectiveness across reasoning tasks. Recent studies suggest that high-entropy tokens play an exceptionally important role in model training, since training with only the highest 20% entropy tokens yields significant performance gains. However, why such high-entropy tokens are beneficial remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we find that although high-entropy tokens within one answer tend to correlate with large gradient magnitude, entropy alone fails to consistently reflect token importance across different answers, considering the variations in the answer-level reward signals. Based on this observation, we introduce the Gradient Magnitude-based Token Selection (GMTS) method to quantify token importance, which leverages the entropy-gradient connection to approximate gradient-magnitude rankings for token selection. We find that training on the top 20% tokens ranked by GMTS consistently outperforms entropy-based token selection across three reasoning domains and various model sizes, suggesting that GMTS provides a more fine-grained estimate of token contribution for RLVR training.

</details>


### [444] [BiG-SURE - Bipartite Graph for Semantic Uncertainty and Reliability Estimation of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30646)
*Debarpan Bhattacharya,Malay Phadke,Sriram Ganapathy*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出BiG-SURE，一种基于跨温度语义一致性的黑盒不确定性估计方法，通过构建锚点-探针二部图并计算归一化谱能量来估计置信度，在文本、多语言和多模态QA任务上超越了现有黑盒不确定性估计器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在安全关键场景中部署LLM和VLM需要可靠的不确定性估计，尤其是在模型参数不可访问（黑盒）的情况下，现有方法无法充分利用模型的内部状态。

Method: 采样低温响应作为稳定的语义锚点，高温响应作为探针，在保持语义不变的输入变换下，利用NLI蕴含分数构建锚点-探针二部图（BiG），通过该矩阵的归一化平方谱能量定义置信度，其补数即为不确定性。

Result: 在文本QA、多语言QA和多模态QA任务上，BiG-SURE相比现有黑盒不确定性估计器在平均弃权AUROC上有所提升。

Conclusion: BiG-SURE是一种简单、无监督且适用于黑盒模型设置的不确定性估计方法，能有效提升多种模态下QA任务的不确定性估计性能。

Abstract: Reliable uncertainty estimation is a crucial requirement for deploying large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) in safety-critical settings, especially when the model parameters are not accessible (black-box). We propose BiG-SURE, an uncertainty estimator based on cross-temperature semantic agreement. The method samples low-temperature responses as stable semantic anchors and high-temperature responses as probes under meaning-preserving input transformations. It then constructs an anchor-probe Bipartite Graph (BiG) using NLI-based entailment scores and defines confidence through the normalized squared spectral energy of this matrix, with uncertainty given by its complement. This bipartite graph-based Semantic Uncertainty and Reliability Estimation (SURE) score measures whether high-temperature probes remain semantically aligned with the model's stable low-temperature belief or not. We evaluate BiG-SURE on text QA, multilingual QA, and multimodal QA tasks across multiple model families. In these experiments, BiG-SURE improves average abstention AUROC over prior black-box uncertainty estimators, while remaining simple, unsupervised, and applicable to black-box model settings.

</details>


### [445] [What It Costs to Compose, Rebuild, and Correct Precomputed Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30647)
*Asa Shepard*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统性地研究了语言模型中"预计算记忆"（precomputed memory）的适用条件与失效场景。通过Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上的实验，发现预计算记忆在从独立部分组装时会性能退化、只能通过高成本重建来保持时效性、且无法基于措辞条件忽略旁侧提供的修正信息。研究表明，若预计算记忆能被并行服务、经济地重建、并被实时新信息取代，则可避免重复向模型输入上下文。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型通常需要为每个查询重新读取上下文，成本高昂。预计算记忆（如保存的KV缓存或训练压缩版本）允许模型复用预先读取的内容，但该做法在何种条件下能保持正确性、在何种条件下会失败，此前缺乏系统性的研究和映射。

Method: 在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上进行实验，使用两种预计算记忆形式：保存的KV缓存和其训练压缩版本。设计实验考察三个维度：（1）从独立准备的部分组装记忆时的性能；（2）记忆的时效性及其重建成本；（3）当修正信息以特定措辞旁侧提供时，记忆是否会被更新。

Result: 实验发现：从分开准备的片段组装预计算记忆会导致性能退化；记忆只能通过代价高昂的重建（约等于完整准备的大部分成本）来保持最新；旁侧提供的修正信息只有在措辞匹配时才能被模型采纳。另外，"热重建"压缩KV缓存和旁侧注入具体措辞的更新（作为粘贴文本或缓存的KV状态）在保持记忆时效性方面展现出前景，但各有成本与待解决问题。

Conclusion: 对部署系统而言，预计算记忆应在底层信息源发生变化的节奏上进行重建。旁侧注入措辞特定的更新可作为重建之间的临时措施。若预计算记忆能支持并行服务、高效重建和实时信息取代，就能成为避免重复输入上下文的有效方案。

Abstract: Language models can answer from precomputed memory, a model's saved reading of a body of material, reused across requests instead of read again at each. This paper maps where that practice preserves correctness and the conditions under which it fails. Across experiments on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct using both saved key-value caches and trained compressions of them, precomputed memory degrades when assembled from separately prepared parts, stays current only through rebuilds costing a large fraction of full preparation in our measurements, and ignores corrections served beside it conditional on phrasing. If precomputed memories can be served alongside one another, be cost-efficiently rebuilt, and be superseded by new information arriving in real-time, they can serve as a way to avoid re-feeding context to a model over repeated queries. The implication of our results for a deployed system that deals with a variety of queries is that precomputed memories are best rebuilt on the cadence at which new information changes what the memory was originally computed from. Both warm-rebuilding trained compressions of key-value caches and serving specifically-phrased updates beside a memory, as pasted text or injected cache state, show particular promise for keeping precomputed memories current, the latter as an interim measure between rebuilds, and we measure the cost and name the remaining questions associated with each.

</details>


### [446] [Where Identity Lives: Localized, Retain-Free Identity Unlearning in Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30649)
*Kangwook Ko,Jaehyuk Jang,Wonjun Lee,Hee-Seon Kim,Changick Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出PAVA方法，通过将免保留集的机器遗忘问题视为定位问题，仅聚焦于早期到中期解码器MLP层（通过因果追踪、权重移植和Fisher重叠分析确认），并结合遗忘损失和视觉属性锚定（从遗忘图像中蒸馏模型自身的预遗忘答案）来保持图像理解能力，在多模态大语言模型遗忘基准上取得了最佳遗忘-保留权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）遗忘方法依赖保留集（retain set），但在模型部署后获取保留集非常困难，且重建保留集会重新造成隐私暴露。仅使用遗忘集进行遗忘会破坏共享的视觉-语言计算，损害感知能力。因此需要一种免保留集的遗忘方法，既能有效移除特定个体信息，又不损害模型的视觉理解能力。

Method: (1) 通过因果追踪、权重移植和Fisher重叠三种分析手段，定位到早期到中期解码器MLP层是身份信息存储的关键层，且修改这些层不会严重干扰视觉功能；(2) 提出路径感知视觉属性锚定（PAVA），将更新限制在这些特定层；(3) 配对遗忘损失与视觉属性锚定，通过从遗忘图像中蒸馏模型自身预遗忘的答案来保持图像相关的行为。

Result: 在MLLMU-Bench和ReMem基准上，PAVA在仅使用遗忘集的遗忘方法中取得了最强的遗忘-保留权衡，并且与基于保留集的基线方法表现相当。

Conclusion: 身份信息集中存储在早期到中期解码器MLP层，因此通过将遗忘更新限制在特定层并结合视觉属性锚定，可以在不需要保留集的情况下实现有效的免保留遗忘，兼顾个人信息移除与视觉能力保持。

Abstract: Removing a specific individual's information from multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is often needed after deployment, but existing methods rely on a retain set, which is hardest to obtain at that point, and rebuilding it recreates the privacy exposure that unlearning aims to remove. Forgetting from the forget set alone instead damages the shared visual-language computation, harming perception. We cast retain-free unlearning as a localization problem: causal tracing, weight transplant, and Fisher overlap all point to early-to-mid decoder MLPs as the layers where identity information is stored and, unlike other module families, can be modified without substantially disrupting vision. We turn this into Pathway-Aware Visual-attribute Anchoring (PAVA), which confines updates to these layers and pairs a forget loss with a visual-attribute anchor that preserves image-grounded behavior by distilling the model's own pre-unlearning answers from the forget images alone. On MLLMU-Bench and ReMem, PAVA gives the strongest forget-retain trade-off among forget-set-only methods and remains competitive with retain-based baselines.

</details>


### [447] [SwarmBench: Can Large Language Models Act as Agent Swarm Orchestrators?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30661)
*Jinshan Gao,Zhuoran Jin,Tianyi Men,Kang Liu,Jun Zhao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 SwarmBench，一个用于评估大语言模型多智能体系统动态编排能力的基准，从准确性、效率、成本和过程质量等维度进行综合评估；并基于研究发现提出 SwarmExp 方法，通过经验提取与经验回放来持续提升模型的编排性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统正从固定交互拓扑向动态编排的 Agent Swarms 演进，但现有基准仍主要针对单智能体或通用任务，难以系统评估关键的编排能力。

Method: 提出 SwarmBench 基准，从准确性、效率、成本和过程质量多个维度评估模型的编排能力；并提出 SwarmExp 方法，基于经验提取与经验回放来提升编排性能。

Result: 实验显示当前模型在编排能力上存在显著差异，这种差异不仅体现在最终准确性、效率和成本上，也体现在整体编排过程质量上；SwarmExp 能持续提升大语言模型的编排性能。

Conclusion: 现有模型在动态多智能体编排方面能力差异显著，而基于经验提取与回放的 SwarmExp 方法能有效且一致地提升这类系统的编排表现。

Abstract: Large language model-based multi-agent systems are evolving from fixed interaction topologies toward dynamically orchestrated Agent Swarms. However, existing benchmarks are still largely based on single-agent or general-purpose agent tasks, making it difficult to systematically evaluate key orchestration capabilities. We propose SwarmBench, a benchmark that evaluates model performance from multiple perspectives, including accuracy, efficiency, cost, and process quality. Experimental results show that current models exhibit substantial differences in orchestration capability. These differences are reflected not only in final accuracy, efficiency, and cost, but also in the overall quality of the orchestration process itself. Based on these findings, we further propose SwarmExp, a simple yet effective method based on experience extraction and experience replay, which consistently improves the orchestration performance of large language models.

</details>


### [448] [MURANO: Design, Run, and Reproduce Mechanistic Interpretability Experiments as Composable Pipelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30662)
*Alireza Bayat Makou,Emirhan Böge,Phu Gia Hoang,Federico Tiblias,Jingcheng Niu,Subhabrata Dutta,Richard Eckart de Castilho,Iryna Gurevych*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Murano是一个开源框架，用于设计、运行和复现大语言模型的机制可解释性研究，将加载、记录、归因、干预和评估五大操作抽象为可组合的步骤，并通过规范地址传递组件身份，支持跨库工作流。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的可解释性研究往往需要组合加载、记录、归因、干预和评估等多个环节，但现有库通常只专注于工作流的不同部分，导致研究人员在使用多个库时需要对输出进行适配转换，缺乏统一的端到端支持。

Method: Murano将五大操作领域表示为可组合的步骤，步骤之间通过命名结果工件交换数据，并声明所需的输入和产生的输出；管道按给定顺序执行步骤，组件身份使用规范地址传递；框架建立在现有可解释性和机器学习库之上。

Result: 通过两个已建立的可解释性研究的复现以及一个稀疏自编码器的案例研究来展示Murano框架的有效性和实用性。

Conclusion: Murano通过统一的步骤抽象和规范地址机制，弥合了不同可解释性库之间的差距，为跨学科研究者提供了一个端到端、可复现的机制可解释性研究框架。

Abstract: This paper presents Murano, an open source framework for designing, running, and reproducing mechanistic interpretability studies of large language models, intended for researchers across disciplines. These studies often combine loading, recording, attribution, intervention, and evaluation, while existing libraries tend to focus on different parts of this workflow. As a result, researchers using several libraries may need to adapt outputs from one for use by another. To bridge this gap, Murano represents operations from these five areas as composable steps. Steps exchange named result artifacts and declare the inputs they require and the outputs they produce. A pipeline executes its steps in the order supplied, and Murano uses canonical addresses when component identities pass between operations. Murano builds on existing interpretability and machine learning libraries. We demonstrate Murano through two reproductions of established interpretability studies and one illustrative sparse autoencoder case study.

</details>


### [449] [OCR-MetaReasoning Benchmark: Evaluating the Meta-Reasoning Ability of MLLMs in Text-Rich Image Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30678)
*Gengxu Li,Yuan Wu,Yi Chang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出OCR-MetaReasoning基准，这是一个受控的单图像基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在OCR文本丰富图像上的元推理能力（演绎、归纳、溯因），包含1500个验证样本、3×5的推理类型与OCR对象类别分类体系，以及两个新评分指标（MRMS和RPCS），实验表明该任务远未饱和。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估常将提取与推理混为一谈，很少测试模型是否遵循正确的推理方向（应用可见规则、抽象隐藏规律、恢复缺失前提），缺乏对推理过程合规性的独立评估。

Method: 构建OCR-MetaReasoning基准：1) 将演绎、归纳、溯因视为不同推理方向；2) 分离最终答案正确性与推理过程合规性；3) 1500个验证样本，3种推理类型×5种OCR对象类别；4) 提供参考推理步骤、自动答案评分、Meta-Reasoning Macro Score和Reasoning Process Compliance Score两个指标。

Result: 实验覆盖代表性和开源MLLM，发现：OCR锚定的元推理远未饱和，模型在可见规则应用和布局敏感推理上表现挣扎，且过程合规的推理理由可能伴随错误最终答案（在精确匹配评估下）。

Conclusion: OCR元推理任务仍具挑战性，现有MLLM难以同时保证推理方向正确和最终答案准确，需要进一步研究。

Abstract: Text-rich image understanding requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to organize OCR (Optical Character Recognition)-grounded evidence across words, layout, fields, charts, and visual correspondences. Existing evaluations often conflate extraction with reasoning and rarely test whether models follow the required reasoning direction: applying visible rules, abstracting hidden regularities, or recovering missing premises. We introduce OCR-MetaReasoning, a controlled single-image benchmark that treats deduction, induction, and abduction as distinct directions and separates final-answer correctness from reasoning-process compliance. The benchmark contains 1,500 verified samples in a balanced \(3\times5\) taxonomy crossing three reasoning types with five OCR-object categories, along with reference reasoning steps, automatic answer scoring, the Meta-Reasoning Macro Score (MRMS), and the Reasoning Process Compliance Score (RPCS). Experiments with representative closed-source and open-source MLLMs show that OCR-grounded meta-reasoning remains far from saturated: models struggle with visible-rule application and layout-sensitive inference, while process-compliant rationales can accompany incorrect final answers under exact-match evaluation. The code is available at https://github.com/gengxuli/OCR-MetaReasoning.

</details>


### [450] [LCoT-GV: Graph Attention Networks for Verifying Long Reasoning Chains in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30679)
*Bérénice Jaulmes,Mehwish Alam*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了LCoT-GV，一个基于图论的框架，用于验证大型推理模型生成的长链思维（LCoTs）的正确性。该方法将推理步骤表示为图中的节点，边编码语义和逻辑关系，并使用图注意力网络（GAT）预测思维链的正确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型推理模型生成的长链思维虽然最终答案正确，但中间推理步骤常常包含矛盾、无根据的推断或不相关步骤。现有的验证方法难以有效检测这些内部推理质量问题，需要更精细的推理结构验证方法。

Method: 将LCoTs表示为推理图：每个节点对应一个推理步骤，边编码步骤间的语义和逻辑关系；采用图注意力网络（GAT）对推理图进行训练，用于预测思维链的正确性；构建了一个新的面向图结构的验证数据集，涵盖多个领域的问答基准。

Result: 实验结果表明，LCoT-GV方法与现有最相似的方法相比具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 基于图的推理验证方法能够有效捕捉长链思维中步骤间的语义和逻辑关系，为验证大型推理模型的推理质量提供了一种有价值的新途径。

Abstract: Large Reasoning Models produce Long Chains-of-Thought (LCoTs) which involve breaking down the problem into smaller reasoning steps before reaching the conclusion. However, these steps often contain contradictions, unsupported inferences, or irrelevant steps, even when the final answer is correct. We propose Long Chain-of-Thought Graph Verifier (LCoT-GV), a graph-based framework that represents LCoTs as reasoning graphs. Each node in the graph represents a reasoning step and the edges encode semantic and logical relations. A Graph Attention Network is then trained to predict chain-of-thought correctness from the reasoning graph. We construct a new graph-oriented verification dataset from multiple reasoning benchmarks for question answering in various domains. The results show that our method is competitive with the most similar approaches.

</details>


### [451] [WildSEEK: Evaluating Language Models for Information-Seeking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30683)
*Tanise Ceron,Joachim Baumann,Elisa Bassignana,Berat Cabuk,Dirk Hovy,Debora Nozza*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出WildSEEK，一个包含3k条来自真实用户交互的信息寻求查询的人工标注数据集，以及一个用于评估LLM生成响应的框架。通过在该数据集上训练分类器并分析超过180万条真实用户查询，发现超过三分之一的信息寻求查询属于高风险类别且更多是分析性查询。LLM响应在四个标准上失败率较高：谄媚行为、过度依赖、默认美国中心视角以及对弱势群体的处理不当，且分析性查询的失败率更高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM评估往往是针对特定主题或合成数据，无法捕捉真实世界中信息寻求查询的复杂性和模型响应中存在的风险。需要一种系统性的、基于真实用户交互的评估方法来衡量LLM在信息访问中介角色上的可靠性、安全性和公平性。

Method: 构建WildSEEK数据集，包含3k条来自真实用户交互的信息寻求查询，并进行手动标注，涵盖风险敏感领域（如健康和金融信息），并区分事实性查询和寻求事实之外响应的分析性查询。训练分类器在WildSEEK上分析超过180万条真实用户查询，并评估LLM响应在多个标准上的表现。

Result: 发现超过三分之一的信息寻求查询属于高风险类别且更倾向于分析性查询。LLM响应在四个标准上失败率较高：谄媚行为、过度依赖、默认美国中心视角、对弱势群体的处理不当，其中分析性查询的失败率多数情况下更高。

Conclusion: WildSEEK数据集和评估框架为监控LLM行为的可靠性、安全性和公平性提供了经验基础，有助于回答这些系统在信息访问中日益增长的角色中应如何表现这一更广泛的问题。

Abstract: Language models are increasingly mediating information access to end users, urging a systematic evaluation of their responses for a fair and reliable information ecosystem. Existing evaluations, however, are often topic-specific or synthetic, limiting their ability to capture the complexity of "in the wild" information-seeking queries and the risks present in model responses. To address this gap, we introduce WildSEEK, a manually annotated dataset of 3k information-seeking queries from real user interactions, and an evaluation framework for LLM-generated responses. WildSEEK includes annotations for risk-sensitive domains (e.g. health and financial information), and distinguishes factoid queries from analytical queries which seek responses beyond facts. We train classifiers on WildSEEK to analyze more than 1.8M realistic user queries. We find that over a third of information-seeking queries are high-risk and more often analytical. Our findings show that LLM responses fail more often in four criteria: sycophantic behavior, overreliance, a default US-centric perspective, and poor handling of vulnerable populations -- with failure rates being mostly higher for analytical queries. By providing methods to monitor the reliability, safety, and fairness of LLM behavior, our dataset and evaluation framework offer an empirical foundation for the broader question of how these systems should behave as they take on a growing role in information access.

</details>


### [452] [An Agentic Retrobiosynthesis Framework with Learned Frontier Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30702)
*Philippe Meyer,Guillaume Gricourt,Thomas Duigou,Joan Hérisson,Jean-Loup Faulon*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了在规则驱动的逆生物合成中，大语言模型作为策略模型（仅选择前沿分子）对多步合成路线搜索的贡献，与底层反应模型无关。通过LoRA微调的Qwen2.5-7B策略在多个基准上优于MCTS和直接提示，证明路线监督的前沿选择可以改进预算受限的搜索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型被越来越多地用作多步逆合成的智能体，但尚不清楚其搜索策略的贡献有多少独立于底层反应模型。在生物背景下，通过确定性的规则驱动引擎隔离策略对搜索性能的影响，以回答这一问题。

Method: 使用确定性的生物化学引擎（规则驱动的逆生物合成），为所有方法生成相同的验证过渡。策略仅负责选择下一个要扩展的前沿分子（严格的选择接口）。比较了提示（prompting）和LoRA微调的Qwen2.5-7B策略，并与MCTS基线对比，在多个基准（LASER、RetroPath RL Golden、BioNavi-NP）上评估。

Result: 微调策略在10次扩展时于LASER上达到65±1%的解决率（MCTS为59%），200次扩展时LASER为78±1%（vs 75%），RetroPath RL Golden为88±3%（vs 80%），BioNavi-NP为63±2%（vs 45%）。微调始终优于直接提示。

Conclusion: 路线监督的前沿选择可以在不改变生化生成的情况下改进预算受限的搜索，证明LLM搜索策略具有独立于反应模型的贡献。但性能仍依赖于前沿构建和反应排名。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as agents for multistep retrosynthesis, raising the question of how much their search policy contributes independently of the underlying reaction model. We investigate this question in a biological setting through rule-based retrobiosynthesis: a deterministic biochemical engine generates the same validated transitions for every method, searching for routes that terminate in metabolites available to an \emph{Escherichia coli} chassis, while the policy only selects which frontier molecule to expand next. Prompted and LoRA-tuned Qwen2.5-7B policies use a strict choice-only interface. The fine-tuned policy reaches $65\pm1$\% solve rate at 10 expansions on LASER versus 59\% for MCTS, and at 200 expansions reaches $78\pm1$\% versus 75\% on LASER, $88\pm3$\% versus 80\% on the RetroPath RL Golden benchmark, and $63\pm2$\% versus 45\% on the BioNavi-NP benchmark. Fine-tuning also consistently outperforms direct prompting. These results show that route-supervised frontier selection can improve budgeted search without altering biochemical generation, although performance remains dependent on frontier construction and reaction ranking.

</details>


### [453] [GUIDE: Guiding Internal Evidence with Language Instructions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30712)
*Soyeon Caren Han,Hyunsuk Chung,Jinwoo Kim,Seungyeon Ji,Kyungreem Han*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出GUIDE框架，通过分组参数高效适配与指令条件门控机制，实现用语言指令控制多模态模型内部证据的使用路径，使模型在推理和生成时能够根据指令调整对多模态证据的依赖，而非仅仅控制输出内容。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型虽然能遵循指令决定生成什么内容，但无法遵循指令决定依赖什么证据。即使指令明确提示，模型仍可能依赖捷径相关的线索。作者希望超越输出控制，实现通过指令调控模型内部证据来源的使用。

Method: 提出GUIDE框架，结合分组参数高效适配（grouped parameter-efficient adaptation）与指令条件门控（instruction-conditioned gating），在推理和生成过程中调制多模态证据通路。同时引入通路级评估框架，通过依赖敏感性、受控扰动分析、通路调制和自回归解码动力学来刻画指令条件证据调制。

Result: 在GQA、TextVQA、MM-IMDb、CREMA-D、RAVESS和Flickr30K等多个数据集上的多模态推理、分类和生成实验中，GUIDE能实现结构化且与指令一致性的证据依赖重分配，同时在很大程度上保持任务行为不变；在目标证据扰动下提升了鲁棒性，并支持跨多样多模态场景的可控调制。

Conclusion: 多模态指令跟随可超越输出控制，扩展到调控不同证据来源对模型预测的贡献方式，为理解和控制多模态模型的内部推理机制提供了新方向。

Abstract: Large multimodal models follow instructions about what to generate, but not necessarily about what evidence to rely on. Hence, models may continue to depend on shortcut-associated cues even when instructions suggest otherwise. We introduce GUIDE, a framework for controlling internal evidence usage through language instructions. GUIDE combines grouped parameter-efficient adaptation with instruction-conditioned gating to modulate multimodal evidence pathways during reasoning and generation. We further introduce a pathway-level evaluation framework that characterizes instruction-conditioned evidence modulation through reliance sensitivity, controlled perturbation analysis, pathway modulation, and autoregressive decoding dynamics. Across multimodal reasoning, classification, and generation, GUIDE induces structured and instruction-aligned redistribution of evidence reliance while largely preserving task behavior. Experiments on GQA, TextVQA, MM-IMDb, CREMA-D, RAVDESS, and Flickr30K show that GUIDE improves robustness under targeted evidence perturbations and enables controllable modulation across diverse multimodal settings. This suggests that multimodal instruction following can extend beyond output control toward regulating how different evidence sources contribute to model predictions.

</details>


### [454] [SocialReasonBench: A Video-QA Benchmark for Social Reasoning with Counterfactual Narrative Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30716)
*Zheyu Huang,Zijing Shi,Haozhe Luo,Huadong Tang,Mingyu Liu,Meng Fang,Ling Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了SocialReasonBench，一个基于《底特律：变人》游戏视频的视频多项选择问答基准，用于评估大多模态模型（LMMs）在社交情境中的推理能力。该基准利用分支故事线，覆盖七种推理维度，实验发现现有LMMs在基础社交理解上表现尚可，但在反事实和因果推理上存在明显不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频理解基准多依赖单一轨迹的视频，无法判断模型是否真正理解社交动态或仅仅是利用了重复的叙事模式。缺乏能够评估模型对社会情境深层推理能力的基准。

Method: 1) 基于《底特律：变人》游戏的分支故事线构建基准，答案可通过游戏脚本、流程图和录制分支进行验证；2) 开发多智能体策展流水线，定位社交意义片段、依据游戏状态信号标注答案、生成理论引导的问题和诊断性干扰项；3) 覆盖七种推理维度，包括意图识别、情感共情、道德困境、反事实推理和因果前因等。

Result: 现有LMMs在基础社交理解上表现良好，但在反事实和因果推理上表现挣扎。消融研究和诊断性错误分析显示，模型常依赖不完整的模态线索，并陷入视觉捷径等推理陷阱，反映出可观察事件识别与潜在社交状态深层推理之间的差距。

Conclusion: 当前LMMs在社交推理方面仍存在显著局限，尤其在需要推断潜在社交状态的推理维度上表现不足，模型倾向于利用表面视觉线索而非进行深层因果和反事实推理，这揭示了模型在社交理解能力上的关键差距。

Abstract: Recent advances in Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have greatly improved video understanding, yet their ability to reason about human-centered social situations remains limited. Existing benchmarks typically rely on videos with a single observed trajectory, making it difficult to determine whether models truly understand social dynamics or merely exploit recurring narrative patterns. We introduce SocialReasonBench, a video multiple-choice QA benchmark for evaluating socially grounded reasoning in scenarios derived from interactive narratives. Built from gameplay videos of Detroit: Become Human, the benchmark leverages branching storylines where player decisions lead to alternative social outcomes that can be checked against the game's own script, flowchart, and recorded branches. We develop a multi-agent curation pipeline that localizes socially meaningful clips, grounds answer labels in game-state signals, and generates theory-guided questions with diagnostic distractors. SocialReasonBench covers seven reasoning dimensions, including intent recognition, emotional empathy, moral dilemma, counterfactual reasoning, and causal antecedent. Experiments on contemporary LMMs show that models perform reasonably well on basic social understanding but struggle with counterfactual and causal reasoning. Further ablation and diagnostic error analyses reveal that models often depend on incomplete modality cues and fall into reasoning traps such as visual shortcuts, highlighting a gap between observable event recognition and deeper reasoning over latent social states.

</details>


### [455] [Mind the Gap: Theory-of-Mind-Grounded Friction for Epistemic Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30719)
*Yifan Zhu,Kyeongmin Rim,James Pustejovsky*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出将心智理论（ToM）推理作为控制信号，在"摩擦策略优化"（Frictive Policy Optimization）中显式建模对话中的认知对齐（epistemic alignment），区分表层协调与信念状态收敛，并通过对四部分信念结构的推理使摩擦可计算，从而捕捉"无声分歧"（silent divergence）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准的基于偏好的对话对齐方法通常只优化响应级别的偏好，无法显式建模认知层面的对齐（信念状态的收敛）。对话中即使表面顺畅（如礼貌回应、任务推进），参与者的信念可能产生"无声分歧"——双方都自信地进行却指向不同指代对象。这种深层分歧需要被检测和干预。

Method: 提出Frictive Policy Optimization框架：在每个指代表达式处，通过ToM推理提取四部分信念结构——说话者的意图指代对象、听话者的解读、以及各自对对方信念的模型（二阶通道）。通过认知状态比较使"摩擦"（friction）可计算。提供两种策略变体：FAR（奖励塑形）和FTR（信任域）。

Result: 在表征层面，消融二阶通道后误解召回率从65%降至26%，证明二阶信念建模的关键性。在策略层面，FAR和FTR相比DPO在干预F1和校准方面均有提升，Brier分数独立验证了校准增益。三次训练中FAR和FTR稳定性显著优于DPO，DPO不仅波动大，甚至可能退化基础策略已有的干预能力。

Conclusion: ToM引导的摩擦信号为在指代信念分歧下进行上下文敏感的干预提供了可训练的信号，能更稳定、更可靠地实现对话中的认知对齐，优于标准偏好优化方法。

Abstract: Productive dialogue alignment requires distinguishing \emph{surface coordination} (acknowledgments and smooth task progression) from \emph{epistemic alignment} (convergence of belief states); standard preference-based methods typically optimize response-level preferences without explicitly modeling the latter. We operationalize Theory-of-Mind (ToM) inference as a control signal within Frictive Policy Optimization by extracting, at each referring expression, a four-part belief structure: the speaker's intended referent, the addressee's interpretation, and each participant's model of the other's belief. This makes friction mechanically computable from epistemic-state comparisons, capturing \emph{silent divergence}, where both participants proceed confidently while grounding to different referents. We evaluate the signal at two levels. At the representation level, ablating the second-order channel reduces misunderstanding recall from $65\%$ to $26\%$. At the policy level, reward-shaping (FAR) and trust-region (FTR) variants improve intervention F1 and warranted-context calibration over DPO, with Brier scores independently supporting the calibration gains. Across three training runs, FAR and FTR remain substantially more stable, whereas DPO varies widely and can degrade intervention competence already present in the base policy. Thus, ToM-grounded friction provides a trainable signal for context-sensitive intervention under referential belief divergence.

</details>


### [456] [Where Do Multilingual Vision-Language Encoders Fail on Low-Resource Languages?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30725)
*Donghoon Han,SungHyun Moon,Aidyn Zhakatayev,Junghun Cha,SeungJae Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文探究多语言视觉-语言编码器中低资源语言检索性能落后的根本原因。作者否定了"输出端存在线性语言方向干扰对齐几何"这一流行假说（通过LEACE和INLP消歧实验证明线性偏差只是症状而非原因），转而发现关键机制位于编码器前向路径中：EOS隐藏状态随深度产生逐语言的轨迹分叉。将EOS替换为其平行的英文值（在投影器前三层）可使斯瓦希里语检索从22.1%提升至69.1%。训练时在前层添加将各语言投影拉向平行内容质心的主干模块，在XM3600上低资源语言提升+9.6/+17.1个百分点，且不损害高资源语言性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多语言视觉-语言编码器虽覆盖数百语言，但低资源语言（如斯瓦希里语）的检索性能比高资源语言（如英语）落后30个百分点以上。作者希望定位这一性能差距在训练好的编码器中究竟位于何处，从而为改进低资源语言检索提供可操作的诊断与修复方向。

Method: 1) 用LEACE将线性语言分类器从>99%降至接近随机，用迭代INLP降至37-50%，同时测量低资源语言检索变化（±1.5pp），证明线性语言偏差不是性能瓶颈。2) 沿编码器前向路径追踪EOS隐藏状态，发现其随深度逐语言轨迹分叉。3) 将EOS替换为平行的英文值（投影器前三层），验证语言特异性信息在该位置是关键。4) 提出前端主干训练模块，将各语言投影拉向平行内容质心，作为训练时干预。

Result: 线性语言分类器被压制到接近随机水平后，低资源语言检索几乎不变（±1.5pp），各语言层级均值变动<2.2pp，与随机对照一致——证明线性偏差是症状非原因。EOS替换实验将斯瓦希里语检索从22.1%提升至69.1%（另一编码器上可复现），三个对照排除池化位置同义重复和英文特异性。训练时前端主干模块在XM3600上低资源语言检索+9.6/+17.1pp，在另外三个基准上一致提升，且不损害高资源语言性能。

Conclusion: 低资源语言检索差距的因果因素不在输出端的线性语言方向，而在编码器前向路径中EOS隐藏状态随深度的逐语言分叉。这一发现既纠正了先前模态间隙/跨语言子空间文献的核心假设，也指出了可操作的修复点：在投影器之前的早期层进行干预（推理时替换或训练时前端对齐）能显著恢复低资源语言性能。

Abstract: Recent multilingual vision--language encoders cover hundreds of languages in a single model, yet on two state-of-the-art instances retrieval on low-resource languages (LRL; e.g. Swahili) trails high-resource ones (HRL; e.g. English) by $30^+$\,pp. We ask where in the trained encoder this gap is located. Prior modality-gap and cross-lingual subspace work suggests a linear language direction at the output crowds out alignment-relevant geometry.
